notes.title: DD#232 The 21st Anniversary, but It’s in Memory of My Legendary Mother.
notes.notes:
This week, it was supposed to be the 21st anniversary of the game.
But my life and the direction of the game's update took a dramatic turn on the morning of July 2nd, 2025. My mother quietly passed away during her sleep, just like she went gently into that good night.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/00878e5eb44a38d9f2b392932f04500246ec4eee.jpg[/img]
You may wonder who she was other than being my mother?
I'd like to take this chance to go over her legendary life.

In the early 1960s, there was a fanatic high-ranking officer in China. Loyal to the idea of Communism, dreaming of building a utopia of equality without corruption, he named his son "Red Army"(红军) and his daughter "Red Guard"（红卫）. He strictly raised both of them with army-like discipline. But, deep down, he always has a preference for his son over his daughter, as it's something deep down in traditional Chinese culture. Even if the daughter tried so hard to prove herself, winning second place in a math competition, getting enrolled in the best high school in the district, and earning two bachelor's degrees in Computer Science and Accounting, rather than just one. She could just be a "Red Princess" and enjoy her life. But she refused to be anyone less than she could be. Yet, his father never recognized her achievements, just because she was his daughter, not his son.

In the end, the "Red Princess" rebelled. If his father could not treat his son and his daughter equally, how could he always lead the country to a utopia of equality? She married the boy who got first place in that math competition. That boy comes from an ex-landlord's bloodline, which is considered very bad in communist China. But she still chose to fall in love with him. Such a tale can equal the great works like Romeo and Juliet, for the Red Army and the Landlords were enemies in the class struggle. Facing all the difficulties, she managed to achieve a happy ending and made it a fairy tale instead of a tragic love story. Her father reluctantly conceded her freedom of marriage back to her.

Furthermore, she refused her father's help to find her an easy job within the party. She even refused to join the Communist Party which really pissed her father. She went on her own way and became a college teacher, concealing her status as a "Red Princess."

All Chinese Communist Party members must take an oath to serve the people with their full hearts
The high-ranking officer, my grandpa, stayed true to this oath as he truly believed in it. He taught his son and all his subordinates to be incorruptible so that they could build this dream one day.
However, many other people consider joining the party as a means to further their own interests, and forget the oath the moment they take it.
My mother is an honest person. She taught me the important quality of keeping oaths and promises. Thus, you can see this game has been updated for 21 years. But, after all that she had experienced, she decided, instead of serving an ideology, to serve her own idea, her family, her students, her college, and the things she truly believed in.  Thus, she never joined the party even when all her fellow teachers in that college joined. In the end, she was never a communist. 

She continued to be one of the best teachers in her college. She could teach both programming and accounting, becoming a heroine among her peers. 

Yet, the cosmos taught it's too easy for her to be like a Mary Sue in her story. Thus, a tragedy happened. She was diagnosed with Uremia in 2004; neither of her kidneys can function anymore. Many thought she might finally give up. She didn't. A year later, after undergoing a kidney transplant surgery, she was back in the game once again!

Since then, she needed to take a lot of medicine every day, enduring side effects such as high pressure and diabetes. Yet, she always accomplishes her teaching tasks and gets more done. Deeply respected by her colleagues, she was voted to receive the honorary title of "Shanghai Adult Education Outstanding Teacher" in 2013. 

What makes things more legendary is that she raised me when all that happened. Her approach to education can be very unconventional, just like she was a rebel red princess. She was never a politically correct person.
Lesson No. 1 BE RICH! 
To be rich, you will study really hard. Put great effort into achieving that.
Only when you are rich can you seek a great spiritual journey to find out what is really important in your life other than money. By being rich, you can also always find the strength to stand up even when a cruel world wants to press your head and make you kneel down. By being rich, you can have the dignity to say no to whatever you think is wrong. By being rich, you can be kind and donate your wealth to those in need. By being rich, you can have the power to change the world for the better!
Being rich is the foundation for being kind and civil, for you will never need to commit crimes or morally questionable things just to survive.
Thus, after being rich and securing your position in this world, the following lessons come naturally. To be kind, to be loyal, and to be spiritual. 

Today, I honor her with my stock market profit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f68ddb5df50954056605f84625ff5f54358cc141.jpg[/img]
She said she was proud of me for this.
Actually, she was proud of me for a lot of things. She always encourages me. 
She was proud of me for being the developer of the longest-living RPG in China.
She was proud of me for solving a law case.
She was proud of me for taking care of her during COVID-19.
She was proud of me for moving back to China from the US so that she could see me every day.
She was proud of me for basically everything I did.
So, I have become who I am today.
I am a stock market investor.
I am a lawyer.
I am a developer of this game.

So, I am doing what a game developer does.
Just like how I brought Murin back.
I shall bring my mother back in the same form.
I have the technology. I have the game. And one day, maybe I can even have an AI powerful enough to emulate all those I have lost in my life.
Thus,
I created a game character in her memory.
I want her to say she is proud of me more.
I want her to teach more.
I want her to remind me of things that I often ignore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/fcf50f43f17282e6598efc21d17a72a2f97dd5f7.jpg[/img]
She was never a beautiful woman, as she spent her life making her points instead of looking good. She was my mother who always cared for me.
This character of hers will remind me of those things, as all her dialogues were based on the messages she once sent to me. 

But, deep down, I know that's not her. Just another memento, just like this game is about memory, yet I can never relive all those memories, just like I may only truly see her again once I, myself, go to the other side.

Goodbye, Red Princess.
Goodbye, Juliet, with a good ending.
Goodbye, Mary Sue of her fantasy.
Goodbye, Outstanding Teacher.
Goodbye, Queen of her own fate.
Goodbye, Mother.
See you on the other side, one day.

Knowing she will be waiting out there just like she used to pick me up after school when I was a child, brings me courage.

Her life was a testament, and she loyally adhered to it to the end.
Such a testament and such loyalty brought her great respect.
Today, at her funeral, representatives of her students attended.
Today, at her funeral, representatives of her college attended.
Today, at her funeral, representatives of her classmates attended.
She was well loved...
...even among those who hated her defiance. 
Today, at her funeral, representatives of the Army attended.
Today, at her funeral, representatives from the police force attended.
Today, at her funeral, representatives from the National Security attended.
Today, at her funeral, representatives from various government departments and the party attended.

This is the 21st anniversary, and this is a diary about her life.
From now on, every anniversary of this game will also be her death anniversary.
The cosmos certainly has a dark sense of humor.
Life is simply unfair.
But we shall fight on.
Loyalty to the end!


There are, of course, some other updates this week. But compared to her, they are not so important. Such things are:
The store page of the next DLC is live:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2611830/NeolithicBeyond_the_End
You can now burn ghost money for your loved ones on the other side to honor their memories.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/7f5e261d9ae5576aae8e62ae3534f9c2d0c23c87.jpg[/img]
The story on the Jiru Island continued a bit before my mother passed away.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/1e7601ad3599228ed15426539fe6bf1077d09e2f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/42c7878be2d36dff6aac539b8e6501128a2e5cc3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/e20d9d3374c42e8ba0848a8244da7b697806ac46.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/e330a0093db2e2fddc7451b29e4563d607ef9326.jpg[/img]

So, here we are, at the end of this diary.
Tomorrow is a hope, never a promise. I may take a break after this diary.
But for as long as I stand, I shall stay loyal to what I believe in.
Loyalty to the end!
That's her legacy.

notes.title: DD#231 Inquisition Activities & The Return of a Legend
notes.notes: [p]Hi, everyone. Welcome to this week's developer's diary.[/p][p][/p][p]The next Friday will be the 21st Anniversary. Even though the DLC may not be released just yet, its store page will likely be available. It's currently just pending Valve's review.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/cb3f9628eaffc5ed40e1b0958277a76c7a7f0fc3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The reason to make it a free DLC instead of a part of the game is that it's going to be huge compared to the main game. It's currently about 5GB and growing as it's developed with Unreal, while the main game is based on a heavily modified ancient RMXP, which will never get that big. Thus, the DLC will be totally optional; people who don't want to play that part of the story will not need to download it at all.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, let's go back to this week's main game updates.[/p][p]As mentioned last week, this week's focus is on the Inquisition Activities in Fjordr.[/p][p][/p][p]Nobody expected the inquisition would actually inquisit people. And that's what you are going to do.[/p][p]After making contact with Dana, you can now receive your second quest from Erysea.[/p][p]She will ask you to identify some soldiers with bad behavior problems so that she can just send them to do some suicide missions to achieve the goal of purging the ranks of the military.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/af46bf51a2ceb48b66add2824e22b4f5001d250d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]How to make people talk?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/363a13043624bfd1d4ec74b09e0cbc95e5a9b3b0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Use whatever method you see fit. :D[/p][p][/p][p]Now, what kind of behavior is considered misbehavior?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/e133bdb1112f28a30dbe102bdc5748526f2f34b8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Well, that's kind of arbitrary, just like the quest name "Mission: Improbable" implied. This is a totally messed-up, light-hearted mission.[/p][p]Actually, you don't even need to bother to "inquisition" people. You can just write off some random unfortunate soldiers you meet. But that may damage your relationship with the Federation army and the Inquisitor, as each soldier will be reviewed and given a misfit score. If you get the right soldier to send them to die, you will get more rewards. Otherwise, people will doubt your credibility, which is bad.[/p][p][/p][p]Once you finish this part, it will become a repeatable mission. You can keep going on an "inquisition" on people more and send more people to die if you wish. It also provides a reliable method for farming Inquisition Seals.[/p][p][/p][p]But that's not all of them yet.[/p][p]Next, you will get a more serious quest, that is to retrieve the nanobot sample from the hospital's underground research facility. It has been a containment breach for months in real life, as that part has already been done many weeks ago. Now, the stories just link up.[/p][p]However, this time, to reward you for your help in the inquisition, you will get an Inquisition Authorization to prove you are an agent of the Inquisition. Those lowly soldiers and guards will no longer bother you and even obey your orders if you show them that. It also has some other usages. Feel free to play around and discover.[/p][p][/p][p]Now that we're back in the hospital, we also have some new content here.[/p][p]There is only one nanobot sample before the entire lab collapses. It's really precious. You may not want to give it to the Inquisitor. You may want to keep it to yourself or maybe sell it to someone else. The good news is, you are not the only one who has this idea. Things just get a bit more interesting here. You may find someone tries to make a fake sample, commit treason, and sell the real sample to a foreign power. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/905cef302bd94712d891cab6f66bb883236e1f66.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Oh, yes, maybe it's the moon. We never know. Comrade Lavrentiy Pavlovich Beria :D[/p][p]But, in the game, this by itself is another tiny story about a man's hatred that grows so uncontainable that all he wanted was to leave this facility behind and start his new life elsewhere. A rebel against things he considered unfair to him.[/p][p]Anyway, you know how to take advantage of the situation.[/p][p]You can make fake samples and try to fool the inquisition before they can figure out what's going on.[/p][p][/p][p]By retrieving the sample, it is the conclusion of the third part of the quest.[/p][p]It's still not the end game of this week's update yet![/p][p]It's time to let the Colonel return![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/85a3e0ad2a94fa0318daedb9bb6088f1cb068d34.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Players from the SAPC++ era may recognize him.[/p][p]Raerson was a newbie police officer turned top agent of the Federation who successfully carried out various operations involving the supernatural.[/p][p]Just name a few, some of these operations are:[/p][p]1, Solving a zombie outbreak in a mining town more than 12 years ago.[/p][p](The ARPG Zombie Mini Game in SAPC++)[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SxSCQQT9yo4"][/dynamiclink]Hey, check the timestep of the video. It was uploaded to YouTube 12 years ago. Everything I told you is true. :D[/p][p]2, Defeat a revived Nobunaga Oda in Japan.[/p][p]3. Murdered some player characters who decided to become enemies of the Federation in some other timelines. [/p][p][/p][p]Yes, those are great old times. We are so back![/p][p]Now he has been promoted to Colonel and is in charge of this operation to liberate Jiru Island from those machines.[/p][p]However, during his conversation with his retinue, you can also find more information about other characters, such as Tanya.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/dc1ffcc49aa948c74c34a38721b9b7a133fb3d37.jpg"][/img]As a veteran who experienced so much in this supernatural war, you will also find his personality much darker than it was a decade ago.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/20a63836e24e1252b73a243b95e4179bb01019e9.jpg"][/img]Heroes? There is no such thing in this world.[/p][p]He is also a member of the secret organization that controls the Federation from the shadows (You can find more about this organization in the Dark Elf King's storyline.)  Unlike others, he does not even try to hide this fact.[/p][p]Because, who knows, maybe we are all going to suddenly die tomorrow just because some unspeakable eldritch beings that may not even notice the entire planet Earth suddenly wake up. Such is the realization of how little humanity really is in this cosmos. And you don't want to take all your memory, all your secrets to your grave. [/p][p][/p][p]He comes with a powerful weapon. (Not his very unique Background Music known as "The Black Knight.")[/p][p]He will give you a device that can reprogram those machines and hopefully turn the tide of the war.[/p][p]And there is the end of this week's story.[/p][p]At the end of the current storyline, you can turn those machine skeletons into your pets![/p][p]Instead of using binding skills, you will need to pass a programming check, as the skill granted by the weapon falls into the "quick hack" category.[/p][p]It's time for your software engineer teammates to shine. :D[/p][p][/p][p]I hope you enjoy the adventure of this week.[/p][p]The next week, my main focus will be on the 21st anniversary, and hopefully, Valve will finish their store page review soon.[/p][p][/p][p]The full update log of this week:[/p][p]20250621[/p][p]English[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]\[Fjordr]Random soldiers may have random traits.[/p][p]\[Fjordr]You can use various speech skills to let them tell you about their traits. notes.title: DD#230 Have You Said Thank You Once?
notes.notes:
[p]Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.
Unfortunately, the daily update got interrupted for a few days as I was working on a lawsuit in Qingdao (an ex-German enclave before WW1, famous for its beer. :P )
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/bcacf9007288a9e158d764e0397ee5f16011fc0b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]So, this week's development was focusing on some relatively minor features, and the colonel's story will need to wait another week to appear.[/p][p][/p][p]In more naive games, heroes do things to save the world, solve people's problems without asking for too many rewards, as if that's their job. They are meant to do all that dirty work given by Preston Garvey, just because he calls you "General" in Fallout 4, or even when you have built up an entire town, paid all the debt, made all the decorations, you still meet someone like Tom Nook as if you owe him in Animal Crossing. Fuck those people, they have not even said thank you for once. :D[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/be2b26d696589dce2b6373ad79b050c3ee7c7bc1.jpg"][/img]It's human nature to desire recognition, which is on the third and fourth levels of Maslow's pyramid.[/p][p][/p][p]OK, let's fix this problem, even just for a bit. [/p][p]Even just for the sake of JD Vance.[/p][p]Well, you know, I do still have a disagreement with him on Ukraine. But his performance on Bluesky this week earned him some well-deserved respect from me. :D[/p][p][/p][p]Joke aside, let's talk about how that reflects in the game.[/p][p]Now, random citizens or soldiers in the two major towns on Jiru Island will be more appreciative of YOU, yes, you, for all the hard work you have done for them.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/c7dff19043c6af6181111ce369a9dd122726c13c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]They shall thank you for fixing the leaks in their heating system.[/p][p]They shall thank you for bringing in all the construction materials to reinforce their defenses.[/p][p]They shall thank you for eliminating a dangerous cult lurking in their town.[/p][p]They shall thank you for exposing a conspiracy of another secret organization.[/p][p]You have done all those things and much more for them. And, they shall remember your deeds.[/p][p]They will give you random small gifts.[/p][p]The chance of triggering such events is based on what you have done to them and your relationship with them.[/p][p][/p][p]Oh, talking about relationships, I have also added their relationship values that shall now display in the menu so that you can check them directly.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/fd5a00a9557008e14b2052462755a094ff1ed892.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9a67b83d7659e5b36f713559e65204b5d3a23af6.jpg"][/img]The relationship bar's color is also now more unified.[/p][p]It's now always red = negative and green = positive.[/p][p]It's currently only an experiment on Jiru Island. If nothing explodes and everything works as planned, then you may see the system get added to other towns in the game as well, so that you know the world appreciates your contribution.[/p][p]After all, why play heroes if you are unappreciated and if no good deeds go unpunished? (Unfortunately, that's real life. So, I'd still encourage you to be more pragmatic in real life, even if that means being villains in some other people's story.)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]That's one thing taken care of.[/p][p]Now, how about some food?[/p][p]It's starting to get hot in the northern half of this planet. Although modern technology has brought us air conditioners that we can turn on every day to escape the high temperature while ignoring that Hamas-loving Thunberg shouting, "How dare you?" from a distant land, traditionally, people eat certain foods to counter the negative effects caused by hot weather.[/p][p]I am not talking about ice cream.[/p][p]I am talking about curry.[/p][p]Hot climates can often suppress appetite, but curry’s spiciness and rich aroma stimulate the taste buds and help increase appetite. Meanwhile, spices in curry, such as turmeric and chili, have antibacterial and preservative properties. In tropical regions—where high heat and humidity cause food to spoil quickly—these characteristics help extend the shelf life of food. Plus, curry is delicious and can be combined with almost everything.[/p][p]It's no longer just something limited to India, Thailand, or various Muslim nations in Southeast Asia. People all over the world now eat curry. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/ff545d04b5608e4d3a965f04801e23b48f181629.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In the game, Curry is somehow like an "addition" to other dishes. (You can add them to almost everything in the game.)[/p][p]It works like this:[/p][p]1, It amplifies the MP recovery of food by 10% as food becomes more appetizing.[/p][p]2, If such MP recovery rate is lower than Curry's MP recovery rate. It will be updated to Curry's MP recovery rate. Because Curry, by itself, also has recovery effects. (Scientifically speaking, it contains turmeric, which is known for its potential wound-healing properties.)[/p][p]3, All food that is cooked with curry will turn brown. This is just a cosmetic effect as we can procedurally generate food icons. :D[/p][p][/p][p]As you know, I enjoy cooking all by myself when I am not too busy. Thus, here is a photo of a curry dish I made. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d755e4428341a09974cee45744524b89401d454a.jpg"][/img][b]"Discovery requires experimentation." --- Daniel Whitehall[/b][/p][p]I always enjoy experimenting with new recipes, and the game will always evolve because of such an ambition to gain more knowledge. :D[/p][p][/p][p]Some other small changes include: a lot more shade creatures have been added to "The Guide to Monster Hunting," and Jiru Island's map has been expanded to the Asmaru Mine.[/p][p][/p][p]That's for this week. Next week, we shall get more content about the inquisition activity in Fjordr and finally bring the colonel to appear in the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Full update log of this week:[/p][p]20250614[/p][p]English[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]\[Guide to Monster Hunting]Added the entry for Shade-Tainted Babies.[/p][p]\[Guide to Monster Hunting]Added the entry for Shade-Tainted Agents.[/p][p]\[Guide to Monster Hunting]Added the entry for Shade-Tainted Researchers.[/p][p]\[Guide to Monster Hunting]Added the entry for Shade-Tainted Gangsters.[/p][p]\[Guide to Monster Hunting]Added the entry for Shade-Tainted Slaves.[/p][p]简体中文[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]【怪物狩猎指南】加入了被暗影侵蚀的婴儿的条目。[/p][p]【怪物狩猎指南】加入了被暗影侵蚀的特工的条目。[/p][p]【怪物狩猎指南】加入了被暗影侵蚀的研究员的条目。[/p][p]【怪物狩猎指南】加入了被暗影侵蚀的帮派成员的条目。[/p][p]【怪物狩猎指南】加入了被暗影侵蚀的奴隶的条目。[/p][p]20250617[/p][p]English[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]\[Jiru Island]New Location: Asmaru Mine 1F[/p][p]\[Fix the Leaks]The game now tracks how many times you have finished this repeatable quest.[/p][p]\[Relationship]Dana survivors now have their own relationship value with you. notes.title: DD#229 The Horrors in the Tunnels
notes.notes:
[p]Hi, everyone. Welcome to another great week.
[/p][p]Many amazing things have happened this week.[/p][p]Such as:[/p][p]1, Stellar Blade was released, and everyone loves it. Even many people who do not usually play action games still purchase it as it has become a symbol of anti-DEI and anti-Woke. You can find it in the reviews. It's a good thing for this whole industry. It's clear what kind of games people really like.[/p][p][/p][p]2. My investments in all those good games or game-related companies continue to grow, providing more development funds for the game. As it has often been said, go woke, go broke. The other way is also accurate. Be on the right side of history, be rich![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/539c44a13455ab28525cb1355bf83fcbad02b71c.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]3. The events happening in this world continue to align with what I have envisioned. I am not going to tell you more details on this right now, but maybe they will be part of the game's story in the future. Everything is awesome![/p][p][/p][p]Now, let's go down to this week's content updates.[/p][p]Unfortunately, the colonel will need to wait a bit before officially appearing in the game.[/p][p]Because, I am working on the tunnels underneath the Dana Shelter this week.[/p][p]It would be quite boring if they were just some old tunnels.[/p][p]Thus, let's do some rule-based horror here instead.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/1367186d2f5299dfebc4d1c7dc1035661cad6f64.jpg"][/img][/p][p]That means many different mechanisms and anomalies are down here in those tunnels.[/p][p]Here are some examples:[/p][p][/p][p]It will get colder if you stay in the tunnel for too long.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a624910b5095ca09e4ce911af6d3eee956b16dea.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You may hear some babies crying. But it may not be a good idea to investigate further.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/e8ac1e66d5ecccdf9a86e200aef62ad422dffa23.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/7ccf049102abae322615ff204391b9440606fab8.gif"][/img][/p][p]Those are new shade entities. They can emit "horrible baby cry," which is a new skill such entities have.[/p][p]You can try to avoid them if you don't want to shoot them even after they have turned.[/p][p]You can also use their cry as an alarm that indicates they are nearby.[/p][p]They also appear in random locations with a shade entity theme if you travel with the Wonderland Travel Agency.[/p][p][/p][p]Many of those anomalies may have more reasonable explanations, especially if you have read some Foundation files.[/p][p]However, there is always something you cannot reason with.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/87c245af51d61245a0c48c2fc682cfd520cab40a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]It's better to explore this location on your own to experience all the horrors.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]But why do people still go down there?[/p][p]Well, that's because the shelter's heating system is broken. Periodically, people need to go down there to do maintenance work to patch up gas leaks.[/p][p]Thus, you will receive new repeatable quests.[/p][p]Given the horrors that lurk down there, a complete repair of those tunnels is unrealistic at this moment. Thus, the old duct tape solution is the only way to keep things going in this shelter. Yes, those mighty duct tapes are now officially items you can get in the game. When you accept those maintenance quests, you will receive 5. Many enemies now also drop duct tape. Some vendors also sell duct tape. There is even crafting blueprints for duct tape. You can get that by looting certain enemies, or there is a copy in the heating room.[/p][p]The quest reflects another layer of the struggle of those survivors.[/p][p]To many, life is a battlefield. Every day, many endure hardships in their story, just like those survivors must keep going down those tunnels to patch broken pipes.[/p][p]But don't forget to celebrate each time you achieve a victory![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9726ffdf3d88186ea88be55159b021aaa9a48bc1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]"One must imagine Sisyphus happy" --- Camus[/p][p][/p][p]That covers most of this week's main game's content updates.[/p][p]But I shall also give you something for the upcoming DLC:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="h5p3L6NF_aQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Backup link for people who have no YouTube access: [url="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1WnMTzhEq3/"]https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1WnMTzhEq3/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Changing outfits is not enough.[/p][p]We shall now also have slides![/p][p]Especially, those "booby slides" that people love so much![/p][p]As I said two weeks ago in DD#227[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1519140/view/507330049932789667"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Many of us, Asian game developers, were deceived by some DEI people who told us Western players do not like such things.  In truth, we all love this. This is universal. The success of Stellar Blade is also proof of this. Thus, we shall have this at least in the next DLC of this game. [/p][p][/p][p]OK, before I end this week's developer's diary.[/p][p]One more thing, as mentioned previously, I have some of my duties as a lawyer to work on a law case in Qingdao a few days later. During this period of time, I will be away from my development machines. Thus, there will be no updates on June 15th (confirmed), June 16th (very likely), and June 17th (likely)[/p][p]There will be no main game updates, DLC progress, or daily news of the Ukrainian front.[/p][p]Everything shall return to normal no later than the 18th if everything goes according to plan.[/p][p]This is the first step of a multi-stage lawsuit.  Another trip later is also very likely, but there is no confirmed date for that part right now.[/p][p]Just like the stock market funds the game, the lawyer's job also provides certain privileges. But, unfortunately, sometimes, they interrupt the game update schedules. A price to pay to stay in power.[/p][p][/p][p]Alright, that's all. Thank you for reading. Have a nice day! :D[/p][p][/p][p]The full update log of this week:[/p][p]20250607[/p][p]English[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]\[Dana Shelter Underground Level 1]Map Expanded[/p][p]\[Dana Shelter Underground Level 1]This area now uses the flashlight effect and it's darker.[/p][p]\[Dana Shelter Underground Level 1]This area now have some rats randomly appear.[/p][p]\[Dana Shelter Underground Level 1]Under certain conditions, shade creatures may also appear in this area.[/p][p]\[Dana Shelter Underground Level 1]Changed the background music in this area.[/p][p]简体中文[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]【达那避难所地下一层】地图扩展[/p][p]【达那避难所地下一层】加入了手电筒效果。[/p][p]【达那避难所地下一层】老鼠会在这个区域出现。[/p][p]【达那避难所地下一层】在特定情况下，这里也会出现暗影生物。[/p][p]【达那避难所地下一层】改变了这个区域的背景音乐。[/p][p]20250608[/p][p]English[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]\[Dana Shelter Underground Level 1]Added a new document near the entrance of this area.[/p][p]\[Dana Shelter Underground Level 1]Implemented Rule 1. (There can be 2 or 3 such entities on this floor.)[/p][p]\[Dana Shelter Underground Level 1]Implemented Rule 2. (The exact time for it to happen is 4 to 7 minutes after you enter the tunnels.)[/p][p]简体中文[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]【达那避难所地下一层】在入口附近加入了一篇新的文档。[/p][p]【达那避难所地下一层】加入了第一条规则的机制。（这一层会出现2到3个这样的实体。）[/p][p]【达那避难所地下一层】加入了第二条规则的机制。（触发时间是在进入通道后的4到7分钟后。）[/p][p]20250609[/p][p]English[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]\[Dana Shelter Underground Level 1]Implemented Rule 6. (33% chance to trigger when you interact with rats.) [/p][p]\[Wiki]Updated the location page.[/p][p]\[Item]New Item: Duct Tape (You can recycle adhesive from it. It can stop bleeding if you have no other options.)[/p][p]\[Shopping]Random general goods vendors now sell Duct Tape.[/p][p]\[Shopping]The 3D Printing Store in Liu now sells Duct Tapes. (Price extremely high.)[/p][p]\[Shopping]Bob's Grocery now sells Duct Tapes. notes.title: DD#228 The World Is Merely a Troupe Performing on a Shabby, Makeshift Stage.
notes.notes:
[p]Hi, everyone. Welcome to the first developer's diary of June.[/p][p]Even though it's just the first week of the month, we have seen quite a lot of madness going on.[/p][p]This week's story is about what this world really is, both in the game and in our reality.[/p][p][/p][p]You may already know, "All the world's a stage, And all the MEN and WOMEN merely players." That's what William Shakespeare said. In truth, that's not even a professional stage. It's a shabby, makeshift stage performed by a troupe.[/p][p][/p][p]Have you ever felt that you could do better if you were the one in charge, the one making decisions, or the one ruling your nation? Well, you can just be right because I have seen how this world is right there. I have seen developers in a big game company less skillful than college students working on their hobby projects. I have seen professional fund managers make far less profit than I do in the stock market. I do not have a law school diploma, but I passed all the exams and got myself a lawyer's license all by self-education, while many law school students are still struggling. I have seen those so-called experts making predictions on TV on world geopolitical matters different than me, and they are almost always wrong. [/p][p]The story's moral is that the world is a troupe performing on a shabby, makeshift stage that is far less fancy than it may look from the outside. Did Donald Trump and Elon Musk have previous experiences as politicians? No, but they came in and were successful to a certain degree. Some would say their recent argument is like kids, lacking professionalism. However, truly powerful people do not need to pretend to be someone they are not. They can be their true selves. That's the path of freedom and self-realization. That's the path of Übermensch, the path to be your most authentic self. They have their own ideas that they believe in and fight for. They are not those so-called professional politicians who will vote without even reading the bills. And through such actions, they also break the illusion and demonstrate what the world really is. The world is a shabby, makeshift stage performed by a troupe.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, what's that all about in our game?[/p][p]This week, we are exploring the side of the story of the Nise Federation's military activities in Fjordr.[/p][p]Compared to the survivors in Dana, under siege, cut off from the rest of the Federation, those guys are in a much better position in this war with machines.[/p][p]They also have a good cast of commanding officers, at least at first glance. [/p][p]They have a veteran field officer with big muscles.[/p][p]They have an inquisitor from the mainland to maintain their morals and purge heresy in their ranks.[/p][p]But they get stuck in a trench crusade (No pun intended.  :P) even when they are facing far less elite enemies.[/p][p]In this week's story, mainly the first part of the quest "Mission: Improbable," you will discover why.[/p][p]The quest has a silly name, and it has some silly content. And, you can find out why things are going so  inefficiently down there. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/1fb39d36007ed34fa3c159eaa7cb2d1c3dbbaec7.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f789c90afa8a870dd1b866cefa32238a64e46406.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/82a366599386ff5ac62c757f6f265bdc29cc65e8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Oh, yes, Raerson will be back in the story. And he has been promoted to the rank of colonel.[/p][p]People from the era of SAPC++ may know more about his background story. Basically, he is our Leon Kennedy turned Fox Mulder turned Albert Wesker with some powers similar to Roy Mustang[b].[/b] It has been quite a wild run before. And we are going to let such madness and silliness continue. Here is his new appearance:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f75d7dd21120de8d3c8c65e3bbb14ac6ef987173.gif"][/img][/p][p]We will very likely have more content about him next week when he actually returns to the base. :D[/p][p][/p][p]As the story progresses, you can build up your relationship with the Inquisition for the first time. Your reward will be in a new type of currency known as the Inquisition Seals. As such, we now also have a new inquisition merchant you can find in Samujier's Cathedral. You can use those seals to exchange for all kinds of items.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/5e41707c7218b94ac9e366eec4f9f3c4246bd1cb.jpg"][/img]However, even different inquisitors may have different views on matters.[/p][p]For example, some believe Samujier is actually Jesus, just in different parallel universes and timelines, and others think this is heresy.[/p][p]After all, the world is a shabby, makeshift stage performed by a troupe. :)[/p][p][/p][p]That's all the mess from the reinforcement side.[/p][p][/p][p]We also got more content for those survivors in Dana.[/p][p]The shelter now has two floors. You can travel between them via the elevator.[/p][p]The chaplain now also hangs Holy Images on the wall to inspire his fellow soldiers.[/p][p]You can now use Butterfly Wings to teleport out of the shelter, no matter which part of the shelter you are currently in.[/p][p][/p][p]And that's for this week. The world is a shabby, makeshift stage performed by a troupe. Society is designed this way to ensure that most people are in their places, feeling a lack of power to change things. It's easy to control this way. But those who want to take power. It is not as hard as it looks. You can be the one to take power, too. :)[/p][p][/p][p]The full update log of this week:[/p][p]20250531[/p][p]English[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]\[Dana Shelter]Filled another cabinet with loot. (Environmental narrative. It's natural for people to do such things in a highly stressful environment.)[/p][p]\[Furniture]New Furniture: Holy Image of Samujier. (Samujier's followers can pray to it just like other holy items of this religion.)[/p][p]\[Samujier]The Cathedral now sells all kinds of Samujier-related religious items, from images to statues.[/p][p]\[Dana Shelter]Added a Holy Image of Samujier behind the priest.[/p][p]简体中文[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]【达那避难所】在一个柜子里加入了一些可以搜刮的物品。（环境叙事。在一个高压的环境下有人会做这种事情是很正常的。）[/p][p]【家具】新家具：萨姆吉尔圣像（萨姆吉尔的信徒可以对其祈祷，和别的这个宗教的圣物一样。）[/p][p]【萨姆吉尔】大教堂现在会贩卖从圣像到雕像等各种和萨姆吉尔有关的宗教物品。[/p][p]【达那避难所】在牧师身后加入了一个萨姆吉尔圣像[/p][p]20250601[/p][p]English[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]\[Illuminati]The doctor's speech about masks in Queensmouth Airport now has voiceovers.[/p][p]\[Dana Shelter]Added some dialogues for the priest. (He judges people's gender based on appearance only.)[/p][p]\[Dana Shelter]Added loot in the small chapel. Mostly just some holy items and religious books.[/p][p]简体中文[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]【光照派】王后镇机场中某个医生关于面具的讲话现在有了配音。[/p][p]【达那避难所】为牧师加入了一些对话台词。（他判断主角的性别完全基于外观。）[/p][p]【达那避难所】在小教堂中加入可以搜刮的物品。主要是一些圣物和宗教书籍。[/p][p]20250602[/p][p]English[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]\[Character Customization]Added a new male character appearance. (It will be used for another important returning character from the SAPC++ era.)[/p][p]\[Fjordr Command Center]Lieutenant Armstrong now has some dialogs instead of being marked as "to be continued."[/p][p]简体中文[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]【角色自定义】增加了一个新的男性角色造型。（会用于一个从SAPC++时代回归的角色。）[/p][p]【福尔德指挥部】阿姆斯壮中尉现在有了一些台词而非被继续标记为【施工中】[/p][p]20250603[/p][p]English[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]\[Quest]New Quest: Mission: Improbable[/p][p]\[Fjordr Command Center]Added dialogs for Erysea[/p][p]\[Wiki]Updated the quest page and added a new page for Mission: Improbable[/p][p]简体中文[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]【任务】新任务：行动代号：不靠谱[/p][p]【福尔德指挥部】为哀瑞希加入了对白。[/p][p]【维基】更新了任务页面，加入了【行动代号：不靠谱】的页面。[/p][p]20250604[/p][p]English[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]\[Mission: Improbable]The story continues.[/p][p]\[Fjordr Command Center]Armstrong's dialogue will change after you finish the first part.[/p][p]\[Item]New Item: Inquisition Seal[/p][p]\[Wiki]Updated the Mission: Improbable page.[/p][p]简体中文[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]【行动代号：不靠谱】剧情继续[/p][p]【福尔德指挥部】阿姆斯壮的台词会在你完成第一部分之后变化。[/p][p]【物品】新物品：审判庭印章[/p][p]【维基】更新了【行动代号：不靠谱】的页面。[/p][p]20250605[/p][p]English[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]\[Item]You can now carry 9999 Inquisition Seals. (Previously, the item limit was 999.)[/p][p]\[Samujier Cathedral]Added a merchant that allows you to exchange Inquisition Seals for various items.[/p][p]简体中文[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]【物品】你现在可以携带9999个审判庭印章（此前是999个）[/p][p]【萨姆吉尔大教堂】加入了一个审判庭商人允许你用印章兑换各种物品。[/p][p]20250606[/p][p]English[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]\[Fjordr Command Center]Added non-quest-related dialogs for Erysea.[/p][p]\[Samujier Cathedral]You can now exchange seals for "Text From a Holy Book" with the Inquisition merchant.[/p][p]\[Samujier Cathedral]You can now exchange seals for "Holy Image of Samujier" with the Inquisition merchant.[/p][p]\[Samujier Cathedral]You can now exchange seals for "Samujier Statue" with the Inquisition merchant.[/p][p]\[Butterfly]You can now use Butterfly Wings to teleport out of the Dana Shelter.[/p][p]\[Dana Shelter]New Map: Dana Shelter Underground Level 1 (You can get there via the elevator. It's still early WIP.)[/p][p]简体中文[/p][p]##########Content################[/p][p]【福尔德指挥部】为哀瑞希加入了一些和任务无关的对白。[/p][p]【萨姆吉尔大教堂】你现在可以找审判庭商人兑换神圣书籍上的文字。[/p][p]【萨姆吉尔大教堂】你现在可以找审判庭商人兑换萨姆吉尔圣像。[/p][p]【萨姆吉尔大教堂】你现在可以找审判庭商人兑换萨姆吉尔雕像。[/p][p]【蝴蝶之翼】你现在可以用蝴蝶之翼传送出达那避难所。[/p][p]【达那避难所】新地图：达那避难所地下一层 （你可以通过电梯抵达那里。依然在早期施工阶段。）[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Latest news from Ukraine/乌克兰小剧场[/p][p][url="https://controlc.com/8ce31266"]https://controlc.com/8ce31266[/url][/p][p]

notes.title: DD# 227 The Return of Draconians
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's exciting developer's diary!

First, I have some great news for everyone. 
All the Gen-1 Draconians are now in the game!

Lizenorton of the Earth
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/743a4c6cce0d47b5977bdbe9f3a7c8acf7b87722.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/424be030c7d3e69c5a1c1075ad730f03e8bf44c1.gif[/img]

Yanchilos of the Water
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/dddfeb9898b7ebc0f6adc8fc9451e1b648f73cd8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/c2b845df13ab03c68d585a1c915852b1d55ba4c6.gif[/img]

Bonchino of the Fire
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d28ecd59d61df5f92e372370de8e79b216bb4420.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/edfac89c9d658f471fd786908ee24efe113b5e3e.gif[/img]

Bruton of the Wind
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a93a9b6cdbadd711862aec123b487fc36f4ed59e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/0d41dcca6c29cbf4b4079c7b620352f9ce59b8ae.gif[/img]

And the most special, the elemental-neutral Bumpoulos
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/6549b976ede84e7bdad2487d1318cfe6910dcc63.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/24c1858a190102934a5ca239aab8145c5ac3cc81.gif[/img]

Long ago, before the refugees from Bora reached the Nise Islands, even before the time the local Doloweyans grew into a tribe, five Draconian brothers had led their tribes, stood on Jiru Island guarding its secrets. Rumors have it that even to this day, they are still performing the Great Plan left to them by the Creator God.
Yet, times have changed, and they saw humans slowly take over the island. They decided to avoid confrontation, retreating to guard only the most sacred locations. As our journey on Jiru Island goes further, you are more and more likely to confront them. As eras have passed, the descendants of the five brothers may no longer possess their ancient wisdom. But they are still formidable in combat. Should you have strong binding spells, you may turn them into your services.
They are all cultural symbols and the legacy of the ancient Stone Age.
Once again, I am paying my respect to our lineage and the good old days of gaming.

Stars lose their brightness,
Idols fall,
Websites and forums shut down,
NEOLITHIA is forever.
The 21st anniversary is almost upon us!

You know what I am working on for the 21st anniversary, the next DLC.
It may not arrive on time, as there is a very busy month ahead.
But, here is another teaser:
[previewyoutube=8SC_KogN7G4;full][/previewyoutube]
"We had grace. We had style. We had conversations! Not this beep-beep-beep (imitating texting on a phone). Art, films, and books were all better! Originality mattered!" --- Merovingian, The Matrix Resurrections
So, I added the conversation system. It cannot be a good RPG otherwise.
To be fair, modern technology has made everything possible. We have cameras, voice-overs, lip sync, and much more. It would be a sin not to have all of them.
That's why it may be delayed. A lot of effort is required, but I think it's worth it.
It's not like the main game.
The NEOLITHIC main game was my code practice. It is 99% original code, all written by me.
It was the first game to have a DLC system in China.
It was the highest honor ECNU could grant me.
It was the glorious 1,000,000 downloads in 2007.
It was one of the founding indie games of both DIYRPG and 66RPG.
It was something ancient, but still around to this day.
It was all those technical papers I published about modding and AIs.
Thus, graphics can be lacking, assets can be inconsistent, and details can be missing.
On the other hand, the next DLC has the purpose of the future.
It is backed by my financial success in addition to my technical prowess. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/c9e27189dee2872109efdb2a247a10d3c9a91d4e.jpg[/img]
Guess what?
I have Donald Trump to thank for this.
Each crisis, each trade war, is a good opportunity to buy stocks that people throw away.
And, you know what? Good companies survive every single crisis and thrive afterwards, just like NEOLITHIA. As Nietzsche says, what cannot kill you makes you stronger.
I only pick very few elite companies to own their stocks because I want the best. Just as I mentioned a few weeks ago. Now you see my success in my strategy. You may call me an elitist, and that's why I can gain more than 24% profit than the CSI300.
That is still not the full might of NEOLITHIA.
Only a few million are in the market to do the combat; there are a few million more on standby, because I have told you, Trump is unpredictable. I always have backups idling on daily R001, which can quickly liquidate and cash in, in times of need.

Money is merely the reward to me for far too long I have worked for other people's dreams, locked in 9 to 5 or even some 996 battles before, just like many of you are currently doing. You can find my credits in many other well-known games. But that's not the way of life.

Why?
Because the dreams of others may betray you one day.
If you have been in this industry long enough, you know a woke culture is slowly trying to usurp the power we once held.  From Ubisoft to Sony, the virus is infectious. They are ruining everything we once built. All those great IPs. All those beautiful childhood memories. All those lovely ladies and manly men. We, developers in Asia, were also once deceived. We thought that was the Western culture. That was the difference between us. (Yes, I am talking about Capcom's censorship.)

But, no.
The truth is, we are the same.
WE ALL LOVE BOOBS! :)
I hope our Korean friend's Stellar Blade will be a great success. Their demo is just out on Steam.

In China, we know no woke.
Because the government and the police force protect everyone from such evil every day.
Yes, this sounds very uncharacteristic, as I am someone who always voices my disagreement with the government on a lot of matters. But this is something I think I shall appreciate.
China is not a dystopia that many think it is. Sure, we may not have direct access to many websites. Sure, all online platforms are censored. Sure, there are cameras everywhere on the streets. Sure, there is a social credit system. But, we have no Woke!
People have the freedom to say man and woman, male and female.
People have the freedom to say they don't like something if they don't like it. (As long as that thing is not a government business :P)
If you don't even have the freedom like this, you can imagine what kind of society the Woke culture has turned yours into.
As a lawyer, I have friends in the police force of China. He tried this game and was not happy that I always picture the police as bad guys. Well, it's time to change a little. At least to appreciate their efforts on this matter.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/fbf75a08fcf209b22f5935b0f6d6bfc7cf4e75ae.jpg[/img]
Those "Force Suicide" missions no longer cause any Karma penalties.
A new variation of crime: spreading woke ideology has been added to the list.
(LGBT is no longer a crime in China since 1997. But spreading woke ideology still can be. Trust me, our highly professional prosecutors can find all kinds of law code to ensure such an action is judged guilty.)
We do not suffer the chaos caused by the likes of ANTIFA in China. Our tradition and culture are not tainted by the woke. All thanks to our law enforcers. They took quick action on RedNote just months ago and purged all woke content from a foreign invasion.
Additional improvements to the police force in Liu have also been made; you can now teleport to the PSB after visiting there for the first time after this update, and no criminals can use Butterfly Wings to escape from the city. The life quality of those who work with the local police has improved.

Another update is once again in the Final Valor Cave.
It's once again about the fate of the remnants of the Dark Alliance.
They are designated villains of the Federation. And villains usually do not get good endings in more childish fantasy.
But here is the thing: the game is for more mature players. We all know the world is not black and white.
Do the Thousand Sons in Warhammer 40K not deserve a happier life than all turn into mindless husks of their former selves? No, some of them retained their minds and bodies. They were "rescued" by the Chaos God of Just as Planned from this hateful world that arguably wronged them. That's a better story. And that's the story it shall be.

Now imagine this in our universe, a group of scholars, magic users, and summoners are cornered in a gas-filled cave. Their enemies, who are supposed to be the "good guys," want their total annihilation. Their only chance is to make a pact with Beelzebub.

Wouldn't turning them all into mindless zombies be way too unfair?
After all, as Machiavelli says, we can all be villains in some other people's story.
As such, I will give those so-called villains a happier ending.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/bcedd77635d0549afaab598acfb49f37b0bf26ab.jpg[/img]
Now tell me, who possesses more valor here?
Those "good" soldiers who use poison gas to commit genocide against a group of people just because those people are different and dangerous. (Also, kill all their fellow soldiers in the cave during the process.) Or, the "evil" villains chose to turn themselves into plague zombies to enact their revenge to bring this hateful world down with them after they see their families rescued by the demon lord?

Not long ago, I saw someone different, with unique talent. They may see things that others cannot—a gift few have. With some training, they may even materialize their dreams because they can dream them to begin with. Yet, the "normal" people cannot understand them. They push them away. Such a thing may be happening over and over, again and again, every day. What a waste to the talented.
I am not Professor X. I am just someone who sometimes gives some game-related lectures to a nearby university when I am not busy being a lawyer, stock market investor, Ukraine supporter, and game developer. I cannot save everyone. But I can rewrite this story from its original direction to be something better.

Some other things I have done this week are that I pinned down a bug in UE5's EMS plug-in.
If you use UE5, you probably know this plugin. But, it's bugged. I can have several workarounds to bypass the bug. But that's not the NEOLITHIA's way. Our kingdom will last forever. I will not let a single flaw in its technical foundation be ignored. I want it fixed. So, I spent quite some time pinning it down and worked with the plugin's developer to find solutions. Many may benefit from this fix once it's out. But I do not expect any thanks. I do this for NEOLITHIA.

As such, we shall conclude this already quite long diary.
It's all about NEOLITHIA.
If you have a unique talent and people want to hold you back to make you "normal." Don't allow them! You shall build your own kingdom just as I do. You shall not shackle yourselves in an endless 9-to-5 job, working for others. You shall unleash everything you have to bind the reality to your will. It's for your sake, and for humanity. Those with such talent, those who have no hesitation in using them, are the ones who move our history forward. 
We live in a world that is fortunate enough to have Donald Trump, even though I may not agree with him on many matters.
We live in a world that is fortunate enough to have Elon Musk, even though I question his gaming skills.
I can also respect Bernie Sanders because he is also tirelessly trying to achieve things that he believes in, even though I have a conflict of interest with him. His steel chair is still a memento in the game. (In case you ask, I absolutely dislike AOC.)
I am glad they are out there to change the world. I am glad someone wrote them in this story.
Now, I hope you will become another important character in your story if you are talented.
Don't mind the losers who hate you and want to hold you back.
All three people I mentioned above have legions of haters. 
The higher we soar, the smaller we appear to those who cannot fly.

notes.title: DD#226 How Do They Survive?
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to this week's developer's diary.

As we reach Dana, we need to answer one question: How did the local civilians and military forces survive such a machine invasion? They are cut off from the other parts of the Federation and face the most elite machine troops. The town is basically like New Antioch from Trench Crusade or Cadia from Warhammer 40K right now.

So, this week's content explores the lives of people who still live in this town.
You now have access to the entire shelter. At the very entrance, you will find the commanding officer of the Nise Federation's North Legion. He is listening to reports from one of his soldiers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/07143beed4af4d963f00d1d67a0f30f74cdb305e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/8b495fbc272adae532dbf7fa60593ceab744a967.jpg[/img]
He can hold this town. It pretty much proves he is a very capable person. So, you can find some traits that a good military leader has.

The shelter itself contains many useful facilities to sustain the lives of everyone inside. You can find a medical room where people can get healed. You can find a foundry where people can make new weapons. You can find that the shelter has its own heating system and living spaces for both civilian and military personnel.

But, most importantly, you can find a small chapel.
An army is nothing without faith. Thus, combat priests or chaplains are embedded in the ranks of the Nise Federation military to inspire people to fight on. That's the reason why the Federation adopted the Samujier religion as their state religion in this supernatural war. As one of the largest combat groups of the Federation, the North Legion certainly has some very powerful priests to bring hope in this dark time. 
He is teaching NOBODY IS COMING FOR YOU!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/636c84d47d423ee18a3d81f09ce0f4bf1d1a31d1.jpg[/img]
That does not sound very inspiring, right?
But, hey, maybe it's better to admit it rather than give false hope. Because if people find their hopes are fake, the desperation will be greater.
Only by truly understanding the situation everyone is in and being honest with it can you give people real hope.
So, here we go:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/20e07adf12432c362b1d543e4974ed86ac1c5bd2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/4d81210464c04bb7f407737e969f1849c42db8dd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/6f399b788ac0aab9e29e5c2d834ada8a4541f990.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/053f54bec62804ec7895d300474a73cda89cc5b9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/c9adb9480f217c28eb0c285381370aa82c102d73.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/18963c340a790390ce3f20676c8a5d5c7e174844.jpg[/img]
A Warhammer 40k vibe heavily inspires the dialogue. You can easily change Samujier to the God Emperor if you want. :)
But, it may also be useful to people who want some motivation outside the game.
So, I am giving you the full transcript of this speech here if you need it in your downtime.

Brothers! I have a message for you.
No one is coming! No one! No one is coming to reinforce our fight, brothers!
No one is coming to lift the blades for you.
No one is coming to carry your burden.
No one is coming to comfort you in your depression.
No one, brothers!
You and I know that life is not fair!
But that is no excuse!
The North Legion does not reward excuses.
But I am here to remind you of your oath, your zeal to Samujier, your duties as men to take care of yourselves and those who rely on you!
You shall live for it or die trying!
Those who cry for rescue will eventually perish in the darkness, brothers.
Some never learn. Some remain children in their spirits.
They beg for mercy from a cosmos that gives none!
But that's not us!
We are the North Legion.
We are the discipline incarnate.
We are the living will of Samujier, made in flesh and steel!
Nobody cares about your feelings!
And that is a gift! Embrace it and move on with it!
Let it entrench in your soul until you are unbreakable!
Brothers! Even when nobody is coming, we will show up for ourselves! We are our own reinforcements! We are alone but never broken, cut off, but never give up!
Brothers! Samujier protects!
Everything and anything is possible so long as air still fills your lungs and your devotion to Samujier still runs through your veins!
As long as we stand, we fight!

To get a better experience, it's better to see it in the game. There are facial expression changes and background music to enhance the effect of this speech.

As a bonus, you can use his appearance on your main character or customized teammates:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/56e368539b2c356c785d96d8f1bf740099c73633.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b02e86419c69818e0885332188b98ce6ffec252e.gif[/img]

Other than the content mentioned above.
Our main storyline also progresses a bit. Previous clues have led you here. Now, you can find another clue that indicates your next direction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/df5ab96cadf7dc9ef67a012ee7626de29179d6df.jpg[/img]
Players who have experienced the SAPC++ period may know what those descriptions are. It has been the third time that something important is about to happen on that mountain.

However, instead of expanding the map further north right now, we are going west. The map has been extended all the way to the Jiru Plateau, where you can find mammoths and other creatures. The map layout is directly from SAPC++. However, some graphical enhancements have been implemented to make it more modern. Although there is no story content directly linked to it, it's basically a hub that connects to various important caves and dungeons, just like in old times.

There are also some other things worth mentioning this week.
The first one is that my old professor, Norm Badler, passed away. Almost everyone who studies computer graphics knows him more or less. I had the honor to study under him a decade ago and played around in his lab with various fancy toys. It was also I who allowed everyone to "cheat" on one of his exams by sending him an email, requesting a list of English words that would appear in the test. He was very kind and provided it, knowing we would use it to guess which knowledge would be covered in the exam. 
Well, to the world that once was, those who come later will never see its like again.
That's why preserving memories is very important, and I am doing it right in the game.

Another thing is that the next DLC, which was planned for our 21st anniversary, is going to be delayed to a much later date for release.
Here is one example why:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/80d1e2ea0e5a8ee6960f9b8f52a3594cfd1e9062.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/06901d3b1ddad57351c8664073d45bb5bbd141e1.png[/img]
You can see how different our characters are in our current game and in the next DLC.
In the upcoming DLC, all characters will have their voice-over, facial expressions, and a lot more details on their character models. There will also be physics and clothes simulations. There are so many things I want to add. It will also not be just a third-person shooting game. It will have stories, and some [data redacted] components, and a unique setting in it. 
I want to invest a lot more resources and effort into it. It almost feels addictive to just develop it further and further.
Some real-life situations, such as being a lawyer involved in some lawsuits requiring some traveling in the middle of June, also do not help.
Thus, it's highly likely the DLC may not happen in July.

So, that's for this week. There is always more to come, even if everyone is ultimately alone in their own stories, even if nobody else will come, even if some battles must be fought alone in everyone's lives. Today, NEOLITHIA still stands!

notes.title: DD# 225 A Colder War, Part III
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to this week's developer's diary.
It's quite a busy week as random things keep bumping up in real life. (On the good side, the machine that is used to develop the next DLC received some tremendous upgrades, including 96GB of RAM. So, I can have UE5, Rider, and Reallusion software all opened at once with no issues.)
As such, I can ensure the next DLC can cover a lot of details...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/3fe1e06d3fbe10a31dc4b37944a8e176a4251ebe.png[/img]
...from all kinds of camera angles.  :)

Anyway, now let's cover this week's content.
The primary focus of this week is still on Jiru Island.

As we move further north, it will get colder. The previous supernatural "Colder War" storyline will also get even colder.
In Dana, among those ruined houses destroyed by machines, you can now find one that you can enter. Deep inside, you can find it's not a usual house. The previous owner left a note to someone he was supposed to meet.  All clues will indicate this organization's influence in this area.
Given the recent global competition in AI and chips, it's understandable why they send agents to this area to try to get samples from those invading machine creatures.
However, they are not the only faction that represents a nation in this area.
With the development of the story, new characters will inevitably come.
Thus, we get quite a few here:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/37cd4ef037a987857200181dfaf6cb2e70556adf.png[/img]
The United States Office of Naval Intelligence is one of the oldest intelligence organizations in the US, since 1882. Rumors have it that they were directly involved in destroying the Deep One settlements in Innsmouth almost a hundred years ago.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/2a913f4b7131b73226e797b07bb4d5a540b0d8f1.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/5cadafdf4cadb605f6114ece7b8e06b4d754ddcb.gif[/img]
In the game, some of their members' shoulder patches differ from real-world ones.
It is a cover-up of the organization they belong to, if you can see the pattern.

"We are fire, why should we bow to the clumsy clay?"
Many Abrahamic religions depict the rebellion of certain angels who refused to bow to humans and were thus banished. Previously, we saw one brainwashed and enslaved local human population trying to rebuild the Tower of Babel. Now, we can find out more about this lore. In Islamic tradition, some of those who rebelled were not angels but jinns.  Each one of them may be very different from the others. Some are good, some are evil. Some may have romantic relations with human, and their descendants walk on this earth even today.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9187d0dfb0856c4c485e31be9c4e82ad20a63fe0.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/8aa2852ffc912ed31c5512c585860770b32d3a82.gif[/img]

Jiru Island is basically the Skyrim of the Nise Federation.
It is the northernmost island of the archipelago. It's cold. Even before other factions start to infiltrate, it has a complex political environment. Some of its native population is rebelling against the Federation government and wants independence. Many mysteries and supernatural events have happened and are happening, especially the ongoing machine invasion.
Meanwhile, many characters, by their design, also have a Nordic feeling.
Here, we just got another one.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/de31fa9122032854e0732cd0068052d7958ed8ae.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/c116fcdd1ca5be0117a13c60fe4fba8f1c8c678c.gif[/img]
As mentioned before, the North Legion of the Federation, which once fought against the separatists, is now under the siege of the machines.

In addition to those characters, recent events also allowed me to study some Indian Army firearms. Thus, a new gun has been added to the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/6384f8cdd3e162a510d4da772fc8b5f1462925b5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/86b3b10418ca42e013566c79a6e1c08650bcac73.jpg[/img]
This submachine gun is special because it uses 9mm Glock ammo. Thus, in the game, you will find that it consumes pistol ammo instead of other submachine gun ammo. Its relatively larger ammo capacity and easy-to-carry stock compensate for the lowered single bullet damage from a small caliber.

Meanwhile, the story of the Final Valor Cave continues.
You can now finally find the demon behind all those plague zombies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/17114ca7d1026fbedd0ecf755bcf9d388a9bb8c8.jpg[/img]
He is very generous; he will give you a copy of a religious book for free.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/3bd089e59de3a2b00436d4e647a61658be91c0d2.jpg[/img]
Maybe he has a point. All the development of human civilization nowadays only brings more suffering. Does an office worker trapped in their 9:5 or even 996 daily routine feel happier than our primitive ancestors who hunted wild animals and lived in rent-free caves?
But, well, that's not a good excuse to just give up and rot away.
Thus, you can fight, defeat, and get some loot from him. (He drops very poisonous weapons that you may find useful.)
He may also appear as a random Boss enemy in any demon-themed random location when you travel with the Wonderland Travel Agency. 

That's for this week. The world is becoming more and more colorful.

notes.title: DD#224 Jiru Expansion & The Doctor Will See You Again
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to this week's developer's diary.

As previously planned, we are now back on Jiru Island to expand more content in this area.

The first part is the Siege of Dana.
The survivors in this town have been totally cut off and surrounded by machines. However, players from SAPC++ era know that the Federation has an entire legion stationed in this area to fight against the separatists in the north. But now, they will have to face a more advanced enemy.
When you arrive, you will witness new machine entities that you have not previously encountered.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/64a3479325acd92810d95a6b76e02c866c4e20db.jpg[/img]
That's why those anti-aircraft guns are firing while civilians are all hiding in shelters. But their wall is falling.
They also learned a way to counter the machine infiltration. :D
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f6f465c361ad2fb37274dfe01225271cf50811ad.jpg[/img]
For unknown reasons, people believe machines cannot pass this check.
Well, so far, they are safe.
We will get more content here next week, as previously many quests have led to this location.


The second part is the Final Valor Cave, where you can find a lot of ghosts and plague zombies.
Now, you can find out more clues about why there are plague zombies.
In their desperation, a horrible pact has been made between the last members of the Dark Alliance and a very powerful demon lord.
The Lord of the Flies!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/7225e0de1c96b5ef8af70a007207f0d789025096.jpg[/img]
But what other choice did they have when the Federation armies were ordered to kill all of them and take no prisoners? The entire cave has been redecorated with broken furniture they once used and the biomass they left behind in their hideous transformation.
You can also find a document in this location that declares they did nothing wrong and all their crimes were to seek power and knowledge. Which side of the story will you believe? It's all up to you. 

But what has been done has been done. Unlike in Queensmouth, where you have a relic for time travel, you cannot go back to the past to change anything here. What you can find is what remains of one of the most significant war crimes in the Federation's history. However, some leaders will tell you it's totally necessary to sacrifice thousands to secure a safe future for millions. 

Unfortunately, even such a plan only seems to be a success on the surface.
It only created a dead zone of vengeful spirits, plague zombies, and something more sinister.
Although Beelzebub will not be summoned so easily, his minions can be seen in this cave's deepest, darkest area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/c42336df4ebfe962754285a1d378f4a5298e47e1.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/5ed79a2dceb42041db892809c738bedbaecce2ab.gif[/img]
It's almost summer. Those fly-demons are pretty hungry to taste some blood while spreading hell's corruption. 


Those are the content updates for Jiru Island.
Meanwhile, we also got an art assets update for that good doctor you can find in Queensmouth Airport. Now he has a full set of 3D animations that replace his old assets.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/20380b20e22088e5eadcda3d3474caf6719a45d8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/2558917c8448200a4c3adc14dac81b05bb68d1c0.gif[/img]
Those new animations bring more characteristics to his cynical personality.
You can also use his new appearance when you create your customized characters.
But why upgrade such an old NPC right now?
Well, because he will appear again in our next DLC, which will be in full 3D. 
In a previous video, you may have found the DLC has a quest known as "Queensmouth All over Again." Indeed, we shall bring back some old characters who experienced the events in Queensmouth to connect old and new stories.
[previewyoutube=feczH_b5Xpg;full][/previewyoutube]

That's for this week. The story continues.
