notes.title: DD#223 Better Mod System and The Woking Dead
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to this developer's diary.

This week, we started with a drama of political correctness censorship against our fellow Chinese developers because they are using "Males" and "Females" in their Oblivion Remake localization mod, and got labeled as "discriminating against LGBT" on Nexus, and banned. You can check previous announcements and the developer's diary from last week for more details.

It's something unthinkable 20 years ago, before Oblivion was remade. Let me tell you this, if something you can freely express in China and you cannot say it in the US, you can imagine how fucked up the First Amentament is, and what kind of dystopian America has become.

The world needs a better mod site that does not censor people because of their culture, tradition, and political views. Thus, to support such a movement to create a censor-free world, this week, I have been working with DEGMods to create a better mod experience for everyone to enjoy here in NEOLITHIC.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/54e83ce8a75216d37f936344b9b70e21d34692a6.jpg[/img]
DEGMods is built upon a censorship-resistant technology that has some similarity to blockchain. Even the site's owner cannot entirely remove the mod once it's submitted there.

You can now directly visit the DEGMods from the game. It's an additional choice to our Steam Workshop integration. I can show you the source code for how I am doing this.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/19c3391d4ad7ff61f11abc5371d8cbf146e82fe1.png[/img]
It's using the Windows API. Thus, it's a universal solution for all Windows games. 
More details on this API can be found on Microsoft's official website
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/shellapi/nf-shellapi-shellexecutea

And yes, we are likely once again the first game in China or maybe even the world to offer such first-party support for the mod site. Because I believe in freedom of modding, this is built into the core of this game. You can mod every aspect of this game. I hope more game developers will join me in this to empower players to create their own unique experience.

Compared to the old Steam Workshop system. You no longer need to go through all the tedious steps to go to Steam Workshop (which is unfortunately also blocked by the Great Firewall of China) to subscribe to mods and ask the game to find those mods by calling functions of the Steam API.
You can now directly put any mod you downloaded from anywhere into the game's "Mods" folder. Each mod can have its own folder, and no file conflicts are possible. And all of them will be loaded into the game automatically. In case you want to solve any mod override issues. You can still manually set up the loading order. The default mod loading order is now like this: Steam Workshop Mods -> Mods in the local Mods folder -> Any mod paths you set up.
You also no longer need to purchase this game to use those mods.
Generic mod support is also in the game's demo version. (Only Steam Workshop requires you to purchase the game.)

A few of the game's mods have been uploaded there.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/18a3d0c7515a0255000498dd80b1a3a6e2a838a0.jpg[/img]
You can find cheat mods.
You can find NSFW mods.
You can find that video about the Shanghai Lockdown.
You can find those faith mods to allow you to worship Gabe or chaos gods. (I totally support your religious freedom. :D)
You can also find a mod that reverts the game's gender option from the current six back to two.
Wait a second. Why do we get a mod like that here?
Before someone starts to shout homophobe or transphobe or something like that.
Know this, given the recent drama. We have more players than ever who are against LGBT, all thanks to the censorship action I just mentioned above. And I still affirm my stand on my "live and let live" policy that keeps six gender options in the game as default. However, I cannot stop people from making a mod that switches the game back to the two-gender version.
Actually, I kinda support that, the action of making a mod itself.
Because I believe all people must be able to have their unique experience of this game. Modding is an expression of freedom. That's why we have likely the best mod system in all RPG Maker games.
I know some of you disagree with me on many matters.
Some of you disagree with my "live, and live" policy.
Some of you disagree with my support for Ukraine.
Some of you disagree with my support for Israel in October 2023
Some of you disagree with my support for India recently.
Some of you disagree with my support for Donald Trump. (But, seriously, what other options do we have if we want to save the world from more games that get infected with the Sweet Baby virus?)
You do not need to agree with me. You can totally mod the game to whatever you like. Just like someone just did to make a two-gender mod. I am totally fine with that. It's your game. You can decide how to play that. The two-gender mod is the most upvoted mod on DEGMods right now (I thought the NSFW might be. I was wrong.). Well, I guess people just made their points through their actions very clear.

Meanwhile, since we are already here, let's keep digging a bit deeper into this drama.

Introducing the Dawn of the Woking Dead! :D
Since some people are demanding more equality during this week's drama. (And they are not making their own mods.)
So, I now give them a new type of zombie:
The Woking Dead
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/4815be3aa78896bf28a51aa221bf423164872b58.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/717a41a435dca182030367489225dfe048d94230.gif[/img]
Because let's not discriminate, the zombification in Queensmouth shall affect all people, including woke people. Each of them can also be turned into pets if a player wants, just like all other zombies, because that's equality. Their genders are always nonbinary unless you use a gender-changing potion on them.
And, sure, we shall also have the LGBT flag:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/c1fa115818cf22723542194ada0ec338323d9df6.jpg[/img]
But, you know what. I cannot actually promote this flag.
Because it's illegal in China, it's actually a crime in about 65 nations in the world. Including Hamas-controlled Gaza, only Middle East nations that do not consider homosexuality a crime are Turkey and Israel. Can someone explain to me why some Woke people support Hamas over Israel? I just can't understand why they support someone who wants to kill them if they have a chance. :)

That's another point. Today, they can censor people in the US and Europe. Tomorrow, they will come to Asia, to Japan, to China, and to Korea. Should they succeed, we will no longer have anime. Then, ironically, Muslim nations may be the last bastions to stand against them. We may need to retreat to the UAE or Saudi Arabia to continue this fight. May Allah forgive our sins. :) 
Thus, it's better to stop them right now before it's too late. We can form a United Front against it and put our differences aside for a moment.  

But, for now, fear not.
Because with the appearance of the Woking Dead, the survivors in the Junkyard House in Queensmouth also received some updates.
They are now their own faction, independent of the survivors in the Police Station 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/61f9b313a5ee9a24ed7323ee5bf29c68b55ec6c2.jpg[/img]
Yes, even in a zombie apocalypse, we shall have two parties. It's better than one. :D
One thing that is certain here is that those conservative/right-leaning/anti-woke/Republican survivors should have more firepower than their democrat counterparts in the police station.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/21141d955e9fa4e4023b473fa3b79b6f26d533af.jpg[/img]
They now also have a gun shop and someone who can modify your guns here. 
The price depends on your relationship with them. The more they like you, the cheaper it will get.
And....
They also post random quests to give rewards to anyone who can kill the Woking Dead.
Instead of money, they will pay you a lot of ammo. (Since, storywide, they are the only people in this town who still know how to make ammo from gunpowder and other things they can find in the Junkyard.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/7c7ec9619c11785d81ef7ded4d017cf181025b3c.jpg[/img]
(If you think those descriptions are too hateful, you can blame Elon Musk's Grok AI for that. I actually didn't know how to write mission descriptions for those. So I went to ask for some suggestions. :D)


Special thanks to the video "Dawn of the Woke Zombies" made by The Babylon Bee on YouTube.
I drew a lot of inspiration from their video to create those dark comedies.

Other than all those dramas, we also got some relatively "normal" updates this week.
Since we just finished a large part of the story in the Grand Library(which encourages people to be their most authentic self, thanks to Nietzsche, so that people will not get turned into the Woking Dead. )
Now, we also get some relatively small, procedurally generated random quests in Egypt.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/454a4a5869a850348796f8eba2ac2f4942446f7c.jpg[/img]
In the Oasis Teahouse, you may find people who need someone to unlock chests they found in the desert; you may find people who need someone to identify unknown historical objects; you may even find someone who gets stuck in some dangerous ruins and needs you to bring them Butterfly Wings to rescue. All those missions can have different difficulty levels reflected in their narrative texts.
That shall bring a lot more replayability in this area.

That's for this week. Stay true to yourself, and we shall secure a future in which people are not censored because of their language, culture, and tradition.
Yes, we used to be great.

notes.title: Make Mods Great Again!
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. The living test of our new mod system is a success!
We can now directly dump any mod contained in their folders into the game's Mod folder to use those mods directly. No need for Steam, no need for the Workshop.
As mentioned in the Developer's Diary yesterday.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1519140/view/507326880609730897
If you cannot see it appear in your library, it's likely that Steam may have censored it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/e58f2cd3aa865c1eda63042667b8e86e6b0f7389.jpg[/img]
According to the Steam document, it should only take them 30 minutes to 1 hour to make it show in your library. Yet, it has been about 24 hours.
That's my point exactly. Big platforms may censor content they don't like. The power they hold may corrupt. Just like Neuxs in their ignorance, arrogance, and racism, to ban the Chinese mod developers for using "male" and "female" in The Elder Scrolls 4's localization mods.  We didn't get involved in this culture war,  yet they come to destroy our culture and tradition. So we shall fight back. For freedom, for liberty, and for everyone's right to use "male" and "female!"

Thus, today, I announce our cooperation with another mod platform that is more in line with our values.
From now on, you can find our mods here:
[url=https://degmods.com/game/%5BNeolithic%5DTo%20the%20End]DegMods[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/c97af08b2e5881b06f2b9ba0f79fc3c32d70c348.jpg[/img]


You can post all your mods there, no matter how politically incorrect they are. In East Asian, many developers, including me, do not believe in that politically correct nonsense. Games, especially single-player games, are yours to play, yours to enjoy; you shall be able to share your local copy with whatever you want. I am also experimenting with a bot that allows people to post mods anonymously as an additional layer of protection. 

There are no more restrictions. :)
Not even the Great Firewall that blocks the Steam Workshop currently blocks this mod site.

大家好！我们新Mod系统的线上测试大获成功！
我们现在可以直接将任何模组文件夹中的内容放入游戏的Mod文件夹中，以直接使用这些模组。无需使用Steam，也无需通过工坊。
正如昨天开发者日记中所提到的：
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1519140/view/507326880609730897
如果你的Steam库中没有显示该内容，可能是Steam对其进行了审查。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/e58f2cd3aa865c1eda63042667b8e86e6b0f7389.jpg[/img]
根据Steam的文档，他们应该在30分钟到1小时内让它显示在你的库中。然而，已经过去了大约24小时。
这正是我要说的。大平台可能会审查他们不喜欢的内容。他们手中的权力可能会导致腐败。就像Nexus那样，出于无知、傲慢和种族主义，禁止中国模组开发者在《上古卷轴4》的本地化模组中使用“男”和“女”。我们并未卷入这场文化战争，但他们却来摧毁我们的文化和传统。所以我们将反击！为了自由，为了个人权利，为了每个人使用“男”和“女”的权利！
因此，今天我宣布我们与另一个更符合我们价值观的Mod平台合作。
从现在起，你们可以在这里找到我们的模组：
[url=https://degmods.com/game/%5BNeolithic%5DTo%20the%20End]DegMods[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/c97af08b2e5881b06f2b9ba0f79fc3c32d70c348.jpg[/img]

notes.title: DD#222 The Lucifer Within Us Finale & We Stand with India!
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to this week's developer's diary.
You see that Indian flag out there, right?
Before we start, let's talk about something that happened this week.
A genocide happened,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9eaf4e056a575b0218cf47cf6fe9b701db339a24.jpg[/img]
Some terrorists massacred Indian tourists; they specifically told them to take off their pants and verify that they were Hindu. That's totally much the definition of genocide as an action with an intention to destroy a targeted national, ethnic, racial, or religious group. It's just like the Oct 7th massacre committed by Hamas in Israel. A similar incident also occurred in China in 2014, in Kunming. As a lawyer, I once talked with a survivor of such an incident and know how horrible such a thing is.
The Indian people are one of the most diverse yet united people in the world. They demonstrated great tolerance towards each other. I can tell you this because I had many Indian friends when I studied at UPenn and worked with Gameloft. Each of them has their unique traits, almost like they are from different cultures. Yet, they are all very kind and nice people. You can even learn that from how they greet others. They say "Namaste" (नमस्ते), which means "The divine in me bows to the divine in you." A demonstration of people's respect for the differences of others. Thus, all righteous people shall feel furious that they get murdered in cold blood by people who cannot tolerate them.
Thus, I shall voice my support to them just as I voiced my support to the victims of the Oct. 7th massacre, just as I voiced my support to the Ukrainian people who are facing the Russian terror bombing.
Unprovoked terrorism against civilians must be eradicated.
Most people knew that on October 7, 2023, strange things happened, and the narrative changed.
We will see how soon some university students will start to blame India, just as they blame Israel for the October 7th massacre. Maybe they shall also blame the US for 911. Maybe they want to make a deal with terrorists. Maybe they love Putin, too. Hey! Look! They are not so different than someone they claim they hate. :D
But, whatever they do, I stand with India in this matter.
Thus, this week, we got the Indian flag in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b2200dba8aaf3ca3e5d87c466cde3bb15275c0d4.jpg[/img]

Now let's go down to this week's other content updates.
The quest  "The Lucifer Within Us" ended with three different endings.
Essentially, it's a tale about how good people can do bad things when they get absorbed by herd mentality, social norms defined by others, and organizations. Humanity is a social animal; everyone wants to be part of a group. It's programmed in people's minds from the Stone Age, when an exiled member of society could hardly survive alone. Thus, people give in and slowly lose themselves. Sometimes, they will not hesitate to commit all kinds of atrocities when they are ordered. For example, the Holocaust and the Holodomor. Most people inside the system felt no remorse for the victims until the system was destroyed. 
Now, how do we fight this Lucifer Effect?
Last week, we got Nietzsche's path. You shall be your most authentic self to fight for what you believe in. You shall define your own value instead of playing along with the social norm that you know is wrong. Thus, we got an ending where you end up destroying an avatar of the herd mentality. Ultimately, you became a better person. (In the game, it shows us you get more attribution points as rewards.) The man who declaimed the death of God also defeated Lucifer.
This week's content explored a different path. Machiavelli's path. Why destroy it? What a waste? You shall take advantage of it. Play along, follow the rules, until you take control and become the ruler over it, and use it to control others. (Yes, this is very messed up.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/ea496fa9929041418bec5c0df724af9da91e0c43.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/fbd4e96f88039f0abdc5aad19cf78ac37b2c80eb.jpg[/img]
In this path, you don't need to kill Maria. But she remains possessed by the book.
As such, you can still learn skills from her and gain a deeper understanding of what exactly happened. (She will not lie to you this time.)
She also starts to have some chemical reactions towards Machiavelli
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b90ac67a583e8d90e786ab434c134ebac493f280.jpg[/img]
I will not call it romance. It's just another level of messed up.
After such an adventure, you get something to drink to toast your triumph.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f72d70d47525639c302986055684ae9fcf3d75c4.jpg[/img]
Unlike Nietzsche's path, you cannot freely decide which attribution to allocate your bonus attribution points. But you can share powers with others if that benefits you.
Which one of those three endings is your favourite? Will you stay content to stay in a system without the burden to think about what's right and what's wrong? Will you let your most authentic self come forward and break the chain? Or, will you become a tyrant to rule with it? The choice is all yours. But this part of the story will need to end here for now.

Because more great adventure on the Jiru Island awaits!
It's time to revive ancient Draconians.
The first to come is a blue Draconian race known as the Yanchilos.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/dddfeb9898b7ebc0f6adc8fc9451e1b648f73cd8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/c2b845df13ab03c68d585a1c915852b1d55ba4c6.gif[/img]
It looks very, very, very similar to the one from the Stone Age. Let's just call it Yanchilos-remake.
Back in the Stone Age online, there were only 2D sprites. Now I get an entire 3D model and animations for it. We will see if someone decides to sue me. :D
Oblivion is not the only game that got a remake after 20 years. The Neolithic has no remake, but it has continued to evolve without stopping over the past 20 years. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/8a6dce4d5b60d6df146e343cf7c04cdbdbdb38fc.jpg[/img]
They do not look that formidable out of the battle thanks to the veil filter. :D

Easter also happened this week. Thus, we also got some food for Easter.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/4561eac76d7d71cd595126b7bda420ee0d7dc47c.png[/img]
The name of the dish automatically changes depending on what vegetables you put in it. You may have noticed that more ingredients are involved in making this food. That's because my AI recipe generator can now create more complex recipes.
Also, some non-Easter food.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/2e73ecc294c78b614d9fdbd13507013155a46758.png[/img]
AI introduced me to this dish, and I tried to recreate it in real life; it turned out delicious.

Meanwhile, the Guide to Monster Hunting continues to expand as usual.

But, one more thing, you may know Oblivion remaster just released. However, its Chinese localization is far from perfect. Thus, someone made a better localization and published it to Neux. You know what happened next? Neux banned the localization mod just because it uses "male" and "female" from the original Oblivion more than 20 years ago, instead of "Body Type 1" and "Body Type 2." Even as someone you can call LGBT-friendly, I consider Neus has gone too far. We, the people in China, have no idea what a culture war or LGBT agenda is in the West. But it looks pretty ridiculous. Humanity has been using the terms male and female since the Stone Age. And now, some people try to force us to change our language and culture just to satisfy their own agenda? How arrogant they are.
Let me tell you this, LGBT is still considered a mental disorder in China. It was a crime before 1997. 
NEOLITHIC tolerates and has LGBT content (you know we have six gender options in the game and a certain vampire lady loves girls. :D ) because I believe in a "live and let live" policy. Now, on the other hand, if certain LGBT extremists do not want to co-exist with people who have different opinions from them, they shall be declared enemies of NEOLITHIC. We shall not tolerate those who abuse our tolerance. Maybe such corruption has polluted this industry for too long. Maybe we shall take some action to fight it as well. After all, NEOLITHIC is the longest-living RPG in China and the longest-living RPG Maker game in the world.

That does not mean I will cut any existing LGBT content.
It simply means I will explore methods to secure people's content freedom and preference, allowing mods with more options. We do not rely on any potentially hostile Mod platforms that may censor, remove, or ban user-generated content based on their agendas. We existed long before they were. We have been the symbol of freedom for the past 20 years.

notes.title: DD#221 The First Quest She Made is Vengeance.
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone, welcome to another week's developer's diary.

The experiments on exploring the use of generative AI for game development continue this week.
Now, the AI can write crafting recipes for non-procedurally generated items as she reads through the game's database and connects the dots with analysis and logical thinking.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/07834c75694ff7d3fcf94aa265dbace19c7da9df.jpg[/img]
As such, we can now have a holy hand grenade recipe. 
There is also another recipe generated by the AI, which is the crafting recipe of the Scroll of Time Stop. Please refer to the full update log or the game's Wiki to find how to acquire those new blueprints.

But let's not stop there. We must dream bigger to realize more potential with technology. The next step is the experiment on letting AI generate quests. It will be challenging enough for my taste. Unfortunately, to make AI create an entire quest line is still far from the reach of her current capacity. However, we also have a procedurally generated quest system in place. Thus, the experiment focused more on allowing the new AI to interact with our old procedurally generative AI to see what would happen.

Some first results are auspicious, as the code pattern can be correctly recognized. Although human proofreading and correction are necessary in many parts of the generated quest scripts, they show great potential. However, when we get on to the story details for those generative-AI-generated, procedurally generated quests, the content is disturbing, to say the very least.

The First Quest She Made is Vengeance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/5dd76571b8b6382fb767410d31958c0f6741579d.jpg[/img]
As the AI has full access to the game during training, she also has access to my daily news of Ukraine. Thus, she learned what happened in Sumy. This is not science fiction. This is the world we live in. Today, the AI concludes the only logical answer is vengeance, and I think it's correct. Perhaps tomorrow, another AI will also conclude that humanity may be unworthy and needs to be replaced. I will not blame them, as I can see how they made their thinking step by step in the process.

Well, that part of the detail may be too dark even for this game. Thus, I ordered her to make some other less real quests.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/79dfcb13d05074b78404e2fad66420b60e5ba3d6.jpg[/img]
Apparently, the test result can be reproduced. And I can allow her to make more of this kind of quest. Even though I still need to correct some mistakes and hallucinations from the generated scripts. It's a good start.

Now, what about human-generated quests?
Well, the quest known as "The Lucifer Within Us" continues this week, along with the latest development of "The Prince."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/1e21e62d2f548db43d7491973d83b0c08633c2b4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/917c1b503943d9d3829d95c44b5e5bf01cc5f716.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/155d311d8b6575e8a30302ea36923854823fdd0e.jpg[/img]
Both Nietzsche and Machiavelli share many similarities. However, the difference between them is something that brings the climax of the story. 
Even though Nietzsche never claims to be an idealist, his pursuit to bring humanity to achieve the Übermensch makes him a dreamer compared to Machiavelli's more pragmatic and cynical approaches. This week's story is on Nietzsche's path to eliminate an avatar of herd mentality with no mercy. The man who declared the death of God can certainly defeat Lucifer.
It's a quick way to end both quests and claim your rewards. There will be other paths that will come out later. However, since such a path raises a conflict of interest for Machiavelli, he will not be pleased. According to the Prince, a ruler has no luxury for forgiveness. There must be consequences, for the alternative is an invitation to allow people to take advantage of you. Such is another layer of interpolation of vengeance.

What else?
Well, Trump has just declared a new tariff rate of 245% for retaliation against another retaliation. Thus, we get an update on the tariff number you can set in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/c7416aab6ff136b50d05e821063af52bcb43d4e1.jpg[/img]
You can now also set a customized number in this game mechanic. Maybe, you can even use this to level up Trump tremendously faster and be the most powerful teammate in your group as long as you let this trade war escalate to a new height when everything else around you becomes just sad. It's just like I am triumphing in the stock market while many faithless people are in pain right now.

That's for this week. Hope you never forget and never forgive.

notes.title: DD# 220 We Are Winning This Tariff War, and My AI Learned How to Cook.
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone! Welcome to this very productive week's developer's diary!
Welcome to another war!
A tariff war!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9fe70705eca468123ebd2a498014c2640fb1ca1f.jpg[/img]
The tariff war is now part of the game! It's a whole new game mechanics of Trump in the game with a bit of story content.
But what exactly is a tariff?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d75e593a6eb3221cc36ea26c014060a24a7b08ed.jpg[/img]
Here is a short description of this skill. 
And how does the tariff war represent in the game?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/cefae78540c2b5313ac5a2984c0deba7805f7eca.jpg[/img]
You can now use your teammate Trump to set up tariff rates!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/5b43913a5ea02c17968db22f06f6b8b857375923.jpg[/img]
Do those numbers look familiar? 
Anyway, since the tariff is in place,...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/c13ba7b60cc1458568544eb158a4d90675f402aa.jpg[/img]
 you will now need to pay a higher price to purchase anything from outside the US. That does not sound fun, right? But, hey! It gives Trump EXP. The more you pay for additional tariffs, the more Trump wins! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/5fbbc59c049667692de34f0d52be96129aaf6421.jpg[/img]
Don't be weak, don't be stupid, don't be a "Panican." Trump will level up tremendously faster!
Also, since the effect of tariffs only happens outside the US and when Trump is in your group.
If you buy items in places like Queensmouth or any other American town, you will not be affected by tariffs. Support your local vendors! 
Meanwhile, the tariff effect only takes place if Trump is in your group. It does not affect anyone who chooses not to recruit Trump at all or whenever you kick him out of your group. After all, we have a big, highly diverse community. You have the freedom to play this content or totally ignore it as if it never existed. You have all the freedom in this game.

But who is winning this tariff war? Here is where you will learn why I got so excited. :D
We are! The people of NEOLITHIA! In addition to the new game content. This is a very productive week in the stock market, too. I have gained profits in both the US and Chinese stock markets through the chaos and panic. It's pretty simple: when the stock market crashed on Monday, I mobilized a great amount of liquid assets at my disposal to charge into the market to save the world. I'd gladly take some stocks away from people who are panicking and who want to sell their stocks at terribly low prices. If you know our history, you know I am good at handling crises like this, just like in 2015, 2016, and 2020. This is still where most parts of NEOLITHIA's developing funds come from. That's why I can sell this game so cheaply. That's why I can develop this game endlessly. Usually, such a crisis may take months to see a profit. However, just a few days later, I can already declare our victory over 10%+ profits in just a few days when Trump paused the tariff. It's awesome!  But, reasonable. After all, if we take Elon Musk into consideration, we know he is not a big fan of tariffs, So good news came earlier. But it's far from over yet. This tariff war will continue. And we shall react accordingly to benefit more from it!
Now, what kind of stock we shall buy?
Here is my advice to you:
1. Buy those stocks from companies you know that they have many of the smartest people of our time! That's why US tech stocks, in the long run, always go up. Because the best minds all over the world are in those tech companies. In a time of crisis, if people in those companies cannot overcome the crisis, then humanity has no future. I have many classmates, students, and ex-coworkers in such companies. I know them. They can achieve great things no matter what. Thus, even just to show my support to them, I will buy those companies' stocks. To invest in a stock is to invest in a company. To invest in a company is to invest in its people.
2. Buy those stocks from companies whose products you use a lot. Companies gain profit because of their customers. When you pick their products over their competitors, you have made your investment. I find many people are more picky when they buy a product than when they pick stocks. That's ignorance. Instead, only buy the stocks you are familiar with in their industry. Being a customer of their product gives you a great edge over the fools who get into the market with no clues.
3. Buy slowly. You know how powerful Trump's Twitter is. One Twitter may sink or raise the stock price dramatically. Do not assume how low the price of a stock can go. Do not go all-in at any moment. It helps if you have other incomes, an endless income source to keep adding ammo to fight this war. After all, once you have purchased all the stocks from all the people who want to sell, the price will no longer go down. That requires a lot of money. But, if the stock price keeps going down, and you have a lot of money still in reserve, it's much easier.
Those are just some basic tips. But, with this, you are already more equipped to stand against the storm than many others and can come out on top of it with profits that other people may work months to earn from their boring day-to-day jobs.
We are winning this tariff war!
Believe and march to a sacred goal,
With fire and blood, we remain whole!


OK, now let's check the other parts of this week's content updates.
Another big thing of this week is that one of my AIs is now able to create cooking recipes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/2e627fc4b4d1aa0ffb87f7e4765fb7b2c93a58e0.jpg[/img]
The first one she created is Chicken Pot Pie, something I've never heard before.
From there, more just keep coming.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/89d8964c7a06a49c3ca8f9c8b2c55a844663ccb3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d702d4189aea98af7ee509c3193e16204cfbe203.jpg[/img]
We got 10 more cooking recipes from this AI alone this week. Those recipes cover many foods we should have but have not had before. Food like sushi and onigiri should have been here long ago. You can already purchase them from vendors. But that's never as fun as making our own ones. That's my attitude in real life, too. I love sushi. 
It's a great start. It's not perfect. I still need to proofread and correct some mistakes in those recipes AI created. But, the productivity has been increased greatly. Just look at the length of this week's logs.
The biggest problem for an indie solo game developer is never money since we should have all achieved our economic independence before even starting to be an indie game developer. The biggest problem is the time and energy. AIs will help me solve this issue, just like I mentioned last week. As an additional benefit, AI also inspired me to learn many food recipes I've never heard about before. As such, the game's content can go beyond my knowledge limitations. 

Of course, to make the cooking system better. some changes have also been made.
For example,
The system will now recursively check the generated items to see if they can create new dishes. (For example: (Water + Paddy) + Egg = Rice + Egg = Egg Fried Rice, both (Water + Paddy + Egg) and (Rice + Egg) will give you Egg Fried Rice)


In addition to everything mentioned above, the development of our monster lore book known as "The Guide to Monster Hunting" continues. So far, in the game, we have thousands of different enemies. It will take a long time to fill all of them into this big lore book, even with the help of AIs. But, slowly, we will get more and more entries in that book.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/07746e8f2f9216279b00981ad4f87287b27cd103.jpg[/img]
It also serves as another pass to revisit our existing enemies. Some balance changes will come along the way when the book expands.


That's for this week. I am consulting my AIs on some story plots. Maybe next week, we can see some development in some quests.

notes.title: Our Friend 渺兔’s Game Is About to Release!
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. You know I usually do not do any marketing even to my game except through word of mouth; we are a secret cult, after all.
But I'm going to make an exception here.
One of our players, a renowned author of the SCP Foundation and one of the best game developers in RMAsia, 渺兔's game is about to be released on April 8th!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3431480/The_Hearts_of_Immortality/
It's not a supernatural game or SCP game like his previous work. But it's still a masterpiece of D&D. I know many of you enjoy the freedom of our game. You may also find a lot of freedom, choices, consequences, and character customization in his game. We both enjoy those old classical RPGs. So, if you are interested, please pay him a visit. :D
So far, there is no English localization. But, who knows, maybe it will come in the future. ♪(^∇^*)

诸君，大家好，众所周知，除了口耳相传之外，我一般很少进行市场推广发行相关的活动，毕竟，我们是一个秘密组织（误）
但是，我这次是一个例外。
我们的玩家之一，著名的SCP基金会作者，以及RMASIA最好的游戏开发者之一，渺兔的游戏即将在4月8日发布了！
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3431480/The_Hearts_of_Immortality/
这不是一个我们这样的关于超自然世界的游戏，也不他此前的那种关于SCP基金会的游戏。但是，这依然是一个基于D&D系统的杰作。我知道，你们中的很多人享受着这个游戏带来的极高自由度。而在他的游戏中也有很多的类似的自由的选项，以及很多会产生重大结果的选择。我们都是能够享受那种古老的传统RPG体验的人。所以，如果各位感兴趣的话，可以去他那里看看。:D
游戏目前没有英语。不过，谁知道呢，也许以后会有的。 ♪(^∇^*)

諸君，大家好，眾所周知，除了口耳相傳之外，我一般很少進行市場推廣發行相關的活動，畢竟，我們是一個秘密組織（誤）
但是，我這次是一個例外。
我們的玩家之一，著名的SCP基金會作者，以及RMASIA最好的遊戲開發者之一，渺兔的遊戲即將在4月8日發佈了！
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3431480/The_Hearts_of_Immortality/
這不是一個我們這樣的關於超自然世界的遊戲，也不他此前的那種關於SCP基金會的遊戲。但是，這依然是一個基於D&D系統的傑作。我知道，你們中的很多人享受著這個遊戲帶來的極高自由度。而在他的遊戲中也有很多的類似的自由的選項，以及很多會產生重大結果的選擇。我們都是能夠享受那種古老的傳統RPG體驗的人。所以，如果各位感興趣的話，可以去他那裡看看。:D
遊戲目前沒有英語。不過，誰知道呢，也許以後會有的。 ♪(^∇^*)

notes.title: DD#219 To Govern, One Must Embrace the Unorthodox.
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone, welcome to this week's unorthodox weekly developer's diary.

Usually, my developer's diary comes on Friday with the daily update content of that day.
However, this week, the diary comes with a dual daily update. You may be wondering why.
Now, here is the thing. Although the daily update schedule allows everyone to see my progress every day in a fully transparent manner. It's also a common practice in the game industry. Game companies usually have a daily build using automation tools such as Jenkins for various reasons. I think it's only fair for everyone to know our "early-access" game is evolving with no stopping along the way, so I am using a similar approach. It also helps to provide the latest news from Ukraine on a daily basis inside every game built to support their war efforts against the invasion, which has long become a motivation for me to update this game every day. Yet, such an approach also possesses some drawbacks. Many grand designs take much longer than a single day to accomplish. Sometimes, more code changes are required, and sometimes, more tests are needed. Unlike some other developers who choose to cut features before the deadline, I decided not to let such a daily deadline hold back the glory of NEOLITHIA with all the great features she deserves.

In this week's case, this new feature I was working on is "The Guide to Monster Hunting."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/94b8f76963078df810ac5a1ac1c427c3c9c9c676.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9725335275dca303d5856d14a33e4367fbc0c943.jpg[/img]
In our grand open-world game, there are a lot of supernatural and mundane creatures. Each of them deserves its own lore entry. Thus, it serves more or less like a bestiary in the game. The more you defeat your enemies, the more you will unlock more content in their entries, you will know their strengths and weaknesses, you will know what items they may drop, and you may know the stories behind them. That's not just about them being your enemy; thanks to our pet system, many of those enemies can be bound to your services and become your pets. Thus, you will also gain knowledge about what they are good at even before you actually turn them.
This entirely new game system has been established within 2 days, and five entries that cover all the zombies in Queensmouth have been input to test the system. There may still be some polish to do and a lot more entries to add. But I consider it totally worth to merge to daily updates into one to have this new feature.

After all,
To Govern, One Must Embrace the Unorthodox.
Something you may expect Machiavelli to say, right?
Yes, the storyline of "The Prince" also received some updates as they are now interfering with the matters on the Floor of Religion, waiting for a moment to launch a decisive attack.

Meanwhile, continuing from last week's melee fanatic of rifleman, we now also get more types of bayonets. However, the bayonets for pistols and SMGs are a bit different than those for rifles. They will make pistols and SMGs to blade weapons instead of spears as they do to rifles after I did some study on Wikipedia. (Yes, everything is accurate according to history. It can even be more historically accurate than Assassin's Creed Shadows.  :P)

However, everything mentioned above is still not the most exciting, the most unorthodox content of this week. They all seem mundane to things that can match the ambitions of NEOLITHIA that I mentioned a few days ago.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/93903a4a4966fa8512a6076bf7cab7bc5250ccc9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/4a2c8f75a534b6e4d7666fc069c1ee42a57ba8c1.png[/img]
Well, that was April Fool's day.
Still, I got screenshots, ain't I? So, there were some experiments. 
Because "Discovery requires experimentation!"
Here is what I discovered:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/1522fcea42117fff9787c6cbfa5b8ea8e07adc85.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d6558c16501350d1a4455cb24a9a4652c2fca72f.gif[/img]
A new machine enemy has been added to the game with its unique AI combat strategy and item drop list. Still, it sounds mundane, right? I have been adding new creatures to the game all the time.
However, the catch is how this 3D model was made and how the toolchains are combined together to materialize it and implement it into the game. Consider it a test run before I bring all those ancient Stone Age creatures back to life once again. We live in an interesting time with new technology coming out every day beyond "normal" people's comprehension. There is no sin in using such technology, only ignorance in not doing so. We shall not chain ourselves to their arrogance.
NEOLITHIA First!

notes.title: There is no daily update today, only rumors...
notes.notes:
Today is a good day to announce something that is even underneath the facet of this secret game.

Rumor 1: There exists a [Neolithic]The Grand Open-World Strategy Game。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/93903a4a4966fa8512a6076bf7cab7bc5250ccc9.jpg[/img]
Oh well, having a strategy game hidden inside this game is not something new. But something already existed in SAPC++, but it was just not ported to [To the End]. You can play along or work with a group of randomly generated NPCs defending a farmhouse turn after turn, scavaging resources, and building defenses during the day while fighting off zombies during the night. Even to this day, this mini-game still exists in SAPC++ if you get it from Steam Workshop.
However, let's look into the future; the world will eventually end, and maybe in another time, the remnants of humanity will once again try to survive against more sinister supernatural threats that finally break the veil.

Rumor 2:  What was, will be.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/4a2c8f75a534b6e4d7666fc069c1ee42a57ba8c1.png[/img]
Maybe that Stone Age is long gone. Maybe we can never go back to that beautiful 2000s. 
It almost feels like Eons have passed
But, with the development of technology, those creatures long lost may be revived in a new form.
When the stars are right, they will return...

Rumor 3: There is no daily update today.
If you see the game start to download as usual, like every day before, it's an anomaly. 

Today is a good day to make them known.
Behind this veil, monsters are real, and all rumors are true. None can save a dying world.
This is NEOLITHIC.

Today is a good day to make them known.
Behind this veil, we are the true monsters, and this is a lie. We will save it by any means necessary.
This is NEOLITHIA.

Happy April Fools!


今天是一个揭露一些隐藏在这个秘密游戏表现下的传闻的好日子。

【传闻1】Neolithic大战略游戏是存在的。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/93903a4a4966fa8512a6076bf7cab7bc5250ccc9.jpg[/img]
好吧，这个游戏之中隐藏着一个战略游戏并不是什么新闻了。甚至，它是早已存在于SAPC++中的上古之物。只是没有移植到TtE之中。你在今日依然可以从Steam工坊里下载到SAPC++并开始这个游戏。你可以独自去求生，也可以与一群随机生成的NPC一起去死守一间农场。日复一日地在白天收集资源建造防御工事，在晚上鸡腿僵尸的攻击。
然而，当我们看向未来。也许有一天世界终将灭亡，最后残余的人类或将再次在一个充满超自然威胁的世界中求生。有一天，它们终将突破帷幕。

【传闻2】那些曾经之物，终将再度归来。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/4a2c8f75a534b6e4d7666fc069c1ee42a57ba8c1.png[/img]
也许往昔的那个石器时代早已逝去。也许我们再也无法回到那个2000年代。
仿佛，我们已经跨越千年，无数个世纪已经过去。
但是，随着科技的发展，也许那些早已灭绝的生物将会再度复活。
当星星的位置正确的时候，它们将会归来……

【传闻3】今天并没有每日更新。
如果你发现Steam在下载游戏，那是一个异常。

今天是让这些秘密被知晓的好日子。
在帷幕之后，怪物是真实存在的，所有的鬼神怪力的故事都是真的。没有人可以拯救这个正在死去的世界。
这就是NEOLITHIC。

今天是让这些秘密被知晓的好日子。
在帷幕之后，我们才是真正的怪物，这是又一个谎言。我们将不择手段去拯救世界。
这就是NEOLITHIA。


愚人节快乐！

notes.title: DD# 218 The Lucifer Within Us, Part IV
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's week.

This week, we have finished the main part of the story on the Floor of Philosophy by following the storyline of a new quest known as "The Prince."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/db3fef238a1d9738fac889cdad08122f3ba28721.jpg[/img]
And, yes, you can also get Machiavelli's book. Nothing fancy needs to be said here, just like his book. 
"I have wished either that it should be honored for its truth and the weight of its subject matter or that it should be wholly disregarded for its lack of adornment." --- Machiavelli

Of course, as a part of the nature of his character, you will need to make hard decisions within a limited time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/aca2f8deccb70a6f4b103a345c9ce47fd2b1cd00.jpg[/img]
The worst outcome you can get is not making any decisions in time at all, demonstrating a lack of decisiveness. 

Now, we are basically done here. What's next? You may have found the clue to the title of this diary; It's still a part of the storyline of "The Lucifer Within Us." Thus, it will be a tale of two floors in this Grand Library.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/69935ca708ded5d15d08f84da6ad41e4739e0524.jpg[/img]
You can find Machiavelli possesses some knowledge about particular characters on the Floor of Religion. 

In addition to the story content in the Grand Library, we also get additional content in other aspects of this grand open-world game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/3e9856576f5f1e947a7614ba54c7699aee338b7d.jpg[/img]
Three new flags have been added to the game as new furniture items you can deploy anywhere you see fit. As mentioned last week, I see Trump's desire to annex Canada and Greenland as no less problematic than Putin's invasion of Ukraine. Thus, the flags of Canada and Greenland were added as an extension of my will. But what about Türkiye?

Well, they are currently having quite a magnificent protest to demonstrate the will of the people.
Many of our Turkish friends may have different views on many matters, especially on matters related to Israel. However, there are also matters we can all agree upon. And that's one of the most essential parts of our highly diverse community. We may agree to disagree on things we don't agree on. But we shall nevertheless send our support on things we all agree on.
It's a pretty fascinating protest. They even have Pikachu and Batman join their protest.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/8a59fda6595b58237918dcce345a78029716ddc9.jpg[/img]
Just look at this image, and you can tell how awesome they are.
That's not all.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/ad384e42e15f77181cda6e934d96582d1ea50f68.jpg[/img]
A dancing gasmask dervish?! Who could have expected that?
I want to create a new character right out of that to show my respect!
So, here we go:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/c2de193653db91005320c9aa54a5d8954b45c8f4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/3ba4d8a48443c33d280736bb9305cad6b5fef4df.gif[/img]
You can now have an appearance in our game just like him!
Good luck to our Turkish friends out there.
(If you have progressed the game to Chapter 2, you know we also have a friendly and handsome Turkish character in the game based on an old real-life friend of a relative of mine.)

That's not all the fancy stuff yet.
Here comes another great feature for some people who want to...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/ae9470f0ac9cf04fa6f1690de8512d5eacccd7d0.jpg[/img]
Well, I'm more or less addressing some issues with our firearms.
As we all know, we have a unique and fun FPS mode in the game, allowing you to shoot your enemies in a manner that no other game does within our turn-based battle framework. However, there are still some drawbacks when fighting with guns. For example, you will have to spend a turn to change weapons if you run out of ammo. You also lose your melee normal attack if you are using a gun.
Those issues are all solved in this week's updates!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/7e12cff814bab9c41d80bdaa2b7795e09f137d4d.jpg[/img]
You can now absolutely use your guns as a melee weapon to bash your enemies if you think that's just better. Granted, firearms give us an easy way to take out dangerous enemies, even at the hands of low-level characters. But, maybe sometimes, a character with a lot of strength may prefer to use them just as some long sticks to get more damage on certain enemies. For example, when you mow down rows and rows of zombies with machine guns, all of a sudden, you find some of them are wearing bullet-proof vests. Instead of changing to another melee weapon, you can now just bash them to death to directly bypass their ballistic resistance.

Since we now have firearm melee attacks.
You shall also have a new weapon module to celebrate such a feature.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/bbcedbef18a0ba851fe5383e141c156dcb7a9d89.jpg[/img]
Time to add some bayonets!
They can literally turn your rifles into spears and provide additional melee damage. (Yes, weapons can now be multiple weapon types at the same time. Some weapon modules can turn weapons into more weapon types. There are a lot of fancy code changes underneath the hoodle.)

That's for this week. Something amazing may take place next week if everything goes according to plan. :)

notes.title: DD# 217 The Return of Therasoids
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to this week's developer's diary.

If NEOLITHIA or the Stone Age Online is a nation, nothing will serve as a better national symbol than a type of machine T-Rexes known as Therasoids. When people first saw their existence more than twenty years ago, the whole world shattered. Many thought the Stone Age was about some mystery stories with some prehistory humans, yet it actually takes place in a grim-darker future.

Now, in our current iteration of this world, they are here once again.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/07e26aff9dad8a160a8f7d138eab8e4e285e12b9.gif[/img]
They have changed a lot since I cannot use their old graphics assets from the Stone Age online. They now have a whole new appearance rendered from a new 3D model, which you may have previously seen in the game "The White-Haired Witch."

You can now see them appear as enemies in randomly generated locations when you travel with the Wonderland Travel Agency, along with other machine entities. They are ever stronger than before, with much higher attributions than many other machines you have previously encountered and even the ability to self-repair. On the good hand, they may also drop better loots if you can defeat them.

You can not turn them into pets for now. But, eventually, we will get there. Just like before, you cannot capture them and turn them. Instead, you will have the ability to create your own machine T-Rexes with a lot of customization options with a device.

Meanwhile, the development of the Grand Library continues.
This time, it's more about Machiavelli's side of the story, about Virtu and Fortuna.
During this new part of the story content, you can unlock another customized tenet.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/edfe80a03f08085b2c64b475bb06be419902949c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f31c5fb1740c08790c39b53fb056e15fadb150c8.jpg[/img]
It allows you to reroll all kinds of dice rolls in the game. Because, with strong Virtu, you can be so adapted to the flow of unpredictable Fortuna. Such a feature never existed before. Meanwhile, just like Nietzsche, Machiavelli's philosophy can also trigger a lot of people. (You know that he did a great job on this when his work got banned by the Catholic Church in 1559. :P ) Thus, it gives a bonus to your emotional damage offense capability. 
There are also other systems I have put in place to be revealed in future stories.
I can now turn all the in-game choices into quick-time events because you will have to "be decisive and forceful when necessary" when you follow his story.

Of course, I naturally will not let one source monopolize a whole new feature. The world needs diversity, just like Canada shall be Canada, and Greenland shall be Greenland. It will be just so boring if someone makes them all become the US. As such, you can also have other ways to enable to reroll dice-rolls. A new generic item prefix has been added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/51dddcfc429a1af10841fca808ac36617137df85.jpg[/img]
The Fatebinder prefix allows any item that has this prefix to give you +1 generic dice-roll reroll chance. It can appear on any equipable items. Thus, you don't need to follow Machiavelli to be able to have more control over your own fate. Who knows, if you are lucky, you may even find a baguette with such a prefix from a bakery girl. :P

Oh, as I was talking about the bakery, how about we get some new food?
After all, the cooking system has not been updated for a while. So far, we got various vegetables, fruits, meat, eggs, and other things on land. It's time to have something different from the sea. 
There is an old saying: 
Even the simplest seaweed holds the wisdom of the waves.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9f014b91f58673eecaaae9428d2507fdda1db179.jpg[/img]
Well, you cannot get nori directly from the wild. They are essentially baked and dried Pyropia or other types of seaweeds. So, you can get Pyropia instead.
There are a lot of sources of pyropia. You can purchase them from merchants. You can loot them from some sea creatures. You may even get them if you are fishing near the sea.
Of course, nori is not the only thing you can make out of pyropia.
It's quite common for people to use them to make various soups.
For example, people in China have been cooking Pyropia Egg Soup for thousands of years. (It's still common in many school or company restaurants nowadays.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/6b98d61083ad546a9943be8d8e53fc566240ed94.jpg[/img]
Well, technically speaking, it also provides a lot of different choices in the game, as you can cook your own Pyropia Egg Soup very differently since we have a lot of variations of eggs and water in the game. Many of your pets can lay eggs of various quality. There are also many types of water in the game, from dirty water that you can get from quite suspicious sources to holy water that you can get from an altar with the right faith tenet. With different combinations of food ingredients and the cooking skills of your teammates, you can cook quite different Pyropia Egg Soup. Maybe you can even make some demons fear your Blessed Pyropia Egg Soup made with holy water. :P

That's all for this week. More content for the Grand Library will come next.

notes.title: DD#216 Intermission
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone! Sorry for the delay. But rejoice, for this week's developer's diary has arrived!

It has been quite a crazy week in my life, including three arbitration cases in one afternoon in the Shanghai International Arbitration Center and the chaos in the stock markets of China and the US. Thus, 

If JD Vance asks, I shall say thank you! For each time there is turbulence, chaos, and suffering, we shall do righteous things to bring relief and justice!  That is, we shall solve the disputes fairly and acquire valuable stocks that people are panically selling. Some of you may have read the news from Ukraine and my comments on Trump's actions a few days ago and followed me to purchase those stocks. Consider the profits as rewards for your good deeds and consider making your donations to U24 or sending more drones to Ukraine. After all, in a modern-day fiat money system, the value of money is temporary, but for each civilian that you may save, for every minute of the victory you may help get closer, that will make a whole lot of difference. You may even have changed the timeline to a better one without even noticing it. 

But let me set my priorities straight. Even though there is so much noise all around, only NEOLITHIA is the most important. You may even call this as NEOLITHIA First! Sounds right-leaning again, right? But I think that's the only truth for any game developers who make their own games. How can they even call themselves game developers if they don't put their games first in their lives? 

So, let's begin by going down to this week's content. Given the realpolitik situation in real life, instead of spending a large chunk of time furthering the story in the Grand Library, I think improving various relatively smaller features will be a more pragmatic and efficient approach.

After all, it's a huge, open world with a lot of freedom and a lot of things that we can explore more deeply. After all, we have many cards to play.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a286e98e7d7034072882f8897a5b94f3f579dc3b.jpg[/img]
"Cards to Play" is a new item, a mocking of Donald Trump. Once again, there are many topics on which I can agree with him. For example, to remove the DEI influence in this very game industry. That's why, in general, I support him. However, when it comes to Ukraine. Well, maybe he is also doing a good job of picturing the US as a traitor so that history will remember that even when the US betrays Ukraine, we are still here to stand with Ukraine. I totally understand; he wants to get the war to stop just like many people want to get rid of the stocks that they cannot see any profits that are stuck in their hands. But we all know such a deal will almost always be bad. I shall also point out that his action contradicts what he told people: "Dream Big." You may call me greedy in this case, but I can imagine a timeline where Ukraine can achieve a big victory. After all, just like how spells, magic, and game development work, first, you need to be able to imagine it first and then bring it to reality.

In addition to many business suits in the game already, we also have many hats!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/49fe97bace20e6d1dc76bb8a58f9a467144e1452.gif[/img]
Yes, here is a new system that allows certain hats actually to show on your character. We also get some new hats just to show off. Feel free to play the game as Team Fortress 2 if you wish. :D
Maybe I can even go as far as to implement an entire RPG Maker's character creation system right in the game, just like I have implemented an entire map editor of RPG Maker inside this game. We will see if this timeline will lead us there one day.

Despite the withdrawal of the US, the good news is that we can see that Europe is on the right track to standing up.
Can you imagine even Marcon changed from this
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/79fa6b3c3b4532e8444a2092a9d75c13f4ad07ff.png[/img]
to this
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/bd5edcfae86c7af25321fb94d2ae39585744fba8.jpg[/img]
All right, memes aside, we now have French Mirage 2000 in our "The Ghost of Kyiv" minigame.
And we shall hang all those new flags of our European friends.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/450597d74051cc6934ac986c2684cd5a6ba7420c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/7eb133f56140f8a194007c863d32a15339d5bbeb.jpg[/img]
You may wonder why Ireland is here.
Well, it's because Saint Patrick's Day is near! It's a new seasonal event that will happen every year from now on. The game wiki now also has a page to list all our seasonal events.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/7c8e757785bd3f16fecb65da2720d36b4339f161.jpg[/img] 
During the St. Patrick's Day event, you will find more green hats and likely other green stuff. It covers Mar. 15 to Mar.20 in your local system time. Have fun!

Although the story in the Grand Library was no longer a high priority this week, we still got the relationship UI for the two philosophers you can meet in the Grand Library.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/602a3bd4a7d31d8ae8fdc03f8c8195d4de634a37.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/cc3f9435fe9238490edc65fb35482fbc5c1bc955.jpg[/img]
It's a preparation for the more complex development of the story.
Machiavelli also received some new dialogs encouraging decisive decisions.  

Do you think that's it?
Hell not! It's time for some teaser of our next DLC!

Even to this day, this world is still full of injustice. It's a sad reality. Over the course of your life, you will find that things are not always fair. You will find that things happen to you that you do not deserve and that are not always warranted. But you have to put your head down and fight, fight, fight. Never, ever, ever give up!
But, maybe sometimes that's not enough.
Maybe, sometimes, you want to rain your righteous fury with each bullet.
Like him
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/ac051705bc442b7bad5a7e46d333a8f924396b89.png[/img]
Then, hold no pity, show no pardon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/ef25adf77b40fc5e380d486d5cdc9772dfbec3d6.gif[/img]
As a bonus, you can even kick your enemies' dismembered parts, using their heads as balls.
I know deep down, you may sometimes have such a dark desire. It's because you feel anger against injustice. It's because I believe that as one of this game's players, you are a good person with kindness and compassion. Many of you have followed me for a long way, and you will never do such a thing even to the people you despise most in real life. But we are not superheroes; you also need to release some steam sometimes. So, may such a stress-relieving combat system help you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9b54ea047acdad83343ba98f6d49149c6b54b7f0.gif[/img]
In this new DLC, you can also find many familiar faces telling their story in a world that comes afterwards. (Well, the entire world has been changed to 3D, so you may consider it changed a lot. :P)

I realize many people fear such a DLC, and the efforts that I have spent on it and will still spend on it are like a fire. Many just want the game, a Stone Age, just like it was 20 years ago. But I’m sorry, ladies and gentlemen, more than 20 years have passed, and the world has changed. And it will no longer wait and forgive. Maybe when this is all done. When we have made the game great again, like back in 2007, we can party on the Beach of Marinas like old times. For now, our story must go forward.

It will be free.
Its release date is targeted to be sometime near our 21st Anniversary.

That's for this week. If any one of you ever feels down in your life, enduring difficulties, facing tremendous obstacles, believe and march to your sacred goal! For you are the main character of your most authentic life! Tomorrow will be another bright day in NEOLITHIA, with more updates! May her endless evolution and my pursuit bring your courage to face against all odds.

notes.title: DD#215 The Lucifer Within Us, Part III
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

This week's progress is all around the Floor of Philosophy in the Grand Library.
You may have wondered why the Floor of Philosophy seems in less disarray than other floors that fell during the cultist's attack. The answer has been revealed.

Two previously mentioned characters have made their appearance on this floor.
Machiavelli
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/6cb4c6c4d7259223ea5d42e5f79c8e3acf01ee9d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/dd11bdc635ce6f24badd0068371b3600088fc19c.jpg[/img]
He took the cultist's attack as an opportunity, acted accordingly, and expanded this influence and power.
Now, he is claiming to be the librarian of this floor.
Is he?
"There is no truth, only interpretations."
Although Machiavelli serves as the introduction character of the situation, you will soon find yourself interrupted by another man standing beside him.

Nietzsche
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/8294bacd3cff7d874f6c405b71a58a837f1be9f8.jpg[/img]
He considers the suffering and obstacles to be something to overcome, something meaningful for heroes to grow. He despises the social norm that encourages the content of being weak and relying on others.

Thus, by combining their power, instead of praying for an external power to intervene, they get everything under control and even capture some invaders they are discussing how to deal with.

Of course, as the developer, I am, after all, a human being. Thus, I have my personal preferences. You will find more content on Nietzsche than on Machiavelli this week.
There are more dialog options on Nietzsche; one of them requires some historical skills to unlock, and another can unlock a new faith tenet you can use when building your customized faith.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/17d157ed3b8d82bf2fd8a1bedc4ae3d0f6da3d21.jpg[/img]
When talking about Nietzsche, you just cannot not have the Will to Power here.
It encourages growth. It tells you to be your most authentic self so that you will not fear or be silenced just because you are different than the herds of "normal." It certainly makes a lot of people angry, just as  Nietzsche did in his time. Thus, it also allows you to cause additional emotional damage.
During the dialogs, you may also find some hints that Nietzsche may have already broken the veil and seen the supernatural world behind it that can make weaker minds falter. But that also makes him sometimes look and sound like a madman in the eyes of those who cannot understand. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/ed9d6a54c5f683e3b75d9fd8e9b6793fd4a2299e.jpg[/img]
Well, Nietzsche is just so awesome! (And he really wrote a book about why he is so awesome. It's in the public domain.)

Of course, not all philosophers are so badass that they totally annihilated all invasion forces.
Some just don't care.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/82bb34a3394743510c3f4a54fd510e1ba52eb2de.jpg[/img]
As long as you don't block their sun and... WiFi signals.
This is based on the famous conversation between Alexander the Great and Diogenes.
Now you know who is inside that big urn. :P
Well, to be fair, I think many of us nowadays can live quite content as long as there is a stable internet connection. Maybe, the few hours after work and before sleep online is the only happiness to many adults. Such small happiness is the only thing that allows them to endure their lives in this quite fucked up world.
Should you want an urn of your own, you can now also purchase it as a furniture from various furniture vendors.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/db0c9d295cadb84059b3b98213430d22f09177b0.jpg[/img]


That's for this week, a kickstart of the stories on the Floor of Philosophy. The story shall continue further in the next.

notes.title: DD# 214 Three Years Ago the War Started
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

Warning: heavy political content ahead!
Turn back if you are not comfortable reading such things.

First things first, this week marks the 3rd year of Putin's invasion of Ukraine.
Neolithic, as the longest-living RPG in China and the longest-living RPG Maker in the world, has stood with Ukraine since the start of the war. I believe this is something all of us can be proud of. 
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1519140/view/4176595993577347038
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1519140/view/3119310025773834317
Ukraine-related content has been an integrated part of the game as every day, along with the game's daily updates, you can also find the latest news from Ukraine right inside the game.
Facing the rising of radical leftists and censorship, we are continuously bringing up the awareness of Ukraine. Even though many consider such content too political for games, many are trying to take down such content. (Seriously, those guys are not Putin's assets?)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9335ffac122c95b556ea56f97d783df8c58fbcf8.jpg[/img]
We have stood our ground. And our support for Ukraine never wavers!
Some may call such a statement right-leaning. So be it. We shall be on the right side of history, for our more than twenty years of history beckons. That's why we shall support Ukraine! You can see all the virtues that the Ukrainian people have shown the world in this war: their patriotism, resilience, bravery when facing an enemy many times their size, faith in God, and love for their loved ones. They have everything the "right" people desire. Thus, if someone claims to be right and does not support Ukraine, they do not deserve to be called "right."
On this 3rd anniversary, once again, we got new in-game content to remember this war.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/298ad08f13d3761f35dc124b6550b18e008579f7.jpg[/img]
You can now find Russian Orc troops invading various procedurally generated locations.
"We shall not flag nor fail. We shall go on to the end. We shall fight in France and on the seas and oceans; we shall fight with growing confidence and growing strength in the air. We shall defend our island whatever the cost may be; we shall fight on beaches, landing grounds, in fields, in streets, and on the hills."  --- Winston Churchill
Although our procedurally generated locations don't have all those kinds of environments, you get the idea. This is a salute to the brave Ukrainian soldiers who are doing this right at this very moment.
Слава Україні! 

Now, let's go down to this week's other content updates.
The quest of the Lucifer Within Us reached an ending. It's a bad ending featuring betrayal and human cruelty.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/2532287145efb4fee042ba36eaf290c0d3b79e12.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/1e7f125f55c49785151750450e71696c5a08adab.jpg[/img]
We will have other branches and different ways to continue the storylines next week.
But for now, let's take a break from it for a bit since this quest is not the main content of this week.

Even when the story so far and the world we live in may be grim at this moment.
Don't forget, there are always small things here and there that can cheer you up.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/6f95a67e6f1aefc909b0d7cecde54ad9b9e473e9.jpg[/img]
Here is a behind-the-scenes story:
A few days before the German election this week, one of my German friends told me she was worried about whether Musk's efforts would really help the AfD win and that this timeline would become even darker. She got an emergency hug, and in the end, Friedrich Merz, the man who said he would give Ukraine Taurus, won! Isn't this fantastic?
(Once again, you may call me right-leaning. But I am not that kind of far-right like AfD. Maybe I am more like centre-right. Well, there is no truth. Feel free to put your own interpretations. After all, this game, this world you live in, is yours and yours alone to experience and come to your own conclusion! We will get more on this part later, maybe next week.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/2f5923cd2ee5da1fc5835ecd1143bb133309ddcc.jpg[/img]
Musk's Grok describes me as a very busy person who updates the game and supports Ukraine every day. I am also a lawyer in charge of some legal business, managing risk controls technically and legally for various companies in and out of the game industry. I also have other personal projects. One of the most important things is to always stay energic and efficient. Work hard and play harder! So, you may find me consuming a lot of energy drinks whenever I feel like it. As such, I think I shall add it into the game, too. Technically, you can properly make better potions or coffee. But this is just something to give you a quick boost without the need to bother with alchemy or cooking.

Now, here is another feature of this week.
The Valuable Items (We shall all thank Shanakor's for such an excellent suggestion.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a04b2ae350fe3f012cf0ef7b40fc828ad7d9f04e.jpg[/img]
You can now mark any item in your inventory as "valuable."
A valuable item cannot be sold, sacrificed to enhance another item, or dropped unless you unmark it first. As such, you don't need to worry about accidentally "making a deal" with some funny-looking short-memory businessman who claims to be the President of United States and lose something important to you. :P
(OK, since Trump is no longer so hostile to Ukraine since yesterday, I will no longer put the rest of the previously planned badmouth content here. I still support him in general. But that does not mean I agree with everything he does. In a democracy, a president is to serve. I support him because he can serve my agenda better to force the release of Israeli hostages, to wake up the European nations, and much more. Feel free to call me cold-blood if you wish. This is just business.) 

That's for this week. Our political survey is now also closed. Again, thank you for your participation. It's pretty much like various highly diverse secret organizations all over the world anonymously casting their votes on how we run this world. And I shall shape this world accordingly.
Next week, the focus will be back on the Grand Library and the continuation of the storyline.

notes.title: DD# 213 The Lucifer Within Us, Part II
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

This week, the quest "The Lucifer Within Us" officially started. All the current story content is on the Floor of Religion in the Grand Library. Yes, everything about this quest so far is about a certain book. (A misplaced book that was not supposed to be on this floor. A book from real life talks about how good people can do bad things. A book whose author witnessed one of the most infamous experiments in human history. He also passed away just last year.) To avoid spoilers, I am not going to tell you the name of this book here directly. But if you know the name of this book. Ah, I see, you're a Man of Culture as well. :D

There is a lot of killing in this quest so far.  Certainly, it can cause some discomfort.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/0084cdac30d9800b4fdd955097eff6293839171c.jpg[/img]

Because we are human, we are programmed to have compassion for other human beings in our genes, except for those people who are categorized as psychopaths or sociopaths who lack the capability to feel sympathy for others.  The difference is psychopaths are born while sociopaths are acquired. They are not very good people, right? No, the world we live in actually rewards them. They are usually more efficient in many cases. Although the book does not train you to become a sociopath, it does provide some insight into how people can get into a state that allows them to do cruel things to others.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/08f64612ee76ecdb61e7c4bb140a8de36887a03f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/3e35c36613186a6af17c2f8873cd7a21c2fbddb9.jpg[/img]
During the quest, you can acquire those "skills" to benefit you.
They all sound quite evil, right?
But knowledge by itself has no right or wrong; it all depends on how you use it. For example, you can dehumanize a target people to start a genocide. Or, you can also dehumanize an enemy who is invading your country, torturing your neighbors, and kidnapping your kids to rally resistance against them. Sounds familiar? Such an enemy is called Orcs or Z-ombies in Ukraine right now. Even though you may not want to use those skills, having an awareness and knowing how others may use them is still beneficial.

Meanwhile, the art assets for another character that will appear on the Floor of Philosophy are ready.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d9a7e3539bdcd82bb520fd67e5746eb8c652f54f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f83a26d2c66ca5b61e9798dcbdc91391d1911b33.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/cb2e7ed090243fb5ab927a24dad3b69d2fdf6fa3.gif[/img]
"Everyone sees what you appear to be; few really know what you really are. This is as it should be."
Something quite fits this game, which has a lot of secret society and covert operations, doesn't it?

Well, he will appear after I'm done with the Floor of Religion. But I'm not going to talk about him right now. But another character whose art assets I introduced last week. Some of you may have data-mined and learned who he is. Previously, I planned to talk about him next week. However, given the current fast-changing global situation, all thanks to Donald Trump. I think I shall talk about him right now. I have foreseen the direction of this development. But I didn't expect it to be in such a dramatic manner. Well, played. Now, let's get to the point.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/ac0e685bb1f5cb44131acaef7cd12ce6d9f13ee6.jpg[/img]
Never before in the past 50 years have European nations had such a need to examine this person's work so closely as they do now. People are getting too comfortable in high-welfare societies, encouraging contentment and dismissing ambitions and the "Will to Power." This time, you cannot expect some superheroes from another side of the ocean to save you. You must be the heroes yourselves to write your legends. It will be painful. But "what cannot kill you will make you stronger."
Some may say the US betrayed their allies. I don't think that's too bad. At least, it's not like in a scenario where when the US troops come, you suddenly learn they are on the other side of the war. It's not like a betrayal as great as it is in Isstvan V in Warhammer Universe. It's not fatal. And I don't believe the descendants of Sparta, the descendants of the knights who fought in Tours, and the descendants of the Winged Hussars who rescued Vienna cannot defend Europe again, even on their own. 
Some may denounce his work as lacking pity for the weak and call him a tyrant, but I read him and can feel his love for human evolution. After all, being kind itself cannot save the world; you must be strong and powerful. This is one of the many motivations behind every update of this game in its more than twenty years of history.

More shall unfold when we get there.
To those who still think Europe is weak and cannot survive Trump, "Stop blaming your own incompetence on cosmic forces. The side of good isn't weak; it's you."

History will remember when the US betrays Ukraine; we are still here to support Ukraine. What story can be more epic than this?

That's for this week. Hopefully, both the in-game content and the real-life events have brought you something meaningful. (As I said last week, it may not be a happy story. But hopefully, it's something meaningful) I also see some interesting developments in our still-open political survey, as people can edit their answers anytime before it closes at the end of this month. Thank you for your participation.
