notes.title: DD# 212 The Lucifer Within Us, Part I
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to the developer's diary on Valentine's Day.

The game has already automatically set up some seasonal content based on your local system time. There is delicious chocolate, heart-shaped balloons, and lovely double beds. Have fun before we dive into something much darker.

This week's main content update focuses on a revisit to the Grand Library. How didn't the Floor of Religion fall? How did those nuns get corrupted? Who is the Killer Monk? Why is there a sloth demon on this floor? Many questions were left unanswered previously.

Some questions have been answered in this week's updates.
You can now find the librarian's room on this floor with various documents on a computer describing the events that happened before and during the attack on the library. You can also find another new section of this floor with a very gruesome scene. (OK, because this game is R14 to R16, depending on global rating standards. It's not that gruesome. But you get the idea.) There are some corpses and tomato juice everywhere there. But, on the good side, you can also get some more clues and loot.

After piecing together everything, you may know more about how the traitor of the library engineered the falling of this floor, even under the circumstance that it was heavily guarded by agents from various factions. The corrupted nuns, the sloth demon, and the Killer Monk are all the outcomes of this catastrophic event.

However, in order not to spoil too much about the story. Let's talk about the background of the story instead. Have you ever wondered how sometimes good people can do horrific or even diabolical things? It's not about seemly friendly neighborhood villagers burning "witches" in medieval. It's not about the Reign of Terror during the French Revolution, where revolutionaries executed each other by Guillotine. It's not about the best minds of Germany having a calm discussion on how to systemically genocide Jews during the Wannseekonferenz. It's not about lovers; parents and children report each other to get them purged by Stalin. It's not about the red army committing mass rape when they got into Berlin.
Maybe it's about all of them. But it's more about what is happening right now in this world.
Multiple wars have broken out and are ongoing right now.
Horrific war crimes have been committed all across the war zones.
People are doing callous things to each other beyond everyone's imagination.
Other than those hot wars, other types of wars are getting more extreme. You can now see people threaten to jail each other because of different political views. You can now see people trying to censor others just because they can easily get mad at disagreements. You can now see the rise of that both horrific and hilarious "cancel" culture. Back in 2012, you could not imagine Obama's supporters would want to send Romney's supporters to re-education camps.
Those are all happening right now instead of some faded memories of the world from more than 80 years ago. However, except for very few people, I don't think all those behind those actions are born evil with a strong desire to harm other human beings. In a different situation, they may just be another person with their own virtues. (Admitting this is important to avoid falling into a trap that they may have fallen into.)

During the game's story, we will explore the motivation behind some of those atrocities committed by "common people." Depending on different perspectives, we will then explore how to counter or exploit this. (After all, it's ultimately your choice how to use knowledge.)


Of course, a new story requires new characters.
So, here we go:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/4762cfb6bfa0eec74537976473d755694d2317e7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/31c37d8844a3c3c176b70954d6a6b3f59f6da5c8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/4d521b1ae0826a4733de69ed35c6235a4b318948.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/ac0e685bb1f5cb44131acaef7cd12ce6d9f13ee6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/26591c9c2d9adf4c7220cd23212095782734e3bb.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/69825793b827db73f5566ab00da5732c9812563e.gif[/img]

Other than the updates in the Grand Library, we also have some other content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/1116c5cbcb194e5e390afe09552ebb15ae53e3e5.jpg[/img]
Certain tenets of your customized faith can now affect the local environment if you have some influence in those locations. For example, if your faith has "cat worship," you may motivate more people to love cats and consequently see more cats on the street.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/df6bece0a2f19371411c7267574823e8a56b2ebc.jpg[/img]
In Siberia, Rasputin also gained some content. He can now heal you for free and tell you some information about the story's direction. (Some players from the SAPC++ era may recognize those names.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/cedf1ab55340adf899c4dd9507fb8338cb1bfaae.jpg[/img]
In Liu, random people on the street may now have some reaction if Trump is in your group.
After all, it's quite unrealistic if people in China see someone who looks like Trump and has no reaction at all. (At least, I know when Gabe visited Shanghai, he got "harassed" by many people who passed by and recognized him.)
Most people in China have a relatively positive impression of Trump for various reasons.
Some like him because he is "funny,"
Some like him because his speech is encouraging.
Some like him because he is "more human" than other politicians.
Some like him because he will likely push Europe or other political factions to become more independent from the US and grow stronger so that the US will not be the only superpower in the world. (It's simply too risky if one nation can dominate the fate of the world, isn't it? Maybe we can still fix this and have some diversity in the power distribution by forcing people into action.)
Some like him because there are not enough choices. (Unlike many nations in the world, the US has only two parties. People can either be left or right, one or another; no wonder things get extreme. )
If you had to choose between Stalin and Hitler, which one would you choose? Many European nations faced this question in WW2.  Will you blame Finland for working with Hitler? Will you blame the Baltic for bowing to Stalin? 
This is not an argument about whether this is right or wrong or whether the reasons various people give are convincing. It is something for everyone's own self-discovery and growth. Everyone can agree or disagree on different things. (You technically can even kill all those random citizens on the street if you really want to. But, will you?) After all, what is important is that everyone can make their own decision to be themselves without being compromised. Just like this game is yours to play, and it has a focus on freedom of choice when engaging in various activities. 

As such, there is also one last thing for this week:
https://forms.gle/EL6xQUubFyXCqgeQ7
A political survey has been launched so that everyone in this community can freely express their ideas on different matters. All answers will be kept secret, and no personal information will be collected, but they may affect what happens next in the game. (None of the reasons why people like Trump is from this survey. They are all from something much older, back in 2016.)  You can also edit your previous vote in case things change. The survey will stay open till the end of February. Thanks to everyone who has already participated. Most of the questions have very diverse answers. They are all very helpful in letting me learn from your different perspectives. This is an important way to avoid extremism. 

That's for this week. The journey of revisiting the Grand Library has just begun. It may not be a happy story, but hopefully, it will be meaningful.


The full update log of this week:

Hi, everyone. We all know the game has a large amount of content related to modern-day politics, and we also have a big and diverse community across the globe. Thus, I decided to try something different this time. Here is a political survey:
https://forms.gle/3Dba4Ex5x75i7EHi6

You can answer by expressing your views on certain matters, which may impact future game content updates. In NEOLITHIA, we have true Freedom of Speech, so feel free to voice what you believe in. All collected data will be kept secret, and I will not even know who answered the survey.


諸君，眾所周知，我們的遊戲中存在大量和現代政治有關的內容。而同時，我們有一個跨越全球的龐大而多樣的玩家群體。所以，我決定這次來試著進行一次不一樣的實驗。這裡有一份調查問卷：

notes.title: DD#211 The Chaos After the Spring Festival
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to the first developer's diary of February.

The Spring Festival holidays are over in China. (Well, in a traditional sense, it shall end after 15 days since the Spring Festival. However, in modern days, people have to get back to their work much earlier. Why? Don't ask, comrade. The official version is always to blame the USA. :D) 

Anyway, the chaos is over. Now, let's get back to the game content of this week.
Last week, I mentioned many things in my plan. Instead of focusing on one, why don't we get as many of them done as possible? So, let's get started.

First, about the Spring Festival: It's a time for family reunions. In a traditional sense, the term family does not just refer to the living; it also extends to deceased family members. Thus, in rural areas of China, you can still see people holding ceremonies. Before the living starts their feast, the ghosts of the deceased shall "eat" the delicious food first. The living also shall burn ghost money for the deceased so that they can have a good afterlife. (Surprisingly, it's heavily influenced by Zoroastrianism, a religion of pre-Islamic Iran that somehow found its way to China long ago. Thus, people believe that fire can send items from the material world to the spiritual world.)
Thus, we now also have Ghost Money in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/6dc3a3a2918627c6ea89215d88233a3a892beba0.jpg[/img]
In addition to its traditional usage, you can also use it to pacify hostile ghost entities.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/512aa571f571a30373b1ed72ef2437ff22e09afd.jpg[/img]
Although not all ghosts can be pacified this way, it may be a good addition for you to clean some haunted locations without any tough fights.

Next, we need more types of heavier machine enemies in the Jiru direction other than those cannon fodder machine skeletons.  So, here we go.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/492bfe14372b92226e4a715894d4710eb5fe2e02.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b51f5366abfee2a47cdf532de339ffbeae0e070b.gif[/img]
Near Dana, you can now find the new Assaulter M.K.IV units that serve as stormtroopers to break the defense lines of the survivors. They have their own AI scripts that focus on quickly disabling their targets and then taking them down with stronger attacks.
As more intelligent machines, they may also drop a new type of chip which may be useful in future updates when you craft something.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a5a43e85cf61a77f13ab9ae77a354595878716fb.jpg[/img]
Other advanced intelligent machines may now also drop this type of chip too.

And then, another kind of snake just joined the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/1e4e4200850abe7e8fd7ae6b455af36c6cb85c20.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/6a1e07fd0621ade709a2c7c25d99e07feb0a4daa.gif[/img]
This new wind-element snake, known as Ehecacoatl, is somehow influenced by Aztec religions. You can find them near the entrance of the Xuanhuang Cave. They are not your mundane snakes. Instead, they may cast strong wind spells.
On the other hand, you may turn them into your pets or slaughter them to get their unique meat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d3fc6b0155be4705dc86c6e7e367e94c0b4dc82e.jpg[/img]
In many old religions, it's commonly believed that if you eat something, you can gain a slice of the power that once belonged to what you eat. At least, it's true in this case. But, in modern days, people rarely eat raw meat. Thus, you can use such meat to make dishes or make potions. Those dishes and potions can inherit the attribution that enhances your wind spell power.

In addition to a new snake, we also get something for Serpent-Men.
The Serpent-Men can now summon some mundane snakes to assist them in battles. However, that's not all. All civilization is nothing without faith. Thus, they now have their own faith, too.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/5749a45b2aace658c0281b4e32be4829993378d8.jpg[/img]
That brings us to another Great Old One. Yig, the Father of Serpents, is who they worship.
In addition to what Lovecraft has written, what if all those Snake Gods and Goddesses, from Quetzalcoatl and Kuklkan in the Aztec and Mayan cultures to Nuwa and Fuxi in China, are merely avatars or offspring of Yig? What if many human leaders have been replaced by serpents and reptilians? You can find the Book of Yig dropped by the Serpent-Men or from the Great Library to unlock this new faith.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/8f60da0fed4ff7423f088a6dc124a71a53a7bb8f.jpg[/img]
Faith is what you believe in, even if others may not agree. Do you want to believe this is the truth or burn it as another heresy?
One thing is certain: once you pick this as the core of your customized faith, you can get a lot of snakes on your side.

The best part is yet to come!
Here, another new feature just got added!
Say it again; time is about to speed up!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/7edc4180f2d86a05a0a3936bf8c74ecbfcc3aa36.jpg[/img]
You can now hold down the shift key on your keyboard to make all battle animation runs much faster.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/589e1dfee42bca17dc475b78154a9dce7e828f21.png[/img]
This is made in heaven!

OK, that's for this week. Have fun!

notes.title: DD# 210 The Year of Snakes
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Happy Lunar New Year! Welcome to the first developer's diary of the Year of Snakes.

As mentioned previously, we got a lot of snake-related content this week.
First, we got two more types of snakes in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a3343c660139a65fa80de1dcb09d01dbeecc66d2.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/04469fe44430806806d7092b31b68db8c1ea593c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/c316c6b4077c265b68288a39cab2e7d73d559dfa.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/7e15c2471e28579f76f7a0dc3bd5f880d06ea335.gif[/img]
You may find those blue Water Snakes in some moist areas, such as the Sewer of Liu, while those Mudscale Snakes will appear in cave areas. You can turn them into your pets if you wish. Each of them may come with their own unique traits.

Meanwhile, a new type of enemy known as the Serpent-Men Infiltrators have infiltrated and trapped in the Abandoned House (a.k.a anomaly UPEX-5182) 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/2e4ea6a97caebc23023a2f33b5791f5abd5f35a4.gif[/img]

If you don't want to go to those locations around the world to find them, they will also appear in random locations generated by the Wonderland Travel Agency. The Agency now has a new enemy theme, known as the Snake Entities. All maps with this theme will generate all kinds of snake-related enemies mentioned above, plus those already in the game. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f29734a9f8ad59ba324aa10dcc3facd66fab9caa.jpg[/img]

Of course, they don't necessarily have to be enemies. The second big update of this week is a huge improvement on the "Snake Worship" tenet. If you have this tenet in your customized faith system, you can now find some more beneficial effects it has.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/e3715b234f5a7917857e433121d58c636ac4a681.jpg[/img]
You can now spend devotion to turn snakes into your pets directly.
You can now spend devotion to pacify them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9fa62b835704dcb887aa9938e401f7c793860631.jpg[/img]
Each type of snake may require a different amount of devotion for you to take those actions.

That's not everything. During this week's updates, we also finished another part of the Dark Elf King's story, and here is something for all our fellow ancient Stone Age players:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/6a5076d6122067d48d6b94ce266d3fbb09e5a6a8.jpg[/img]
The return of Marifirya is on schedule. Get your pets ready if you know what that means. :D
To make this a reality, we also just got a massive map expansion all the way to the South of Dana, where we will continue many of our major storylines. But before that, I will work on some more machine creatures.

The Dark Alley of Liu also received some updates. The maps continue to expand to the North, and you can now convert those gangsters to follow your faith. At the end of the new expansion, it's another building holds a well-known local urban legend of China to be revealed. (You may already find its document in the local Public Security Bureau office.)

That's for this week. Happy The Year of Snakes! More snake-related content and some of the things I mentioned above will come the next week. The Spring Festival is temporary. The glorious evolution of NEOLITHIA is eternal!

notes.title: DD#209 Treasures Along the Way
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone; welcome to another week's developer's diary.

This week's story content brings us back to Killian's mansion in Hottle. You can now find a way to this retired adventurer's vault room and take whatever treasures he keeps inside. 
Here are some of them you can find:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/4a6eeb7aa0d8570983422e8aace9552f4b2e0927.jpg[/img]
"Maybe The Real Treasure Was the Friends You Made Along the Way." But with a dark twist.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/df245e01d2eda23e6c4471202bc8b207a5d25848.jpg[/img]
You can guess what's inside.

However, those two chests may not be the reason why you are here. If you have progressed far enough in the Dark Elf King's storyline, you may get a quest from the Black Frog King to retrieve a treasure that has been long stolen from a group of adventurers. With some investigation, you can easily piece together that Killian is one of those adventurers, and the Black Frog King's treasure is right in his vault. However, he will warn you that treasure is evil and can invoke violence even from the most peaceful heart. From here, you may find this item's true nature and decide accordingly. Maybe you will let out a sigh when you see the icon of this treasure. It's another twist that may make you feel life is a joke.

The Black Frog King also tells you to punish the thief as you see fit. So, there are a lot of options. You can kill him, harvest his soul, enslave him, or do whatever nasty thing you can think of. (If you use an identify wipe collar on him, he will turn into a unique human pet.) But, as long as you leave him alive, he will turn hostile from now on. 

Anyway, once you have returned the Black Frog King's treasure. The Black Frog King shall reward you with something special. As we know, he has a lot of magic weapons hoarded in his lair. Thus, I am going to do this a bit differently. You can choose what kind of weapon you want with a prefix of your choice.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/4e66172922fb3b8579dee0061dbc42784f5408bf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/efdbba939fd9a15675f2ca0409e5dd13645ceadc.jpg[/img]

Afterward, he will also be more than happy to assist you if you are on a quest given to you by the Dark Elf King. Everything is intwisted here. However, as this game has great freedom in how you do almost everything, you can decide how to finish all those quests in any order. I have put in all the details to ensure all cases can run smoothly. That also includes the fact that if you lost your mission items, you can get them back in the Lost & Found stores. By the way, a new Lost & Found store just opened in Fjordr; it comes with a unique background story related to an ongoing war.

As such, a quest about those treasures along the way is concluded. Here, we shall have some music.
Oh, wait a second, we didn't have music skills before. Why don't we get it now?
So, music is now another life skill in the game. Your story teammates now have some levels of music skills by default. You can also get music skills by practicing, reading skill books, or equipping certain items with a new prefix.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/30e855d868e73ef447e21f3ae3285876ca6f969b.jpg[/img]
As always, skill books come with their own twisted stories in this supernatural world.
This one is inspired by a Warhammer 40K horror story about Slaanesh, while the Empire's totalitarian oppression of their own people makes the chaos god feel like a lesser evil.
You can use music skills in various situations. For example, you can now use your raw music skill level to pass the piano puzzle in the House Near a Paddy Field.
You can also use your music skills to charm snakes to stop them from attacking.

Oh, right, snakes. With the Year of Snake just a week away, it's time to get more snake-related content.
At least some art assets are ready:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/22fddd4d82ebbcd4bad556c9c4162badd6a37de9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/2e4ea6a97caebc23023a2f33b5791f5abd5f35a4.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9cbe0353e23bc55984473c882f08403bb785de43.gif[/img]
Have you heard the lore about how Serpent People once ruled this planet before humans did?
Maybe they will even interact with another lost prehuman civilization, too.

That's it for this week. The music will continue so that Azathoth does not wake up and end his dream, known as this reality.

notes.title: DD#208 The Bearer of the Word - Part II
notes.notes:
Hi, my fellow faithful, welcome to another week's developer's diary.

[b]This week, you can see your faith's influence continue to grow[/b] with more and more people you can convert to your cause. From the beggars and homeless to the police officers and even the monks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b613138afd01b6a89a72f5075a81b3237149d488.jpg[/img]
For each successful conversion, they shall add their contribution to your influence in this area.

Each follower may have their own original belief. The closer your faith is to theirs, the easier they will convert. A police officer who believes in Law and Order may try to follow your faith that has this tenet when they are disappointed with a corrupted legal system they see no other ways to improve. A monk may consider your Buddhist faith not so different from theirs but more true. A random citizen in China may be more happy to join your faith if you also claim to be a descendant of Dragons. 

Each follower may come with a different background. May such diversity be your strength. Let the monks who joined your faith spread your words and gather devotion. Let the police officers secretly follow your truth and provide you a path to escape the prosecution of the false authority in time of need.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d5de55f38bdcbd708083d872b372469788d94db5.jpg[/img]
(Well, not necessarily "Hydra," they just put your faith's name here. You may get something more creative.)

Meanwhile, you no longer need to convert new followers one by one, all by yourself. Once you have enough devoted followers, you may see your faith's local influence passively grow on its own. You may also invest your resources in some old-school propaganda. Maybe you can post some religious articles on that infamous fake new newspaper known as the "Universal Times" and see some naive people come to join your flocks without any second thoughts.

As your faith grows and more people of different occupations join your ranks, various effects will appear on your faith influence page.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/651e190434941764b2ec8e0d0e105f007019de18.jpg[/img]
In this supernatural cold war behind the veil, we may win it by simply conquering people's hearts.

[b]With the spreading of your faith, we also discovered more faith tenets that you can further customize your desire.[/b]
Astrologers proclaim the coming of the Year of Snake as the Year of Dragon will soon depart.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/4259e5def9e676a3d5f0abd44230a372f093dde6.jpg[/img]
More snake-related content may randomly appear when we approach the Year of Snake in the Chinese Calendar.
But since we are not there yet, maybe we should also give the Year of Dragon a departing gift.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f418205a5dd0c34dcf3347e8908b1825404f5a60.jpg[/img]
The Descendant of Dragons is a cultural identity of many people with East Asian ancestors.
But you know Dragons come in different colors if you have learned it in the game's lore. Many can make such a claim while having totally opposite beliefs. It's still an ongoing war of succession among various factions. Will yours be the one who comes out victorious to be the true heir?


Aside from the religious and ideological turmoil,  the other parts of the world are also evolving.

The save/load menu now has multi-thread support to make everything much faster.

The master of a certain house in Hottle finally revealed himself, foreshadowing a new story.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/7b5a2437b7fdb72a51c38b52e983e31bc0752e8a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/714eb7ce2f11d37c744838369d9d4953ebc50a7d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a8dca365ff7b3758df04d8e332f73828623a09a3.jpg[/img]

With enough persuasion, you can now even officially turn your emotional-support demon into an emotional-support demon cat instead.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/ca8993afc83d6eabfb8b64d9f7dd3826c2840460.jpg[/img]
Yes, it's been a community meme for quite a while.

That's for this week. Will you be a saint to serve as a shepherd to your followers or be a cult master to dominate the world and further your own gains? It's all your tales to tell in this vast open world.

All I ever wanted was the truth, to build a world of greater pursuit, to bind all hearts in devotion's decree. The voice of truth shall be heard, for I am the Bearer of the Word!

Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.
Have you ever wondered what would happen if you could spread your customized faith to every corner of the world, gaining followers and influence? 
During this week's update, this is starting to come true. You can now convince random citizens in Liu to follow your faith. By passing a persuasion check, maybe you can let them reconsider their beliefs and learn the one truth that is your faith. There are many facts that can affect the difficulty of this persuasion skill check, such as the complicity of your faith and if they like you enough.  Of course, a tenet like the "Word Bearer" can reduce the difficulty by about 30%.

In many religions, spreading the faith is a way to show your dedication and, in general, a good thing to do as you are trying to save other people's souls. Thus, you can now also find many of those belief cores that allow you to gain devotion by converting more people to your faith. But not all centers of belief have this feature, such as a certain elitism, one that prefers you to keep the truth to very few best people like you in the world while trying to rule the majority of talentless people from the shadow. However, a faith core is not everything. Some tenets can adjust this. Such as, once again, the Word Bearer tenet can allow you to gain devotion by converting others no matter what faith core is on your customized faith.

Things can be even more fun from here. You can even try to convince those Aten Cultists that your cult is better than theirs!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/04c6facbc3b959094153888b3b9700419e55c547.jpg[/img]
Of course, the Aten Cult as an organization will not be happy that you steal their followers.

However, from a game design perspective of view, if a feature you cannot see from the UI, it's not a feature at all. Thus, a relatively basic UI was also added to the game just so that you can see how far your efforts have been achieved.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d5d524cd2ea297aa7d37e6e250a6799c8a7ddf3e.jpg[/img]
Yes, there will be different effects in the future depending on your faith system and how much influence it has in a certain location.

That concludes the first part of this developer's diary.

Meanwhile, this week, we also received many other content updates, in addition to the feature of spreading all kinds of strange faiths for people to follow.

The "Family Honor" quest has been completed.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/925235dfda2d70873075372e6d0022c0d0e99f04.jpg[/img]
Two more endings, in addition to the one from last week, just arrived, giving this story three totally different endings. Sometimes, it may be easier to maintain a lie that people believe in than convince them to accept an ugly reality. That's also why many secret organizations prefer to keep the majority of the normal world in a blessed ignorance, isn't it?

More creatures appeared.
Are the outskirts of Hottle too peaceful, with only very cute animals?
Well, let's change this. Now we get more aggressive wild lives such as Boars.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9f2f9a3ddfcd2d4fb290f4cc9163c15f23abe8d9.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/2a78be2bb3844e9cb1f332483259d5d88d27f73e.gif[/img]
You can turn them into your pets. You can butcher them for meat. You can take them for a walk and see them poop around. Basically, everything your other animal-type pets have, they have them too. This is also a part of efforts to restore the biodiversity in the Nise Federation. It shall not be a merely ancient memory from that Stone Age that we had so many interesting creatures all around those islands.

What about urban environments?
Have you ever considered that maybe your cleaning bots in your house are secretly plotting to murder you when they are recharging? Maybe not the normal ones. But, well, we live in a supernatural world where everything can be real.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/6ed1e87d29d770a321b00c1228926e05ebc71f93.jpg[/img]
Maybe there are just some bugs in their program. Maybe their AI somehow concludes that human beings are unclean and should be purged from this planet. Anyway, all of a sudden, those bots may decide it's a good idea to mop the floor of your group.
Fun fact: I got this idea from Street Fighter 6. But don't worry, fridges are not going to join those cleaning bots to murder you, at least for this week.

That's for this week. I'm looking forward to seeing how many followers you can gather and unite under your faith.  :)

notes.title: DD# 206 Happy New Year
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to the first developer's dairy of 2025.

Alright, it has been the 2nd developer's diary of this week. The last one was released at the End Day of 2024. Now we are in 2025. So, Happy New Year!

Now, business as usual, let's go down to the details of this week's content updates:

First, continuing from last week's work. The "Book Slaves" are now a new type of enemy in the game:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/acc4c128bc416fa432f6483ebb5a6fdfdc736680.gif[/img]
They have some quite unique game mechanics. As they are human or corpses possessed by those corrupted books. Once the body is destroyed, the book will detach from the body and continue to fight you. (As it is shown in the image above.)

Next, the Foundation gets a new cutscene.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/376f894017b4c690739b5039596ea7318d435455.jpg[/img]
This is part of the story of the slowly developing DLC in the game. It's the first time I have used a fully UE5-rendered cutscene in the game; all previous cutscenes were made with other software.

At the same time, due to the various chaotic situations during Christmas and New Year, many people are quite exhausted. (Hopefully, this is a good thing, and everyone is using the holidays to enjoy life, do things they are usually too busy to do, or spend time with friends and family. Rather than rushing to work overtime. :D) 
As a result, many people are already quite drowsy. Sleeping is something pleasant and important. Everyone who has been busy all year deserves to enjoy a comfortable rest. (Hmm, I paused for a few seconds here to rest and then continued writing this log. After all, the evolution of this game is eternal, and there are still many things to be busy with. :D)

So a new faith tenet has been added to the game:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/bceb5b55001cc99533ab5df7ed370d15d93bfef4.jpg[/img]
Hey, do you know you can gain devotion by simply sleeping in and out of battles?
Just put this tenet to your customized personal faith. It can also help you make other people become very sleepy. :D

Fun Fact:
Originally, I planned to use a creature like this to represent this tenet:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9ebb2a025ec3c9473705841e439d5892f17416d9.jpg[/img]
However, considering that Nintendo's legal department might come over and send me a lawyer's letter, although I also have a lawyer's license and could fight them, I'm just too lazy to get into such trouble. So, to avoid the hassle, I used a cute anime girl instead.

In addition to the new game features mentioned above, I am currently working on a new storyline about a young man rebuilding his family's reputation. This is the quest called "Family Honor." It will be a relatively short task. (Relative to the Foundation's containment breach and the ever-lengthening legend of the Dark Elf King.) In fact, one of the three planned endings is already in the game. It is the shortest and most brutal one, but it is also the one that can be completed this week. The purpose of this task is to enrich the content of Fjordr and guide everyone to the Final Valor Cave. It includes many stories that happened in the past as the background of this quest. Those who have played this game for more than ten years may be familiar with some content. However, considering the ever-increasing number of new players joining the game, this quest also includes many descriptions of these past plots in dialogues and item descriptions. The guy who gives you the quest alone has four options and a lot of dialogue to handle this task. A seemingly ordinary item retrieval task may lead you to one of the biggest conspiracies in the history of the Nise Federation. Have fun. :D

That's basically all for this week, in addition to what was mentioned in the previous diary. Because of the two diaries a week, it seems a bit chaotic, but as the start of 2025, it seems pretty good. I hope this year will also be a meaningful one for everyone. We have many things to accomplish this year. Ad Victoriam!

notes.title: DD# 205 The End of 2024
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to a special Developer's Diary at the End of 2024!
Another year comes to an end in our more than 20 years of history.
So, first, here is an end-of-the-year video:
[previewyoutube=QQNbVKRr36I;full][/previewyoutube]
Backup address for people who are unable to access YouTube: https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Fc6EY4Eqf/

This game is unquestionably the longest-living RPG Maker Game in the world since its first release in July 2004. Even to this day, it's also likely one of the most frequently updated games on Steam.
According to SteamDB, we got 355 updates this year:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f290f64d9745965dcccf64ae3be921396be014f9.jpg[/img]
I see no end to the development schedule because this game is just so amazing as it is.
According to Steam, only very few really great games that can make me spend more time playing them than NEOLITHIA.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b6452ae91fc94e90e7031b2b08440342e35eb05b.jpg[/img]

The world of NEOLITHIA will continue to expand to conquer new territories, acquire new assets, and develop new technologies that can hardly be rarely found elsewhere.
We stand for both history and eternity.

It's another colorful year. Other than the game, I also made some successful investments in the stock market and was part of a winning team in some world gaming competitions. (Something more memorable is that the organizers of the game tried to turn it into a Hunger Games, and we successfully overthrew the judges, leading to the last three teams all winning together. First time in its history. Because there are many people like me who are out there, working together to make seemingly impossible things possible. I have many allies to thank for. Well, maybe it will bring more hope to this warring world. Maybe people can believe the ending of Danganronpa can happen in real-life events. And we will be remembered in that game's history. And maybe we also stopped World War 3 for another year. Who knows.)

Well, since the world does not end this year. Our story will continue next year.

One more thing, here is the latest news from Ukraine:
https://controlc.com/a5658421
https://pastelink.net/ebs7rbom
It's also available in the game's folders, which you can also access from the title menu.

The story behind this is:
Shortly after the invasion started, the game acquired a mission to spread the news from Ukraine, especially to heavily censored nations. It's part of my promise to a Ukrainian who lives in Poland. I have a good reputation for keeping my promises. As you can see, this ancient game is still updated to this day. It is all because of a promise I made more than 20 years ago. And I intend to keep it that way. As such, you may find about 1000 entries in the game's folder with almost daily news from Ukraine. Each time the game updates, you can find at least one more entry. In 2025, it will still be like this for as long as it takes. 

Anyway, Happy New Year.

notes.title: DD# 204 The Latest Developer's Diary Sneaks In
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

Updates are getting slowed down in this end-of-the-year season as there is much chaos between Christmas and the New Year. But it's still running steady and smoothly. 

Continuing from the introduction of the sneak skill last week, we got a lot of polishing around it. How an enemy rolls dice against your group's average sneak skills have been reworked, polished, and made more balanced. However, it will not be fun if you can easily know you just avoided their detection. Thus, visual feedback has also been added. You can now see your character blink a bit once they successfully defeat an enemy's detection attempt.  There are also many tech-prove works that have been done to make this system more customizable both for development and modding. Each enemy can set their detection strength differently; for example, those zombies are now less sensitive when you are running around, while those zombie dogs are still very aggressive in detecting anyone nearby. Meanwhile, additional concealment bonuses can be acquired by standing still or other means. The old smoke grenades are now part of this new system, allowing a beginner to use them to farm the sneak experience relatively easily. You can find more details on those tweaks in the completed update log at the end of this diary.

During the development of this system, I also took other games as references. One thing nobody can avoid checking into when developing a sneak system is Metal Gear. As such...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/7a015f073a9ba4864161eb2eed751074b8e11dfc.jpg[/img]
Hey! We shall have those boxes too! XD
Once you equip those card boxes on your main character, you will also see your image on the map changed accordingly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/fc823474793460dd45339176a89e71ef4a7b76ce.jpg[/img]
Totally nothing suspicious here.
When you are hiding in a box and start a conversation with random NPCs, they may also react differently.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/5dfe025e180f7a72ad9fdaac6672ea358bc1f587.jpg[/img]

There are many different ways to acquire those boxes. You can purchase them from various merchants or craft them by yourself on any 3D printer after you get the blueprint, which can also be purchased from merchants or dropped by enemies. The ones you craft may come with various prefixes, and based on your 3D modeling skills, you may get ones with better attributions.

That's not all of the change yet. Various pets now also come with different racial bonuses to allow them to have higher base sneak skill levels. For example, a cat or a ghost certainly can conceal them better than large animals such as a mammoth. In the case of ghost cats, they get a racial bonus from both being a cat and a ghost. XD 

Other than the sneak updates. I also made some new assets for new enemies that are about to appear in the game, such as this guy:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/30ba56864f41cfed351b904b5c34cf69a8b4a9e3.gif[/img]
Aliens, the whispers of an old god, viruses, and those nasty shades are not the only things that can corrupt your mind. Sometimes, it's as simple as a book. 

That's for this week. Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!

The complete update log of this week:

notes.title: DD#203 Christmas and a Colder War Part II
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Rejoice! We have reached another Christmas, and it is also the Winter Solstice in China.

Tens of thousands of Steam games are on sale, and I certainly participated in it as well.
Meanwhile, the game shall automatically detect your local system time and start the Christmas Events accordingly. You will find Christmas trees appearing in various locations, new furniture you can purchase from merchants to decorate your pocket dimension, and another every year's limited Christmas Hat to be added to your collection. 

However, behind this "normal" facet where everyone enjoys this winter holiday season, a war is still going on, a Colder War. After all, the Winter Solstice also refers to the coming of winter in China. Thus, let's embrace the chill and dive deeper into this week's content in our ever-evolving supernatural world.

The Red Dragon's special force has infiltrated Jiru Island for a while. As you make contact with them, Commissar Bao offers you [b]a job related to a suspicious device, but also with a handsome reward.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/025ed8fb7e3cfa7bf714118fd612b2f0a76a3cb0.jpg[/img]
Will you accept this offer and do as he told you?
Or
Will you report him to the Sheriff and expose his plans with the evidence you collect before it's too late?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/3f7d8cc55e3336e17898271c2c1407ddc1bc0053.jpg[/img]
Alternatively, if you cannot find any evidence, you could use your outstanding persuasion skills to convince the police to arrest him anyway.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/e46d5927644cb298888114740398cb436dcbdccd.jpg[/img]
In a classical "Trust me, bro!" style.

It's another story with different outcomes based on your choices and approaches. (If you decide to ally with the Red Dragon, an immediate outcome is that the local mayor will start to complain that his computer has become very laggy.) Even in a world with various supernatural threats that can bring an apocalypse in the next few minutes, different nations and secret organizations are still working on their own agendas to shape the world according to their desires. 
 

On another frontline, far from those Nise islands, deep in another cold place on this planet, in a Siberian church, another story continues across that ruined Russian village of meat cubes. [b]A twist and unexpected "ally" awaits you.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/c8489c321b62f9b79e8d997d6c85bd9bfbafc0bd.jpg[/img]
Can you trust him to be who he claims to be?

Of course, to add more flavor to this colder war,  the updates do not only include new stories but also more supplements in our updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/ff047d64a6db8d5907a664ad25899be62b20f983.jpg[/img]
We all know those covert operations can be highly risky. [b]Thus, new suicide pills have been added, [/b]like in old spy movies. However, as we are in a supernatural world with magic, you may easily find more creative ways to use them. For example, as you may already know, in most games, killing and reviving a character can usually remove many nasty debuffs they had. Just don't try it in real life; there is no evidence that if you kill yourself, you can actually reappear in a fantasy world filled with anime girls declaring you as the chosen one.

[b]Another exciting update this week is the emergence of sneak life skills.[/b] Unlike many other life skills, this is mostly a passive one. Your enemies will now need to pass another dice roll against your group's average sneak skill levels to be able to detect you. Combine it with smoke bombs and those assassination takedown skills; you may find a way to your victory without direct confrontations.
A new item prefix that allows those items to provide you with a sneak skill bonus and a new skill book that allows you to read and gain sneak skill experience have been added as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/8eb1d4f48ee52ac727413ffa97b35ab6e0dfa065.jpg[/img]
Like many other skill books, it tells a little story all by itself. This one is just a description of how people pretend to play the Assassin's Creed and end up actually playing the Berserker's Creed. :D

That's for this week. As usual, some unmentioned small updates are down below in the full update log. Happy Christmas as we continue to manipulate this world from the shadow in this Colder War.

notes.title: DD#202 Fishing Improvements and Other Things
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

This week, how about we go for some fishing with an entire group?
Yes, all your group members can now go fishing instead of just your main character. If one of your group members has equipped something that can be considered a fishing rod, you can now go fishing. A new UI will pop up to let you select which group member you want to send to fishing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/3041b0e1c5e3cda630d69ab9bca24aaead7f3844.jpg[/img]
This UI will display everyone's fishing skill levels, MP cost, and a warning if this character has not equipped a fishing rod.

Meanwhile, as I mentioned above, there are more types of fishing rods in the game now.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/0f323bcda4195d921e7f02efff30f2145e290564.jpg[/img]
A straightforward variation is an improved version of the fishing rod. They usually come with some bonus to your fishing skill levels.
But how about something strange?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a50270d657853e4e033a5474256a04c2d2bdab7d.jpg[/img]
Here is a new rifle barrel module that allows you to convert assault rifles into fishing rods.
Well, there is no magic or supernatural rocket science here. This idea comes from real life. There are indeed hunting-rifle fishing rods out there. Now, we have that in the game too.

So, where do we get those new items?
I decided to update all our fishing equipment vendors. First, they now share a common shop inventory list, including those new items mentioned above, which makes them easy to maintain throughout our vast game world. After that, we got more fishing equipment vendors in more towns so that the items they sell are more accessible. 

That's the fishing part. We also got some other interesting updates elsewhere too.
At an abandoned Foundation facility, some researchers have transformed into vampiric creatures, while others are now corrupted by the Shade.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/69a3d602b093883071a27ca33085f6ce2e91cceb.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/4e0a050fc7a2dc477466141a40c541bd901b4fb4.gif[/img]
They serve many different purposes during this week's updates.
One of them is to test some new AI functionalities. As they are researchers, they shall behave differently than those more brutal versions of shade creatures. They retain their knowledge to study and analyze their target's weaknesses. They are also empowered by shade to cast shade touches to cause more nasty state effects on their victims. However, it will not be very smart to spam analyze over and over again or keep casting debuff spells on the same targets. Thus, new AI functionalities have been introduced to both the decision-making and target-selecting processes of enemy AIs. Those shade-tainted researchers can coordinate their attack with other shade creatures and serve as support debuffers. They may also appear in any shade-themed procedurally generated locations you can travel to via the Wonderland Travel Agency as a new kind of threat.
Another purpose is they will be some of the earliest enemies you may encounter in a future DLC. I will reveal more details about this later.

The storyline of the Dark Elf King received some minor progress, as you may find more details from the Black Frog King about what the next thing to do will be. The expansion of Hottle and a new location in this town can be considered a preparation for this next stage.

That covers most of this week's updates. There are also some other small improvements. If you are interested, feel free to read the completed update logs below. It's almost Christmas season. The game shall automatically recognize your local system time and make seasonal content appear accordingly. Have fun! :)

notes.title: DD# 201 The 200th Week
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to the developer's diary of the 200th week of this game on Steam!

Unfortunately, this is not a very productive week because it's also the birthday season for many members of our little community. I have some interesting parties or celebrating events to attend almost every day, and there is still another one this weekend. Meanwhile, the courts in China usually rush to finish some unfinished cases in December, just like some students rush to finish their studies before exams, which is also keeping me a bit busy in my legal business.

Anyway, let's start to cover this week's updated content.
As it's the birthday season, I think we should get more cakes. So, let's head to the bakeries.
All bakeries in the game now also sell all kinds of fruit cakes in addition to those both delicious and formidable baguettes. Well, talking about baguettes, in addition to using them as food and melee weapons, I just discovered they can have another usage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/e0bbdbe99a892cf0a6ec99b97eb346b759232660.jpg[/img]
They can be RPG warheads! It's inspired by some of our French friends when we were joking around. (Well, why not? RPGs currently have fewer weapon components available than other firearms. So, one more funny one will not hurt. :D)
It can turn any RPG's ammo type into baguettes, which are 90% cheaper than normal RPG missiles at the cost of the weapon's power. (You are unlikely to use it to take down an eldritch horror. But it may still be powerful enough to obliterate some cultists. :D )

Of course, such a weapon can be viewed as a kind of HERESY!
You know who likes to shout "HERESY!" ? 
The inquisitors.  You may have heard people talking about the Inquisition branch of the Samujier Church. But now, we get the first Inquisition character to appear in the command center of the Fjordr frontline, where the Nise army is fighting supernatural machine entities.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/52001d4ef970307543b175efed7337144b0202d9.jpg[/img]
After the incident at the east barricade, you can find her arguing with a local commanding officer, denouncing his soldiers' lack of faith.

A bit away from the cold north frontline, the Illuminati field office in Hottle also received some updates.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/5cc4f7e2bf60715c01fd3d74d2315cdc700f64fd.jpg[/img]
Their building now has their all-seeing eye symbol marked on the wall.
Their iconic gas masks also received an update, allowing them to have various prefixes.
In case you missed the one in Queensmouth, this office has a 3D-printed blueprint of the gas mask. You can also purchase gas masks from their merchant here. However, he only sells the ones without prefixes. Thus, it may still be better to craft your own gas masks.

Meanwhile, in the Dark Alley of Liu, the shade corruption can now start to taint local gangsters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/1828a167c37e860dd8953c8765aa1f84ce3268f0.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/8896ff0a7197bcfa6cb163b4d9af0dac1f5c024f.gif[/img]
They are no longer human but mind-controlled shade creatures. They also no longer drop their normal loots but the shade-tainted versions. As the chance and the number of their appearance are linked to the local supernatural awareness, you can actively influence this. Should you embrace the power of the shade or want their more powerful shade-tainted equipment, you may want to increase the supernatural awareness fast and even actively spread the corruption at the cost of the relationship with other secret societies. Alternatively, you may also try to combat it to maintain a normal facet for as long as possible.

One more thing, as November is behind us, it's time for another progress video for that upcoming DLC:
[previewyoutube=1ombkVo1LqM;full][/previewyoutube]
Backup link for people who have no access to YouTube: 
https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV119zsYnEkv/
It will take a long while to release. But you know what we are getting.

That's for this week. I hope everyone enjoys this last month of 2024.

notes.title: DD# 200 The No. 4 Pawnshop
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to the developer's diary of Thanksgiving!

It's the 200th developer's diary, Thanksgiving, and the Steam autumn sale simultaneously. Thus, the game is on sale. You know what? Next week will be this game's 200th week on Steam, the Steam Early Access anniversary, and our traditional Holy Days. So, the sale will be extended for another week. Plus, it's also Christmas soon, and there will be another Steam-Wide game sale. So, I guess we can already call it the holiday season now.

Alright, anyway, let's start this week's content update rundown.

[b]If you can have a chance to get what you most desire in your life, what price will you pay for it?[/b]
Many people in Liu spend their daily lives working their hopeless jobs over and over again, seeing no real future. The economic decline only makes things worse. Some lost their jobs and could not find another one for months. Despair is like a plague spreading among the population. It's in such a desperate time that people start looking for ways out, even supernatural ones. As such, urban rumors about there exists a pawnshop that can fulfill one's desire start to emerge. As more and more people began to desire such a place's existence, it finally emerged into reality once again.

This is the tale of the No.4 Pawnstop. You can now find it deep down on a path in the Dark Alley.
Here, you may find your desire fulfilled as long as you can pawn something they consider worthy to grant you their blessing or curse.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/29f6ae049e01ab63031dff045c60ec95c7191c08.jpg[/img] 

Many functions of this location are still working in progress. But, at least you can sell some common items to exchange for money or pawn some human souls you have collected for various purposes, such as something you may be interested in.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/3c016fb538b626a032dfdaea0a3cde851b402510.jpg[/img]
Of course, a particular demon friend of yours will not be pleased about this. As he also desires those souls. A conflict of interest may grow in future updates.

Such is the first part of the No.4 Pawnstore's story.

[b]History is a terrible university major, and students cannot find a good job once they graduate, isn't it?[/b]
Oh, well, as a new life skill I just added last week, its usage is undoubtedly quite limited. But let me fix this for you. You shall have infinite opportunities to use it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/1da96d1c911c094207d334267b015293c8ea7f14.jpg[/img]
A new procedurally generated quest just appeared in the Bazaar. In this secret world of the supernatural, it's not uncommon for people to find strange historical items with various meanings. Sometimes, they cannot identify those objects by themselves. Thus, they come to the Bazaar, looking for an expert to help them. That expert can be you or your teammates if you have the skills. Such procedurally generated quests may come with various difficulties, as reflected by their descriptions and rewards. Will you choose easy jobs and earn a small amount of rewards slowly, or try something that puts your reputation at risk but may gain a huge reward? It's all up to you.

[b]What? Those annoying assholes again? Ugh, I told your superiors we should have sealed them with my concrete when we had the chance![/b]
During the story in Queensmouth, you may have heard the story about Dr. Klein and his concretes. (And how much trouble it caused to almost everybody investigating the church area.) Well, it was inspired by a meme from another game. But that game may be long forgotten by now. It's still a fun memory. So, I think I shall put more effort into making it live on in this game's eternal journey. As such, Dr. Klein's Quick Concrete is now officially an in-game item that you can use to cause some nasty effects on your enemies (or your allies, if you so desire). Usually, it can only make its victim slow down. But, if the victim is unfortunately wet, they will instantly become petrified without any resistance checks. 
A certain magic item merchant in the Bazaar can sell you this item. Alternatively, you may find a significant amount of supplies in the Unfinished Building. You may find it in local supply boxes or dropped by all those crazed construction workers.


[b]Wait, what was that smell?[/b]
This was the last word of a white wolf warrior in the Final Valor Cave. You may have pieced together some ideas about what happened in this cave based on previous clues. But here comes one more clue:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/c85bc5fb66ac3b48124e71516e7f32e69f89d20f.gif[/img]
You can now find a new type of zombie in this cave.
Of course, you can bind them to become your pets. Compared to other zombies in other places in this supernatural world, you can find they come with some very unique traits. They have a natural regeneration power. But, once they are poisoned, their regeneration power also amplifies. Rather than lose HP, they gain HP when poisoned. They are also very easy to be poisoned thanks to their very, very low resistance to poison. On the other hand, any of their physical attacks can cause poison effects. They can be very nasty foes. But, you may also make them become nasty foes to your enemies. Does this new clue confirm or deny your assumption of what happened here? Anyway, we will learn more about the background of this cave in future updates. That's for sure.

Those are some of the major updates for this week. There are certainly more. The completed update log for this week contains everything below. Happy Thanksgiving!

notes.title: DD#199 Another 1000 Days in Human History
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

This week marks the 1000 day of Ukraine's brave resistance against Putin's invasion. Thus, first thing first, a new post has been added to the game. You can find a copy of it in the Safehouse.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/92be8399059d9df55ca83b632fdfa52146ce9c16.jpg[/img]

If you have followed this game long enough, you may feel that the life we live today will become the history of the future. After all, this game has been around for more than 20 years—not a very long time. But still, I think you get the idea. Every day, the game's update is one more step in our journey to the future together. It certainly brings some important meanings with it.

As such, a new life skill has been added to the game, known as "Mundane History." It just represents a character's knowledge of this "normal" world. It is nothing supernatural, but it is still an important part of this modern-day world.

I intend to make it a bit different this time. Every character may have some knowledge of the history of the world they live in. So, all existing teammates do not start this skill with level 1, but various, depending on their background stories. If you chose your main character's background as a student, you can also start with this kill at lv6. All related code has been changed to provide retroactive save compatibility. The life skill system has also become more flexible because of those changes. Even though there may be some efficiency loss, the game is optimized enough to allow a computer from 2004 to run it. So, that shall not be a problem.

Now that we have this new history skill. Let's move on to get more pieces of human history.
First, I continued with last week's updates, and Guan Yu now has a statue.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9fdcb44023ef86491081d3514c14146a432b20bb.jpg[/img]
It's a new furniture item you can acquire from the manager of No.181 River Road.
Many business owners in China may also have such a statue in their shops in the game.
Depending on whether you have unlocked the "Guan Yu" tenet, the interact option will be different.
If you have not unlocked the tenet, you can pass a history skill check on the statue to unlock it.
If you have the "Guan Yu" tenet in your faith system, you can worship the statue and gain some temporal beneficial effects just like the Samujier statues do to these followers.

Meanwhile, about some item availability issues from the last week:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/97246c376c811c7d558de1f9f6de3a189986a31f.jpg[/img]
Since some of the players will prefer a much more peaceful approach to everything, defeating the gangsters and looting them is no longer the only way to get Guan Gong Fu. You can now exchange Dragon's Marks for both Guan Gong Fu and Guan Yu Statue in the Dragon's Treasure.

Of course, we shall also have some content from the history of other parts of the world.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9f2261cb159729871d6a827aef2b17af95be7c8c.jpg[/img]
A new faith tenet is the 2nd Amendment to the US Constitution which provides additional ammo when you shoot firearms.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/851724170c5415ee93dd10ecc467455604c0d148.jpg[/img]
A new skill originated from the tales told by British sailors, which is an attack that can cause silence. (Well, you can find the original story was much darker if you search for it.) All your newly bound cat teammates shall start this skill automatically. All existing cat teammates can learn it from the Caretaker Services. The definition of "cats" also got much wider and wilder during this week's updates.

One last thing before we end this sector: The new history skill also comes with infrastructures around it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/6353025c824956e270da31bd1a89cdf3ad19f768.jpg[/img]
War, war never changes.
So, you can find history skill books from bookstores or loot them from enemies that drop books.
Many items you can equip may also have the new "Historian's" prefix that provides various levels of history skills to buff your characters.

That covers the majority of this week's content updates. But, again, we have other small improvements across the board. For example, the pet withdrawal window of the Caretaker Services has been improved, and there are now more loots in the Fjordr Command Center. If you are interested in all the details, please find them in the completed update logs below.

The 200th developer's dairy and the 200th week on Steam will soon be upon us. And our best days are yet to come because the game's evolution never stops.

notes.title: DD#198 More in the Dark Alley
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, welcome to another week's developer's diary.

This week, our journey into the Dark Alley continues. In addition to a new battle background, better Butterfly supports, and more decorations. The main focus is on the people living here, those gangsters. Thus, the content updates about them this week can be viewed from different aspects of them.

[b]The Interact:[/b]
As mentioned in the last week. Those gangsters are not lawless bandits who want to rob you. However, they will still be alarmed by your presence in their territory. They will approach you and ask you to leave, by words or by force, one way or another. In response, you can also have various options. You can agree to leave or convince them you are not leaving one way or another.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/98fd9e25d8fd75940a8fae6cde15144468ff3ad4.jpg[/img]

[b]The Loot:[/b]
I can already see that the most bloodthirsty among us are very eager to fight them and loot them. So, they will need some loot if you decide to defeat them. That is, besides doing all those messed up things, you can already do to them after defeating all human enemies. (Such as enslavement, collecting their corpses, or sacrificing their souls to some evil deities.)

So, what does a gangster in Shanghai drop? Well, it's not like in some Hollywood movies; it's real life. You cannot find them carrying big guns or even rocket launchers to start a massive gunfight with the police forces. They may, instead, carry small daggers, but that's also rare. In most cases, you can find them using makeshift weapons you can find in your daily life, such as steel chairs, broken glass bottles, bricks, and things like those. Those are what you can expect them to drop. 

"The advantage of the steel chairs is that they can be hidden in people's houses. You can sit on them to hide your murderous intentions. Even if the police catch you, they can't sue you just because you are holding a steel chair. It is worthy of being the best of the seven weapons."  ---   《The God of Cooking》

[b]The Faith[/b]
As it was also mentioned in last week's developer's diary, those gangsters follow their own rules. Many of them worship the legendary general Guan Yu from the Three Kingdoms era of China because of his loyalty, righteousness, and martial prowess. He is both a God of War and a God of Prosperity.
Thus, if you use the "Detect Faith" skill on those gangsters, you may find they may have Guan Yu as a belief tenet in their faith system.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/44c8aaa2b3db22a489a75437cb1a52cc2819663f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/4a950cfa51fada519f9eb257a0edff8e548166d7.jpg[/img]
But not all gangsters are that traditional. Nowadays, new members of those gangs may be atheists or even nihilists. Thus, you may find them in the game as well. Even though they may be using the same graphics assets, no two gangsters in the game are exactly the same.

More background facts: In real life, Guan Yu is still widely worshipped by many people in East Asia. Hong Kong police pay respect to him to show their loyalty and resistance to corruption. Many business owners worship him to be blessed with good fortune when doing business. You can even find his temple in Osaka, Japan.

Now, how do you unlock this faith tenet?
Well, that's another item those gangsters may drop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/e18ff982a3bd4f0191aef4210e7b772a97d35b14.jpg[/img]
Guan Gong Fu is a kind of Taoism talisman believed to be blessed by Guan Yu and thus can protect people from evil forces. Some of those gangsters may carry such an item. You can unlock the "Guan Yu'  tenet just by equipping this item once. This is also a real-life item. You can easily order some from various online stores in East Asia. Meanwhile, it feels unnatural to unlock it through a religious book like many other tenets in the game because of cultural differences. Thus, I made a quite different design choice to this tenet.

[b]A "Car Dealer" in the Dark Alley[/b]
Of course, the Dark Alley has some unique gangsters who provide their unique services. Thus, we also got one this week that can help you dispose of cars you stole or acquired by various meanings. Even those toy cars you get from another timeline. You can also buy some cheap materials from him. Let's just pretend this has totally nothing to do with GTA. :D


That shall conclude the majority of this week's content updates. But, as usual, we also got some small things here and there. Things such as a new battlefield effect in the Final Valor Cave as another clue to tell the story of what happened here, and all procedurally generated citizens in Liu now have their own faith. Please find the full update log below if you want to know all the details. Have fun!

notes.title: DD# 197 A New Era Is Coming, Same as an Old One.
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to the first developer's diary after the United States presidential election.

First, I congratulate the majority of American people on successfully electing their preferred candidate for president. Everyone has their own reasons for voting for Donald Trump. Some endured terrible inflation and wanted a better life. Some had enough of the politically correct nonsense. Some want to protect their way of life. Some witnessed the horror of the democratic party dictatorship under the cancel culture they promote. Some are angry that the Biden government allowed those Hamas supporters to burn the US flags in New York without consequences, even though Harris claims to support Israel's right to self-defense. And there are certainly a lot more reasons for everyone to come together on that day to vote for Donald Trump. Otherwise, we would not have witnessed this landslide result of the Republican victory not just in the presidential election but also in the Senate and the House. The map has been painted red. 
Even though I do not live in the US, I can understand those feelings. 
[b]I, too, want games to have beautiful characters instead of ugly, politically correct characters.[/b]
Oh, well. Some may say [Neolithic]To the End, which had an engine from 20 years ago, does not have a beautiful character. How about this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/eeb154a8b1736c7fdb1f6315b148c8e2dc7ee599.jpg[/img]
This upcoming DLC is still very much a work in progress. There is still a lot of work to be done. 

[b]I, too, recently encountered democratic supporters with such cancel culture in their belief.:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/29604b5a152bb0768a76f77d211f2461775e3193.jpg[/img]
They call others fascists and nazis just because they want to censor everyone who disagrees with them. Do you know who else calls everybody they don't like Nazis and Fascists?
Putin!
They say others are fascists. Yet, their actions speak louder than their words. They must love dictatorship very, very much as long as they are the dictators. Some of them never learn their lessons; even right now, they, as a small part of the minority of the American people, still refuse to accept their defeat in this election of democracy. They still call the majority of American people morons. Very disrespectful!

[b]I, too, denounce those violent terrorism supporters, for my cousin is a police officer in New York, and his brother-in-law is a Jew. I am worried about their safety. [/b]

As such, I sent out a call to some of my friends in the US before the election: HE MUST WIN!
A last-minute mobilization you can rarely see in this game's more than 20 years of history.

Anyway, Trump wins! So, I also added a little something in the game to celebrate this day.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b5ed5f14354bf122002e26c75a6d9f09d78698d9.jpg[/img]
Your teammate "Trump"'s relationship interface has been long overdue. But I think this is a good time to add it to the game, finally. 

[b]Of course, there are some concerns about Ukraine.[/b] It's understandable. But don't forget, we were already here before the US sent her first military aid. In February 2022, when the whole world did not believe in Ukraine, we did, and we still do. I hope Donald Trump will make the right decision to help Ukraine to win this war. I mean, this is not something that hard. Look at Biden; he still has 90% of aid not sent to Ukraine 2 months before the end of his term. All talks and no actions are not very helpful. But even if Trump does not, even if in the worst-case scenario, it will just make our support and Ukraine's inevitable victory more epic. In this war, we are here to support Ukraine and Ukraine alone. We have faith in Ukraine and Ukraine alone. If the US helps, then good. If not, then history will just remember us, not the US. 


OK, let's end all those election-related dramas here.
Let's see what other game content we have. My main focus of this week is still at the Black Frog Cave and the Dark Alley of Liu. Let's go down to them in this order.
The Black Frog Cave:
The throne room of the Black Frong King is now fully accessible. You can find the Black Frog King, talk to him, and learn more information. The Dark Elf King's story also has some slight progress here, but just some dialog. I think I still need to refine how the story will unfold as it carries the weight of our long history of this game.
Of course, in the king's court, there is more than just the Black Frog King. You can meet his chef. After all, all royal monarchs shall have a royal chef to cook them nice meals. 
However, you will also find that because humans keep coming here and stealing their treasures, they have grown a passion of hatred even in their recipe.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/6ebb4268ceff1acd19afd987db9157743bc32eef.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/28ec07b63a8f59b24cfbb5ff16ce2976b5505b67.jpg[/img]
You don't want to waste any remains of a dead body after you put its head on a stick.
That's also one of the reasons why the Black Frogs earned a terrible reputation among nearby townfolks.

The Black Alley:
The map keeps expanding towards the north as we go deeper down into this dangerous location. Shade creatures may now even appear if the local population's awareness of the supernatural world grows too high.
But, here is a problem. I am planning to put some gangsters here. However, I don't think any existing art assets fit to illustrate some Chinese gangsters. As this game is now global and has a lot of players from outside China, please let me explain this, China has a long history of gangs. But they are not all like bandits or criminals. Many of them are not lawless people; on the contrary, many of them obey their own set of the Laws of River and Lake. River and Lake is a term you may find in Kung Fu movies. Simplified speaking, it's basically a very glorified version of an underworld ruled by various gangs in China. People here learn material arts and try to do good things for people when the government fails to bring justice or prosperity. As such, you may think some of those gangs are like Robin Hood with Kung Fu, a group of Kung Fu Batman, a Justice League with no superpowers but know Kung Fu, or a group of Paladins following their own disciplines to do what they think is right when traveling around the country. (Seriously, one of the most famous Chinese games, literally known as "Chinese Paladin," translated them as Paladins, which sounds very weird to both Western and Chinese audiences.) But, although I cannot tell you everything in this short paragraph, you may already get some ideas. So, to illustrate those gangsters in the Dark Alley, I need to create new characters.

Now, go down to the character design.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a32b577cef17d4a9a82d7cfe8ff5a27c67eabb7c.jpg[/img]
Those gangsters you will encounter here are not very rich people. (They are rogers, not roger traders.)
But they need to be very healthy as they practice material arts and exercise quite often. 
Fun fact: Shanghai police once warned people that someone who often exercises is more likely to be a terrorist, Spy on your neighbor if they exercise a lot!
It soon became a meme.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/87e78904371e67d7453353889cd5bf304997893b.jpg[/img]
They may have some tattoos. In this case, a common choice is the word "義" on their arm.
 "義" has many meanings in Chinese. It can represent brothership, loyalty, justice, and repaying others' kindness, among many other good virtual things. Many gangsters in China value these virtual. (Surprise? I told you many of them are very different from criminal organizations.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/ae55c16f4d5522e3b2b7a819e17f8685bb4c5b71.jpg[/img]
Guan Yu, a Hero from the Three Kingdoms era, is well-known as the God of "義" (and also a God of War.) and is worshipped by many gangsters. As such, that shall conclude the character design.
Now, let's add some animations:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/cf4240313371f5d624205b57cd57485b00482530.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/652a9c6752a707a9a5082f7f2cdbd3439eed05ba.gif[/img]
And it took a bit longer than I expected. I found myself running out of time to add them into the game as NPCs. But you can already use this character appearance on your main character or customized teammates. The work will continue next week.

That's for this week. I probably forgot to mention something, but all the details of the updates can be found in the completed update log below. The world moves on. But no matter what changes, NEOLITHIA is eternal. The updates continue.

The full update log of this week:
