notes.title: DD#196 A Silent Halloween
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. I hope everyone just had a nice Halloween.

This year, I’ve brewed up something delightfully different! While you might not spot Halloween mentioned in the update logs, brace yourself—the game is set to run the event automatically! Sounds spine-chilling, right? 

Picture this: gardening vendors starting to offer mysterious seeds that might just give you a fright. Imagine stumbling upon pumpkins in your garden, transformed into something truly twisted. And what’s that eerie sound? Oh, just the distant screams echoing from certain Foundation facilities! When you want to leave all those messes behind and look for a vacation place, check out the Wonderland Travel Agency. You may find most of the destinations are filled with all sorts of terrifying creatures. The thrill of the unknown awaits you! But remember, what you encounter depends entirely on your local game experience. If you happen to miss the frightful fun, you can always rewind your system time to relive those spooky moments. Or, if you prefer, you can simply relish in your blissful ignorance—unless, of course, that’s just what the game wants you to think. Enjoy the eerie excitement! It's temporary; the game will automatically go back to "normal" once your system time is no longer in the Halloween period.

Now, let's go down to other, a bit less scary game content.
First, I took some time to clean up the localization files. The game reported about 30 localization issues, and I manually found 3 more. All of them are fixed. One interesting thing is that I also found Steam is not very non-English-friendly when uploading game content through its webpages, causing all localization in our "All Fear Comes from the Lack of Firepower" DLC to get messed up. It's fixed by uploading the DLC again via the Steam pipeline client. Of course, I took this chance to add the latest new firearms to the DLC, including Israel Uzi Submachine Guns.

Next, The game received a massive map expansion in various locations. The Black Frog Cave gets a 3rd floor. There is a new cave on the northeast side of Chillwind Valley. Liu got a Dark Alley, which is supposed to be very scary, and there is now a parking lot in front of the courthouse so that you may take a taxi there. More details on some of those new locations are below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/ad53eb7ec9ca0d0a03bf79b1cbb5a315f87be4c2.jpg[/img]
How scary the Dark Alley may be? You ask?
Well, it is as scary as real life. :D

With new locations, we also need new characters to start their stories. So, some preparations have been made. Here are some new character assets:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/bb762ce4c74bbc95e6a7724ab801f339aebc0a3f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/69abba897ed00060e0a9231c4b90e71ab5de341f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/428c34cdb09035820bbbc2a8387d80764345f1c4.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/aaf177239359aba732c992f2f4af949389983ef8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/c68de9a1400ef403d08a59e2a91d2b401b07fbd9.gif[/img]
Feel free to use them on your main character or customized teammates.

Now, what's this week's new story? It's about a lost White Wolf Legion of the Nise Federation.
Let's go back to the cave on the northeast side of the Chillwind Valley. There are many ghosts of White Wolf Warrior here. You may have learned that a big battle took place here long ago. But what
exact battle is it? Now you may find more clues in this new cave. Once you enter it, you may have a vision of what happened here.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/de16825bc418780a9d446e04bbef9e2544f8f62c.jpg[/img]
More clues will come when this cave is further developed. Before that, feel free to make your own assumptions about what happened here.
Previously, in SAPC++'s era, we already know General Barov and his legion died here. Now, after many years, we may get the answer to how they perished.
In addition to their stories, you may find many new loots from the general and his warriors, including his blade engraved with his battle cry "For the Federation" (always +100% VS Demon effect) and many pieces of armor worn by those warriors. That is if you can defeat their ghosts first. Various ghosts of White Wolf Warriors can be found at the entrance and inside the cave. And their general will always spawn where he made his last stand. He always drops his blade, but each time, he may have different attributions and prefixes in case people want to farm this unique boss. But be prepared, as he has a set of unique skills and can call reinforcements into the battle.

But this world is not all about wars and supernatural threats. Next, let me introduce you to some traveling merchants. Have you wondered how those hermits, such as Master Kuyi and Dr. Kyoryu, live in their isolated homes far away from civilization and replenish their daily life supplies? Sure, they sometimes go to nearby towns. However, there are often times when some traveling merchants pass by their homes to do business with them. (After all, they are considerable quite reach.) So, from now on, every time you get into their home, you may find some random traveling merchants already there doing their business. Of course, you can take this opportunity to resupply yourself as well. Each traveling merchant may have different kinds of goods to offer. If you don't find the one with the goods you like, maybe you just need to wait a bit for the next one to come. Essentially, that can allow you to get some potions, some ammo, or some scrolls right there without the need to go all the way back to a town.

That covers the major part of this week's update. There are some small updates that are not mentioned above; feel free to check out the full update log below if you are interested. Once again, we have reached a brave new month, and our evolution continues.
That also means we got another video about that certain DLC:
[previewyoutube=KE2MYIZ_zEw;full][/previewyoutube]
I got too much tomato juice for Halloween, so I put them in the game. :P
For people who live in places where YouTube is blocked, here is the backup link:
https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Ua1HY8EBo

notes.title: DD# 195 Deeper Inside the Black Frog Cave
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

This week, we get more content around the Dark Elf King storyline, which involves Master Kuyi and the Black Frog Cave. You will find the reasons why he brings you here and what your next target will be.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/feb1cf3059f16303b7512a88b02ff185b0d4b153.jpg[/img]
From one ageless elf to another, both are beyond their journey's end. (It's a Frienren reference.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b55431b0b51567ef524c2397d81fc8e29470473b.jpg[/img]
Nostalgia, aren't we?
If you are curious, you can find additional information and background stories by talking to him and selecting other optional dialog options. All of them echo the ancient stories from Stone Age Online. If you pay attention, you will also discover the truth behind another shady operation involving misinformation and cover-ups carefully.

Meanwhile, have you wondered what kind of treasures Master Kuyi possesses? After all, he was an experienced adventurer from old times. You can now pick the lock to his storage room and find certain relics from ancient times.
For example:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/555b92c278aaa47230f83277304b58e132df0b57.jpg[/img]
Something unique about the Mirror of True Heart is that it can always display the exact number of your Karma value. Sounds familiar? Right, it works just like it was in the past iterations of this world.

After all the talk on the surface, it's time to dive into the Black Frog Cave, which just got another floor with three different entrances from the floor above. According to those lores you may have discovered, you know those creatures like to hoard shining and magical things. You may wonder where they are hoarding them. Well, you are about to find the answer. You can even use your mining skills to dig out some valuable items. But, the black frogs will certainly not like it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/4df2eabdfe9c82f061d9d16c8849cd6d96149e1a.jpg[/img]

Oh, yes. The game tracks your relationship with them, and it's linked to the Black Frog King. To display this on your relationship UI, I also took some time to add the art assets for him. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/3e11c634fea0126affe6efb2e74237ad8418987d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a5987145d44d33c8b7a143f3b626b5b6070e2ca6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f8d25ea641567430b9d8d33428e32917e841eb13.gif[/img]
Compared to common black frogs you can find in this cave, he is larger, wears a crown, and has wings. 


That's the major part of this week's content updates. But, of course, there are other little things here and there, such as ghostly items from the ghosts of ancient white wolf warriors who still roam the Chillwind Valley today, further explanation in the Eastern Jiru Ridge, and more creatures that can drop cruse stone recipes and fragments of curse stones. You may find more details in the complete update log below.

Next week is Halloween, and Steam will put this game on sale. There may also be some spooky content to come. Have fun!


The Completed Update Log of This Week:

notes.title: DD# 194 God Is Slow to Anger
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Welcome to this week’s Developer’s Diary!

It’s been a hectic week here in Shanghai, thanks to some unexpected electronic power system maintenance and some other real-life business on my schedule. While I didn’t make much major story progress, I've got some equally awesome updates.

[b]Did you know?[/b] The word “awesome” had a deeply religious connotation about 400 years ago. You can even find it in the Holy Bible (e.g., Psalm 68:35, Genesis 28:17, Exodus 15:11). So, let’s dive into some faith-based content!

[b]New Faith Tenets[/b]
First up, a powerful verse from the Bible: Nahum 1:3: “The LORD is slow to anger but great in power; the LORD will not leave the guilty unpunished. His way is in the whirlwind and the storm, and clouds are the dust of his feet.”
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/66888bdcd25aae0660e605975135b3e0293cbc23.jpg[/img]
The effect of this tenet is about a delayed punishment towards your enemy. The world has many injustices. Sometimes, those who caused such grief may even seem to get away. However, this verse assures the faithful that evil will be punished just at a later time. 
[b]Game Mechanic[/b]: This tenet introduces a delayed punishment system. If an enemy damages you, they enter a countdown state starting at 7. Each subsequent attack reduces the countdown by 1. When it hits 0, they suffer true damage based on the number of times they’ve harmed you. This mechanic was added on October 12, 2024, just days before the news of Israel eliminating Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar, the sinful man who caused this entire war. I like that people sometimes talk about how my content can cause reverberation in reality.

Of course, such belief is not limited to Abrahamic Religions. In various Eastern Religions, people also believe those who commit evil deeds will be punished in time, while those who do good deeds will be rewarded in time. It's a tenet was originated from India, and some spread towards the rest of the world, known as Hetu-Phala.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/0b7d665d3894eb0db488d081c99d3b1ece46d481.jpg[/img]
It works similarly to Nahum 1:3 in the game.
Either way, you can now have the power of the "cause and effect."

In many religions, there is always something in common, something that represents the good of humanity. Thus, there have been many movements since long ago, trying to find common ground and achieve great things together for the good of all humanity. That leads to our next new tenet:
[b]Pan-Abrahamism[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b8605c0507887905bed3d3df8d54cf6dd462aa6b.jpg[/img]
If you search this term, you can easily find the Baha'i religion movement in your search results. It is a religious movement with an Islamic root. However, its followers believe all famous religious figures throughout history are carrying God's message. Thus, all shall be respected. They also explicitly reject notions of racism, sexism, and nationalism, putting aside people's differences to achieve the unity of humanity. Consequently, they may be one of the most tolerant Islamic religions. However, in this cruel world, it is often those who are most open-minded and the most tolerant who get persecuted. The Iran government has been genocided them for a long time. Only less than 70 of them remain in that nation, imprisoned. 

Now, as we have just talked about, those who are kind and tolerant. Let's check the other side of the coin. Just like a kind and tolerant belief can grow in a place lacking freedom, a totalism tenet can also grow in a free nation. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/29604b5a152bb0768a76f77d211f2461775e3193.jpg[/img]
Some people talk about free speech, yet they want to silence whoever is against them. What makes it worse is we are witnessing this phenomenon not just in the world's most despicable nations run by dictators but also in the United States. When many people in the world are still struggling to get more civil freedom, there are people out there who do not only not appreciate the birthright granted them by their forefathers, but they are also actively undermining the very foundation of their nation. Even though it's not my nation that gets screwed up by those people. I feel very sorry for my friends in the US. This tenet contrasts with true Freedom of Speech (in the game, they are mutually exclusive.) and highlights the irony of such behavior in both oppressive regimes and democratic nations.


That concludes the first part of this diary.
Now, the second part is mostly based on feedback I received this week.
Someone complained about how this game developed by a Chinese developer has wheat but not paddy and rice in the game. Oh, well. I guess the answer is that I don't have enough time to cover all the content I want to add. But such feedback is legit. If, after the death of a developer, they will live in the game they have developed in their lifetime, then I certainly want my game to have paddy and rice in the game. So, here we are:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/47d925d3b1a2b767ba4fe932bba17ab8006c9c86.jpg[/img]
Taking this chance, I am also going to add the cultural importance of paddy and rice here. Because, it's not merely food that makes who we are. Thousands of years of history are all behind us. It's also something beyond the borders of nations, as you can find it common in various Eastern Asia cultures.
As such, we can now plant paddy in the game and have them rest. (For those who are not into this, you can just purchase some from vendors.)
The rice from what you grow in the soil will be more delicious.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/e63809d7f064e06510d179990d114be703614b23.jpg[/img]
You can even use holy water to cook rice and get a blessed version. After all, rice is used in many rituals and ceremonies in East Asia as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/45d09f5f70a99f274f14d90262fd17b51bf962d3.jpg[/img]
You can also put some eggs in the rice and cook some Egge Fried Blessed Rice. It also held a certain cultural importance since about 1500 years ago; It's also something that when I get busy, just like I am this week, I can quickly cook and stay focused on my work.

Paddy's usage is not limited to cooking rice. There are more you can discover in the game. For example, you can use them to make some Sake, or maybe you can use them for alchemy.
To conclude this part, we get one additional faith tenet here to celebrate all people who share this cultural heritage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/43607c9cc960a8cd25c0c122967aafaa0f63b349.jpg[/img]
As it's a tenet of peace and harmony. It's mutually exclusive to the raider tenet. You are free to choose if you want to be a settler builder or a raider, just like you can in Fallout 4. But you can hardly promote both in your own faith system.


Next, about the ropes.
What can ropes do in a game? Well, in Elona, a game that has just as much freedom as ours (and you can also do quite a lot of messed up things there, just like our game.), you can get some surprises when you use a rope. You will accidentally hang yourself. A dark humor well-known by many back in the old days. The developer of Elona has experienced some tough times in his life. But, recently, he is back! His new game is right here at the Steam Next Festival! I'd recommend everyone to try it. And in his honor, I added the rope joke to my game as well.
OK, that joke aside, we certainly have other usages for those ropes. Let's see...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f5a2dc1fa6929a994ee4ec1fa9ccf3329483c03a.jpg[/img]
Make a teru teru bozu from a corpse. Oh, well, things are getting dark quite fast, aren't they? But that's the point; this is a game about supernatural, unspeakable horror beneath the seemly peaceful and normal facade. Thus, this crafting recipe based on Japanese urban legends fits this theme quite well. Many evil enemies can drop the blueprint of this. They may also drop the blueprints that can allow you to fuse all those fragments of curse stones together and make a whole one, which you can then use to unleash the power of calamity on your enemies.

Of course, we also get new procedurally generated quests:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/e873e23637e3118424c275e78049b176ccea646b.jpg[/img]
Many alchemists in Qinuyi want test subjects for their potions. If you want, maybe you can find a way to get some quick money. But, just in real life, this is totally not healthy. However, in real life, people in desperation may sometimes volunteer to test questionable medicines. The price varies depending on where you live. Life is simply unfair. People's lives may be worth millions in developed nations, while in China, the world's second-largest economy by nominal GDP, even in the most economically advanced city, Shanghai, it's only worth about 150 thousand dollars. I can tell you this because, as a lawyer in China, I have first-hand experience. Can you imagine how much people's life worth in an even worse place? 

That's for this week. Thanks for reading. I know this is not a very pleasant diary. But games are sometimes more than just funny and mindless content.

notes.title: [Update Interruption]Neighborhood Electric Power System Maintenance
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone. This is an announcement that you are unlikely to see in other games. But here it is. I just received an announcement from Shanghai's electronic department that my neighborhood is going to have 2 Electric Power System Maintenance on Oct.18 from 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM (About 6 hours from now) and on Oct.21 from 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM.
Those are just estimated time periods when the whole neighborhood will have no power supplies.
Obviously, during this period of time, I will be unable to work on the game's update. Thus, we may have less content than usual on those 2 days. I may also need to rescue things in my fridge. Prepare some ice bags.
Well, such is life. It happens sometimes.  =￣ω￣=

诸君，这肯定不是你经常可以看到的游戏公告。但是，欢乐的事情就这么发生了。刚才我接到了上海电力部门的通知，我所在的小区即将发生两次由于电网维护导致的停电。分别是2024年10月18日7点半到15点半（也就是过大约6个小时就要开始了）以及2024年10月21日的7点半到15点半。
这是他们提供的预期的停电时间。期间整个小区估计都没电。
显然，我没法在没电的情况下更新游戏。因此，在这两天里的游戏更新内容的数量将受到影响。同时，我需要去拯救一下冰箱里的库存，准备点冰袋什么的。
好吧，这就是人生，对吧。 =￣ω￣=

notes.title: DD# 193 A Change of the Plan
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

It’s been another incredibly productive week! However, due to various factors, our original plan to develop more of Master Kuyi’s story content had to be redirected. As a wise man once said, “The only constant is change.” This has been a recurring theme throughout our 20 years of game updates.

Before diving into the main content, let’s take a moment to remember a significant event. Over a year ago, on October 7th, 2023, Hamas terrorists attacked Israel. Many innocent lives were lost at a music concert meant to celebrate peace and joy. Even now, many are still held hostage by Hamas. I can’t imagine the hell they’ve endured over the past 369 days. Once again, I reaffirm my support for the brave Israeli people fighting against numerous barbaric foes on various frontlines. To honor their resilience, I have added another iconic Israeli weapon to the game: the world-famous Uzi, a symbol of Israeli ingenuity and strength.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/8d9a698261a1f30776e684103f59be3704562ba0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/896308bf93d46674e26bd864d7ae316003c46f2b.jpg[/img]

Now, let’s explore this week’s content updates:
[b]Black Frog Cave Dungeon[/b]
While there’s been little progress on Master Kuyi’s storyline, the Black Frog Cave dungeon is now accessible! This dungeon is filled with black frogs that bring a unique flavor of ancient Stone Age lore. These creatures can be formidable enemies or powerful allies if tamed. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/13272cafd3469aaa61c9c278e3706ab739815a39.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9bc78e39eb4dc3ea8b57d7a5255dcec545a880b9.gif[/img]
Plus, their unique meat can be used to cook dishes with special attributes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/90d644266639fea742990781f815e3cfe02812c2.jpg[/img]

[b]Something Inspired by Crusader Kings 3[/b]
I recently had some spare time to play CK3’s new DLC and was impressed by the “activities” system. This concept, dating back to their Royal Court DLC, fits our game perfectly. So, I adapted it into a procedural quest. Let’s go fishing in the sea!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f62ce2c11837f4d458357474fc12a2f8501dbe89.jpg[/img]
In CK3, “activities” involve off-map adventures with random events. These events can offer rewards or challenge your skills, making each experience unique. Similarly, our fishing voyages will feature three types of random encounters, each requiring different solutions.
[b]Find a good fishing spot and test your skills.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/da22d9cc208f115c43b42c70db212b6cd04098eb.jpg[/img]
[b]Encounter storms and use strength, wind spells, or a Teru Teru Bozu to fend them off.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d1b4fdccaf51cab6d8bb10d9d64f558b5b52d2be.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d8123acbcff102e81fb7c9b46baea930f0056d37.jpg[/img]
This provides opportunities to catch bigger fish, improve your skills, and gain rewards. (After all, there may be many things in the water. But, no worries, SCP-2316 is not included! :P)

[b]A New Faith Tenet about Fishing[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/28c64ee18ecfd8b6b97950dbafc64bc766459bdd.jpg[/img]
As we are at it. I've added a new faith tenet for fishing enthusiasts. You can now gain devotion by fishing, thanks to a system that checks faith effects during skill checks. This tenet also offers an alternative for those seeking fishing skills without selling their souls to Cthulhu.
Other faith tenets have also been updated. For example, “The Grand Masquerade” now grants devotion for passing deception skill checks. But where can we find more deception skill checks? Well, let's go down this path further.

[b]New Mission Board in Katan[/b]
I’ve introduced a new mission board in Katan, the lawless town. It features old procedurally generated quests requiring you to bypass computer passwords for shady figures, and a new one that requires you to sow discord among victims. There, you can have a lot of opportunities to use your deception skills.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/14f8f4a4ab6fdb0da1f39d63023ef7dfa4e03cc7.jpg[/img]
Here’s a bit more on this new procedurally generated quest. In many fraud activities, criminals try to sow discord between their target victims and the victim’s close family members and friends to isolate them and make them more vulnerable. For example, if a charlatan wants to sell “health potions” to an elderly victim, it’s common for the victim’s children to voice against purchasing those potions. The charlatan will then try to discredit the children. If successful, the victim distances themselves from their family, becoming more isolated and susceptible to further manipulation. As a lawyer in China, I sometimes see such stories. This quest is based on real-life experiences, aiming to raise awareness, even though you play from the bad guys' perspective in the game. 

[b]Tzeentch Arrives in the Steam Workshop[/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3346275736
Finally, the reason for our plan change: Tzeentch has arrived in the Steam Workshop! Una has completed all her Warhammer Chaos Gods mods, and they are quite overpowered. At least, I am overpowered by Tzeentch and had to make some plan changes to implement some new game features to support the new Tzeentch faiths. Change is good. After all, the game has been evolving for a long time. Every day, the game is becoming better. Every day, new updates, new experiences, and closer to perfection! Such is the joy of changing...oh, wait, I am slowly slipping into Slaanesh's realm again. Let me stop here. :P

That’s all for this week! Due to the large amount of content, some smaller updates are only listed in the completed update log below. Please find them if you are interested. More changes and mutations await next week. Stay tuned!

notes.title: DD# 192 The Valley, The Shelter, and Potatoes.
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! Welcome to this week’s Developer’s Diary!

This week has been packed with exciting developments, and I can’t wait to share them with you.

[b]Chillwind Valley Adventures Continue[/b]
Our journey through the mystical Chillwind Valley presses on. As mentioned last week, this ancient and magical place is now teeming with new creatures. Alongside the Yetis, you’ll now encounter more beings tied to the rich lore of this land.

[b]The White Wolf Regiment [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/31d5ad0653be0c60fa35d2b50c95075df27ab25f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/fbd9964207964dd3838bdcbbfff42ab07bed92cb.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/70fa179ee1651cb52fee6b671209e6bbe977133c.jpg[/img]
The White Wolf Regiment was once the elite force of the Nise Federation, these soldiers were dispatched to battle the Dark Alliance, who sought to unleash demons and seize control of the world. The battle was fierce, leaving the ground soaked in blood and the air filled with the clash of steel. Legends say these brave warriors’ spirits are so strong that they continue to fight even in death, their spectral forms locked in eternal combat.

[b]Corrupted Yetis[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/1b69ec5440f576912c2611b6a0b28ea281f4cd60.jpg[/img]
The lingering negative energies from this epic battle have mutated and corrupted local creatures. The corrupted Yetis are a testament to these dark forces. Check out the image above to see the stark difference between a corrupted Yeti and a normal one. Sometimes, you might even find fragments of Curse Stones after defeating these twisted beings.


[b]Meet Master Kuyi[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/6385fdc72ec45e46472ab231bf5fa4fe8c682876.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f0a26535bcb356aeeb93317a6ab91b53ac83a297.gif[/img]
Beyond the valley, many heroes and adventurers from past generations still roam the world. Master Kuyi is one such adventurer. His home, located at the entrance of a dungeon he once cleared with his companion, stands as a testament to his legacy. Unlike the ageless elves, Kuyi has aged significantly, and many of his close allies have perished. Yet, the true horror of old age isn’t death but the decay that comes with it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/93bfd975f94b8e568d079fc4dac2a9d6abe69c76.jpg[/img]
As we age, it becomes harder to stay focused, and memories start to fade. This decay is why we hold onto cherished memories from our youth. For over 20 years, I’ve been updating this game, a testament to how I combat the decay of aging and remain true to myself. Take care and stay young at heart.

[b]Life in a Wartime Fjordr[/b]
Our game isn’t just about heroic adventures in a supernatural world. This week’s updates also focus on the everyday lives of the people in Fjordr. A new shelter building is now accessible in town, housing those who lost their homes to machine attacks or refugees from other towns on the island. Some of these stories are inspired by real-life wartime experiences. (A reminder that the war in the real world continues after more than 2.5 years. Don’t forget Ukraine!)
In the game, you’ll hear people in the shelter discussing the war and seeking news from the frontlines. The Phoenicians are also present, looking for those with a fighting spirit among the refugees to join their ranks. As mercenaries and merchants, they are never far from war zones. You’ll also encounter shady activities, like someone selling fake identities based on the recently deceased, offering a way for people to start anew amidst the chaos.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b0efecdb6412d87bc0ba9c35f6e892dc031da5ba.jpg[/img]

[b]Finding Joy in Dark Times[/b]
Even in the darkest hours, we can find joy in life. One such joy is enjoying delicious food. This week’s update introduces a new fruit: the Tomato. You can grow tomatoes from seeds or purchase them from merchants, and then cook a variety of dishes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/c34400b8e293e8805b324779a05aff889037a54d.jpg[/img]
[b]Tomato Egg Stir Fry [/b](The dish name changes dynamically based on the type of egg you use. Have fun creating unique combinations! 😄)
So...for example:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b9a144598aaa5fcd5bb74dfedd7fa487d82c3fe1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b6bdfec6c9f76aa9555907a563cbc83493e60a4f.jpg[/img]
[b]Tomato Fish[/b] (The dish name changes based on the type of fish you use.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/95d067ab3530909ef369398bf8e4613bbfd7ae34.jpg[/img]
[b]Tomato Stewed Meat[/b] (The dish name changes based on the type of meat you use.)
Bon appétit! 🍅

That’s all for this week. Next week, I’ll be diving deeper into the story of Master Kuyi and the dungeon beneath his house. Stay tuned!

notes.title: DD#191 A Memory to Carry On
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, welcome to the last developer's diary of September 2024.

This week, once again we have a wide range of diverse content.
1. Jiru Expansion to the East 
The adventure continues as we delve deeper into Jiru Island! This week, we journeyed further east of Fjordr, reaching the mysterious Chillwind Valley. Long-time players will recognize the historical significance of this location, as its tale has been woven into the fabric of our game for over 20 years. During the era of SAPC, Chillwind Valley was the battleground for a decisive clash between good and evil, shaping the Nise Federation as we know it. In the era of SAPC++, the ghosts of that epic struggle still linger, locked in eternal conflict. Now, this legendary location re-emerges in our current world.
But fear not, this isn't just an empty expanse. Brace yourself for encounters with new Yeti enemies!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/4fdb55c0b2c9d6f3f86564c0bfd1e3f4fece6767.jpg[/img]
And guess what? You can even turn them into your loyal pets!

2, The Journey from the Past Continues 
As previously hinted, the Dark Elf King awaits us in Fjordr. From there, we embark on a quest to reunite with our old allies from past adventures. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a516c8ec660f13b39929e2d4fe4b595f261ea110.jpg[/img]
After 20 long years, will these allies still be around Beyond their Journey's End? If not, will you carry their memory forward into the future?

3, Something New from This Reality 
Just like in our journey in the past 20 years, real-life events always bring me new inspiration. As such, we always have new content related to such events. Now, here we just got another one.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/6db23a5d6ff3f1de673a59b370c077add3ebcd55.jpg[/img]
The Attack of Pagers (based on Israel's recent attack on the Hezbollah terrorists.)
It's a hacking scale which means the effect is scaled based on the user's programming skills.
What makes it very unique is that, unlike most other hacking skills that target machine enemies, this skill is mainly used on non-machine targets that carry electronic devices. Such devices can be pagers, walkie-talkies, phones, tablets, or just anything someone can carry. As a surprise attack, it even has a very high chance to stun its targets. If you have quite high programming skills, it's quite possible to one-shot kill the target.
Oh, by the way...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/563eb40db44ab94580706ea09f9aa3f1124611b0.jpg[/img]
Do Orcs use pagers? Asking for a friend. :P
Well, it does not matter. You can hack a lot of different targets and make their electronic devices go boom in this game that absolutely includes those orcs.
You can acquire a hack tool from the GPA organization that comes with this new skill.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/6cd3892eec34f0179331073131d2ed1b94463de6.jpg[/img]
Have fun, playing Mossad. :P

4, A Quick Way to Return Home
Traveling back to your safehouse or pocket dimension just got easier! Introducing the Scroll of Home Portal:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/5c4f31939558a61e9adc4af6c4b83df9d71ef5a7.png[/img]
This new scroll allows you to teleport back to any location defined as “home” in the game. It’s a convenient addition to doorways and Butterfly Wings, making it simpler to leave major areas quickly.
However, once again, let's not forget in real life there are currently still many people who cannot return to their homes at this moment. Some are kidnapped, and some have their home destroyed by invaders. Hopefully, humanity can have a future where such things never happen again one day.

5, The Conclusion of the Main Quest in Fjordr 
After confronting the Aten Preacher in Fjordr, you can uncover a twisted truth and decide his fate. Explore his hideout to find clues leading to your next investigation and loot imbued with the power of the sun. This marks the end of the main story in Fjordr, but the journey continues as we chase the conspiracy of the Day Break.

That shall cover the most part of this week's update. Of course, there are some other things now mentioned such as a new skill for some cute pets that can reduce enemies' hatred towards them. Please feel free to read the full update log below if you are interested.

That's for this week. I will continue to carry this memory into the future for as long as possible. 



The full update log of this week:

notes.title: DD#190 Day May Be Broken Again
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

Let's see what we got this week:
1, Aten Cult Hideout
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d6043e412f77acfdef17478f1e7d235c2ba74aab.jpg[/img]
This week, I made some progress in the main storyline. After tailing the elusive Aten Preacher back to their secretive hideout, you’ll discover a building teeming with hidden rooms and a vigilant guard at the main entrance of the central hall. Your approach to this guard can vary: will you deceive him into believing you’re a new cult recruit, or will you channel your inner action hero and force your way in?
Once inside the main hall, prepare for a showdown with the Aten Preacher. Like any classic villain, he won’t face you alone. Instead, he’ll send waves of brainwashed townsfolk, convinced that Aten, the Sun God, will aid them in their fight against machines. Here’s where your choices matter: will you show mercy to these misguided followers, or will you unleash your wrath in a Warhammer 40k inquisitor style to burn them all?
Your decisions will ripple through the game world, influencing your teammates’ reactions and altering how other factions perceive you. The fate of the cultists is in your hands—choose wisely. 

2, Sun Spells
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/147f528212ae757bd96243470006bcf21cfaf76d.jpg[/img]
With the resurgence of the Aten Cult, a new array of spells has emerged. Previously, sun-related spells were lumped under fire or light categories. Now, they proudly stand alone with their unique tag: “Sun Spells.” While some may still carry fire or light elements, what truly sets them apart is their enhanced power when cast outdoors during the daytime, under the visible sun. These spells also pack an extra punch against vampires.
Each Sun Spell boasts its own special flair. Take Solar Flare, for instance—it’s devastatingly effective against machines. The Aten Cultists in Egypt have upgraded their spellbooks, replacing their old, generic spells with these potent new Sun Spells.
And here’s the exciting part for you: as you defeat those Aten Cultists, you’ll have the chance to loot rings that grant these powerful spells. Embrace the power of the sun and let it guide your path to victory!

3, And...Sun Bullets
Of course, we can’t let mages have all the fun. For those who prefer the thrill of firearms, we’ve introduced new pistol weapon modules that allow your pistols to fire UV rounds. These rounds benefit from any equipment or spell that enhances the power of the Sun, making them incredibly effective against vampires.

4, The Sheriff of Fjordr Has Arrived.
Previously, you encountered the ice-cold Sheriff of Fjordr during her heated argument with members of the Red Dragon. With the East Barricade incident now temporarily resolved, the crisis has been delayed, giving you a chance to regroup with her.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/df1a979a8f565dac791bfe9d305760fc65840ffb.jpg[/img]
You can now find the sheriff in Fjordr’s administration building. Your first impression here is crucial—how you choose to interact with her will shape her perception of you and influence how the entire town views you. 

5, So Comes New Quests
With the sheriff back at her station, a new mission board outside her office is now brimming with opportunities. These quests offer substantial rewards and a chance to strengthen your relationships with the local townsfolk and even the military.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f14ba0d87fb0d50aedba0d383bfdc1e18d2889db.jpg[/img]
The most pressing task is to repair and reinforce the town’s defenses. You’ll find a variety of procedurally generated jobs focused on this critical objective. And this is just the beginning—more types of missions will be introduced later, each offering new challenges and rewards.

That's for this week. However, the story is far from over. There are still many unanswered questions. Why is the Aten Cult in Fjordr so different from the one in Egypt? You’ll uncover the truth in next week’s update. And that’s not all—there will be even more loot to discover as you pursue the escaping preacher. Stay tuned, because there’s a lot more excitement on the horizon. :)

notes.title: DD#189 Memes
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

There are quite a few story content updates this week. However, those are also quite hard to write in the diary as they may be spoiled. So, I will try something different in this diary.

1, Fjordr Hospital Underground
Congratulations!  You’ve almost reached the end of this part. Get ready to claim your final rewards and uncover some long-awaited answers which involve...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d6d54bb603f326421faae6a899adbd15c2bd3308.jpg[/img]
Deep within the vault, you’ll discover prototype anti-machine weapon components. Kudos to the genius who decided to lock them away instead of handing them over to security guards during this crisis. They are now all yours. :D

2, Aten Cultists in Fjordr
As you step onto Jiru island, the main story picks up pace. Instead of aimlessly exploring and tediously investigating everywhere, you encounter a fervent cultist actively recruiting new members for their Day Break agenda. How does he do that?
Oh, well...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/8ceebb6f8d8709f11de663ddfcb5f15db2f91399.jpg[/img]
With the town under siege by machines, the cultist’s pitch is compelling. After all, Aten is a sun god. His words resonate deeply with the fearful townsfolk, making it hard to resist the allure of joining their cause.

3, A Surprising Development in Siberia
It’s been a while since our last update in this part of the game world. Previously, you ventured into a village teeming with meat cubes and orc soldiers. Now, the church doors have swung open, revealing a shocking plot twist involving a historical figure, coming with a lot of blood and dark magic.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a8cff4ba33d295017e3b5defc9a7849445b698bd.jpg[/img]
As you step inside, the atmosphere thickens with an eerie tension. The church, once a place of solace, now harbors secrets and corruption. Prepare yourself for a revelation that ties history with the supernatural, bringing forth a character who was meant to be a major antagonist. However, due to recent real-world events, he is taking on a new role in my script. After all, everybody hates Putin's illegal invasion of Ukraine even this guy.
Some Behind-Scene Facts:
1, If Putin hadn’t launched his bloody invasion over two years ago, this character would have been the main antagonist in this part of the game. But given the current circumstances, he’s been repurposed for a different role.
2, The phrase “Fuck your cyka, drink your vodka” comes from a song by the Russian band “Russian Village Boys.” They fled Russia after the war began and publicly supported Ukraine, an act of courage that I respect.

Other than story developments, we also got:
1, Photosynthesis
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/ab3bf225296f8c1136091dd648ac3da170f62b2a.jpg[/img]
Your plant pets are about to get a fantastic upgrade! Introducing a new skill that allows most of your plant companions to absorb incoming light-element damage and convert it into health. This unique ability not only makes your plant pets stand out but also proves invaluable when facing Aten Cultists who wield sunlight as their weapon. Imagine your plant pets thriving under the very attacks meant to harm them, turning the tide of battle in your favor
Side Note: Mushrooms, unfortunately, don’t possess this photosynthesis feature due to scientific reasons. But who knows? With a touch of supernatural intervention, they might just surprise us in the future.

2, Make Your Own Alcoholic Drinks!
Introducing the Brewing Machines, a fantastic new addition to the game! With these machines, you can make your own beer and vodka wherever you go. Simply add materials like water, wheat, and yeast, turn it on, and watch the magic happen. Cheers! But that’s not all! These Brewing Machines also double as item containers with unlimited space. Dump anything you want into them, and they’ll keep your items safe. (for totally no reason.)  
Fun fact: This feature was inspired by my recent tasting of Swedish Absolut Vodka. (for obvious reasons, I am not buying any Russian vodka no matter how cheap they become.) Anyway, it sparked me with a newfound interest in learning how to brew it.  :)

That's for this week. Have fun and carry on. :)

notes.title: DD#188 A Colder War, Part I
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to the first developer's diary in September.

As previously mentioned, the HD version of the "White-Haired Witch" cutscene is now released
[previewyoutube=g3RLNwP1iVA;full][/previewyoutube]
There is also a short video about the progress of our upcoming Unreal DLC.
[previewyoutube=C9ZKuNucOqw;full][/previewyoutube]

Now let's go down to see what game content update we have for this week:
1, The Development of the Plot Unnearth of Fjordr Hospital 
Exciting news! New rooms have just been unlocked in this mysterious location, each brimming with secrets waiting to be uncovered. As you explore, you’ll stumble upon more intriguing research notes that piece together the dramatic events that transpired here. But beware, despite all those machines running amok here, some determined guards still stand vigilant, fiercely protecting a safe amidst the chaos. To get closer, you’ll need to defeat them and solve a clever puzzle to disarm the defense mechanism.

2, Machine Menaces in Procedurally Dungeons
Procedurally generated dungeons now feature machine-themed enemies lurking in every type of environment. This exciting update shall make it much easier than ever for people who want to farm loots from all kinds of mechanical foes.

3, Counter Methods
With the rise of supernatural machine threats, we’ve rolled out new countermeasures to keep you ahead of the game. Now, you can purchase a variety of new hack tools from GPA agents, each designed to unleash unique effects on your mechanical foes. But that’s not all. You can get your hands on crafting blueprints to create your own hack tools as well. 

4, More Story Content of Those Dragons
After the incident at the East Barricade, you can now find Commissar Bao at the traven, during the conversation, you may find more about their motivation here on this anomalous island. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/60d21b5c0c8a93b17e0360c04e082f1d6a550ab2.jpg[/img]
Of course, those are things about their reunification and their glorious revival of the ancient world order where they consider they were on top.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/0ea275739fea7daa755384a464a3eb17a1063052.jpg[/img]
He will also appear in your relationship list to reflect his attitude to you based on your actions and choices.

5, More Usages of Phones
Last week, we introduced a feature that lets you summon your teammates with a simple phone call. This week, we’re taking it up a notch. Those phones now have expanded functionalities: you can order food delivery and even contact the Phoenician Mercenaries for backup! (Just make sure you’ve used their services at least once since the latest update to unlock this feature.) After all, who doesn’t love a bit of convenience in these modern times?

That's for this week. Our ever-lasting journey continues.

notes.title: DD# 187 A Delayed Flight Cannot Cancel This Developer’s Diary
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. I just came back from Guangdong because the flight got delayed for a whole 6 hours because of some air traffic control. But that cannot stop me from getting this developer's diary to you in the end. As this is NEOLITHIA, the longest-alive RPG in China, the immutable fix points of all the timelines, and the ever-lasting evolution of the game content, WE ARE ETERNAL! Yeah, I need to keep high to fight back some sleepiness.

Now, let's go down to the game content update of this week.
First thing first, Genzou's storyline finally connected to the cut scene. After an event, you can witness at the east barricade of Fjordr, 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/11ff8b469f1b4934b19e15543433ee530281b7cb.jpg[/img]
Meanwhile, A certain commissar certainly does not take any gentle attitude towards any military failures.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9660bcc7c401dfba5652d7a3ae7981b8c5c1825e.jpg[/img]
you can learn more from a certain drunk soldier in the traven. Genzou will actively ask around about the girl he waited for decades. And here, he finally can get some answers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/7501696610edf70a3c0ddbbc486b098a74bb56f6.jpg[/img]
The journey ahead may be dangerous. But we all have something we can die for in our life, don't we?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/7071219ca9a8c3405f8b38fa86fe2d3d2d47df52.jpg[/img]
The story will continue when the map further expands deeper into Jiru Island.

Another major part of this week's update is the Mini-Game Room.
Especially about the secret of this room.
Have you found the secret of this room yet?
Have you been doing what you have been told to get a score as high as possible on the leaderboard or try to find what exactly happened here and look for your true freedom and liberty?
Now, in addition to finding a way to escape, you can also fight back. (Just a side note, few people successfully escaped as I think most of the people haven't even found the secret yet. To them, it's just a place with a lot of mini-games.)
This new scenario in this Mini-Game Room leads to a nuclear ending.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9a42041288d7b0e16d58f51b6e66647f8828358e.jpg[/img]
Of course, there will be a lot of death.
But, it's because men die, that liberty will never perish.
(You certainly don't want to live in a dystopia where dictators are immortal.)
Even though, this will not fully stop the experimentation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/e4e1c4bcde470aaae084dae495b84bb763f8f5ba.jpg[/img]
But the game now actually tracks how many times you get everything to explode. So, maybe in the future, something new can be added to this possible ending.
Meanwhile, just so you know, the pickpocket mini-game is now also in this Mini-Game Room. You may need to play it to get something critical for you to blow everything up.

In addition to those story content updates, we also get something that may really improve your life quality a bit when try to regroup with your teammates. Thanks to the suggestion of 吉尔伽美什， you no longer need to go all the way back to where you recruit your teammate to ask them to join you again. You can just make a phone call to summon you where you are. There are many fixed public phones you can use in different parts of the game world. However, I am not going to give you a mobile phone just yet. There are many considerations to take into account to implement fixed public phones instead of letting you take a mobile phone with you that can serve as a teammate teleportation device. 
The first reason is obviously that it is too cheap from the combat strategy point of you. When you start an adventure you no longer need to consider the composition of your teammates if you can just summon them anytime anywhere. The second reason is it may cause an alarmingly high amount of bugs to mess around the storylines. For example, if you have a mobile phone, you can easily teleport Genzou right to the East Barricade and bypass his dialogs when he reaches Jiru Island for the first time. There can be quite a lot of such cases that need to be pinned down before implementing mobile phone devices. The third is more a story reason. As we know, the Illuminati cut off communication between the local citizens of Queensmouth from the outside, and the Nise Federation quarantined Jiru Island, The Foundation is also not likely to allow you to just use your phone to call people outside from one of their facilities. Thus, it makes no sense to even be able to use a mobile phone in those places. It will also feel quite weird if you have something you can't use lying in your inventory forever. Thus, the system is currently implemented as it is right now. 

Now as I got quite busy with those real-life legal businesses, other updates are relatively disjointed from each other. For example, you can exchange beer for random rumors in Fjordr's Traven; You can find out why those random soldiers do not want to answer Genzou's questions about the "White-Haired Witch."  You can now find out a dark secret of the origin of those machine skeletons in the basement of a certain hospital. (at least the origin of some of them.)

That's for this week. The game is currently on sale and it's the last sale before the game's price goes up. I hope everyone had a nice August. And there will be more interesting updates in September.

notes.title: DD# 186 RPG Maker Event Summer 2024
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

This week, the development of the Mini-Game Room continues.
First, two more new mini-games:
The Mass-Effective-2-Sytle hacking game and the Sliding Puzzle Mini-Game. They are both ported to this game mode and fully functional. The lock-picking mini-game is also in this room. But, it's a bit different, we will get it a bit later in this developer's diary.
Meanwhile, all mini-games in this room have been adjusted to work much better with the time-limited challenge mode. 

Now, you may be wondering why I spent time doing this now in addition to the reasons I mentioned last week. Here are more details:
[previewyoutube=Iw5XlVCmvzA;full][/previewyoutube]

In addition to the game's update, we also got the most important RPG Maker Jam of RPG Makers who speak Chinese to mess around. :D
But another important thing is that some British guys told me it's also near the Independent Day of Ukraine. #MakeNoiseForUkraine
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/00ffaa3502bb75708cdcefcaaa825bd386999167.jpg[/img]
So, I decided to do all three things together in one independent Mini-Game Mode. :D

In about 20 hours, the RPG Maker Event will hit its deadline for entry submission. There will be about 20 games free for all to play. The entry I added there is the standalone version of the mini-game room. But, you can still grab the save files of it and extract those GPA coins you get in the main game. There will likely be some other quite interesting RPGs people can play.
Feel free to pass by and take a look:
https://itch.io/jam/rm-event-2024-summer
But as it's an event whose official language is Traditional Chinese, not all game entries are localized in other languages. 

But, is that everything about the Mini-Game Room? Of course not. Because this is NEOLITHIA. You can always expect to find some dark secrets beneath a seemingly normal facade of reality. (Here is also the part where your lock-picking skills will come in handy.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/5d720e524106a021cac0686d29d0a99372f290d3.jpg[/img]
Sometimes, it's better to not know the truth. But, I don't think such a warning will stop many people. Because many of this game's players are extraordinary people.
"You love fighting evil. You don't run from it, you don't try to avoid it; you welcome it, you crave it. You invite the pain and cherish the suffering. You dive right into the Filth and you make no attempt to wash it off, and when you finally climb back out, it doesn't matter how bad it smells, how the stench and the taint cling to you, you just can't wait to dive back in..."
Is that a description of you and me sometimes?
If it is, maybe you will find what dark secret behind this "Mini-Game Room" and even somehow enjoy it.

In addition to the Mini-Game Room, as we can now gain GPA coins in a more concentrated manner, I think it's also a good item for adding new items you can use those GPA coins you gain from playing mini-games to exchange. Six more items have been added to the list. You can exchange GPA coins for them in the game with any GPA Agent. More details can be found on the game's Wiki or in the full update log of this week.

Even though the main focus of this week is still in the Mini-Game Room, we still have some other content for Jiru Island. Fjordr East Barricade is now accessible. But stories still need to be filled in. I will likely do it right away next. Of course, the new story needs new characters.
So, here we are:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/cb7132a20e238941cfb8b7d113bc099cab0381a1.gif[/img]
Even though you have not met him yet. You can already use his appearance on your main character or any customized teammates.

A few things before I end this diary.
About the next week:
1, I will be traveling to Guangzhou next Friday for legal business. (Yes, once again, for people who don't know, I have a daytime job as a lawyer even though I pretty much spend more time developing games than doing those lawyer things.) But anyway, that may cause the next developer's diary to be delayed.
2, The end of August is coming. The game's price will increase at the beginning of the September. (Once again, for people who don't know, this is kinda a tradition as more and more content gets added to the game, the game's price will slowly increase every year.) As mentioned earlier, there will be a sale before the price increase which is also a tradition. It will happen next week, too.

So, that's for this week. I hope everyone has been enjoying this summer so far. :)

notes.title: DD# 185 The Mini-Game Room and A New Cutscene
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

It's been a very productive week. There are many interesting things going on. Please find them below.

1, Even More Fridges!
Continue with last week's refrigerator updates. We now have even more fridges all over the world that you can use to create ice and ice-related dishes or alchemy potions. Different fridges in different locations have unique sets of default items that match the context of their nearby environment. For example, the fridge in "This is a Bar" has a lot of meat while you can find some potions in the fridges of different hospitals.
Of course, that leads to some funny new dialog too.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f20d86022c5a534a977a4a2f7fea9bb5569ba65f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/cc9144ae5a350b42c9fe152b45d51615dbf7da7e.jpg[/img]
Dr. Light once again put a human organ for her study and her lunch in the same refrigerator in Fjordr Hospital.
But, there is more to it. You can now use those fridges as permanent item storage. Everything you store in those fridges will not get lost unless the whole building gets blown up, causing the fridges themselves to get destroyed. That opens up more possibilities in this secret world in the future. Maybe, in some future updates, you may see them as deaddrops just like the ones used by real-life espionage operators.

2, Mini-Game Room
As we all know we have tons of mini-games in this game, the problem is, sometimes we just want to sit back and play some card games inside the game, yet, somehow we may need to find the right NPC to start with this who may be unfortunately on the other side of the world at the moment. So, how about this? We put all mini-games together in an entirely new game mode that concentrates on all mini-games of the game. Thus, we get this mini-game room!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/7dc521dd4c63333c2567e476e1ae6c50be8f1364.jpg[/img]
So far, you can already play "The Ghost of Kyiv," "Special Tractor Operation." "Black Jack," "Minesweeper," "Tomb Stone," and "Gomoku" in this room. More will be added later. Meanwhile, you can also find a boombox and a piano inside this establishment allowing you to change background music or play your own music at will.
Storywise, it also has a lore related to two major factions of the game, the Caretakers, and the GPA. Basically, you are playing as one of your pets that you have stored in a facility built by the Caretakers in this game mode. So, you no longer need to worry about your pets suddenly getting teleported into the void when you store them. They are actually having a lot of fun. 
In addition to that, it will not be a good game design if this stand-alone game mode has no connection to the main game. Thus, another feature has been added. You can still earn GPA coins in this game mode. You can store those GPA coins in a global account that can be shared among all your saves. In the main game, you can retrieve all those GPA coins you earned in this game mode and exchange them for more useful items during your supernatural journey. 
Sounds fun?
Why stop here?
Let's go one more step further!
The Mini-Game Room itself shall also be a mini-game! Thus, in this mini-game room, you can talk to a GPA agent to start a time-limited challenge to gain as many GPA coins as you can so that you can have a chance to be listed in the Hall of Fame!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/13f05c84a8479b763baa7131b8a0e666b0c8a09f.jpg[/img]
You can find many of the game's characters occupy some of the default ranked slots. (Murin is definitely cheating as she can stop time while Eve is just good at playing games because she is our Illuminaughty Internet-Addicted Girl.)
But even if you can't beat them, don't let it discourage you. The rank list can have a total of 20 entries. There are 5 slots empty by default. Thus, even if you got 0 coins during this challenge, you can still be listed there as long as you play. Just like the Olympic Games, The important thing is not to win, it is to take part. :D

3, More Story Content Underneath the Fjordr Hospital
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/6cd659a12f6501bd0c546fe209f00ea93d784030.jpg[/img]
But, let's not spolier it here. :D
All I can tell you is those machine skeletons are now enemies in this location.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/50ece2a1d7c5344b654ef799341a279abf1e4c6a.gif[/img]

4, A New Cutscene
You may have noticed I am not in a hurry to open up the east side of Fjordr. Here is why.
I think Genzou's Story from that long-dead Stone Age Online across more than 20 years of real-life deserves something more than things you can see in any other RPG Maker games. It needs a new cut scene to kick off the future stories!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/4e2b05a78395a6cffdf7de3b0bea4b7b6c105ef2.png[/img]
The girl he has been waiting on his bridge for decades is not that hard to find in Jiru. Actually, she got quite a lot of attention on this front line.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/558461f2a2fcfce75b402279a4c4f88eb2048a46.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/2e94285fc43d02da0a9d552dd1942cf991029c7d.png[/img]
But, something is not right. Is she an enemy?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9ea978f535cfd6e3a30e1b254f5e3ff4c511b059.png[/img]
And of course, we shall have our iconic Machine T-Rexs. (Just not the same ones in the Stone Age Online because of obvious copyright issues.)
The cutscene is currently in the game. But as the story is not linked to it yet. It cannot be unlocked by normal meanings. But players who have the Gallery Unlock DLC can unlock it in the Gallery of Memories directly. Because of the engine limitation of RPG Maker XP, the cut scene is downscaled to 640x480 resolution. I may release a higher-resolution video sometime later. This is the longest cutscene in the game so far.

That's for this week. history exists for the memorable, those tales in the Stone Age Online may be long lost elsewhere. But they still exist here. Even though the game started as a fan game more than 20 years ago. When everything else has been forgotten, the stories I write are the canon.

notes.title: DD#184 Something Underneath the Fjordr Hospital
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

Before we start, we shall cheer for the brave Ukrainian heroes who are currently liberating the Kursk People's Republic, efficiently bringing the war back to the invaders. I wish them good luck.
As such, we got some new flag furniture items in the game that you can place anywhere.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/59125bce01928c8a35881da375cb0ebbd3f2ed13.jpg[/img]
The Flag of Ukraine.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/8b93b8133b40315d0708455cb90053cea587cada.jpg[/img]
And the Flag of Georgia. (16 years ago, exactly at the beginning of the Olympic Games, Russia invaded Georgia and is still illegally occupying 20% of Georgia to this day. Thus, many brave Georgian soldiers are in this war on the side of Ukraine as well.)
There are also 4 other new flag furniture items you can find in the game as we may have related game content to cover those areas as well in the future.

Of course, flags are not the only new furniture items we got during this week's update. We also got 2 new refrigerators that can be used as containers. But, there is something more than that. They can actually allow you to freeze items, turning water into ice. Generic water will turn into generic ice. But, if you have some special water such as holy water, you will get better ice as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/62c25c8ff5eebc9ed12e8599c7707155a23d43cc.jpg[/img]
Here is an ice made from holy water. As you can see from the image, it inherits some distinct features from holy water.
The ice can then be used for cooking and alchemy. So, feel free to make some Holy Fruit Milkshake if you wish. :)

Now, let's go to the main game content updates.
Following the development of last week, the journey inside the secret rooms of the Fjordr Hospital continues. Unlike what it may look like from the outside, you can find a military order known as the "Order-1062" in one of the rooms. You can easily notice something is very wrong here. Going further deep down in this room, you will find a stair leading to the basement.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/63a814d9b1d578631732ed3893b0239a66275391.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a350c40519970331d91c738d2253272bf9c283e9.jpg[/img]
And those are what you will find there. In order not to spoil the story, I am not going to tell you what's going on here. But there are some interesting loots down there.

Talking about loots, those heavy soldiers of the Nise Federation now also have their own item drop list and some quite unique gears you can get from them. If you prefer more peaceful ways to acquire those pieces of equipment, maybe you can find them in some chests or cabinets as well. They are all procedurally generated with various attributions and may have different prefixes.

Other than that, we also have a new quest for the Eternal Staff faction. You can help them clean up their ever-messed-up library filled with those cursed books and gain some scrolls as a reward while also improving your relationship with them. It's repeatable. So, you can farm your reputation if you wish. Meanwhile, nobody seems to care if you put some of those books into your inventory after you cleanse them. So, have fun with those additional loots. :D


That's for this week. Sorry for the relatively short developer's diary this week. Things are just getting way too exciting in life right now. Slava Ukraini!

notes.title: DD#183 Alternative Paths to Jiru & Game Price Rising Notice.
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone, welcome to another week's developer's diary.

Before we start, just in case some of you have not noticed, another big historical event is taking place right now. That is the brave Venezuelan people are rising up to overthrow a dictator who stole their rightful election. During the game's development in the past 20 years, there are many such big moments. And each one of those events we are experiencing today will be the history of tomorrow. Thus, let's take notes of this in this game's eternal history.
As a bonus here, there is now a new cooking recipe in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/8ed81f7201c59df45fbd511092a350de7f31d3bd.jpg[/img]

Well, there is also some other new cooking-related content this week. For example, you can now get ice as cooking ingredients, add some fruit, and use the milk we added last week to make your very own fruit milkshake. Nice drink in summer. At least, I know I want some as the temperature in Shanghai has stayed at around 40 centigrade in the past few days, and it's not very healthy to stay in an air-conditioned room 24/7. :)

Those are just some snacks for this week. Now, let's get to some main courses.
First of all, I am addressing an issue of the game. That is, we need more freedom, and more alternative paths to go to Jiru Island. Otherwise, all those exciting things that are happening right now may be locked out to everyone who has not finished the Dark Elf King's quest. That quest is mostly a monument in memory of the game's 20 years of history. As the story takes place for 20 real-life years, it's relatively long. I don't think that shall be a hard requirement for you to reach Jiru Island. Thus, 2 other ways to reach Jiru Island have been added this week. First, the most straightforward one, you can now just break through the Underwater Checkpoint by force, taking out anyone who wants to stop you. Of course, some certain factions will not be happy with such actions. But, why not? After all, it's you who are playing the game. You shall have the freedom to do so. Another less violent path is to forge a faked document that indicates you are allowed to go to Jiru Island. You can find someone in Katan who can help you with that with a price. That's enough to fool most of the soldiers who come to check your documents. But, eventually, the suspicion may grow. Thus, maybe you still need to consider acquiring a real one later. But, for now, at least, you can go to the island. Some stories and dialogs will change accordingly if you decide to go to Jiru Island via those new relatively easier ways. For example, Tanya will notice what are doing and make comments accordingly.

Meanwhile, the development of Fjordr continues. In the tavern, you can now order a room to do whatever you want inside. It's now also equipped with more useful items and NPCs to make it a good frontier base for your further adventure on the island. The town now also has a hospital accessible.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/813d1da3ee3f5f457c82daff48f05be58d13c997.jpg[/img]
You can learn more about what is happening in this town and get some medical supplies.
Bot the hospital and the tavern have several secret rooms you may sneak into by picking the locks (or blowing up the locks.) There is more behind the normal facet of this relatively peaceful town. For example, there are many soldiers guarding an area of the hospital that you are not supposed to enter.
We will cover more of this in future updates.

In addition to the main game's content, I mentioned I will keep you informed about the upcoming DLC.
So, here is another small teaser:
[previewyoutube=8qYo9W_AOts;full][/previewyoutube]
Alternative link for people who cannot access YouTube: 
https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1GYvUeuESA/
I just heard Putin finally blocked YouTube in many parts of Russia. It's a pity that he is still around. I hope if another revolution takes place out there, everyone who enjoys YouTube in Russia will remember this and be on the right side of history. Even those who still refuse to admit Putin's invasion of Ukraine is wrong. It's still not too late for even them to recognize their true enemy is in Moscow before the nation turns into an extra-large-sized North Korea.

One more thing. The game's yearly price adjustment will take place in September, and this is the one-month notice just like the past years. As usual, there will be a sale before the price goes up.
Some exceptions to this tradition are:
1, The price in Ukraine will not increase. It will stay as low as Steam allows all the way to the end and victory!
2, The DLC price will not change as they do not receive daily content updates like the main game. Thus, a price increase is not justified. 

Alright, that's for this week. There will be more content in Jiru next week.

notes.title: DD#182 Fjordr
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

As mentioned in the last developer's diary, we are heading to Jiru Island this week. The first stop on Jiru Island is a town known as Fjordr, a seemingly peaceful snowy town in the north in lockdown.
Soon after you arrive, you will find some clues about what is going on here. For example, you will learn why the Red Dragons are here.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a841888619d7bfa82a44a7b5b87465f5b426b265.jpg[/img]
However, this conversion will soon be interrupted by an alarm. But, let's not spoil that here.

Of course, without going too deep into the storyline, a world must be constructed first. As such, another major part of this week is about the infrastructure of this town. The town has a tavern where you can find some merchants who can sell you weapons, ammo, and warm clothes that can counter the local cold environment. You can also sit down to play some Tomb Stone card games here while enjoying some warm food and drinks. There is also another merchant right outside, as people are escaping from this town, he is purchasing everything people cannot bring with them. Thus, you can also dump all your junk or unwanted items on him.

Meanwhile, in East Asia, there is a huge Typhoon running wild at this moment. Even though it still has some distance from me. I can already feel some strong wind punching on my windows in Shanghai. My friends in Taiwan and Japan also sent me some images and videos to let me know how much "fun" they are having right now. So, how about we add more weather effects to the game?
So, during this week's update, we now have an enhanced weather effect system. 
Different weathers can now affect everyone's special attributions differently. They can also have their own weather strength in line with what you can see on the screen. Here are some examples:
Rain effects: Fire Elemental Effect - (2 x Weather Power)%  Water Elemental Effect + (1.2 x Weather Power)%
Snow effects: Fire Elemental Effect - (2 x Weather Power)%  Ice Elemental Effect + (1.2 x Weather Power)%
However, even though some people enjoy those "exciting" weathers, others may not be so fond of them. (including some fire mages, of course) So, we shall also have some supernatural items to stop them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/888ed130c84050bd66d75b5889fa851ab3978608.jpg[/img]
So, here comes Teru Teru Bozus. Those small dolls are used to pray for good and sunny weather. However, modern urban legends add more dark stories to them beneath their normal facet. For example, one may see a Teru Teru Bozus hanging near someone's window at night. Only to find that's a dead corpse hanging on the roof the next morning. Maybe, we may cover some of those stories later. But, for now, you can use them to stop bad weather.

The next main update of this week is about milk. Finally, we have milk in our game. You can purchase it from many food merchants or food ingredient merchants. In addition to that, some pets now produce milk passively when they travel with you.
Just like other passive resources generated by your pets, here comes the fun part. As the milk generated by your pets is named after your pets and you can name your pets anything you want, so...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a22e13c2e59dcbfd57a7d496ac3db917512ba7f5.jpg[/img]
Oh, well, I know Homelander drinks milk instead of producing milk. But, you get the idea. You can have whoever's milk you like you just need to make those names for your pets creatively. :D

One more thing, with Steam's latest demo updates. the game's demo version is now officially renamed to the "Free Version" with its own store page.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1549460/NeolithicTo_the_End__Free_Version/
3 years ago, the previous plan was to stop the demo support after I finished Chapter 1 of the game.
However, the war broke out. The demo version of the game received a new mission to bring awareness of Russian Invasion of Ukraine. Thus, it has been updated every day alongside the main game since then. Everyone can receive the latest news from Ukraine while also enjoying the game through Steam's auto-update system for free. I think this is a very meaningful cause. I can give out this game for free because, as you know, I don't care about the game's sales and I believe there are things far more important than money. If there is even one more life we can save. If this can make the war end with justice one day earlier. I think this is meaningful. Thus, the "Free Version" will continue to carry out this mission TO THE END of this war. To victory and Slava Ukraini!

That's for this week. Stay safe and have fun.

notes.title: DD# 181 The Marinas Lighthouse
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary. 


First, regarding the main story's progress, the preparation for Jiru Island is almost done. As mentioned in last week's developer's diary. The Red Dragons will appear in this area. Last week, I showed you the graphics assets for their commissar. Now, here are some images of their common soldiers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d64af2e5ae5e9aec93ee4e87db7136fc804ac033.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/2fb32bcaed776574788c0041ba92ab408443c4ce.gif[/img]
I took some reference from Fallout 3's Anchorage DLC. So, you may find some similarities between the PLA soldiers in our game and the ones in Fallout 3. They may be friends or foes depending on your choices just like how you chose your allies in previous chapters. You can also use their appearance for your main character or customized teammates if you want.
It's likely the first area in Jiru will open its public access sometime next week unless Microsoft's bluescreen of death suddenly wants to have some fun. (Good news, so far, I am not affected.)

The second major update is the Marinas Lighthouse. You can now find out what happened here. After the only survivor in this location realizes you are carrying the same curse as his, he will let you in. It's a curse of knowing something normal people blessed with ignorance are not supposed to know. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/36ac64a653d9fa5f86b605a491e91b84f8b5db9c.jpg[/img]
Of course, the Foundation will not allow such knowledge to spread like a disease and get more people exposed. They tried to do something but, it didn't end well. It's all about UPEX0000.

The rest parts of this week's updates are just some seemingly small and insignificant content spreading all across the world. (But who knows if there will be any chain effects in the future triggered by such tiny little seeds planned at this moment in time.)
Those updates are:
1, Deers now appear in the old town of Liu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/0f2d92b476f2076effd3ac70544bba4714ff8071.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/8c78c4f0ed7e20b57c35df43fdfb6a952b531fa7.gif[/img]
Thanks to someone who keeps bombing me with that シカ色デイズ song. :D
Fun fact: There were indeed some deers that once existed in the real-life counterpart of this old town. I saw them about 30 years ago in that park. Now that area which was once a park, is full of commercial establishments and little green remains. I think that's a common fate to many once-rural areas around Shanghai. A pity that kids nowadays may never have a chance to see what that once was. Oh, well, at least it exists in our timeless game. :D

2, Egypt now has a new area that connects the Long-Forgotten Mountain Path and the Bank of the Nile.
That means you can go directly to the Nile without even entering the city, allowing the area around the Nile to become more accessible to people who want to catch some crocodile pets or just see sharks eating some unfortunately tourists. 

3, More random pet perks.
There are a total of four new random pet perks that may appear on any pets that join your group for the first time. That shall bring further diversity to your pet collection and allow you to have more ways to solve problems with their unique talents.

That's for this week.
And a bit teaser for the game's DLC-in-development.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/3f52b912784c7407c57cf2186e8dd40d60156430.jpg[/img]
Although we will have a lot of guns, you don't need them. You can absolutely go melee.
