notes.title: DD#166 Ah, Fresh Meat! - Part 1
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

The game is currently on sale under the influence of some unspeakable Lovecraft horror. But, don't worry, counter methods have been deployed to fight such cosmic horror. The free DLC "All Fear Comes from the Lack of Firepower" has come with a lot of firepower you can find in your safe house. :)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2877000/NeolithicAll_Fear_Comes_from_the_Lack_of_Firepower/

Modern science and the development of weaponry have made it much easier for humans to defeat many once-feared monsters. Dragons once terrorized villages may now be slayed not by brave knights, but by artillery strikes. Zombies and orcs that once may overwhelm the defense of human forces with their number may now be blown up by bombs dropped from drones. Even some self-claimed gods can be taken down by nukes. The table has turned. Many predators become prey. If the world behind the veil is known to the public, maybe it will be a fashionable sport among the rich to hunt mystic creatures for fun.

Oh, well. Maybe they cannot. But you can.  It certainly involves some animal cruelty, both to normal animals and supernatural animals. But, I am not here to judge. Happy hunting out there! Well, it will not be a good hunt if you cannot take some sort of trophy. Thus, I added loot tables on almost all animals this week. But, what can be on this table? Some may have furs, some may have parts that can be used for alchemy. But, most commonly, they all have meats.

Thus, a lot of different types of meats have been added to the game to replace the previous generic meat. Previously, we only have two types of meat, they are "meat" and "strange meat." Let's not discuss too much about the "strange meat" for the sake of everyone's sanity while the "meat" was just a generic turn to all other "normal" meats. Now, we shall get down to more details. Almost all kind of enemies now have their own meats. To be specific, we now have 22 more different types of meats from different animals ranging from the meat of gigantic mammoths to the meat of small rats. Certainly, you can easily expect mammoth meats shall allow you to recover more HP than rat meats in "normal" circumstances. (But, again, we are living in a highly free supernatural world, many things can happen.) That shall also bring more satisfaction to big-game hunters.

With the change to the meat, two more systems are immediately affected.
The first one is the cooking system.
The result is very obvious and direct, as the meat you use to cook a dish can directly affect the HP recovery rate on the final products. Even if your cooking skill is low, you may use good meat ingredients to make up the effort. A pork soup may be delicious enough to recover a good amount of HP after battles. But, a mammoth soup cooked by a skilled cook may even turn the tide during a battle. That means the meat dishes may now have bigger impacts on your life quality and war efforts.
The second one is the butchery.
Although sending your own pets to be butchered to get meat is highly detested by many animal-loving organizations, it's still a choice in the game. With the variations of meat added to the game, it can also become a more useful system. The HP recovery effect of the meat you will get is now scaled based on the animal you sacrifice. You can now level up the pets you intended to butcher later to get better meats and thus be able to make better meat dishes. The butcher, Zhao Sandao has been upgraded to using our new system to give you specific meats based on the pet you give him.
Actually, he is now an NPC with a relationship entrance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/98f02e3550653e54545fa791b261dbfd1ca6519b.jpg[/img]
You can improve your relationship with him by providing him with more animals to butcher.

That basically concludes the majority of this week's update. But, the title says "Part 1." What does that mean?
Well, there is much more to explore on this topic. 
Before the development of the new content and picking the topic of meat, much research has been done. In addition to being a food source, different meats also have significant places in many different cultures and religions. That's quite natural as humans have been taking meats from other creatures and eating them since prehistory eras.  Some believe God created certain animals for humans to eat, it's our birthright to consume. Some believe eating certain animals is taboo and must be avoided at all costs. In some nations, certain animals were consumed as traditional dishes in history while now such consumption is forbidden by laws as a result of social evolution. The meaty content update of this week opens up more possible content updates in our faith system and cooking system, and there may even be related quests.

And, there is also something darker. Both "fresh" and "meat" can mean something about sex usually in a depravity manner. Strangely, it's common in many cultures and languages. There is one place in the game that shall serve such content. Some art assets have been made to fulfill such dark desires and pleasures deeply coded in everyone's DNA.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/8b33d64436d7240ac16fdf24b42ebeed85f7388b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d54fa39508a1b456bbe71180d02cf86bc6a24f6e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/efa2ed15dc89d0111e33a606284a10ba8d4493c9.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/22bdfbee6cc3970e6c230f2d87c910d347da8236.gif[/img]


Meanwhile, just some random other content:
We now have chickens in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/05bf91b0ff7f980c1cf693befe796e0d8b24a6d0.gif[/img]
They can lay eggs. They can be slaughtered for meat. I don't see why not to have them.

That's for this week. 
Maybe humanity shall not fear monsters. Monsters shall fear us. Because humanity is more than capable of doing things more horrible than monsters.
Bon appétit.

notes.title: DD# 165 Ron, These Things Are Better than Magic Wands!
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

With the release date of the "All Fear Comes from the Lack of Firepower" DLC, we got more gun-related content this week even from the most unexpected places.
Such as:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b10fcf4f3cb899bee7e7487918e94d7d5af15c1f.jpg[/img]
(You know I tend to make all those memes into the game. :P)
There is a new magic school in the Mages Guild known as the Gunmancy. You can now find Harry the Gunmancer to purchase guns in the Mages Guild. He can also teach a new spell that allows you to magically have more ammo during a gunfight. Nobody knows exactly how that spell works. Whenever something cannot be explained. That must be magic or quantum physics. :)

Meanwhile, as he has a new unique character appearance, you can use his appearance on your main character or customized teammates as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/3c952f978473868f81cc697c01f42346a2c3dc09.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/aec88c93e444171fe9057e54dba1dc0203031096.gif[/img]

I hope you just had a good laugh. Now, let's move on to more serious topics.
The content development for the new DLC needs to be locked down to give it a proper release. That's just a good engineering practice to avoid any last-minute change to blow things up and cause the DLC to miss the deadline. So, the DLC content is already this week. But, before the content lockdown happens, two new guns have been added to the game.
Those are:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/354e858add31dd747a854d7be240f06fbb856d7c.jpg[/img]
and
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a88bbe798b2bd0fbd8c07fd44032ecb8f30d5351.jpg[/img]

QBZ-97 is an interesting assault rifle. It's made in China by Norinco. However, unlike its previous version QBZ-95, QBZ-97 uses  5.56×45mm NATO ammo instead of the 5.8x42mm rounds used by many other guns made in China. It's also a widely exported weapon. You can even find it in Canada for civilian usage. Since we have Chinese players in the game's QQ group proposed to add this gun, I made it happen this week.

Beretta PX4 is a small pistol designed and manufactured by the famous Italian company Beretta for self-defense and law enforcement purposes. The reason to have it in our game this week is to provide another alternative to the relatively cheap but less useful M1911 and the powerful but expansive Desert Deagle. 

We also got a not-so-supernatural version of equipment that can provide additional ammo during a gunfight just like the Phantom Magazine spell does. That's the ammo belt. Many enemies such as Russian Orc Soldiers, Undead Russian Soldiers, Bandits, Mercenaries, and Katan Outlaws now drop this equipment. 

Talking about those Russian Orc Soldiers, they may now also have a small chance to drop the washing machines they stole. You know where it goes. Here comes the weekly make Putin's supporters unhappy part of the developer's diary. :)

Thus, let's go to the story content of the Siberia front.
The map has been expanded to the Church on the Hill. There are a lot more Russian Orc Soldiers and Meat Cubes, plus some vengeful spirits in the graveyards. All areas outside the main church building have been completed and are accessible. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a744ca99e21156c2579c3f94e80e9349fe4a9402.jpg[/img]
Of course, there are always some small details here and there to add more insults to Putin's supporters. 

But, again, the village is not all orcs, there are...or at least, there were humans. Thus, a document known as <<A Draft Dodger's Note>> can be found outside the village. Good luck to our Russian friends who are against Putin. I understand it's a nation where free speech is a crime and not everyone can risk everything to do it publically. Yet, what you do in secret is also admirable and valuable.

In addition to everything mentioned above, the dark elf I previously mentioned now finally appeared in the Sealed Palace. It does not matter if you were there 20 years ago or not. By default, he acknowledges you have forgotten everything. Yet, the ancient story from that long-lost Stone Age shall continue. 

That's for this week. The weapon pack is coming. May the firepower eliminate all the fear of terror.

The full update log of this week:

notes.title: DD# 164 Intermission
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

This week's work is mostly around polishing existing content and laying the foundations for future story and feature developments, thus the title.

Here are a few main updates of this week:

1, Guns!
As the "All Fear Comes from the Lack of Firepower" DLC announced last week, I am working on adding more firearms and related features to the game.
Thus, we now get the Israeli Negev as a new type of machine gun.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/03530dd5360a36039621551d829fa88bc02646ef.jpg[/img]
It may be more cost-efficient than M249. It also comes with a higher ammo capacity.
To make different types of guns have their more unique feature. A new game mechanics has also been added. That's the accuracy of a gun. The accuracy governs how likely the projectile from a firearm will accurately hit where your mouse clicks. A sniper rifle usually can have 100% accuracy while a machine gun usually has far less their bullets may spread from the center of the crosshair widely and wildly. As a result, you may find using machine guns to snipe enemies and secure headshots critical damages become much harder. But, that's compensation for their superior firepower when against a large group of enemies. You may also use various gun modules to make adjustments and find what can suit your needs in battles best.

2, More Cooking Variations.
The cooking system also received a tech-concept upgrade this week. Previously, each combination of ingredients could only make a single type of food mapped to them. However, that makes things less flexible and not very realistic. Thus, a change on system level has taken place to address this. The same sets of ingredients may now be used to cook different types of food if matched recipes exist.
For example:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d3e86300186c2d2d1af5fb8d43f11b5768c3c5a1.jpg[/img]
When you use apples and flour to cook something, you may now choose to get an American Apple Pie or a French Tarte Tatin.
It may not be a big change that will bring you many benefits when you are fighting unspeakable horror to save the world or build your underground supervillain empire. But, I think we shall all enjoy some normal game in an RPG sometimes.

3, The Abandoned Village.
Here comes more content to make those Z-ombies of Putin mad. We now have a loot list on those meat cubes. Not many valuable things are on that list. But, if you are playing a necromancer, those blood, bones, and strange meat may have some use to you.
In addition to those meat cubes, the village now has some orc soldiers as mentioned previously.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/06d71c394454cd26fc0734577f17334d2b102499.gif[/img]
They also have a loot list. You can even get some AK-47s from them.
However, those AK-47s are ill-maintained. Thus, they have terrible performances during battles.
Technically, that's achieved by adding a highly customizable prefix on normal AK-47s. The prefix itself can have a parameter list to decide how to modify an item. Thus, it's possible to make more unique items in the future. Both better ones and worse ones.

4, Another Dark Elf
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/0dd40e3622a65915991071615805445c597f7799.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d0ddc7b1f1b07f6ce332010a4e2be087b89c3a6e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a18419ba2da6bda1165320bd1755e641dc6da9e3.gif[/img]
He will appear in the Sealed Palace soon. But, let's keep his identity a secret for now.
Meanwhile, you can use his appearance on your main character or customized teammates if you like.

That shall cover most parts of this week's update. There are still more small changes that can be found on the full update log. Next week, we will have one more developer's diary before the release of the new DLC. It's likely I will add more guns and actually start to work on the content of the DLC and hook everything up. :)

notes.title: DD#163 Let There Be Escalation!
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

This week, we can see great development in our real life and in the game content.
The situation is escalating quite fast.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/4205325855e77f7e783e86cd663d1d87a6967b9f.jpg[/img]
Just like from MP3 to MP4 and then to MP5. :)
Yes, we now have more guns!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/039b3a748401a9a55311b3168f93be7c5efa5acb.jpg[/img]
We got MP5s as a new submachine gun.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/16751d967caeea39771426a7b41c2acb197fadb8.jpg[/img]
We got an update on the Ukrainian Zbroyar Z-15s.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/e7dd4ec632624a2444fdfb76365c7229b5d279d2.jpg[/img]
We also got the iconic French "Fusil d'Assaut de la Manufacture d'Armes de Saint-Étiennes" (or, in short, FAMAS) which is famous for its high rate of fire and reliability. 

What's all this about?
Well, as I mentioned in the last week's developer's diary "There are so many beautiful things in the world other than video games, yet Putin still started a war on Feb. 24th, 2022." It seems this very sentence made another Putin's Z-ombie quite unhappy. So, they came and left some negative reviews on our game. They even try to justify Putin's genocide against the Ukrainian people, all those murders, rapes, war crimes, and terrorist attacks with some of Putin's propaganda. Ironically, last week, I was mostly talking about the censorship. And, it seems we immediately find a pathetic victim of such brainwashing revealed themselves.

Fun fact, that guy who loves Putin so much is actually Chinese and properly lives within a quite short distance from where I am, no longer than the distance between Bilhorod and Moscow. What makes things more funny is, that I also have many real Russian friends who do not even like Putin or support his war at all. Some of you may not believe it. But, there are indeed good Russians out there. I will talk more about this later.

Anyway, since we got some Z-ombies came here knocking on the doors again. You know how I do things. I am not going to abuse my power to excommunicate them or ban them for now. I am simply adding a lot more content they will not like and watching them cry louder and more pathetically. In addition to the guns, I mentioned above. The paused quest in Siberia is now resumed with a modified story script going directly to the war.

As you continue following a bear to find the distress signal in Siberia, you will now find an abandoned village.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/00c8f020884c06f2ce41cfe4fca728947e2e6c82.jpg[/img]
With certain types of new enemies:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/4fdedcee9bce3bb3d9651dcdc418b040103ebe7e.jpg[/img]
Well, orcs are not added yet because it will take a while to make 3D models.
But, meat cubes are real.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/de37e044367fe970269490f37c2afa94a7e0529d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/fdffc9189aee5312f1ba6841cb37bd3a0d06fd1a.jpg[/img]
They are marked as "undead" and "evil." They drop strange meat if you defeat them. For our players with very... extraordinary tastes, they may also capture those meat cubes and turn them into pets. (Well, I will not do that, but I will not limit your freedom to do so.)
This is the first time we have a quest directly about this war. And its original plan was quite different. But after more than 2 years of the pause, maybe it's time to finally take a more direct approach to the game's storylines.

Just as in real life, many things changed this week. By the time I am writing this developer's diary. "Liberty of Russia" Legion is casting their "votes" in the Russian presidential election by attacking Putin's troops in Bilhorod and Kursk. See I told you there are good Russians. :)
And French President Macron also delivered a great speech with inspiration and passion to support Ukraine with no red lines unlike two years ago. (That's the main reason why I added FAMAS to the game.)

Ladies and gentlemen, we are all civilized people. But, we shall know full well that when some uncivilized barbarians start a war, we shall not play nicely with them as they know no limitation and do not follow the rules. Many of us have been following our high social standards for a long time. Especially in East Asia, we usually try to be polite, try not to offend others, and try not to bother others. Thus, when something like this happens, many of us will first try to negotiate, try to reason with the other party, try to avoid escalation and try not to anger dangerous criminals. As if, deep down in our hearts, we all fear that they have a good reason to do all those terrible things. As if, deep down in our hearts, we all fear those villains are not actually bad, they are just misunderstood. 

Now fear no more! It's time to trust your guts to confirm you do not need to negotiate with them, you do not need to tolerate them. You shall take a stand, and do what is right, you have the firepower in you to support you!

So, here also comes the store page of our upcoming free DLC:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2877000/NeolithicAll_Fear_Comes_from_the_Lack_of_Firepower/
(It's just the store page. Content is still being developed.)

Fear no more. The righteous shall never fear the wicked.
Let There Be Escalation!
When seeing the dying of the light of life in such injustice, let us rage. 

That's for this week.
Unfortunately, I am needed in Guizhou next Monday and Tuesday to do some legal investigation. Thus, the development may pause for a day or two. In other countries, this may be more of a private detective's job. But in China, no such kind of private detective is allowed. Thus, lawyers like me are also playing the role of private detectives sometimes.

notes.title: DD# 162 Once upon an Uncensored Time
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

Before we start, let's take a moment to mourn the passing of the world-famous Akira Toriyama, the author of Dragon Ball. On March 1, 2024, Toriyama died from acute subdural hematoma, at the age of 68. His funeral was held privately with only his family as attendees. His death was announced by his production company Bird Studio one week later on March 8. Thus, we only know that recently. It's the end of another era. We once lived in an era with him. Now this era is no more.

However,  have you really seen the full Dragon Ball animation for once? There are many different versions outside, in the US, Germany, France, and many different parts of the world. All of them are more or less censored from the original versions in the name of protecting the audience from bad influence while actually denying the whole and complete experience of such a masterpiece. We live on the same planet. We watch animations, play video games, and see movies of the same name. Yet, what we get is different.  Because someone out there does not want us to see the same thing, they make our prospect be manipulated to their liking. They try to play God, denying us from sharing the same memory, making us unable to understand each other, as if an uncensored original piece of artwork is a Tower of Babel that will challenge them.

Yet, do you believe there was once upon a time, there was no censorship?
If you do, type in "[b]I want to believe.[/b]" in the game's console command and you can unlock all the faith beliefs and tenets of the game. It's a phrase from X-File. So, we also get a new faith to worship aliens because of that.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/db9b841f2d7af2c76e5d1a8ad3ce845752cadb1a.jpg[/img]
It's an Atheism faith as it believes all gods are just their advanced alien overlords.
Yet, the followers of this faith can pray. Although there may be no divines listening, their alien overlord out there may somehow listen in mysterious ways. Thus, they also get a quite different prayer. They may pray for an orbital bombardment upon their enemies. If they are very devoted, maybe their alien overlords will even answer that. It's an instant act which means they can try to pray multiple times in one turn during a battle, burning both their devotion and the HP of their enemies very quickly. 

Now, let's get back to the X-File. do you know, such a television series with all the conspiracy theories, sometimes blood and gores, sometimes exposed and naked bodies, and sometimes quite politically incorrect, can once actually be on TV in mainland China?  Don't be surprised, in that era, there were also very violent (towards today's standards) Japanese animes such as Dragon Ball and Fist of the North Star, and sexy (towards today's standards) Japanese animes such as Sailor Moon on the TV of China. They were all uncensored and available to audiences of all ages. Of course, there was no "Twin Peaks" because I think the government really really really does not like Agent Cooper's political views. But, you get the point. There was once upon a time no censorship even in China. That was the beautiful golden age of the 1990s when I grew up. Unfortunately, many of our younger players may never experienced such an era of freedom that rarely appeared in the history of this nation. But, such an era was there. So, I intended to carry on the freedom I embraced in my childhood to this game so that maybe there is a chance that people can know games, animes, TV shows, and the culture they carry were different back then.

In that era, [b]Blood is Red and Bones were White[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d08832d654c7c258aff46ccd32530a91d237485f.jpg[/img]
We are human. Our blood is red, our bones are white, and we die if we are killed. Yet, what do some modern censored games tell people? You can find in some countries, blood is censored to green or black. If you play League of Legends and pick Valdmir, you do not get a vampire, you get an oil baron. You can also find in some countries, white bones are also subject to be censored. Now imagine the Lich King in World of Warcraft has his head entirely concealed in a big box and his skeleton minions do the same. Funny, right? Unfortunately, it's not so funny to players who live in those countries. One more, you can also find people do not die if they are killed in some games. They somehow start to wave their hands to surrender or kneel on the floor allowing your bullets to shoot right through them in Counter-Strike. If you don't know any of those, then congratulations, you are lucky enough to live in a country where you can fully enjoy your games, a privilege that about 20% of the population on earth does not have.
I don't know when such censorships start. I don't know who would do such inhumane things.
But, I want you to remember that Blood is Red and Bones were White in a new procedurally generated quest added this week even one day "they" come to censor it and take away such memory from you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/96febdeb136dc3a25adcdb245434530db4303599.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/1c2085554a9472c7feb8b32f75688d9d817751f8.jpg[/img]

In that era, [b]girls could show their beautiful bodies as they liked and wore whatever clothes they wanted.[/b]
When did even Mortal Kombat stop having sexy girls?
When did all female characters start to look ugly in games?
When did companies like Sweet Baby Inc. appear in this industry?
Those so-called "awakens" and so-called political correctness are just another form of censorship to me. They shall have no place and will not exist in my world. Sure, we have diversity and towards a level of freedom that many do not have. Yet, our difference is, that I let you, players make your own decisions instead of forcing those decisions upon you. You can certainly play heroes or heroines. But,
If you want to burn down the entire city, killing everyone, you can do that. If you want to make love with girls, you can do that, we even have animations. If you want to just let the world burn when you play some mini-games, you can do that, we have plenty, including a built-in HealthStone skeuomorph. If you want to try out all those different character appearances, customizing your gender, changing them whenever you want, go ahead. That's the diversity I am talking about. 
So, as we just finished the story of the Dark Elf King last week. Someone proposed to have a beautiful dark elf girl in our game. I think that's a great idea. After all, we are going to eventually have all 4 knights of the Dark Elf King return to this game. Here we are:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/7897c19706195b00ae3864041500a3ad1dc89df7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9b3c7937beae5b0cf30a13947f1eafc5be187700.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/e184376e2b78a7c6335ff5ef3e1cada78241c071.gif[/img]
Judging by her hair color, you may already figure out which one she is.
She looks darker and more elf than his king because of some backstory reasons. 
Most importantly, she does not hide her beautiful and formidable body. After all, why wear armor if you do not plan to get hit? And who says a spellcaster cannot have an athletic body? Just like the element she represents, she may look slender and fragile from afar, but she may also be the strongest among the four. We will have more information about her when her story comes. But, for now, you can already use her appearance for your main character or any customized teammates.

But, what about the other side of the coin?
After all, you are playing a secret organization agent. It's a grand masquerade that many organizations like yours want to hide the supernatural world from ordinary people. There may be no worse censorship than that.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/8bb535814e3c814c0c64e0e0fc7caebac2d84edc.jpg[/img]
A new faith tenet you can unlock if you ask a certain Illuminati doctor in the Queensmouth airport about the masks or ask Kalina about the veil. Maybe, once you have the power and knowledge, you may not want to share with others. Maybe, you finally learned it's too dangerous to have others know the unspeakable horror behind the truth, you want to "protect" them. (However, in real life, I have no idea how censoring and slut-shaming adult content even for adult-only games can help protect anything other than sinking the birth rate of a nation even further. It's not like you are fighting Slaanesh in Warhammer 40k or something like that.)
Anyway, you do not need to be someone who breaks the wall. You can also choose the path to reinforce it. Maybe that way is most beneficial to you as you already have the power, why have more competitors? So, you need tools to manipulate the public.
You now have it:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/294b34bdb51c66de3c33b815d757373760720463.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b21dfd46b29915fee428305091e753b149cd2036.jpg[/img]
In Liu, you can now find a newspaper named "The Universal Times." It's a media with quite low moral standards. As long as you pay them enough money, they can post everything you want in the newspaper to change the view of the majority of people who live in their blessed ignorance like sheep.  
You can improve your reputation. You can decrease the public's supernatural awareness. Or, for some reasons that only you may know, to increase the public's supernatural awareness. It's another tool at your disposal that allows you one step closer to a puppetmaster.

Of course, you are not alone in this game of social re-engineering. Remember that one-eyed officer in Liu's Public Security Bureau? He now receives constant reports regarding anything supernatural on his desk. The good news is, that you may also sneak into his office and take a look.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/78441f2761c52b14820c4423c0614189760f5616.jpg[/img]
Oh, well, most of the data is still redacted. At least, you can now know the value of the local public's 
 supernatural awareness.

That's for this week. You can have your own choice to pick your side in this war to either break the wall or reinforce it. But, remember the history, once upon a time there was no censorship, then "they" came. In the name of protection, they made blood green and black, they covered bones with boxes and clothes in the name of your protection.

However...
"感動的な映画はたくさんあるが、それで世界が平和になったかい？" --- 北野武
"There are many beautiful movies, but have they brought peace to the world?" --- Takeshi Kitano
The answer is no.
100 years ago, there were no video games, yet the World War 1 and the World War 2 still broke out.
100 years later, there are so many beautiful things in the world other than video games, yet Putin still started a war on Feb. 24th, 2022 and Hamas terrorists still went on to murder and rape on Oct.7th, 2023. Does anyone's censorship on anything stop that from happening?

Once upon a time, there was no censorship.
Will that time come again?
I don't know. But, this game comes from that golden era and it is still alive.

notes.title: DD#161 Do Not Go Gentle Into That Good Night
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

We have a major story development this week.
The Legend of An Elf King is now completed! The information you may get from this mission will not only just change everything you may have known but also link up many major events in all previous iterations of this game that happened in the past almost 20 years in real life. (During the story, you may even open the links to the "Back to Stone Age" and "Back to Stone Age 2" mods in the Steam Workshop with each mod providing hundreds of hours of gameplay content. Unfortunately, they are not localized to English.)
But, even without knowing those events happened before, it still will be a quite unique experience to find out the potential possible identity of your main character. Even though, who is telling the truth and who is lying is still based on your judgment and interpolation.

The whole story contains a lot of spoilers. Thus, only a few screenshots that will not leak too much information about the story are here.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/1b9d66dd175e402af04e1838707b26971076baf7.jpg[/img]
This quote of the sun and stars shall bring back some old memories of Stone Age Online.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f0d2be86e12fc71c8d59f98dd3fb31805621ea65.jpg[/img]
This theory of healing is a mock to many RPGs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/c180a8b11b6c5c2e5a1a051583b40191af4be8cc.jpg[/img]
And, this is a quote from a famous poem by Dylan Thomas. And you may find out what it means to the story that it becomes the title of this week's developer's diary.

The story also contains content such as how modern-day AIs are trained, the infinite monkey theorem, and what happened after [NEOLITHIC]SAPC++ and before [NEOLITHIC]To the End to fill in the gaps between some stories. However, even though the story contains almost a hundred thousand of words, it's still far from an Epic of the past 20 years. Thus, sequels of this mission are very likely.
As the story has many branches, you may not even find all those in play through. But, that's one of the fun parts of this endless evolution game of endless replayability. 

The rewards of this mission include all those powerful spell books you previously got, the rings of the 4 Knights of the Dark Elf King, an ultimate armor crafted by the dark elf for a human hero to face the upcoming doom. Those you can already get from previous versions. During this week's updates, you can further get a lot of Dust of History, even some attribution points, and the skill: The Dark Wound.
However, the truth may sometimes cost your sanity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/86f56c14926918ea121fa6cee59b9a4bab5c4f36.jpg[/img]
The idea is largely coming from Sanguinius of Warhammer 40k universe. Even this story itself may share some similarities with his fate.

[b]Do not go gentle into that good night,
Rage, rage against the dying of the light.[/b]

Here is also a bonus part of the story.
You can now actually romance the Dark Elf King.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/53a77cbe89754e611b0903f9667bcd9d5bf8305f.jpg[/img]
There may be some concerns similar to some characters in the "Frieren: Beyond Journey's End." As the story happens after an old adventure, we may also share a small amount of similarities.
But eventually, you can make it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d5138a1a2fd2cddb523d841e13f4d7404aa1b095.jpg[/img]
The Dark Elf King will also have his portrait changed a bit if you succeed.
The main thing is, I don't want you to wait another 20 years to see this happen. Maybe it should have happened 20 years ago. But, back then, there was no happy ending. "After this battle, I will marry you." is always a big death flag. Hopefully, it's not too late to make up for that.

Anyway, I will leave the story to you to explore.

With the development of this story, as the last part almost all happens in the Sealed Palace. Some improvements to the Sealed Palace also has been made. You will find more infrastructure in the Throne Room, including alchemy devices, spell fusion devices, and a magic circle that can directly teleport you out of the Sealed Palace. In addition to that, I also made the Sealed Palace much easier to traverse.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/31d8f10904289d4b6bde3d746ad7e6e701ef8a5a.jpg[/img]
The fountain at the Qinuyi Underwater Checkpoint can now teleport you to any floors you have previously visited in the Sealed Palace. You no longer need Butterfly Wings to do that each time you enter the palace.

In addition to the story content, we also got:
1, Collision system rewrite thanks to 渺兔's bug reports.
Now the cars shall not collide with each other in Liu. It's also less likely for traffic jams to happen.
Oh, by the way, it also makes your traffic insurance fraud activities a bit easier. :)

2, A progress bar in the Ghost of Kyiv mini-game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a3c55dedf84acc45d3244d637605cbcbf10190a8.jpg[/img]
The goal is to clearly show players how close they are about to win the game.
However, a generic bar simply cannot satisfy my design. So, I got the idea to technically make two bars, one blue and one yellow, they progress at the same time to resemble the color of Ukraine. Plus some text above the bars to show what they mean.

3, Another pass of Traditional Chinese proofreading.
I received some criticisms and suggestions on Traditional Chinese texts this week. I welcome them as they all will make this game better. And honestly, although Traditional Chinese looks similar to Simplified Chinese, deep down there are a lot of differences. It's also my least-used language among all three officially supported languages. So, I got another pass of Traditional Chinese proofreading with the help of the latest Microsoft tools this time. Hopefully, that will not make Steam scream that's "AI-generated content!" :P

That's for this week.
[b]Do not go gentle into that good night,
Rage, rage against the dying of the light.[/b]

notes.title: DD# 160 Two Years Ago the War Starts
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

First of all, today marks the second year of Putin's full-scale invasion of Ukraine. Let's turn back the clock and remind ourselves of the developer's diary exactly 2 years ago.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1519140/view/3119310025773834317

In the beginning, many have joined the cause to support Ukraine like us. There were many great fundraisings on Steam, Humble stores, Itch, and many other places. There were many developers like me making donations to Ukraine. That was a great moment when the world demonstrated solidarity and unity, standing with Ukraine. However, as the war went on, many grew fatigued, many went silent, and many even forgot this war was still not end yet. That will not do!

Thus, let's start with this week's developer's diary with new Ukraine-related game content.
During this week's update, we got 2 new playable character variations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9c0647a44a3124e4eb1adcae8c2ddc62a39f68da.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b6014b831624c7cb226382d7921c9ef770c5b8bb.gif[/img]
The first one is an Iron General in Ukrainian Power Armor.
The armor is basically a re-texture of the Templar Power Armor with a bit of modification.
The character is based on an old image online that illustrated General Zaluzhnyi in a Warhammer 40K Space Marine armor. I cannot make the model too similar to that one of Ultramarines because of potential legal risks. And I know Zaluzhnyi is no longer the command-in-chef any more. But, that does not stop me from making this model to remember his heroic deeds at the very beginning of the war. Just like we also have another "old gentleman who likes smiles" who is still giving quests to players to close the sky. Hopefully, we can see F16 this year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/0ab50059cbb37f8d28e7ed37a7c145fa4d92f4f2.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b304fc88d04d142f09693d7612dab570aafa1609.gif[/img]
The second one is a Ukrainian Cossack. The outfit is made by Optigon and I purchased a commercial license so that it can be used in our game. Cossacks were people seek freedom from Feudal Lords in medieval. They escaped from their overlords and made their communities in Ukraine. In their communities, they decide everything important in a democratic tradition which can be quite rare in that era. As such they become a symbol of Ukraine.

Although those are just cosmetic skins with no story content related to them at this moment, maybe there will be in the future. We still have a large undeveloped area in Siberia. The original plan for that area was canceled because of Putin's invasion. But, maybe, one day, we can get a new story of that area with all those characters involved. 

One more thing, just as a bonus content. We cannot just add a Cossack without also adding their iconic weapon. Thus, here we are:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/063d45af5e40f16b7c07115239c187652826c71c.jpg[/img]
No, wait. Not this guy from Metal Gear. Just the last part of his name.
So, here it is.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/2be8523e56e3ca5376b1cf89ed7381bf8697ed17.jpg[/img]
Shashka has been added to the game as a traditional cossack weapon.
The weapon can always cause bleeding and may also have other prefixes.
You can purchase it from several merchants in the game.


OK, that's all the Ukraine-related content of this week. My support for Ukraine will continue. This may be the longest live-operation of this game even in its almost 20 years of history. But, isn't that awesome?


Now let's cover our other content update of this week. There are 3 main parts.
[b]1, Elemental Proficiency Books.[/b]
We now have 8 books that you can read to improve your 8 different elemental proficiencies. You can find them in the Book Store of Liu among other books. Alternatively, you can go to the Mages Guild to find another vendor who sells those books. Some enemies such as the corrupted books in the Grand Library may also drop those books.
They are not just some random books you read and forget. I intend to make fun of them. Thus, each book has its narrative in a light-hearted manner and they all seem quite mundane yet can somehow improve your elemental proficencies.
Here are some examples:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/8ee48ec972b9494cebc6f9882c70cdb3c8cc1d6b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/e16108b30fd1b76a8e4c5c363c176f17858f09f1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/61bd879d2fe828da3e7089ec2bdeb7e5324f94a1.jpg[/img]


[b]2, New Food Recipe.[/b]
It has been a while since the last update to our cooking system. So, maybe this time we shall have more recipes added to it. New recipes are mostly fish recipes so that we can make better use of our fishing system and egge recipes.
Here is one of the new fish recipes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/8c0ed58ab721ef4f108282697e7c0a8984884310.jpg[/img]

But, eggs? Yes, this food ingredient is finally in our game now. But, where can we get it in addition to purchasing from those food ingredient vendors?
That's a question that led to my over-complex game design. In real life, eggs are from animals that can lay eggs of course. So, in our game, we can do the same thing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/8686cdfb84e7dccd5ec66cbf2c85dbff7792f7e6.jpg[/img]
......
....
...
Something seems not right. OK, to be honest, a certain North Korean human male known as Kim Jong Um cannot lay eggs. The screenshot is here because I captured a female turkey and renamed her Kim Jong Um just to make some fun. :P
So, basically, all the female bird pets in your group can now lay eggs for you periodically. (Unfortunately, we only have Turkeys in the game right now. We will get more, such as chickens, ducks, and other pets later.) 
Meanwhile, all those eggs are procedurally generated and named after the pets that lay them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/0d8d1c5e5de82e79138ef97de5d73afedcb33b1b.jpg[/img]
Now, let's cook those eggs. We can get...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/3f4065d950083ac666576f39ebc642e916f6dc5b.jpg[/img]
Fried eggs will automatically named after which egg you fried just to make it even more fun. As we can rename our pets to anything. So, you can basically fry anybody's eggs no matter that's Trump, Biden, your boss, your coworkers, your classmates, someone you hate, or someone you like. The important thing is you shall have the freedom to have all the fun. You can do all that just by renaming your pets.
There are 7 new recipes added.
[b]And here is a bonus[/b]. As we have new cooking recipes, we shall also have a cooking-related quest. Thus, we now have a new NPC in the Marinas Town Hall. Marinas is famous for her fish. But, they are now also looking for good cooks to make fish dishes. If you are confident in your cooking skills, you can submit your fish dishes to a Fish Dishes Critic. If he likes your dishes, he will reward you. You may even get some items with "chef" prefixes. Alternatively, you can also be a trouble person to submit some poisoned fish dishes and see what will happen.  :P

Now, as we just talked about food. Maybe we shall wait a bit here. Because the 3rd part may cause some uncomfortable to people.

So, let's wait for a bit.
....
...
...
...
...
...
...
OK, are you ready?
...
.
.
.
.



[b]3, Poops[/b]
Errr...I told you I have warned you. :P
Alright, as not many pets can lay eggs right now. But, we have a system to passively generate resources from them. What else do most of our pets generate? After taking a few moments to think like a Palworld player, I get the conclusion that most pets at least create poops! (If you have a cat or some other pets, you know it's your duty to take care of their poops. Thus, this is the first thing that came to my mind. :P) So, now many different pets will automatically generate poops for you to use.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f9fe77d9925c0a977202162b7b95acc9b1e85ef5.jpg[/img]
Wait, does that North Korean human male Kim Jong Um actually poop? Some rumor says he is a great guy so great that he never poops. I don't know.  :P

What's their usage?
The first usage is quite obvious, they are biological weapons that you can throw at your enemies. (They even get a special animation for that.)
Meanwhile, they can also be used in alchemy to create some very disgusting potions to cause more mayhems.
You can also sell them to some merchants to make some profits.
Of course, there shall be more usage of those poops. Unfortunately, I failed to get all planned features added this week so we will have to get them in later updates.

One more thing, it may be annoying to see Kim Jong Um keep pooping and laying eggs every now and then. Thus, I also added control over our passive resource generation system. You can turn on/off each pet's resource generation in the character menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/45ad8361765a8bbf2eb08e9cda47d9acbadbbcb5.jpg[/img]
Now Kim Jong Um can no longer poop.


Alright, that's for this week. I hope everyone has fun and don't forget Ukraine is still at war.

Another thing is I will be on a business trip to Guangdong next Monday and Tuesday to handle some legal business which is my daytime job as a lawyer that I do not enjoy but it pays well to financial the game's development. Thus, the update will likely pause on Tuesday as a result of that. Sorry about that.

notes.title: DD# 159 Attack On COVID-2024
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

As mentioned previously, I was hospitalized because of a new strain of COVID. It started with fevers, and half of the tests failed to detect it. It wasn't one week later, that the doctors finally got some conclusive results to prove it may be a new type of COVID. The good news is, I am an indie game developer with little to none social life even during the Lunar New Year. Otherwise, I'm not sure how many people I would have infected if I had run around before getting admitted to the hospital ward. The doctors originally planned to keep me there for 2 weeks because this new COVID-2024 is nothing like they had seen before. During the first 4 days in the hospital, I went through all kinds of tests they considered necessary. Of course, I also received the best medicine they could provide just to suppress the symptoms.  However, a two-week-long vacation is simply not something suitable for me. There are still a lot of things to be added to the game. Thus, I came out of the hospital a bit earlier ignoring the warnings of the doctors right after all test results of COVID went back negative. Although, there are some symptoms still remain, such as fatigue and having some trouble breathing, I think I can work with that. Thus, the game's update was somewhat restored a few days ago. It may still take some time for me to fully recover. But, we are getting there. After the game's update back to full production, the restoration of anything additional such as the war support to Ukraine shall follow. It's the first time COVID ever caused any direct trouble to the game's update. May it be a mere footnote in our eternal evolution.

Of course, you are not here to just see me battling COVID behind the scenes. So, let's go down to what happened during this week's short updates.

[b]The story of the Dark Elf King continues.[/b]
We now reached his Throne Room. It may still take some time to put an end to this. But, if you have previously collected the rings of his four knights. It may be a time to collect an ultimate reward for your effort.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/853c4c2ff00de5d2267741d1d01020e5e91dc2c2.jpg[/img]
It's another relic from 2004, re-purposed to be something for our current story.
But, there is no need to worry if you were not part of that old story 20 years ago. The whole story of the Dark Elf King will shed some light on what happened back then. It's an epic story as 20 years have passed in real life and the story develops in almost real-time.

[b]An Army of Trees at Your Disposal[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/33ae8158f1d13be2f790fbfc56d6b634a85a83dd.jpg[/img]
Thanks to Dagarond's suggestion on the forum. We can now bind trees to be our pets, too. That feels weird as it certainly takes some magical efforts to move those trees around as pets. Yet, it can be fun to see those trees stand there to tank enemy attacks. In most cases, they are likely quite harmless as the skills they can learn are quite limited. However, they, too can equip firearms and suddenly start to shoot your enemies or cast some devastating spells from nowhere. It will all depend on your creativity on how to best use them in your team. The supernatural world does not always need to make sense. Sometimes, it just makes meme materials. :P

[b]New Procedurally Generated Quests in Queensmouth[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d51f4694a40d63f92273d568f63333958a17155b.jpg[/img]
A new type of procedurally generated quests has been added in Queensmouth. Basically, it requires you to snipe some named zombies. To provide a bit of unique feelings on each of those zombies, a name generator has also been added. The quest itself may come with different narratives. Such as a zombie becomes a threat to survivors so that survivors want you to hunt it down, or some survivors feel it's heartbroken to see their previous friends wandering around among the undead so that they ask you to put them out of their misery. Yet, the goal remains the same. It may provide additional activities for you in Queensmouth areas. It can also be used to improve your relationship with local survivors in addition to getting some extra money as a reward in each such type of mission.

[b]Technical Rewrite on Customized Skills[/b]
I also took some time to rewrite some infrastructures of the code during this week to solve a problem. The problem is the game's structure is way too free from a data storage point of view. We have endless procedurally generated items. We now also can have endless customized skills as the spell fusion system kicks in. Thus, garbage collection is necessary to make sure the memory will not eventually explode. However, it provides unique challenges once again because of the level of freedom of the game. The question comes to how we do the garbage collection. We cannot just check if a skill is currently attached to a character in our database. Because we allow cross-save character exporting/importing in the mercenary system. We can also drop pets everywhere, especially in the pocket dimension. Thus, we cannot just go around to mark those skills to be removed just because currently nobody has them. Those skills may still be somewhere even in an external mercenary file. Consequently, a garbage collection system in the traditional sense cannot work. So, what can be a good solution? Here is one. What if I do it in the way of a database? What if skills or items can be garbage collected and destroyed, but, they have data that can restore them afterward? And that's the direction I took. We now have data to restore the skills attached to each character themselves. That way, we can now even transform customized skills through character export/import. For example, you can export a character in our mercenary system with customized skills from the spell fusion system. The characters will have code attached to them that knows how to generate those customized skills. After importing the character, the game system had no idea what those customized skills were. However, it will start to execute code on those characters that restore those skills. Consequently, we now have even more freedom in all our related systems. You can now have a full set of powerful customized characters with their customized skills imported as mercenaries to aid you in your journey.
Have fun! :)

Some other small changes include new craft recipes for Baseball Bats and Brass Knuckles, some reworks of zombie enemies in Queensmouth, and some bug fixes.

That's for this week. COVID-2024 cannot kill the updates. I just need to make more effort to overcome its symptoms.

One more thing: RPG MAKER XP is currently 100% off on Steam. It can serve as a map editor for our game. Our game fully supports map export/import with RPG MAKER XP. Thus, it may be a good idea to grab it. :)

notes.title: DD#158 The Spell Fusion and the F.F.F Dan
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.
This is not the most productive week as I mentioned earlier because I got infected by some unknown bacterial that the doctors haven't figured out yet. So, the update is slowed down even now.

But, we still have one big feature and something else for this week.

The biggest new feature of this week is the spell fusion. Even though this is not Magicka, you can now create your own spell from some basic elemental spells by fusion them together. More details can be found in an in-game document and the game's wiki page. I'll just copy-paste here:

The process of spell fusion is to merge multiple elemental spells and create something new. The first spell selected is the main spell, it determines some major attributions of the spell you are about to create, including the affected area, icons, and the main element. The other spells you selected are the secondary spells. They will add their elemental attributions, animations, and damage or healing effects on the main spell.
However, things are not just that easy. To fuse spells, one needs to have some elemental proficiency to begin with. More complex spells require higher elemental proficiency. The spell you created may also require a lot of MP to cost. You may find ways such as improving your elemental proficiency or finding a helper to migrate those drawbacks of the Spell Fusion.
Some fusion spells may have unexpected results.

Currently, the function exists mostly in the Mages Guide, you can use their Alters of Books to fuse spells. The Alters of Books are also purchasable furniture. Thus, you can also buy one and use it elsewhere. In addition to that, you can also find someone to help you bypass the elemental proficiency limitation required to fuse a spell for a fee. That's one of the main income of the Mages Guild.

Some related changes are also been made. For example: we got two more earth spells you can learn from the mages in the Guild.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9330c499fd9d57e8cc6b2d01c9aa61c1eada6e62.jpg[/img] 
Adobe means, well, just adobe. Thus, it's an earth spell. But, in this supernatural world, popular culture matters. Thus, its power is scaled by a user's 3D modeling skills.
Another thing is, that you can now find it's much easier to level up your elemental proficiency early on so that this system is not too far away from the reach of your use.
Of course, it will continue to improve in future updates.

Now, let's go to the "something else" parts of the diary.
The first one is the coming of the F.F.F. Dan. What can be something great to add to the game if there needs to be something that can enhance spells and be ready for the upcoming Valentine's Day? We already have merchants selling love gifts from the past years. So, how about we do something opposite? So, here comes the new F.F.F. Extremism tenet:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f4d1c8d0431ff6c10a6d2a8fd2abd612aeb03729.jpg[/img]
You can find their fliers from enemies' loot or trash bins to unlock this tenet.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/e721ba4c340151a5856244158f57e09065d3e8a9.jpg[/img]
It was originally a real-life organization to punish unfaithful lovers. However, with popular culture development in East Asia. They are now more and more pictured as a parody organization that looks similar to the infamous K.K.K. But, they do not burn people of specific races. They just want to burn people who are in love equally. So, by adding this tenet to your customized belief, you may gain a boost for your fire spells. However, this is also the first tenet that defines actions that will damage your devotion, you are softly discouraged from taking certain actions. 
Previously, I planned to let them have more presents in the game. However, as the reasons I mentioned above. I am currently unable to add all the planned content this week.

Some other small updates are:
You can now turn corpses into fertilizers in smelters.
And the Creepy Dolls get a functionality description to let people know better of their usages.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9f5899ce5e7ded2aaf888428941f011b41241289.jpg[/img]

That's for this week. I am still battling the infection. Hopefully, that's not the start of a new pandemic. :P

notes.title: DD#157 The Floor of Wind and the Cave of Dreamers
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

This week's content update is still focusing on Qinuyi areas. Those areas are as follows:

[b]The Sealed Palace[/b]
The Floor of Wind is now almost complete. When you enter this area, the Dark Elf King will briefly tell you what to expect.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/0336b242a1990645c6f6bddb52e4f272c8fe298f.jpg[/img]
The entire floor is an illusion of the once-floating Sky Island the dark elves once inhabited. The guardian of the floor is too proud to forget their lost glory. His regrets and hatred become the storm that periodically blows through this floor even to this day.  You will need to take shelter if the wind grows strong.

The Floor of Wind is also the home of those creatures known as Dorabis.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/0793b5b4caf2a4c8d98cf90ce3b79f1b327125b2.gif[/img]
They will attack any interlopers just like other creatures on the other floors. You can capture them and turn them into your pets. Defeating them may also reward you with the Golden Stones of Xuanhuang.

On the Floor of Fire, Melton Golems may now provide additional challenges to your adventure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/628ed301a35ae638e060db838f146d802398e37d.gif[/img]
You can also turn them into your pets. Defeating them may reward you with the Ruby Stones of Shenhong.

On the Floor of Water, you may now do some fishing.
On the Floor of Earth, trees now grow and become a new feature.

That's all four floors before the Thron of the Dark Elf King with their unique mechanisms.
That's all four floors each has a ring left by the Four Knights of the Dark Elf King.


[b]The Cave of Dreamers[/b]
It's another familiar location for any SAPC++ or Stone Age Online players. During this week's updates, we now have a part of it accessible all the way to the Mages Guild. However, to reach the Mages Guild you will need to solve two puzzles and defeat a guardian. Just like in SAPC++ and Stone Age Online, the cave's entrance will lead you to two different locations depending on when you enter it. Daytime and nighttime each has its own puzzle. You can access the other one once you solve your current puzzle. There will be more to come as there is an entire Mages Guild awaits.

In addition to those two locations, we also have some other updates:
[b]Counter-Silence Methods[/b]
It's quite annoying if you get silenced as a spell caster. As we are currently focusing a lot on spell casters, I also took the chance to add some additional solutions for you to counter enemies who love spamming their silence skills. Here are some examples:
Eloquoria
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f9d5afa1c3a32bc5397d7b224b2c68916f7b2ed7.jpg[/img] 
It's based on real-life medicine for ASD. However, because of some complex rating reasons, I didn't put its real-life name here. We are mainly using its side-effects here as the medicine can cause overtalkative which is to "remove silence" in the game. Yet, I'm still going to use this in the game. It's another reminder that life is simply unfair beneath the "nice and beautiful" facets. There are people who suffer from ASD from an early age. There are people unable to have a social life that others consider "normal" because of this disorder. Some may keep their distance from them while I will not. Everyone is welcome in this game for myself is also a freak who updated this game for almost 20 years.

Beak of Heroic Speech
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/ef2bbb2bd3443c8c29b10ff89acd34dfe0604849.jpg[/img]
It's another item with some old memories. The name of this item has a history back in the day of SAPC++ and even Koei's old classical game Uncharted Waters 4. That's almost as old as this game. However, Koei never made an English version of UnCharted Waters 4 even after they made a remake. 
So, it's likely something people never heard about anywhere outside the Far East part of the world. So, I decided to add it to the game with English localization to describe its anomalous effect in our game. Of course, there are some changes to fit our game. But, you can get an idea about what this strange artifact is. Functionally, your enemies will find it quite hard to stop you from spell-casting as you can gain a lot of state resistance.

[b]Egypt Polishing[/b]
Thanks to 渺兔‘s streaming on his journey to get through Chapter Two, I did some polishing and bug-fixing in Egypt areas when I watched.  For example: You can now use Ultrasonic devices to blow The Sphinx Boss into pieces as it's stone after all. 


That's for this week. Time goes by so fast, it's already at the end of the first month of 2024. I hope everyone is having a happy and productive January.  :)

notes.title: DD#156 The Legacy of the Four Knights and More Prefixes
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

This week's development focus is the Sealed Palace so that we can continue the story of "The Legend of an Elf King."

Here is the breakdown:
1, The Floor of Water
It has an environment similar to the underwater tunnel. However, it has its unique mechanism. The floor is made up of a few islands in the sea. To traverse through this area, you will need to study the flow of the water and let the water carry you to your destination. You may need to literally test the water to find the correct path. However, the area is not as safe as the peaceful sea looks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/582b7116c5bd77a28c976c8fc4844b7b9caf7933.jpg[/img]
Water Nymphs are guarding this area against any interlopers. Their charming skills can be as deadly as their water spells.
The good news is, that you may bind them and turn them into your pets if you are skilled.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a51b167a9035d556771d9a023dbdd09cdb1407dc.jpg[/img]
As we are talking about binding, thanks to Dagarond's feedback on the forum, the system is now much clearer about how everything works. The dice-roll system has been integrated into the binding skill. You will see your skill against your target's binding difficulty roll. That shall allow more informed decision-making when trying to capture pets. Bonus point: You can now also use Loaded Dices to manipulate the chance. That can significantly reduce the difficulty when you try to capture your desired Pokemon... err...I mean pets. :D

2, The Floor of Fire
Although the Floor of Fire in the Sealed Palace is not yet as complete as the Floor of Water, some of the nature of this area can already be experienced.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/fee4a5c5cbb724242d0e6ca59f5ece9db2105dc1.gif[/img]
It's the domain of one of the Dark Elf King's most hot-tempered knights. The floor is just as hot and unstable as its guardian. Grounds are shocking, floors may rise from or fall into lavas. To overcome this level, you may need some patience and stay calm even when everything around you is burning.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/df3797fe693a9028a4a3cf987103bed29cf0a878.jpg[/img]
Just like this. :)
More content on this floor will be added soon as it still does not have any hostile entities inside yet.

3, The Legacy of the Four Knights
Each one of those floors was once guarded by one of the Dark Elf King's knights. They are Yaers of the Earth, Waqi'er of the Water, Fairey of the Fire, and Wyande of the Wind. In ancient times, adventures had to defeat each one of them to pass the floor they guard to have a chance to have an audience with the Dark Elf King. Now eons have passed, and those four knights are gone. Yet, their legacy remains for worthy adventurers to find.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a7a3820fc48914e630912a174e8819272b9a145f.jpg[/img]
Each one of their "approval" is a unique ring. Each ring can grant its user a spell of their respected element, spell power increase of its element, and even allow its user to level up their elemental proficiency faster.  Each floor of the Sealed Palace has one of those rings. As such, finding those rings can be an optional object for anyone who wants to fully explore the Sealed Palace.

4, Alchemy Usage of Elemental Stones
Previously, we already had access to the Golden Stones of Xuanhuang, which has the power of the wind, outside the Sealed Palace. They can be used in Alchemy to create potions that enhance a character's wind power. Now, as we go down deep into the Sealed Palace, the guardians of this place may also drop other elemental stones. The Earth Golem may drop the Emerald Stones of Liuli which are the stone of the earth and the Water Nymphs may drop the Aquamarine Stones of Biqing which are the element stones of the Water. Thus, their alchemic usages have also been added to the game. You can now use them to create element empowerment potions accordingly. New animations for those enhancement effects are also added to provide a feeling of power when a character is enhanced with an element.

In addition to the development of the Sealed Palace, we also have many more special attributions and new item prefixes derived from them added to the game this week. The goal is to have a method to accelerate the level-up speed of a character's Life Skills, Element Proficiencies, and Weapon Proficiencies.
Here are some of the new prefixes that you may find on random equipment:
Semantic	Increase Speech Skill Level Up Speed	
Code-Study	Increase Programming Skill Level Up Speed	
Apprentice-Engraver's	Increase Modeling Skill Level Up Speed	
Kitchen-Hand's	Increase Cooking Skill Level Up Speed	
Potion-Researcher's	Increase Alchemy Skill Level Up Speed	
Kendo Apprentice's	Increase Blade Weapon Proficiency Level-up Speed	
Gun Trainee's	Increase Firearm Weapon Proficiency Level-up Speed	
Novice-Wand-Wielder's	Increase Magic Weapon Proficiency Level-up Speed	
Baseball Rookie's	Increase Blunt Weapon Proficiency Level-up Speed
More details can be found on the game's wiki pages.
Hopefully, those new prefixes may provide a better gaming experience and make the game less grinding especially when training a new pet or customized teammate on those skills.

That's not everything yet. During this week's update, we also have the Magic Staffs appear on more loot lists so that they can be more available to everyone. For example, Skeleton Cultists may now drop Magic Staffs of Dark. Water Nymph may now drop Magic Staffs of Water. Boss chests in random caves may now have a +2 Magic Staff of a random element. Kayir's Chests on the 2nd floor of the Maze underneath the House near the Paddy Field may now have +2 Magic Staffs of a random element. Compared to their counterparts sold by merchants, those Magic Staffs you loot as your trophies are more powerful as they can have prefixes.

That's for this week. The Floor of Fire is still burning. People are falling into the lava. But, everything is fine. :)

notes.title: DD# 155 A Hotel, a Magic Shop, and a New DLC
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

This week, the development in Qinuyi Island continues. The main focus is on some of the infrastructure inside the town.

The Hotel
As a town at the geographical center of the Nise Federation, Qinuyi has many visitors. Thus, the town obviously needs a hotel. Thus, we have one known as "Phantom Tide Lodge" added in this week's updates. You can order your room and some drinks at the front desk. Alternatively, you can just go upstairs, pick some locks, and occupy a room for yourself. Just be careful, not all rooms are empty. You may accidentally break into something horrible.
As a town promoting magic power, the employees of the lodge are very open-minded. They don't mind you doing anything in your room as long as you don't bother other customers. They even sell some special drinks for customers with their unique taste. They also provide condoms in their hotel rooms.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/70c76035b6fc2baede2592b8cd0a46cdcf6ba490.jpg[/img]
Oh, well. That's just for fun. No real functions in the game right now other than you may be able to sell them to some merchants or recycle them to get some rubbers. In real life, you don't need to visit a hotel located in a magic town to see those. They seem quite common nowadays in many hotels all over the world even in some quite conservative places such as China. 

The Magic Shop
As a town with strong magic power, it shall also have its magic shop. Thus, a shop known as Enchantopia Elegance Emporium was also added during this week's updates. 
For common adventurers. There are different magic tricks ranging from those that can grant you light/mirror/guardian spells to protect you from close-range physical attacks to those that can manipulate your skill check results or item appearances.
For alchemists. There are different ingredients and a book that teaches alchemy skills in their inventory. You are also free to use their devices to make your potions. Or, you can also use them to cook some food.
For spellcasters, they provide magic staffs and off-hand spell books that can enhance the power of one of the user's elemental attribution. Those weapons are specifically made for spellcasters. They are rarely found in the "normal" side of the world or even in many other parts of the Nise Archipelago. With more tools for spellcasters that will come in future updates, they may become even more handy to create magic-based builds.

That's for Qinuyi Island.
But, we also have other updates for this week.
1, The heavy units of the Nise Federation now have their combat animations
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/360529aec00c9d0931423341f5e856b3120d77af.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/fc561f675845d75bb9f0f38fa603d1c1fb9e5052.gif[/img]
Depending on your choices, they may be your friends or foes in future stories. One of them is currently guarding the entrance towards the Jiru Island which will be the main stage of Chapter 3 of the main story.
For now, you can use this appearance on your main character or any of your customized teammates.

2, A new faith that worships The Great Pestilence.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/c55afcc2bc8d9d39aee9f9d87014d4e9d4034861.jpg[/img]
When Una was making her Nurgle mod, I also had a similar idea in mind. Thus, here comes the faith of the Great Pestilence. The bonus of this faith has some similarities to the Nurgle worship in Una's mod. They both welcome poison. They heal instead of getting damaged when they are poisoned. But, their cultural background and stories are quite different. Many belief systems in the world can have their own interpolation on a plague god. Even in the Bible, there are mentions that the first Horseman of the Apocalypse will come, raiding on his white horse with the power of Pestilence to conquer the world. In some religious texts, this rider is also viewed as the Antichrist or an Archenemy. Thus, he certainly can have his own faith to gather his followers instead of being a sub-faith of another religion.
You can learn about the existence of this faith by talking to Inaba ' The Witch' in Katan.
Or, you may find one of his less friendly followers if you pick a certain lock and break into a certain room of the "Phantom Tide Lodge" as mentioned above. 

3, A new DLC
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2763550/NeolithicGallery_Unlocker_DLC/
Well, don't get too excited. This is a very light-weighted DLC to test Steam's DLC system.
Its sole functionality is to unlock the entire "Gallery of Memories" of the base game.
Those 3D cutscenes are one of the most distinguishing features of this game compared to other RPG Maker games. Just a content warning here, some of them have sexual, nudity, and violent scenes. They may not be suitable for all players in all locations to watch.
Meanwhile, You absolutely have no need for this DLC as everything can be unlocked through normal gameplay.
But, for those who want a shortcut, I think I can allow them to have it. Because there are many different ways to play this game. Yet, that's not going to be free. After all, I would prefer people actually play the game instead of using the unlocker. We have way too much fast food already nowadays. As a wise person once said, boobs are temporal, the glory of our game is eternal. So, it's all up to you. But the choice is here. The planned release date is Feb 12th or 13th depending on where you live.

That's for this week. The next week's development will likely still be on Qinuyi Island and the Sealed Palace. Have fun!

notes.title: DD#154 Qinuyi
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone! Happy New Year! Welcome to the first DD of 2024.

This week, we reached the 2nd accessible island of the Nise Federation. It's the smallest island in this archipelago nation. But, it also holds the strongest magic power thanks to the Sealed Palace beneath its underwater checkpoint.

The Sealed Palace is where the Dark Elf King went on his self-exile eons ago. Thus, during this week's update, a new quest "The Legend of the Dark Elf King" starts right after you finish the pre-required mission you received in Marinas. You can now already access the Floor of Earth in the Sealed Palace. Other floors will become available in future updates. The journey of this quest is also a journey for your main character to find their true identity. What were they before the airport incident? Will this be the truth or another false memory? 

“There are no facts, only interpretations” - Friedrich Nietzsche.

Of course, to recreate the heroic journey of the ancient time, to break through the 4 floors of the Sealed Palace and reach the Dark Elf King's throne, it will not be that easy. You will meet powerful guardians of this palace.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a4fc0168059c0b9fe363f04c1d848fe5bf992ee7.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/19a0995710e44715cdf96707e25aed0f0843c967.gif[/img]
The good news is that you may be able to turn them into your pets if you have a significant binding skill level. Alternatively, as those Earth Golems are all stone creatures, a certain invention of Dr. Kyoryu may be very helpful here.


In addition to the magic power, Qinuyi also has another unique feature thanks to its geographic location. As it is at the certain of the Nise Federation, it also became an airline center. Yes, this anomalous nation even has a domestic airline company. The difference from nations in the normal world is that they use giant bats called "Jamei" to transport passengers or goods.  The first Jamei Airline between Qinuyi and Marinas is already available. It makes exploring and solving quests in the Nise Federation become much more flexible. It also brings back some old memories of that long-dead Stone Age Online.

Other than the updates in Qinuyi, we also have:
1, A new quest that rewards you when you explore the Nise Federation
You can get this quest from your local contact after you reach the 3rd chapter of the main story. Report any major towns you have visited to her can give you some decent rewards. The order does not matter as the quest is absolutely non-linear. Thus, you can do this quest at your own pace and path.

2, Better Organized Bandits
From the desert of Katan to another desert in Egypt, bandits of the world are united! (At least when they decide to try to rob you together.) They are now technically in the same faction. That allows them to put them as random enemies in themed random caves that also have been added to the Wonderland Travel Agency this week.

3, The Abandoned Building In Egypt Is Now a Foundation-Categorized Anomaly.
The building may now randomly spawn a dead body and a foundation document in its rooms. The document shall provide additional background stories of this Abandoned Building. It's no longer just a building that spawns random things in its rooms. It's part of a secret history. There are certainly some references to the "normal world" such as the Second Arab–Israeli War and the Cold War in general.

4, Nurgle Appeared in the Steam Workshop
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/536eb061bd9896e292922ca3b4c11f7b1d803d82.jpg[/img]
The latest mod from Una. She says it's a New Year gift. 
Quite strange. But, reasonable. After all, Nurgle is also about "rebirth" and "the circle of life." 
Something fun with this mod is that the followers of Nurgle seem not only immune to poison, but they can also gain additional life regeneration power when poisoned. Image, some bosses such as Covid Vector try to poison your entire group, yet you welcome that, bathing in the poison and becoming almost unkillable. It's quite game-breaking. :)

That's for this week. A lot more content will come this year just like in previous years. I hope you will enjoy them in this vast open world. :)
