notes.title: DD# 142 Deuteronomy 32:43
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

This week's diary will contain three parts of information. The last part is about what is happening in Israel. It may contain sensitive content causing a lot of negative emotion to people. Feel free to close this diary if you do not want your mood to get ruined just as I am right now.

The first part is short, 
Today is October 13th. Happy Birthday to Wulan! :)
For people who don't know about her. She is our favorite 4-year-old little girl(Self-claimed. but if anyone questions her age, we will shoot them. :P)
She has published many beautiful art assets. Her horror game will be released on Steam next year:
Here is a link:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2453830/DollHouse_survive__or_death/
This is a very dark diary with more horrible contents to come. But, I don't think I shall allow those terrorists to ruin all the fun we have in our life.

The second part is about Dr. Kyoryu
There are two new quests that involve him.
One of them is procedurally generated, his assistant will ask you to help her do some house clearing. Oh, by clearing, I think she means, eliminate some bandits and terrorists near their research facility.
The other quest may be a bit more interesting. You will have a chance to learn what Dr. Kyoryu is working on.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/3111cf014e27b8e60ca78bd382accbf76f7bfebd.gif[/img] 
The idea comes from a real-life treatment method to cure kidney stones.
It got weaponized and can now cause massive damage to stone structures or anyone who unfortunately got turned into stones. As such, it may provide a bit more strategic choices for your Petrification spells.

Last warning. I am about to move on to talk about Israel
...
...
...
...
...
OK, it seems you are still reading. Good. Let's begin.

What happened:
Early this week, a group of Hamas terrorists invaded Israel. They targeted a peaceful music festival with a lot of civilians and no military presence at all. They fired at everyone they saw no matter gender, age, race, or nationality. Among the victims are people from all over the world. They then moved on to kidnap survivors and retreated by to Goza. Along the way, they also raided villages and committed great atrocities such as beheading babies and burning people alive.
I am trying to write this as calmly as possible so that you will not see me get stopped by my tears. What really happened there, the horror scenes may surpass many horror games you may have played by just looking at the photos and videos released on media. 
Yet, those terrorists and their supporters know no boundaries of their crimes. They even proudly publish what they did with no remorse. They consider our compassion for their victims as a weakness. You can see their supporters mocking the Israeli people who are in great pain.
That cannot stand!
Thus, Israel launched an assault on Goza in order to stop such a tragedy from happening again with the goal of eliminating Hamas once and for all.

Now, I will tell you where is my position on this:
First, my deepest condolences to everyone who got harmed in this terrorist attack. Especially to our Israeli players, followers, and those who added our game to their wishlist in Israel. Even though, the number is not that great. But, thank you for having an interest in my old game. I will voice for you just as I did for my Ukrainian players a year ago. That is something at least I can do for you. Please stay safe. Please don't allow such horror to stop you from enjoying all the happiness you deserve in your life. You have my support!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/58e57c517e1780b696544f22d5a996f1405238fd.jpg[/img]
A new post furniture to support Israeli people has been added to the game.

Next, I'm going to share some of my personal experiences with Jewish people with you. I am not going to tell you any faded stories about the friendships between my forefathers and Jewish refugees in Shanghai during World War 2. I am going to tell you the experience of mine that I personally have. I lived in New York 10 years ago. My neighbor is an old Jewish gentleman. He is kind and pious. Sometimes, he invites me to his home, sharing some stories with me. He is also very serious about his ritual to praise God every day even in a way that I am not very familiar with. But, I can see he always does that at specific times and on specific days no matter the difficulties. There is also an IT store run by Jewish staff in Manhattan that I always visited. Because we have different holidays. So, sometimes when other stores are closed, they are still open. My English was not quite good at that time. Yet, they always patiently guide me to satisfy all my needs. They are all very good people. I would not want to see any harm happen to them. Yet, I can only imagine many many good Jewish people lost their lives in this terrorist attack. I feel very sorry. Especially, the shameless Hamas also called for a global slaughter of Jewish people today. There are already people who get hurt in the US, in France, and in Beijing. I can only hope my old Jewish friends are safe.

Another thing I'm going to point out here is I feel quite angry about people's indifference to the hostages. To be specific, I am talking about the indifference of a large amount of Chinese people who do not even show a tiny bit of compassion for an Israeli girl with a Chinese mother. They do not care about her as they say she is not Chinese. They even insult her for once being an Israeli soldier. Well, I can only say we are better than this. Once again, I shall mention that 10 years ago when I was in New York, I was a stranger in a strange land. It's one of my very distant cousins provided me with a place to stay until I find an apartment to rent. He is an American citizen and now a police officer of NYPD. He provided me with help no matter how distant our family bond we are sharing. He provided me with help without questioning our differences. And I believe, a kind person like him also helps many strangers when he is on his duty. That is the basic humane, the good side of us as humans. What's more interesting? His sister also married a Jewish gentleman. That is also my family. That matters to me. Yet, that's not the only reason that I support the Jewish people here. The more important reason is that we are all human.

Yet, the terrorists cannot be reasoned with. They lack the basic concept of humane. They see it as a weakness. I am going to stand with the Israel people. I am going to stand with the Jewish people all over the world to prove them wrong.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/64911972088b6f3cb96a8900afa20ba544476d79.jpg[/img]
We now have Israeli TAR-21 rifles in our game.

Let's see who those terrorists and their supporters really are. I'd say they are a group of cowards. They targeted innocent civilians instead of the Israeli military. They may even try to justify their attack because Israel did bad things to them before. But, I'd ask does any one of those civilians did anything wrong to them before? Remember, not only Israeli people were murdered in cold blood here. There are also American, British, France, Ukrainian, Chinese, and many many other nation's citizens who got murdered here. Their justification is pathetic.  They didn't even become the martyrs they claimed they wanted to be there. They cowardly take hostages back to Goze, hiding behind the Palestinian people. An act inevitably will cause more civilian casualties. An act that not only their victims on the music festive as hostages but also took all the Palestinian people they claimed they were fighting for as hostages. That's what those terrorists are. Disgusting.

Thus, I consider Israel's attack on Hamas to be justice. Even though I cannot agree on many things Nētanyāhū did. For example, his legal system reform attempts to allow the government to interfere with the judicial system. However, this is the moment that we put aside those differences for a minute and focus on a big threat to all humanity. This threat is known as terrorism. I don't think any one of us here has a better solution to stop this from happening again other than a total annihilation of Hamas. 
I can only hope the action will be swift, precious, and lethal so that there will be fewer civilian casualties. But, the terrorists are not making this easy.

In other circumstances, I may consider those verbs a bit extreme. Yet, I think they are perfect to be quoted in the situation we are facing right now.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/4180478b1dc0ad62afaa97bb3e05c4589a1406f6.jpg[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/5abb74a1d32a9dbcfc35c20b4976a4d9dce91c9c.jpg[/img]
They are added to the game as tenets that can be added to your customized faiths.
Even though I am not a religious person, I shall pray for the victory of the Israeli army in this war against terrorism. 

You may all have your free will to decide which side you are on. But, I decided to dedicate a large amount of the game content to support Israel this week. And I think that's it.

notes.title: DD# 141 The Dark Elf King and a Paddy Field
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's log.

In this week's updated content, you will finally meet the Dark Elf King. He will reveal a memory that may be yours. (It's true for everyone who has played this game since 2004.)
[previewyoutube=2HYwLqgJ1-A;full][/previewyoutube]
As epic as our long journey sounds, simple Text-to-Speech is not enough. Thus, an experimental text-to-song technology is in place whenever you open your relationship UI with him.
Anyway, the Dark Elf King has returned. Just as his game-broken level of power as a recruitable companion, he will give a very strong spell book as he has a glance of hope that you may be that hero 19 years ago. The spell "Polar Hurricane" echoes back from that long-lost Stone Age. Even though this is a merely short encounter, you will meet him again later when the game world expands to Qinuyi. 

Meanwhile, just something from Mephisto
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/51bb7fab97e6c752d473dc3d273342fd48cb7022.jpg[/img]


Talking about the map expansion, we now reached the Paddy field north to Marinas. It's now occupied by scarecrows.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/11663d5b91454a7ffb90159dd3cf230a7386ec67.gif[/img]
They are almost totally harmless, except for a desire to dismantle your body and turn your remains into one of them. :)
[previewyoutube=J_DwUkg5PAI;full][/previewyoutube]
Once you enter the area near that house, the atmosphere will change dramatically. We will find out what happened to this place later.

Although it is not Halloween yet, we now have Halloween-themed enemies that may appear in our random dungeons. There, you may find scarecrows attacking you alongside pumpkin monsters. The chance to get such random dungeons will increase tremendously on the day of Halloween. Of course, there are rewards as the scarecrows also have their unique item drop lists.

That shall cover the major content updates for this week. More ancient memories may come back in the next.

notes.title: DD#140 Sweet Dreams Are Made of This
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

Today is the Mooncake Festival, feel free to grab some mooncakes in the Dragon's Treasure while you read this week's developer's diary. :)

During this week's update, the "Sweet Dream" side quest is now completed.
All the information can be found on the game's wiki. (Be careful, there are a lot of spoilers there.) 
But, here I'm going to talk about something behind the scenes:
The mission itself was inspired by a case in the World of Horror that happens in a hospital. But, I decided to do something a bit different. After all, each hospital may have its own secret even if the patients have similar symptoms.
The next inspiration comes from the song as you may recognize from the title. Everyone wants something in their life. Yet, not everything can be achieved even after people have tried so hard. Such is the tragedy of life. Is this the end of the world? Probably not. Just like that song was written in a quite miserable time of its author.
Now, what if someone tells you, you no longer need to fight so hard at all? Actually, it's highly likely all your efforts are useless. There is an alternative solution for all your problems in your life? How will you react?
Meanwhile, I know a certain character in the 3rd semester of Persona 5.
With everything mentioned above combined, comes this new side quest in Marinas. Unlike so many times in this game when you face a hostile supernatural entity. This time, you may even face a benevolent one. Even in case, you lose your patient while trying to save the patients anyway and decide to fight such an entity. You will find the Boss fight quite unique because such an entity is true to what it claims to be. The quest can also be solved peacefully without any combat taking place. But is that what you really want? Another aspect of this quest that is quite different is, leaving everything as it is, leaving the quest unfinished may also be a choice. Who am I to disagree? :)

Another quest added this week in the Marinas area is a generic procedurally generated one, known as "Eliminate Bandits." You can find it in the Town Hall of Marinas. The townfolks no longer just ask for random things, they now hire adventurers to eliminate some dangerous bandits hiding in the mountains. As long as you can take care of them, you may find it to be a quite stable income source in this town. Plus, it also provides a +2 quality equipment each time you finish a quest of this type.

In addition to all the stories and quests, another major update is about the prefixes.
One thing I want to address in this week's update to to make a wide range of prefixes to cover things previously missing. We now have 4 new prefixes that improve 4 more types of life skill levels and 8 new effect resistance prefixes to protect your group from certain enemies that prefer to disable you with those effects. It's a quite pragmatic decision as we are now facing things like turtles that can shoot fireballs at you or turn you into stones. There shall be ways to counter them.

That's for this week. Yet, here is a bit teaser on what is going to happen next.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/1a2dc3bca098f20c6516e21ddf3fcd62160156da.jpg[/img]
It has been more than 19 years. You have returned to Neolithic. Maybe you want to see an old friend in his new appearance. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/bbb595a61265f9b4feadc61fb451518f9be5694d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/52635709b96432e666f9943f262355b9a17a120d.gif[/img]
He comes with full new animations. You can even use his appearance on your main character or your customized teammates now. Will he be a friend or foe this time? The story is yet to be revealed.

notes.title: DD#139 A Madness Known as Science.
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone! Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

Before we start, I have something for all my fellow indie game developers.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1519140/view/5848542859095613768
This is the Text-to-Speech dynamic library I made to allow your operation system to read dialogs, books, documents, and some other texts of the game to the player. No need to read walls of text in an RPG like this game, you can let your computer read everything to you. It can be used in any game developed with RPG Maker XP, RPG Maker VX, RPG Maker VXA, and Unreal Engine! Yes, Unreal is included, as long as you know how to use dynamic libraries. It's written in native C++. Thus, all shall be compatible. :)
In theory, it can also be used by RPG Maker MV and RPG Maker MZ if you know how to use a C++ DLL in Javascript. (Something that you may be interested to read: https://nodeaddons.com/calling-native-c-dlls-from-a-node-js-web-app/ )

Now, let's start with the content updates for this week.
First of all,  here comes Dr. Kyoryu
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/17fad8da3733528319359b25abecbe5f2a50dece.jpg[/img]
So far, everything about his research deep in the mount is top secret.
However, you may find some clues from his assistant, a pink-haired girl standing behind the doctor.
She can provide you with pet services like a caretaker.
She can sell you some Pistol Petrification Mags.
She can also modify your firearms for you.
She is quite useful with so many different functionalities you may even wonder who exactly she is. 
So far, there is no answer.

Meanwhile, the cave may burn as a new type of turtle just arrived.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/73e07e4bbf5ff0d90d0c8e72f2028dedb4f06893.gif[/img]
Known as Kameren, in ancient tales of the Stone Age, they evolved to have the power to shoot fireballs without much effort. They appear alongside the Stone Turtles and will not hesitate to protect their siblings against any hostile activities. Their power can be yours if you capture them in battles or peacefully convince them to join you.

To empower you even more, you can now enhance your equipment with the magic anvils just like the weapon enhancement updates last week. Find your favorite armor, clothes, hats, pants, shoes, underwear, and other strange equipment you can acquire in this supernatural world, you may now empower them further to make them more useful to you. Just like weapons, each enhancement level brings a bonus to their attributions. More details can be found on the wiki of the game.

Now, you've met a strange doctor and his mystery assistant, some turtles that can shoot fireballs, and an enhancement system for almost all equipment. Yet, you can't say you've witnessed all the madness of this week until you see the...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d5f82d3eecc8d5290ff190bbf56ee6f32f3fea30.jpg[/img]
Gatling Bodhisattva!!!
In ancient times, in a Polytheism like Buddhism, people believed there must be a Bodhisattva for every aspect of life.
In modern times, people invented Gatling guns. Thus, there has to be a Bodhisattva for that, too. :P
When bullets maw down soldiers on a battlefield, it brings equality and a feeling of liberation. If they were sinners, they would no longer be able to commit more sinners. If they were good, they would be awarded in their afterlife beyond the hell they were facing in their life. Such is the mercy of the Gatling Bodhisattva. (I'm sure a certain killer monk will click the "like" button if he gets a chance.)

Talking about mercy, we also got some development in the "Sweet Dreams" side quest. Actually, it's almost complete. The truth can be revealed. It may also lead to an ending if you choose to do so. With quite a few optional paths non-linearly deployed along the way, the story can be told in many different orders. 

That's for this week. Have fun with all the madness. We will likely see the "Sweet Dreams" completed next week.


Today's changelog:
############Content################
[Sweet Dreams]The nurse in the secret room now always appears. (Previously she only appears when you start the investigation.)
[Sweet Dreams]Made the quest even more non-linear. It's now possible to investigate what happened to the woman from the town hall before you start the quest.
[Game Over]Special game-over texts now no longer inside a window.
[Game Over]Moved special game over texts down so that they no longer overlap with the game over text.
[Special Attribution]Added a new special attribution that increases a character's firearm damage by a percentage.
[Faith]New Tenet: Gatling Bodhisattva (Let's blame Nihilmace for this.  (✺ω✺))
[Item]New Religious Book: Gatling Bodhisattva Sutra
[Museum of Strange History]Added a copy of Gatling Bodhisattva Sutra
###########System##################
[Combat]Added a modifier on enemies that can affect the player's escape chance.

notes.title: DD#138 Old Weapons Never Die!
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week of this game's evolution.

Alongside the expansion of the map and the continuation of the main story, there are always new challenges and obstacles. Meanwhile, there are a lot of randomly generated weapons with different prefixes and attributions we can have along the way. Some of them are already quite strong, and some of them have ways to improve such as firearms can change their components. But, previously, most of the other weapons lacked of meaning to grow stronger. It's no longer the case this week.

We now have a weapon enhancement system.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/bb4aced994720b2df497ea229e45b51ef618f338.jpg[/img]
Most of the weapons now have experience and levels on them. You can sacrifice other weapons and possibly some items that I will add in the future to provide them with Experience to level them up.
Each enhancement level will provide a bonus to the weapon's many base attributions such as the attack value, the physical defense value, the magic defense value, the strength bonus, the endurance bonus, the speed bonus, the magic bonus, the Max HP bonus, and the Max MP bonus.

As a result, you can now hold some of your favorite weapons a bit longer before have to put them on shelves. Although, this new system still has some limitations at this moment such as the max enhancement levels are capped by the weapon's quality. Those limitations may also be lifted one day in the future as the development continues. More details can be found on the game's wiki pages about the Weapon Enhancement system. Old weapons never die, they live on enhanced or live on as the experience of others. 

Sometimes, enhanced old weapons may even be better than new ones. It's just like I've been using the ancient RPG Maker XP engine for more than 19 years on the development of this game without the need to worry about any stupid sudden policy changes like Unity just did this week. Cheers to my old friend. :) 

Other than the weapon enhancement system, our journey in the Anomalous Nation continues. 
5 of 6 floors of Cave of Mountain Keao have been completed with the last floor will be the research station of Dr. Kyoryu whose character files have also been completed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/dd7304b8cb856c31418ad2335072130fd7fb7ead.gif[/img]
Before you meet him, you can already use his appearance on your character or your customized teammates.

Story-wide, we now officially get the mission of the Marinas Hospital known as the "Sweet Dreams." It can be triggered either from the Marinas Hospital if you offer the doctor help to investigate after discovering his secret, or you can also trigger it from the Marinas Town Hall where you can find a young woman asking for help to find her missing brother. Additional branches have also been added, such as you can inform the woman about the discovery of the secret room of the hospital. However, every choice bears consequences. The story will continue in future updates.

Other small improvements include:
Some searchable objects now have spark animations to clearly indicate something is out there.
More characters have the inspect skill by default.
The "Love Tree" has been added as an attraction to the North of Marinas. 

That's for this week. Next week, we will likely meet Dr. Kyoryu. Unlike his counterpart in StoneAge Online, he will be a quite different character.


Today's changelog:
[Marinas Blacksmith's Stop] Added 2 magic anvils for weapon enhancement.
[Weapon Enhancement]Enhancement levels now affect a weapon's strength bonus, endurance bonus, speed bonus, and magic bonus.
[Weapon]It's now possible to attach a script block on a weapon as a special attribution to modify its strength bonus, endurance bonus, and magic bonus based on certain conditions. (We already have the function for the speed bonus.)
[Weapon]Changed the way that a weapon provides max_hp bonus and maxp_sp bonus.
[Weapon Enhancement]Enhancement levels now affect a weapon's max_hp bonus and maxp_sp bonus.
[Wiki]Updated the weapon enhancement wiki page, and added information about the effects of enhancement levels and max level caps.

notes.title: DD#137 Reclaim a Lost World
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week of our expedition on Sayinas Island.

The expansion around the Marinas area continues.
To the south, we now have a nice beach. Although the progress may seem slow to some people, I believe the beach party is still inevitable. We simply cannot just sit here and expect people on the frontline, risking their lives to reclaim their homeland, on what they should achieve. We shall just believe that day will come. But, before that, at least we can have a merchant sell many different kinds of items that may allow you to enjoy your stay here. We got sexy swimsuits, big umbrellas, fishing rods, and sunscreens.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b5f6383682e1fcd716ffd6c4b07c8d958b857b30.jpg[/img]
Rumors have it that certain night creatures from Romania sponsored the invention of sunscreens.

To the north, we reached the North of Marinas area. Some of the local friendly piggies may welcome you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a3e4e517ae21bfe0de9fb13c93de4f8b425d0a8c.gif[/img]
Feel free to turn them into your pets or just pass by. They are totally harmless, especially after their more aggressive ancestors were domesticated in that lost Stone Age thousands of years ago before the story of our current game.

Go even further to the north, you may find the Cave of Mountain Keao. Here is a comparison of how this cave looks like in the Stone Age Online and how it looks like in our game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/6f8ea37220900eaa9f8c1573cd88b1c8ecc20090.jpg[/img]
The Cave in the Stone Age Online.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b60cae7b13b16492f479f9fad0ae8f818f459345.jpg[/img]
The Cave in our game.
All the differences between them are caused by thousands of years of crustal movement that happened on the Earth instead of copyright issues. :P

There are some stone turtles that live in this cave.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/5b11e8686335f3f4223a3310c42e822f3f4120ae.jpg[/img]
They do not exactly look like their counterpart in the Stone Age Online. Again, that is because of thousands of years of evolution instead of copyright issues. :P
They are still quite capable of using their Petrification Attack to turn their enemies into stones.
Fortunately, they are usually non-hostile animals. They can even be convinced to join your group peacefully if you are good at speech. However, if you take hostile actions to attack one of them, all nearby stone turtles will turn hostile towards you. They may even attack you together in groups. If that happens, you'd better have some anti-petrification solutions ready before getting overrun. :)

In addition to area expansion, we also have some more content story-wide. For example, you may now try to blackmail the doctor in the Marinas Hospital after discovering his unspeakable secret. Should you successfully pass an intimidating skill check, he will give you a lot of money. There will certainly be other solutions to this story. They will be added in future updates.

We also get some generic system improvements in our dialog system.
You can now hold the shift+confirm key to fast-skip forward dialogs.
During the dialog, you can now also clearly see the tooltips of hotkeys:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/353b5a8b9f06cee830f1896c85a3145ec0e6a339.jpg[/img]
In case of fast-skip dialogs by mistake, while also providing something that you can also check previous dialogs, we now also have a dialog log.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/c758bafdae5082df1d47f62ee902cd6957fdff04.jpg[/img]
In the archive of the menu, you can see 50 entries of your recent dialogs.

There is also another issue I want to address this week, which that is going from the safe house to the Marines area takes quite some time. That's quite inconvenient for people who want to keep track of their daily supplies from Captain Nameless. So, by some strange magic, a door in the Wonderland Travel Agency has been replaced with a "Door." It caused a bit of panic. But, it also provides some additional story content for your entertainment. :)

That's for this week. Our journey in this lost anomalous nation continues.


Today's changelog:
############Content################
[Wonderland Travel Agency]Added a "Door" in this location. It can be unlocked after you use it for the first time.
[Wonderland Travel Agency]Added some background story content to this "Door."
[Wonderland Travel Agency]As the "Door" is located in a strange location, you can ask the Receptionist about it. And she will give you an idea if the door is in a more awful place. :P
[Butterfly]After unlocking the "Door" of the Wonderland Travel Agency, you can use butterfly wings to directly teleport to it if you are inside the Wonderland Travel Agency.
[Site Demeter]Added some exit signs.

notes.title: DD#136 Marinas Expansion
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to the first developer's diary of September!

As mentioned last week, this week's primary focus is on expanding the Marinas areas. Thus, the development is going accordingly. 

In the Marinas Town Hall, we now have randomly generated quests.
In the great Marinas areas, we now have a pet store and a tourist beach. They all have butterfly settings and fishing settings covered.
In the lighthouse, we now have the 2nd floor where you can find more clues on what happened here. Meanwhile, you may find those shade-tainted agents. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/bfcbdedc361ead284d36803399bdaa1f140b8b7f.gif[/img]
The bad news, they still know how to shoot their guns. The good news, you may loot them to get different firearms, ammo, and gun components. The maybe-good-maybe-bad news, the firearms they drop are all shade-tainted. Depending on whether you are going to embrace the power of shade, it may be an advantage or a disadvantage.
On the way in and out of the Marinas Station, we now get a short cutscene.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b8390a0cd4711619dac124c65418e0031694452a.jpg[/img]
It still feels quite 2000s. But, better than just using a black screen to teleport you directly to the target.
The cutscene is also added to the Gallery of Memories so that you can also check it from there after unlocking it.

But, gentlemen, let's face it. All above are not some of our community members interested most in this week's content update. After all, many players may not even get to Marinas yet. Thus, what may really have a greater and more direct impact on all players in this week's changes is the expansion of the usage of seduction skills. 

With a new skill added to the game, you can now directly apply your seduction skills into battle, causing enemies to be stunned or confused. Mathematically, each level of your seduction skill provides about a +2% success chance. Unlike in some skill checks, this does not have many restrictions or penalties on the user's species or the target's sexual preference. Thus, may your wildest dream come true. Maybe your skeleton or zombie teammates are just that sexy. :)

The functionality of the Profane of Succubus is totally overhauled. Instead of directly doing something nasty on your enemies, it now temporarily adds +10 levels to your seduction skills. And then, you can use your empowered seduction skills to do a wider range of things such as charm your enemies in battles or get through some skill checks.

Carnal Exaltation also becomes a better faith tenet. It now brings you a bonus to your seduction skills while also directly granting you access to the charm skill without the need to learn it from other sources.

In addition to those content updates, some old content also got polished. For example, you can now find butterfly wings in the basement of the 3D Printing Store.

That's for this week. I hope everyone had a great summer. :)

notes.title: DD#135 When the Real Life Comes to Knock My Door.
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone! Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

Well, a lot of things happened this week. I also got quite busy. Thus, there is not much serious game content for this week. See you next week. XD

Oh, wait a second, we instead got quite a few real-life game content. XD
To start with, Prigozhin, the infamous leader of Wagner PMC, died in a plane crash.
Just like this:
[previewyoutube=C6xYsPF_B9s;full][/previewyoutube] 
Here is also an alternative link for people who live under internet censorship: https://www.zhihu.com/zvideo/1678479772823420928
So, basically, we get a new random curse stone event that may happen in Russia's outdoor areas. Who knows maybe your enemy is so unlucky enough that Prigozhin's plane just crashes on them. That's totally random as is the nature of calamity. Or, maybe it is not all left by chance. More details about this new event can be found on the game's wiki. Let's officially pretend it's just an accident. :)

Next, we also know Putin decided to invade the moon. But, apparently, the moon does not welcome his spacecraft for some reason. The Russian spacecraft crashed while the Indian spacecraft successfully landed. Congratulations to our Indian friends! And, maybe we shall praise the moon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b4730d6da9b5c516bedcc55cc17fdccdd8cf65b9.jpg[/img]
Thus, we get a new tenet. It's always unlocked. You can add it to your customized faith/ideology. Something unique to it is it takes your local system time for consideration. Thus, if you have this tenet on your faith and you are playing this game at night, you can get more devotion from praying.
Also on the image of this tenet, you may find some shiba dogs at the bottom of it. One of the most famous Shiba passed away this week. It's sad. But let's hope he went to a happier place for he has left this world with so much happiness.

What also happened this week is the nuclear water from Japan is now slowly dumping into the Pacific. "This is the end of the world!" Many cry. Especially in China, because of massive political propaganda about how bad things are. But, let's be realistic, it's bad. But, it's not that bad. So, I don't think I will change my appetite for delicious sushi. Instead, we got a new side quest in Marinas to get rid of a doomsayer. It's a non-linear side quest. Thus, you can have all the different ways to start it and solve it. If you can pass a skill check, you can also get more rewards at the end.

Now as we are talking about skill checks. Baldur's Gate 3 remains a hot topic this week. Time to "borrow" a bit more content from it. That is the skill check.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/62c8727ad204462f772de76514bf5e90c9a67da3.jpg[/img]
Previously, we already had skill checks everywhere in the game. But, we didn't have a good UI to represent the difficulty range of each challenge. Now we have it, a dice roll sound will also play when rolling the final difficulty number. This is not exactly a D&D system. It's more like the one in CoC. Anyway, good luck with your dice roll. I have gone through all existing game content to replace the old skill check with this new one. In addition to that, we also have more different types of skill checks in existing and new content. For example, you can seduce the nurse who guards the secret room in the Marinas Hospital. You can persuade, deceive, or just fight the doomsayer in our latest side quest. As a big open-world RPG with a lot of freedom, there will likely be more and more places to continually use this system with all kinds of skill checks.

In addition to everything mentioned above, we also have a new location in Marinas, new crafting materials, new background music, and other little content.

That's for this week. Many times in the past 19 years, real life has provided me with great ideas and stories that I sometimes don't even need to write them myself. All I need to do is just add them to the game. This week is another one of such interesting times. :)

The final sale before the game price increases shall start next week. Marinas area will expand further to provide stages for our next stories.

notes.title: DD#134 Additional Features to Special Playstyles
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

This week's updates bring additional features to several play styles.
Here is a list of the changes:
For a shade-influenced character, if your group's shade corruption level is high enough, certain shade creatures will no longer attack you. However, on the other hand, you may still choose to attack them. This is automatic and passive. You do not need to spend additional resources to acquire this perk. The dark figure in the Bazaar may provide you with more information regarding this.

For a character who trades souls with a certain demon, you now have an additional pact that can summon a Gunsmith from Hell to provide you with some fire-related gun components. You can summon them at almost any location. Thus, that shall also allow you to resupply your ammunition in case you run out. For more creative usage, you may use them to block the path of your enemies.

For a character who prefers to use firearms, RPGs can now be modified with additional components you find.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/ca7647e9b482bdc5d292ce9bf9b46c7e442352b5.jpg[/img]

For Baldur's Gate 3 players who saw a lot of tentacles and certain secret cultists who are waiting for the stars to be in the right places, we now have a new belief:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/20a230544ffd71050bfdcaf4b18265210a389973.jpg[/img]
You can gain additional power at the cost of your sanity. You can bring fear to your enemies. If that's not tempting enough, at least, it can also improve your fishing skills. :)
It's unlocked by reading a Lovecraft book that you may find in the Grand Library or given by someone in the dock area of Marinas.
We also get another faith tenet known as "The Sea Will Consume Us All." This new tenant can work with other doomsayer tenets and beliefs to make it more scary when you pray to reveal a vision of doom upon your enemies.

For players who enjoy cheating and use the console command to mess around, more pet data has been added to the pet box.

For players who enjoy randomly generated maps. More enemy types now have a chance to appear.

In addition to the features mentioned above, we also have some other updates related to the further development of Marinas areas. The main story continues in the Marinas Station. New music has been added in the dock area. You may also find something sinister in the hospital.

That basically covers all the content updates. However, we also have an update about our planned price change in September. Although I planned to not change the price in Ukraine until the war ends, Valve updated their price policy to make me have to increase the price a bit as well.
For more details, please check the previous announcement here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1519140/view/3682308808795667954
Valve's price policy change may also dramatically affect some other regions. The impact on Turkey and Argentina regions may be greater than previously predicted.
Here is what I'm going to do.  To compensate for this inevitable price increase, a sale will take place on August 28th or 29th, depending on your time zone. It will last 168 hours. Shortly after that, the price of the game will increase in all regions as we finished Chapter Two of the game.

So, I think that's it for this week. I hope you enjoy those new features. :)

notes.title: [Emergency]Valve Is Forcing Me to Increase the Price in Ukraine.
notes.notes:
Since last year, shortly after Putin started his barbarian invasion of Ukraine, I have changed the price in the Ukraine region as low as possible. And I have been trying to keep it as low as possible since then.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b9294221e3ec6d52f654cb746ed215a79619a791.jpg[/img]

However, today Valve announced their updated policy on pricing.
https://steamcommunity.com/groups/steamworks/announcements/detail/3700310527377680732


Basically, they require me to increase the price in the Ukraine region from UAH20 to UAH26 in accordance with their new minimums price policy.
https://partner.steamgames.com/pricing/minimums

Previously, I mentioned I will try to keep the price in Ukraine unchanged all the way till the war ends. But, Valve's new policy is now making that impossible. I'll have to comply with that in our scheduled price increase in September. 

I am very sorry. It's not something that I can control. But, I will continue to support Ukraine in other ways that I still can for as long as it takes.
For example, the free demo version with almost all the major content of the game will still be available all the way till the war ends. (Unless Valve decides to change their policy about demos as well.)

Please don't blame Valve. I don't think they changed their policy just to undermine my efforts to support Ukraine.

Слава Украине!


自去年开始，普京发动对乌克兰的入侵以后不久，我就把游戏在乌克兰地区的价格降低到了Steam所允许的极低的价格。并一直保持如此。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b9294221e3ec6d52f654cb746ed215a79619a791.jpg[/img]
但是，今天G胖宣布了提高对低价区价格的要求
https://steamcommunity.com/groups/steamworks/announcements/detail/3700310527377680732
基本上，他们要求我必须把乌克兰地区的售价从20提高到26从而满足他们的最低售价政策。
https://partner.steamgames.com/pricing/minimums

此前，我提到会保持乌克兰地区的低价直到战争结束。但是，G胖的新正常导致那无法延续。所以，在9月份的游戏计划涨价时，我必须把游戏在乌克兰区的定价更新到G胖最新的最低定价。

对此，我非常遗憾。这是属于我目前无法控制的情况。但是，在那些我依然能够掌控的地方，我依然会保持全面对乌克兰的支持，直到这场战争的终点。

notes.title: DD#133 Everything Is Perfectly Normal in Marinas
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone! Welcome to another week's developer's diary which is perfectly normal.

This week's development is mainly in the seaside town known as Marinas. Everything is perfectly normal.
You may have heard about some strange rumors from random townfolks. They may tell you about a strange girl on the beach. They may tell you about a haunted lighthouse. They may tell you about the monsters from the sea. But, don't be alarmed, everything is perfectly normal in this town.

Let's go down to some details of this week's development of this perfectly normal town.
The town has a perfectly normal blacksmith's shop where you can find, a friendly young apprentice selling you some useful tools, some smiters, and a 3D printer to craft items. It's perfectly normal to have a 3D printer in a blacksmith's shop.

A bit to the east, there is a hospital. You may find a perfectly normal doctor treating patients with a perfectly normal method that can restore your health without going through complex procedures. Such a method has been well-proved even in some other well-known RPGs in the world, such as Skyrim and Fallout 4. Thus, it's perfectly normal for a doctor to use such treatment on his patients.

To the south, we can arrive at the Dock of Marinas. It's perfectly normal for a seaside town to have a dock. And it's also perfectly normal to have a lighthouse nearby.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/83a9146b3db385b9e4367f027d4d94f76f299678.jpg[/img]
Don't mind all the screams you may hear and all the ruined furniture you may find inside. It's perfectly normal for a lighthouse. Those dead bodies are perfectly normal. Those huge spiders are perfectly normal. And as some of you that can see them have noticed, the shade creatures inside are perfectly normal, too. To ensure everything is perfectly normal, someone left you a perfectly normal note on the wall with a topic that matches the lighthouse perfectly and that's because everything is perfectly normal.

A fact about the dock is it's very close to the sea. And the sea contains a lot of chemicals known as "Dihydrogen Monoxide." It's also perfectly normal that things will become "wet" if they contact with "Dihydrogen Monoxide." Even though, it can cause massive death if people breath in too much of such chemicals. It's perfectly normal that people enjoy drinking such chemicals like their life is depending on it. Some may even enjoy bathing their bodies inside such chemicals. Just like that, people can become "wet" quite easily. Perfectly normally, they become a bit more resilient to fire. Unfortunately, they also become a bit more vulnerable to thunder and ice. Subsequently, you may not want your teammate to be "wet" in a cold environment. It's perfectly normal to throw a fireball at them to fix this condition. I learned this from Baldur's Gate 3 recently. Thus, it shall be perfectly normal.

On your way back from the lighthouse, you may find a perfectly normal girl collecting shells on the beach and selling them to tourists to raise funds for charity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/50607279ce02470138288c114ee4ccc4b5769f27.jpg[/img]
Her name is Yayoi and she is perfectly normal.
She has a perfectly normal combat-ready animation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/e6eb773a7c4ac4170f872856474a22b75ac8afca.gif[/img]
She also has a perfectly normal attack animation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f2534953be11e0ab3cf3aae68950aa310c4af4b3.gif[/img]
You may find her chest nearby. Perfectly normally you may want to pick the lock of her chest just like all heroes in classical RPGs, especially JRPGs do without considering the feelings of the owner of the chest. Now as we are talking about RPGs, it's perfectly normal for an RPG to have RPGs in the game. Thus, RPGs have been added to the game as a new kind of firearm. Now, where were we? Oh, the chest. Yes, you can of course find an RPG and some missiles inside as well. Because it's perfectly normal for a girl to have an RPG for self-defense. Just like this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9981d82551c3d149071c008fffc15ccefc77e6c7.png[/img]

Alright, that's all the perfectly normal updates for this perfectly normal week. :)

notes.title: DD#132 The Day We Count Three
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone, welcome to another week's developer's diary.

As planned, the main story quest "Lost in the Sand" is completed. After you talk to Captain Nameless, he will give you a quick rundown of your previous choices and their immediate impact. Based on those choices, you may get various rewards such as attribution points and exp. You can also get Harold as a permanent teammate to join your future adventure. That concludes chapter two of the main story.

As mentioned before, the game's price on Steam shall increase after the completion of each main story chapter so that all existing players can find not just gain more and more game content but also increase our Steam account value. Just like the last time, the price increases will take place at least one month after this developer's dairy. Before that, there will be one more sale just like we did last year when the first chapter of the game was completed. 

A bit more details on certain regions:
The regional price of Ukraine will not increase and will stay as low as possible because the war is still going on.
The regional price of Argentina and Turkey may have a significant increase because Steam seems increased the "suggested price" in those regions.
Any feedback on the price change is welcome as the action will only take place one month later and I intend to make this as transparent as possible.

Now, it's time to count three for the new chapter. It starts with the new main story mission "The Anomalous Nation," taking place in the Nise Federation, an archipelago nation that suddenly appeared in this world's reality in 2004. If you have played SAPC++, you may already have some clues about what happened. However, that is not required. During the story, you will find out the truth behind this event. This is also the third time we return to the "Stone Age." Well, it's just not that Stone Age anymore. Thousands of years have passed. Or, is this actually thousands of years before that will happen? Anyway, it's the story of another time and space. It may be the end. It may be the ouroboros. Only one thing is certain, that is we are still moving forward in this timeline.

As the first stop in the new chapter, you will travel to Marinas via the trains of the Wonderland Travel Agency. (That's also the reason that we got a lot of updates about the Wonderland Travel Agency before this part of the story is revealed even though the random map generator is not necessarily directly linked to the story content. :D )

The development of Marinas is still underway. It certainly no longer looks like what it was in that online game or previous iterations of this world. It's something new with its own population system that you can find townfolks move on in their own life agenda just like that is implemented in Liu. It has its own map style. And, it cannot be called a fishing town if you cannot buy relatively cheap fish there. Thus, it may be a good idea to buy a lot of fish and then sell that to the sushi bar in Liu to make some profits. You can also find it's quite easy to get seawater in Marinas.

That concludes the big picture of what is going on in the game right now. But we also got some other changes this week. For example, all Bosses in randomly generated locations will now drop a golden chest after you defeat them. You will receive at least a set of Butterfly Wings and a "+2" quality weapon from the chest so that no boss is too mean in their loots. The overall goal is to make defeating Bosses more rewarding while also eliminating the inconvenience of backtracking your steps after defeating them in some cases. To make things more fun, you can even take the chest itself. You can use it as container-type furniture or just melt it for gold. :)

That's for this week. But, unfortunately, something else also counted three this week. That is the Baldur's Gate. The full release of Baldur's Gate is slowing down the development of our game because I failed a dice check to resist the temptation of playing it. But, look on the good side, maybe I will steal some ideas from it and port them into ours. :P

notes.title: DD# 131 Life Quality Enhancements
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

This week's main focus is on polishing existing game systems. Here are some of the highlights of the changes we got.

1, A lot of new Butterfly locations.
We got 6 new locations you can teleport to in Liu, 2 new locations you can teleport to in Queensmouth, and 1 new location you can teleport to in Egypt. Most of them require you to have visited those locations once to unlock. The progress will likely be quite natural as you progress your journey at your own pace. As more and more locations get added to the game. This change may help solve a problem that is to make traversing across different areas easier.

2, Sell items in bulk.
You can now select a certain threshold of item quality and sell everything below that quality in one go. As the game progress, you may get a lot of random loot. It becomes tedious to sell everything one by one. Thus, this new feature can make your profit from trading much easier. Some unique items will not be automatic. You can also avoid an item from being automatically sold by equipping them, dropping them on the ground, or storing them in your home before you use this new feature.

3, More cheats
You can now get a new cheat item that can give you various pets you can get during normal gameplay. It's understandable sometimes we just want to slack back and use some cheat code to get some pets instead of trying to capture them. Meanwhile, there is also another cheat that is designed to fix a max sanity bug that I will talk about below.

4, Bug fixes
It's rare that we have bugs in this game. But, sometimes they do exist. Thanks to all the bug reports. We've fixed some issues that occur when calculating the max sanity value with shade corruption and some issues in certain Boss fights. 

All the above are thanks to some of the game's most ancient players coming back to play this game this week. Thus, I received some quite good feedback. Without that, those changes may not happen. Thus, I'd like to thank everyone who provided those suggestions and bug reports. You are making the development of this game such a fantastic experience! Even though the world changes so much over the years, something about this game may never change as it becomes our shared memories.

In addition to the life improvement changes we also have some other content updates this week, those are:
1, More Enemy Types and Better Location Selection Flow in Wonderland Travel Agency.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/93e065d7d0be6f43cace77de795eb3c842951e39.jpg[/img]
Without the need to go check all the details after selecting a location, you can now get information about a location such as its size, enemy types, and environment information before selecting any of them.  Essentially that shall save some clicks.
Meanwhile, new enemies such as bats, vengeful spirits, and ghoOoOoOots may now appear in random locations.

2, The other side of the coin. The Shade.
One of the most defining features of this game is freedom. Thus, you can totally go against everyone's expectations. Instead of being a hero, you may be the one that brings the end of the world. Previously, you got all kinds of choices to join the dark side. Now, let's go a bit further. You can actually find a new NPC to teach you some shade-related skills. You will need to have a certain amount of shade corruption level to gain access to this NPC and learn and use those skills. But, they are all relatively quite powerful. Those skills you can acquire right now are the "Shade Touch," and the "Shade Binding."
"Shade Touch" has been used by many shade enemies you encountered during the story. Now you can have this skill yourself. What makes it more devastating is, the power of this skill is scaled by a character's shade corruption level. The more you are corrupted, the more powerful this skill becomes. After all, if you seek power even at the cost of all humanity, it will be a quite disappointment if you cannot get something eventually will become apocalyptic.
"Shade Binding" is another approach to fulfill your dark agenda. This skill allows you to turn some shade creatures to become your pets while in all other normal circumstances that is impossible. But, since you are so corrupted under the shade's influence, you can now force your will upon those lesser than you.
There may be more to be added in the future. Even after embracing such dark power, to be a supervillain or a dark hero is all your choice. I am not here to judge. I'm just here to provide some supplements to the story you are going to write.

3, A new character and the story development in the Wonderland Travel Agency.
Another part of the Wonderland Travel Agency is now accessible. You can find a train conductor inside. He can tell you another method to travel around the world in addition to relying on magic or ley lines. That is the science. (Or at least that's what he claims.) With those trains empowered by "science," you can travel between stations in the blink of an eye. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/3f5fe9174bd912b1aee86ac527e560bcc54c2ea2.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/8429589757650520446668b2b4f289f8e8f87180.gif[/img]
You can use his appearance on your customized main character or teammates.
What's the catch?
The first station you can travel to is known as the "Marinas Station."
Marina means something about the sea. And yes, we are heading to a beach.
But, what's more? That is the same name of a location that appeared in previous iterations of this game and that online game known as Stone Age Online. The difference is, we are now in a different time. Thousands of years have passed.

That's for this week. As a new location is now under development, a lot of art assets need to be processed. It may take a while. But, it's almost August now. Maybe we will also finally officially conclude chapter 2 of the game soon.

Today's changelog:

[Wonderland Travel Agency]The flow to select a new location is now shortened and becomes smoother.

[Map]New Location: Marinas Station.
[Wonderland Travel Agency]You can now travel between Liu and Marinas by train.

notes.title: DD# 130 Refining the Infinite Experience.
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Welcome to another week's developer's diary.
 
This week, our adventure in our infinite dungeon system continues (after my air conditioner is fixed so that my GPU will not go boom any time soon.) Because all those dungeons are dynamically generated. I don't think any screenshots will do to demonstrate them.
Thus, I got two videos for this week instead.
[previewyoutube=CydiDnYyx8s;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=Ew5LR6xhG4M;full][/previewyoutube]
Alternative links for players in China where Youtube is blocked:
https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1LM4y1478T
https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV15P411C7rL/

I'm not going to hide my accent at all because someone thinks that makes me sound more like a mad scientist. :)
Anyway, let's go down to more details about the system improvements:
First, something for a better quality of life:
1, You can get refresh randomly generated locations till you find a name that attracts you. Random location names now contain more useful information. You can always cancel the selected location before you enter it and the previous list of locations will be kept unless you chose to refresh it.
2, A better algorithm to make maps feel more compacted with more activities to do instead of large inaccessible areas in between. Details can be found in the first video. In theory, it shall provide 4 times more fun than before.
3, Butterfly support. A maze is a maze, people can get lost. Thus, butterfly wings will come in handy. To avoid some edge cases, they are not going to directly teleport you out of the dungeon. However, they can bring you back to the entrance where the tourist guide can help you get out.
4, Merchants. You can fight as many enemies as you like in those dungeons. It will be quite awful if you run out of supplies in the middle of your killing spree or... pet-capturing spree for the sake of love. So, random merchants may now appear in those random locations. As long as you get money, you can get as many potions as you want. You can also buy some butterfly wings from them in case you have gone too deep in a dungeon.

Second, one major issue of the entire mechanics' design needs to be addressed. That is, why do you want to explore those random locations? They are random locations, naturally, exploration plays a big part in them. However, random alone is not good enough. You need to be rewarded to make every dungeon a truly unique experience and to have an impact on your future journies.
So, here are some answers to this question:
1, Chests!
A common and straightforward solution. There are random chests with random loot in those dungeons. What's better? They have different content in different environments. For example, the fire caves have sulfurs while the water caves have all kinds of different water, including holy water. You can try to sneak through all the enemies with skill and loot everything without being noticed.
2, Bosses!
It gets boring quite quickly after maw down waves of enemies with your machine guns. How about some challenges? Different bosses from the game stories may all appear in those random locations. You may not even meet them before if you haven't progressed the story far enough. But, here in those strange parallel universe dungeons, you can fight, defeat them, and get their unique drops.
3, Customized Information
With the new customized widget system, every map can have its own UI. In those random locations, you can check how many chests you have not yet opened and how many Bosses are still standing.  
4, I HATE THOSE DEAD ENDS!
It's common that we will have dead ends in dungeons. It's boring to backtrace your steps. Thus, some magic statues will now appear in those locations. You can use them to either, return back to the entrance, fully heal your entire group, or get an item with at least +2 quality. As the entire map is procedurally generated, the scenarios you will get at a dead end are also highly situational. Thus, I will leave the choice to you to decide how you want to use those statues.
5, The Design Philosophy
There are many different ways to put a goal in a random location. Some prefer to pin a mission on them. Some prefer to make everything more controllable so that they can add more narrative. Some mobile games will even go as far as putting an auto-guide system to direct you through all the points of interest. But, here, I'm not going to do any of those. Instead, I will tell you there are so many different things you can do in a dungeon. You can set your own goals, such as farming a certain type of material, defeating a certain boss, capturing a certain type of pet, farming Exp, making money from the adventure, or simply seeing what's lurking at the dark corner of those dungeons. The choice shall be all yours. I am just here to make the experience fun, and rewarding, and remove the inconvenience. 
6, Future Plan
The rewarding part still needs some work to make things more diverse. More types of enemies and Bosses will also be added.

That's for this week. There is something more than the infinite procedurally generated maps in Wonderland Travel Agency. As some clue you can get from the conversation with "The Receptionist," there is something behind it. It's no coincidence that I am working on this part of the game after the main story in Egypt is almost finished. Maybe more information will be revealed next week. :)

notes.title: DD#129 the Saint, the Sinner, and the Infinity
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone! Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

Warning! The developer's diary may contain uncomfortable content. Please avoid reading it when eating.

First, some bad news here. The weather is getting quite high and my air conditioner is dead.  It's almost like deja-vu from last year. I'm pretty sure I wrote something like this before. Alright, anyway, please enjoy this week's developer's super hot diary.

The Saint
A new side quest has been added in the Egypt area. You will help slaves trapped in a cave to find their freedom from the cultists. You will find a relatively benevolent ancient Egyptian god hiding in plain sight. In a world of all the eldritch horror, maybe it's time to add something different for a change.

The Sinner
Two new faith tenets have been added to the game. The Ritual Cannibalism and the Carnal Exaltation. I admit, I committed the sin of stealing those sinful ideas from Crusader King 3. Well, to be fair, the entire faith customization system is more or less inspired by Crusader King 3 and Godhood. :D
So, let's move on to some more details.

The Ritual Cannibalism
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/07f72614431fb6328acb94c0d4d5a16e7577f0b5.jpg[/img]
After tasting the human fresh for the first time by using the skill of "devour corpse", you can unlock this tenet. It makes the "devour corpse" skill recover more HP and even adds some devotion to the believer. Bon appetite.

The Carnal Exaltation
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/492218f1440f03e266b4b200483c3abc8084429d.jpg[/img]
It's a relatively simple tenet. You make love and you gain devotion. But, I don't know why many people consider sexual content in games more sinful than even cannibalism. In decades, we can have all kinds of violence in games while it takes a long time to allow a girl to wear a bit less, both in real life and in games. This is not a hentai game. But, we do have sexual content. And I hope people enjoy it. You certainly deserve some naughty fun with Kristin after developing a relationship during your adventure. You certainly can have some eye candies when the world is falling apart, just like those people in Unlucky-13 Motel did. But, it's not advised to do it with a certain succubus, as she usually unintentionally kills her partners in the process until we find a way to fix this later.
Meanwhile, this update also carries a special meaning on this day. One of the best Japanese adult game developers “Illusion” just declared their cease to exist next month. They have been making adult games with a lot of sexual content since 30 years ago. I confess to you this, I played their game even when I was far under the required age long ago. I believe many people did the same. To avoid being caught made it more exciting. Those are good memories. But, now, isn't it sad that whenever you open those games such as "Honey Select," "VR Girl Friend," "VR Boy Friend," or "DES Blood," and cannot help but realize the developers once brought you so many sinful fun is gone. What makes things even worse? People who live in heavily censored countries may never taste such joy in their lives without even knowing how much they missed. Once again, I hope one day there will be no censorship in this world. I mean, we eventually all grow up, we eventually learn. This game itself is more than 19 years old now. What's the point to hide the truth from people with a censorship machine to tell people what can see and what can not?  

The Infinity
Congratulations! You just passed through the paragraph about my daily complaint about censorship. (Please excuse me because I live in China.) Now, let me reward you with a very cool new system! The functions of the Wonderland Travel Agency have been implemented this week. You can pick different randomly generated locations, fight randomly generated enemies, with endless repeatability, and farm specific items you want like there is no tomorrow. It's an upgraded version of the escape simulation mini-game you previously found on the Foundation's Site Demeter. The new system can generate maps that match different themes, with different sets of enemies, procedurally combined together. You can see the details of each location such as environment and enemy types before you enter. You can reroll endless times till you like the playground you get. Even though this system is still in an early stage as it just comes live late this week, it already covers 4 different environment themes and two sets of undead enemies. More will come. And the combination can be infinite. I may even add some new environments, enemies, and pets there before the story covers those areas. It's essentially an infinite dungeon system.

Something else of this week's updates:
1, Expansion of the Floor of Language of the Grand Library.
You can find a new faith tenet that empowers your language skills, making it more possible for you to shout your enemies to death. :)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/e6ba4a8893e53697b95e6f07db56f18a2843ce7f.jpg[/img]
You also get some control switches to decide which types of language characters may spawn on this floor. That mostly benefits people who want to use this floor to seriously learn some Japanese.
To some people just want to slaughter their enemies, those language characters now have a drop list with some nice items.

2, Skill icon improvements.
Thanks to the summer sales on Steam and everywhere else. More art assets have been acquired to add to the game so that we have some better skill icons.

3, New furniture to make nice gates.
Those are also new art assets I bought and some code support to support some furniture that can be passed through from its center.

4, Cluster Smoke Bomb
What's better than a smoke bomb that covers you from the detection of your enemies? A lot of smoke bombs! This new type of smoke bomb can cover a large area of 5x5. That shall be big enough for you to "sneak" through a lot of enemies as long as you don't accidentally step on another enemy who is also inside the smoke. Plus, the word "cluster" sounds quite exciting recently. :)

That's for this week. Endless new adventures await! (After I fix the air conditioner. :P)

A side note on the main story:
Everything in Egypt is done. But, there is still a small part of the main story in the safe house. I can finish that part relatively easily. However, that will be the official conclusion of Chapter 2 of the game. As per the price policy of the game, that means a price increase after about one month of the finishing will happen. The last time we did something like this is at the end of Chapter 1 last September. But, I feel it may be quite weird to announce something like that right after the Steam Summer Sale. Thus, I am delaying the finish date of Chapter 2 to August so that the price increase will take place in September. Nobody gets hurt in their summer vacation season until people start to get back to school and work. :)
Meanwhile, we can have some polishes on other parts of the game and some new game systems.

Today's changelog:
############Content################
[Wonderland Travel Agency]Wonderland Travel Agency now provides five random locations with names already generated to allow you to pick from.
[Wonderland Travel Agency]You can see the details about that location such as the environment of the location and the hostile entity types of that location after selecting one. (Only Undead right now, but they can have different sub-types.)
[Wonderland Travel Agency]Randomly generated locations now can dynamically spawn enemies that match the hostile entity setting of that area.
[Wonderland Travel Agency]The enemy spawn mechanics are the same as the ones used in the Grand Library's Floor of Language. Thus, you can encounter an endless amount of enemies if you want to stay there to farm something.
[Wonderland Travel Agency]Water Caves and Ice Caves may now appear in randomly generated cave settings.
[Wonderland Travel Agency]Fire caves now have a "hot" environment tag.
[Wonderland Travel Agency]Ice caves now have a "cold" environment tag.
[Wonderland Travel Agency]Reduced the traveling cost to those random locations from $5000 to $500. Have fun to keep regenerating those random caves till you are happy. :D
############System#################
[Map]Added a layer over the map_info hash table. With this new layer of encapsulation, game maps can overwrite a map's name without changing a lot of existing code.
[Map]Changed the loading order. Pre-load events can now affect a map's environment settings.
[Map]Added a very early version of the map name generator.
[Save/Load Menu]Mouse/Controller can now use the up/down button on the right to wrap around the top save file and the button save file to be in line with the keyboard behavior.
############Debug#################
[Map]Fixed a graphics issue in one of the cases of a procedurally generated cave start location.

notes.title: DD#128 The Continuation of the Past 19 Years
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone! Welcome to the first developer's diary on our journey of another year of this endless game.

This week, we celebrated the game's 19th birthday with a surprise update to the very first version of the game or "the first world." I know some people still play that version even after 19 years. And I never forgot how everything starts.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/9200df014d64eb53b669fe63223e5d39f2a66ad5.jpg[/img]
That version lives on as a mod of our current game. To make it more accessible, we can now access it from the game's title screen. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/5a8a8c8f8b6edc31b476a512baaa2e9cd14292d0.jpg[/img]
But, from a story point of view, it's still better to find the hidden cyber cafe and launch that version from there. The story of all three worlds of our "Stone Age" are connected by a story both inside and outside the game. 

Next is something from the second world. That world still has a pile of treasury code there not yet ported to our current third world. Here comes the sliding puzzle game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/c5f97157bd4b26da8c609f4fb73b6370acd87bf7.jpg[/img]
Do you remember there is a time Steam is full of such simple puzzle games with beautiful girl images? I will give you this for free as it's part of our legacy. I didn't make a sliding puzzle just to show some nice images. Instead, when I first developed this feature back in the second world, I was studying AI to automatically solve such puzzles. Thus, the old AI is here as well. You can ask your teammates to solve this puzzle for you. They will use a search tree algorithm to solve it. As it's another mini-game, some exp rewards and GPA coins are to be expected. Moreover, in addition to unlocking all possible images to play by progressing the stories, you can use your own images, and make your own sliding puzzles. Maybe, you will never need another sliding puzzle game on Steam anymore. 

The sliding puzzle also serves a storytelling purpose. Many of its default images come with a background story of the game. Once you solve it, you can get more information about this supernatural world.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/8b829939cf910de26eee6eeef8511b139c085456.jpg[/img]

It's the start of a new era. Thus, Captain Nameless got his long overdue 3D model upgrade.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/722fd52fe09c9f8548cad079784380f643dd7d9b.jpg[/img]
About three years ago, his model was made with Fuse. A nice software to quickly make 3D game characters. Unfortunately, Adobe acquired and abandoned it. Now, with some more advanced character-creating software, I am able to give him a new model. Now you know why he previously didn't face the camera during all those cutscenes and photos. Time to allow him to join your relationships.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f0c9aa8842987aabb863874e0d3cfef6167241e0.jpg[/img]

What more about this week?
The stories inside the Black Pyramid come to a conclusion with two different endings. Combined with your previous choices, you can get a lot of different outcomes. In this journey in Egypt, you find many different characters to join you on your quest. Yet, they all have their own desires and goals. You cannot make everyone happy. But will you stay true to your previous promises, will you be loyal to your allies? Or, will you change your mind at the last minute after knowing more about the consequences? We all make hard decisions in our life. No matter what choices you make. Maybe at some point in our life, we all have something we regret. Yet it's our past that defines who we are. What matters more is how we keep going forward. 

That's for this week. 

One more thing, R.I.P. to Coco Lee, the singer of "Mulan." Another star went dark during this game's long history of updates. The game outlived too many good people along the way. Each time, it brings sorrow.


Today's changelog:
############Content################
[Sliding Puzzle]A character who solves puzzles now gains a small amount of EXP.
[Loot]Added an item drop list for Templar Knights.

notes.title: DD# 127 The 19th Anniversary
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. The 19th anniversary of this game is upon us! It's next Tuesday.
So, as our tradition, we get a new trailer.
[previewyoutube=j6VzWlQ5NCY;full][/previewyoutube]
Alternative link for people in China where Youtube is blocked: https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Qu411t7SZ/

It has been a long journey. Thank you to everyone who is walking with me. and the continuous development of the game is also in memory of those who once walked with us. Even though our history can backtrack to 2004, our presence on Steam is relatively young. It's only about two and a half years. It's also quite unfortunate that previous iterations of this world cannot be a part of the main game as they are technically almost impossible to localize. But, their existence will not be forgotten as they have been turned into mods of this game in the Steam Workshop. Thus, we can call this a Trinity of three games. This is our past.

We now live in an interesting time with new technologies emerging every day. Although I currently have no plan to change the 20-year-old RPG Maker XP engine which this game is built upon. Because that will disrupt the game's heritage. You will find me quite open to using many other new technologies to make the game better. Here is an example. During this week's development, I replaced the battlefield background for the High Priest's Lab in the Black Pyramid. As you know I am not good at art. But, now AI can help me with that. Here is the workflow:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/3a7e182ff82f8d0a3900b90981ab4b942f91cf7f.jpg[/img]
Step 1: I get an image that I like its structure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/1e374f3b74f3dfa8f5b4ffbd9769f7ab0bf7dd3b.jpg[/img]
Step 2: I order the AI to replace the wall on the left with a stair to match the map in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/48e84cbbf035ddd4500958d1174d10e33d55202a.jpg[/img]
Step 3: As the story progress, the water shall turns dark and filthy. Thus, I asked AI to modify the image further.
All can be done within an hour while previously I may take an entire afternoon or more to render a similar image with a lower quality. However, that is not without risks. I heard Valve is recently refusing games with AI-generated art to be published on Steam. Let's face it, the problem of copyright is very real. I don't intend to hurt any artists. Here is my role as a lawyer kicks in. I make sure my data training source is either licensed or in the public domain. Thus, if Gabe knocks on my door, we shall be quite safe. Just click the game's "credit" file. You can find where I get those images that I use to train AIs from. Also, Adobe told me, their Firefly can be used for commercial purposes without worrying about the training data. :)
This is the moment we are living.

Look into the future. After finishing the main story of Egypt, we still have a few chapters to go in the main story. There will be more features and content along the way with main story updates. Thus, I don't think the game's early access will end any time soon especially since I am working on this game all alone. Because I am the continuity of the innocent boy 19 years ago who made a promise to an innocent girl. We may no longer be who were anymore. But I still intend to let that fairy tale live on even in a terrible unfair world known as adulthood. We can never go back anymore. The only way out is to go forward. This is the future we are heading.

Now, let's talk about this week's updates.
1, The main story continues. The bad guy has been defeated with a twist in the plot. (It's just not as dramatic as what Prigozhin did. Curse this guy! His 24-hour circus show distracted me from working quite a lot.) The question is, now what? The show goes on in that Black Pyramid. There will be another big decision to make. It's likely not the last battle in this area. You cannot make everyone happy after all.
2, A new cheat code has been added so that you can turn off enemies' field of view entirely so that they cannot detect you anymore. You can turn it back on if you input it again.
3, Dr. Kyofu, Zhao Sandao, and the officer in the warehouse of Liu's PSB, all got their content expanded a bit. Dr. Kyofu has more variations in her procedurally generated random quests. Zhao can butch more types of animals. And you can mess around with the officer in the warehouse by showing him tokens from other factions.
4, Scroll of Time Stop. One of the most powerful spells in the previous iterations of the game is now here once again. With a mod in the workshop, you can now cosplay Dio quite accurately. :)
5, Even bigger window size for bigger resolutions. We now have 1920 x 1440, 2560 x 1920, and 3200 x 2400.

That's for this week. Meanwhile, it's Steam Summer Sale! I hope everyone is enjoying themselves. I will likely acquire more assets for the game.
