notes.title: DD #30 The Loots and Prefixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It's another week's developer's diary.
This week's focus is on making an item generation system that can bring diversity to loots you can get from enemies, chests, shops, and mission rewards.

We already have a system in place that can procedurally generate a lot of different items. However, the configuration can be quite tedious. Thus, a few optimizations in both code and pipeline have been taken to make sure it can be used with more flexibility.

The result is quite good. A few enemies such as the mannequins, the homeless, the crazed survivors, and the corrupted robots all get their own item drop lists that can provide a much wider and wilder range of item drops and variations. There will almost never be two identical baseball bats from the crazed survivors; No two combat robot modules from corrupted robots can be exactly the same. Every weapon or equipment drops from them are almost unique. It's just like everyone who lives in this world is special. You are special. 

To push it a bit further, a prefix system is implemented in place to highlight the strengths or sometimes weaknesses for all those unique items. For now, the database is relatively small (it will be further expanded in the future). But, combined with attribution randomization and item procedural generation, there can be a lot of possibilities.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/8b6acf4f17ba629851f81e6c44d24ecd214e7ea3.jpg[/img]

In conclusion, a baseball bat may have its attribution quite different from another baseball bat while it may also have one prefix (in some rarer cases, it may have more) to make it more unique to others.

They are usually limited in a reasonable boundary which people consider normal.
However, what if such boundaries can get broken sometimes? (Maybe genetic mutation, I don't know.) What if you suddenly find a baseball bat that can cut people like a sharp-edged blade and cause bleeding? What if you picked a baseball bat that has magical power? What if there is a baseball bat that can turn you into a vampire? What if it's not a vampiric baseball bat, but a vampiric pipe or vampiric steel chair? Maybe even a vampiric vodka bottle?  Maybe it will even automatically register how many creatures you killed with it. (StatTrack weapons. :D )

Welcome to this secret world! All those anomaly items are all possible to exist!
If you are too afraid of them, you can melt them down into basic materials and craft something else.
However, it's more likely that you will find them quite useful to help you fight against powerful enemies that normal civilians can hardly takedown. For example, the weird plastic clothes you can get from those mannequins in a certain basement may just be a solution to defeat an enemy that uses a lot of electronic offense skills.

That's for this week. But, the work will continue.

notes.title: DD#29 Friday the 13th
notes.notes:
Alright, agents. We live in a supernatural world but that does not mean we need to be superstitious...

Wait, I just found there is a bug that messes around all the graphics tones right now?
Fine, I fixed it after going through all the maps and event commands. 
It's caused by an automatic script that modifies the way to display a portrait while somehow RGD does not like the way RMXP stores tone information. What a lovely bug!
At least, now the pipeline can be set up better if I just make the game capable to run in a non-RGD environment. It totally has nothing to do with Friday the 13th.

The Euclid Calendar also seems to malfunction if anyone switches the mouse on/off when inputting the number. Who would do that? I wonder. But, it's still just another bug that gets fixed. It totally has nothing to do with Friday the 13th.

Items that are supposed to give a new skill to a character can somehow erase that skill from that character if it is already learned?! Well, something was obviously wrong in the logic. Thus, some more fixes are applied to solve it. It totally has nothing to do with Friday the 13th.

I found some expired potions in the People's Hospital, they are really cheap. So, I grabbed one and drank. Of course, I got poisoned.  It totally has nothing to do with Friday the 13th.

I saw an Internet Addicted Girl wants a bunny, so I went to capture one for her. I successes after the 20th attempt. That's just bad RNG and low binding skill. It totally has nothing to do with Friday the 13th.

I was testing out the new "programming" skill when hacking an enemy combat robot. Instead of causing it much damage, it went berserker. It totally has nothing to do with Friday the 13th.

Meanwhile, I'm feeling a bit fatigued from the side effect of the COVID-19 vaccine I just took yesterday. A civil lawsuit I'm working on turned out maybe a criminal case. The Perfect World stock went well until today some media reports their cruelty to one of their laid-off employees and consequently wiped out all the profits. It totally has nothing to do with Friday the 13th.

Such is the story that happened in the week that has a Friday on the 13th.  It totally has nothing to do with Friday the 13th. 

Why so serious? :)
After all, the bound between this game and the reality is just that thin.

notes.title: DD# 28 The Illuminaughty
notes.notes:
Hi there, it's weekly party time! OwO

Why so serious about saving the world? One day, it's going to end anyway.
So, how about we just laying around or start a pillow war and fill those pillows with cash?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/ec818b36325fcb7df48e730c67576f5a2432949d.jpg[/img]

Remember to get your best makeup before join, as you can now use any of the portraits you have!
[previewyoutube=OU3PLMxD5X8;full][/previewyoutube]

Don't mind those cannon fodders with flashbangs. They are expendable stage effects.

Maybe we can also play some truth or dare.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/377820a531985974c415ccd3a683966ab674e03d.gif[/img]
I dare you to steal this guy's shirt. (It's added this week.) OwO

So, here we are.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/303dce7c8c76a6c67bc5589315f18e4931bd3eb5.png[/img]
This is ILLUMINAUGHTY! OwO

##################################################

The generation gap is quite common all over the world.
The old generations sometimes can go quite conservative as they can never figure out what the younger generations are doing.  
For example, can you believe, it's the year 2021, and one of the "government media" in China still calls games opium? 
Well, I'm your friendly neighborhood drug dealer for today then.  :D
The same can happen to a secret society such as the Illuminati.
When a certain senator is acting like an evil badass in the previous story. There is a teenage girl mess around him in his front base, complaining bad internet connection while he can do nothing about it. It is quite an irony. 
No matter where you are, how cold-blood you pretend to be. I believe deep down in everyone's DNA it's everyone's natural instinct that wants to play games and have fun. (Don't mind me, if you are in one of the secret societies that manipulate people's DNA and removed that part. That's a crime.) 

Thus, as the media in China is condemning the game once again, as the stock price of all game companies is falling apart, I am putting my money on the Perfect World right at this moment. It is the company behind Steam China. It is the company running DOTA2 and CS:GO here. 

Yes, there are rumors about "Steam China" may get Steam banned in China. 
Yes, the Perfect World messed up some good games like Torchlight just like EA does to those studios they acquired. 
Yes, the Perfect World made some quite money-hunger mobile games just like Gameloft does.
People can have many reasons to hate that company.
But, not because some media calls games opium. Not because playing games is wrong especially in a nation that has the harshest game censorship in place already.
Thus, I am once again a shareholder of Perfect World to fight such injustice to everyone in this industry.
There are some deficits in my account right now. But, I don't think that can be a big problem. After all, It's one of the best game companies that can be bought in China with a relatively low P/E.
But, don't follow my steps. Just as the Nameless Captain says "If you don't have a heart of iron, you shall never participate in the A-Share Market of China."  Maybe I will even meet him here once again. Who knows. It was a good time last year.

In addition to all those crazy younger generation madness.
There are...
More madness. :D
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/688e4816934121c847bf30189a02584ceaa9a55f.jpg[/img]
As the DLL of Time has been upgraded from the old 2013 version compiled with VC6. (Now with VS2019) Some functions are added on the C++ side.
It results in a utility item that can quickly calculate the days between two dates which may be helpful both in and out of the game.
For example, I am using it to calculate interests in lawsuits. (I am also an attorney if you don't already know.)
That seems also quite fit the Illuminaughty way of life.
Have fun and be rich. [spoiler]so that you will not think twice to buy this game. OwO[/spoiler]

But, first, we are having some suspicious situations in Liu.
Your operations have been watched by those guys.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/2a485130bb8af5a60d82fe50173322efc13a5f3a.gif[/img]
They are monitoring you from a distance. They will escape if you get too close.
However, you can still get rid of them by deploying traps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/772d9e28a941811b26b8ac4462789e85956e5a9b.png[/img]
They are wearing Chinese opera masks. Thus, it is likely that the Dragons (or at least the Dragon's subdivisions in China) are sending them to you. There is no evidence so far. Their motivations are also unknown for now.

Regarding the masks, here is what an Illuminati doctor says:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/7b84f7aeb99de1f00d3fcf81a3e93b2ccbe0df10.jpg[/img]

In this secret world, everyone wears masks for quite obvious reasons.
Almost everyone wants to keep things quiet to avoid getting too much attention. The civil system in the "normal" world can't fully understand what is happening. Thus, a hunter who kills a human-like monster in a city may still be charged with murder. Furthermore, in a city like Liu where there are security cameras everywhere, even a slight crime may be detected immediately and police forces will get called in. Secrecy becomes so important that someone built "This is a bar" to work as a huge brainwashing center making sure people will think all the strange things happening around them as "normal." No matter what that is, it can be simply explained: "Because...this is a bar..." 
 
The exception is when members of secret societies find themselves already in a hot spot where a crisis is already taking place. The zombie outbreak in Queensmouth is in such a case. Local residents are under direct threats of supernatural activities. They have seen enough and there is no need to cover their eyes. At least when such a crisis is still ongoing. In this case, the masks worn by different secret society members may serve a different purpose. It may provide protection or attribution enhancement to let agents handle the situations better. For example, in one of this week's updates, the blueprints of Illuminati's gas masks can now be acquired. Craft them from a 3D printing machine and you can find them very useful against poison hazards.

Meanwhile, as the development is back to the north side of Queensmouth town, the main story will be continued from here. The Illuminati front base can now be entered if you've already completed previous stories. Their soldiers may or may not be hostile to you depending on your story progress and the choices you make.

The Mayor of Queensmouth can now also be found in the town hall. But, he has become something...different.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/377820a531985974c415ccd3a683966ab674e03d.gif[/img]
The shade does not only consume people's memories, invading the collective consciousness of humanity. They may sometimes infect and turn people as well. When he is defeated, you may discover the tragedy of his own story and a clue about how the shade comes to Queensmouth in 1978 in the first place.

That's for this week. More story-related content is scheduled next. But, making art assets is very time-consuming and I am honestly not really good at that.

notes.title: DD#26 It's Getting Hot.
notes.notes:
Hello, secret agents, underworld criminal bosses, and "normal" folks. 
Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

As the weather is getting hot in the north half of the earth, we got some hot-related updates this week.
First, a new male character variation that is known as the "chef" has been added to the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/6d7be53f8b389553bd95ab3dc3698e5fb82cb025.gif[/img]
With the art assets of this character, the 2nd floor of "This is a bar" is now fully accessible, coming with a short story. You can find the owner and the chef of the bar. There is a conflict and a mini-boss fight.
Beware of the chef as he can cause burning damage with his "Heat Stir Fry" attack.
You can also find him as the best butcher we currently have in the game so far to turn different creatures you captured into meat or...something else.

Next, it's the hotkey bar.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d06e54ebde9d5b1c16c80ff39b193c6447eaee8c.jpg[/img]
Although we have had the hotkey feature in the game for a long time, it lacks UI to display it and send meaningful visual messages to the player. The feature has been under use for a while. Just like many other interesting features.
Thus, a hotkey bar has been added to the game to display the item or skill that has been bound onto a hotkey. Mouse and gamepad can also interactive with hotkey feature to easily use or reassign a hotkey by click left/right mouse buttons or their counterparts on the gamepad. 
If an item is bound, the hotkey bar shall also display the quantity of the item in your inventory so that you can decide how to use them accordingly.  (By the way, the number of crafting materials you can carry has been increased to 9999 for each one of them.)
It can be quite helpful when you deploy traps, place furniture, or plant trees. 
It also makes grabbing a bottle of potion or set up a campfire after a battle much easier. 

There are also some other relatively trivial updates such as a mining animation; new bunny pets; Queensmouth airport; Illuminati mercenaries; and some Rou Baozi (meat buns with Chinese characteristics. :P )

notes.title: DD#25 Coinage and Power
notes.notes:
Welcome to another week's developer's diary.

This week, let's talk about currency. (I'm carefully not to leak anything about Victoria 3. :P)
It's the money of course.
However, what exactly is money, and what makes money valuable?
I consider money as a credit backed by the government that prints them.
By controlling how much money is to be print and who can get them easier, the government can indirectly control the distribution of wealth.
Thus, traditionally, only the government and the central bank of the government can print money. It's a power that nobody wants to give away until virtual currency such as Bitcoin kicks in, a universal currency that has no central bank to control it. Some governments accept this new reality while others do not. 

In our game world, there is also a universal currency that can automatically morph into local currency. It is controlled by a well-known secret organization. As a result, they have the power to control the global economy. Nevertheless, not everybody is a fan of the idea of "one world, one currency."

If a currency is just a credit backed by one government or one secret society, then it is only natural that another government or another secret society wants to compete to acquire this power. Whoever controls the right to print the dominating currency can control the global economy.
No matter what exactly the currency looks like. Maybe in another world, even bottlecaps can be a currency. (Yes, this is a Fallout reference. :P )

As such, this week, "Mark of Dragon" is now officially another currency in the game to be used in the stores run by a few certain merchants working with the Dragon where they do not accept dollars. They have faction-specific items and services unique to them in their inventories. From panda pets to Taoism elixirs. 

It is an extension of political power struggle all over the world. The civil governments or the secret societies are all players in this economic game.
But, people are usually unaware of it until it directly affects their life. Doing business and Trading is one example where people are directly involved. From here, maybe we can start to see a cold secret war among different factions. They do not trust each other as they all hold their own dark secrets. They compete for powers and domination even when living in a twilight world. And, it can always be justified by the "Greater Good."

Other than the Dragon's new store and those fancy new toys in their inventory. We also have some other updates that may interest you this week, such as a new female character variation, the reward for bringing people to an angel for "salvation," a new area in Queensmouth.

notes.title: DD#24 A New Prologue
notes.notes:
Welcome to the first developer diary after the 17th Anniversary.
This week, a new prologue has been added to address some problems that exist in the old one.

Comparing to the old prologue, the new one is more fast-paced. It compresses all the stories and tutorials to let everything happen in the initial airport scene. That allows players to get into action much faster. In addition to the old tutorial's gunfight, lock picking, and pet binding; the sneak mechanism is also mentioned.

From the story perspective, that's basically what would have happened if the Nameless Captain was on duty that day. However, as the story gets shortened in the new prologue, some information may be missing. As a result, another update of this week added more dialogues to the characters in the safehouse to fill in the blanks while also add a few additional background stories for some characters.

The new prologue will co-exist with the old one like two parallel universes. The choice to take which one to start has very slight impacts on storytelling. Otherwise, they are basically identical. In conclusion, we now have 3 different choices to begin the game's main story. The new prologue, the old prologue, and skip the prologue entirely. 

Some other features of this week including smoother allies/enemies target switching when using a mouse or gamepad, some homeless people in a sewer, and the fire extinguishers you can pick up in the fire department of Queensmouth.

Here is today's changelog:
English
#########Content#####################
New item: Fire extinguisher. (Remove "burning". It also has some more interesting effects to be announced later.)
You can use the up/down arrow key to switch allies/enemies target of the fire extinguisher.
Fire extinguishers can now randomly appear in the Fire Department of Queensmouth.
Skill "I am your shield" can no longer be used on enemies targets.
#########System#####################
Mouse/Gamepad can now automatically switch allies/enemies target if allowed by the acting skills or items. (It's to make this feature more obvious.)
Added the return value to $game_map.drop_item_normal function so that I can be used to generate items on the map more flexibly.
#########Debug#####################

notes.title: DD#23 The 17th Anniversary and the History
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/f9f84fa5a1b70872ec28cd5dcfc825ee6a328ce2.jpg[/img]
Welcome to another week's developer diary.
July 4th, 2021 is the day of our 17th anniversary!
It's a good day to look back to the past as it's important to never forget why I even make this game for.
Thus, let's start with a short history video of NEOLITHIC:
[previewyoutube=KlEUv0v9Jl8;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Some data of the game so far:[/b] (Steam Version: [Neolithic] To the End)
133 game updates
10 hours of game-play content
530kb of text files
14 different types of pets
5 different guns
The top free demo in the "modern" category on Steam.

[b]It starts as a promise.[/b]
17 years ago, when I came back from my crusade to the "High School Entrance Examination" of China, I found StoneAge Online, the MMO I enjoy playing with my friends, almost dead. My clan members in that game are almost all gone. At that moment, I made a promise to a girl that I will make our own version of the "Stone Age" that will never die. With some friends from that game, the first NEOLITHIC game was released on ybft on July 4th, 2004. That's when everything starts.

[b]That was the golden age of indie games.[/b]
In the 2000s, people didn't make indie games for money. It's almost like everybody's motivation is so pure. With passion and dreams, we help each other to bring something beautiful into this world. We share our skills asking nothing in return. Three biggest RPG Maker communities: 66RPG, RPGChina, and my humble DIYRPG was found at that time. DIYRPG played an important role in our history as it serves as the hosting website after ybft was down in 2007 because all the management team has to take into "University Entrance Examination." Can you even imagine that website was all run by high school kids?
That was all possible when there were no ICP/IP requirements for websites in China.
There were no ISBN requirements for games in China.
That was the 2000s when Google was still accessible in China.

[b]The "Dark Curtain" behind scenes.[/b]
To be fair, I'm not a good people person. I'm more of an engineer. After the initial super success of NEOLITHIC, I decided to cool it down. There are so many fields of knowledge to explore when in one of the best universities in China. Thus, even the game was still updating, I removed myself from the center of the spotlight. After all, it's a quite personal game made for a quite personal reason, I do not need fame or influence like many others so desire.  From there, I start to go anonymously, a privilege that I am granted by 66RPG. I was called the "Dark Curtain" or the "ancient mighty" when I publish some research results. 
Oh, yes. Even a game made with an RPG Maker engine can do some interesting science. The game was awarded the highest scientific honor of ECNU in 2011. This is the first game that has a functional DLC and Mod system in China back then.  
However, it was also the moment that all the RPG Maker communities in China start to collapses. RPGChina was already dead after losing the competition against 66RPG while 66RPG has its own problem that is no income source. Thus, 66RPG turned into "Chengguang"， abandoning RPG Maker while making their own visual novel game development tools as a registered company. Those who refuse to join "Chengguang" turned into "Project 1" inheriting the legacy of the former 66RPG. DIYRPG turned into a cult staying away from all dramas while slowly being forgotten. (But, it's not really dead till late 2020. It's a good run!)

[b]The tale of shadow and light.[/b]
It's not like I did nothing in this industry when being a shadow. I find myself living in an interesting place in the world. This is a nation that hates gamers with passion. It banned all the game consoles from 2000 to 2014. Its Great Firewall blocks reddit, discord, youtube, and Steam Community. Its parents send their kids to take electrotherapy to "cure" their love of gaming. This is a nation with one of the most strict censorship systems of games in the world. Most people have to comply while I chose to be no part of this broken system. 
When they removed "Hearts of Iron 4" from Steam's Regional Store of China, I worked with Paradox to make sure players in China can still get DLCs on Steam promptly. (Paradox shall have the most of the credit. I am just a concerned player.  )
When they threatened to take off some games because of those games' lack of ISBN of China, I worked with a start-up company to build a HongKong based game market to work it around. (Again, I'm just a shadow under the title of "Head of the Game Department." )
However, I didn't intend to win all the wars. And, I was not able to save everyone. I can only help those I just come across.
In Neolithic, you may find the records of that history. The history that I have written recently. After all, someone must fight in the dark so that others may live a happy life in the light in this land where gamers are hated by many.
By the way, I am also a lawyer. Thus, if you even get into any trouble in China, let me know if you need any helps. :)

[b]A fangame no more[/b]
And here we are, in [Neolithic] To the End. The secret world may not be so secret after all. The fiction may even be real. It's a world reborn after removing all the assets from the old Stone Age Online, telling a story of our own. But, I shall remember where it all starts.
Not everyone made this far in this journey. 
Not only we outlived almost the entire RPG Maker communities in mainland China, but we also lost some friends and families. They will live on as long as I still remember them in this game. In memories to those who once lived in this world. They once walked with us. I shall carry on that promise and their memories to the end.


Today, all 3 games of NEOLITHIC receive an update.
SAPC now has a "thank you" gift at the start of the game.
SAPC++ received many function updates porting back from [Neolithic]TtE to SAPC++
And in [Neolithic] To the End, it's just another updating as usual:

notes.title: DD#22 Why I Added Nudity and Sexual Content
notes.notes:
Hello, welcome back to another week's DD.
This week's development is back to the zombie-infested town of Queensmouth.

It shall be more dangerous than walking in a "zombie theme park" as one of our characters mentioned.
Thus, to begin with, zombie dogs and a new type of zombie have been added into different areas of Queensmouth.

However, zombies are not the worst in the town.
In many cases, the worst enemies in this supernatural world are ironically not supernatural threats.
 
A hotel has unlocked in Queensmouth. In the 1978 version of the hotel, you will find something even a demon prince feels disgusting. That's another page of humanity's dark history, luckily many parts of the world have turned that page over while unfortunately it still exists somewhere in the world. 

For centuries, it's from the very human nature that people seek liberality, freedom and equality. It's everyone's right to want to have a happier life with fewer restraints. However, that does not come without a price. 

Look back to the past.
Many "heretics" and "witches" were burned.
Many of their works were banned.
Many were sent to asylums.
Many were accused of reasons, jailed, or executed.

This is the "pride month". But, in a large part of the world, what people celebrate this month is even straightforward illegal. (Just go check which nations that game called "Tell Me Why" does not release.)
I even heard some of my friends who live in more liberated nations having their parents shouting at them just because they are wearing "inappropriate clothes". 

I believe, people shall be allowed to wear whatever clothes they want. 
I believe, people shall be allowed to have a relationship with whoever they want no matter of their race, gender, or anything, as long as both parties agree.
I also don't like the way many games using nudity and sexual content just to make eye candies. 

Thus, on this day, I lifted the content restriction of [Neolithic] To the End a bit and added a strong female figure wearing sexy clothes in the game, and in this very hotel that also contains the ugly parts of human history in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/edbef6e49b9bf324b8725f1accab9a24b9cc9828.jpg[/img]
This is not a princess that needs anyone's rescue.
There shall be more deep meanings beneath her nudity and sexuality as the story reveals in the future. 


Here is today's changelog:

The room on the left side of the Ardham hotel is now accessible. (It does not have a 1978 version for now)
Warning, potentially NSFW content inside.
It has 2 cutscenes containing nudity, a female player character can get into a sexual scenario (black screen + text), and there are lots of blood.
########System#######################

notes.title: DD#21 No Man's Voice-Acting
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=CcziUHxOYpU;full][/previewyoutube]

OK, it's time for another week's developer diary.
I will take over this one as your new tutorial narrator of the game. 
Just to be clear, I'm not even human. I have other roles in the game as well. But, let's don't spoil it just yet.

In addition to my voice being added to the game, there are a few things that you may want to check out.

First, we have the boombox as a usable item that appears in the game. You can use it to change the game's background music at any time to whatever you want.

Next, with the development of the True Detective side story, it's now interacting with the Unfinished Building side story with the blueprint of a quite useful item as a reward.

A few user-interface changes also took place. For example, the attribution-distribution screen has been rearranged, allowing the keyboard to finish all the operations.

Meanwhile, you no longer need to face certain enemies directly. You can deploy a booby trap and lure your enemies to step on it. They will no longer be a problem to you anymore.
However, as a side effect, I noticed some players are using it to blow up random citizens and cars in Liu. Well, it's up to you to use it creatively.

That's for this week. See you in the game.


#######################################################################
I let my AI do this week's developer's diary. 
I almost blasted a graphics card when training her. But, it's totally worth it.
We live in a strange time, a strange world. And you just found this strange game now having this kind of strange technology behind it. 

Something she didn't mention is, we also have a mystery drink called "Befuddled Life & Dead Dream" in the game now. Rumors are, it can help you forget all the unhappiness in your life if you keep drinking it. If it does exist in the world we live in. I'd like to order a few boxes.

This is the story of this week.

notes.title: DD #20 More Than Just a Game
notes.notes:
Welcome to another week's developer diary.

Everything went quite well on June 9. And I'm back to make more updates.

First, I'd like to thank moonrune for helping me improving the English localization texts of the game. Quite a lot of changes have been made to make everyone outside China can enjoy this game better.

Next, it's a boombox that can serve an independent music player even outside the game. It's a byproduct during game development. Basically, it can play out any mp3/ogg/wav/mid files normally or with their volume and pitch modified. That can easily make some Nightcore or Anti-Nightcore music.

[previewyoutube=vbH358emFAI;full][/previewyoutube]

The music is not included in the game. It's just used to demonstrate the functionalities.

I can't use copyrighted music in an officer trailer of the game. 
Thus, I picked Donald Trump's speech, which is in the public domain, for demonstration. Unfortunately, it seems to upset some people. I saw a few wishlist deletions in the US.
So, maybe I shall make it clear that...

Yes! I am a big Trump supporter! :)
OK, before some people want to stone me, they shall know I am also a Sanders supporter. :P

When I give support to LGBT people in China, some call me far-left.
When I tell people I like Trump's "Never Give Up" speech, some call me a trumpeter.
The truth is, I just like those people who are passionate, coming into the spotlight exposing their ideas without hiding who they really are. They are not some politician robots who just tell people whatever they want to hear.  As an indie game developer, I certainly prefer those "indie" candidates like Donald Trump and Bernie Sanders. I don't care much about the politics in the US as I am Chinese. I don't care if someone is left or right as I believe in "live and let live". 

So, let's see.
[previewyoutube=8Baq44CWV_E;full][/previewyoutube]
Here is the video, and we have a tool to do some audio manipulation.
If you like him, you may want to watch him from the beginning.
If you hate him, you can jump forward to 2:36 where the low-pitch version sounds like a demon.
It's just a tool that you can play with.

During the course of NEOLITHIC development. There were many other features that may sometimes not directly related to the gameplay. However, they are also included in the game code. They are the memory of our almost 17-year-long incomplete chronicle.
That includes but not limited to a code generator, a stock market trading tool, a cat language translator, a weather forecast system, and much more. Maybe some of them will revive into [Neolithic]TtE when destiny calls them to serve NEOLITHIC once again.

In NEOLITHIC, it's more than just a game. It may have strange features in this supernatural world.
Now, you may use it to make your own Nightcore music. Hopefully, it can bring you some additional entertainment.  :)

notes.title: DD#19 What Happened in 1995?
notes.notes:
Hello officer, today is June 5th, not another certain sensitive day.
This developer dairy is also talking about 1995, not another certain sensitive year.
Thus, please do not censor it. :P

OK, joke aside. Let's go back to the dairy.

First, I'm going to cover some short bad news.
I need to solve a real-life problem related to the legal business which is one of the major funding sources of this game on June 9th which is likely going to take a lot of effort.
Thus, the update will slow down till June 10th. That's all that is bad.

Now, let's move on.
When people talk about the horror/ghost/urban-legend stories in the east. It's quite common for people to think about Japan first. Fair enough. I just hope the developer of "World of Horror" can come back to make an update of his game soon. :)

But, there are also a large amount of such kind stories that took place in China. 
Even the government of China has banned all the animals from turning into monsters after 1949. 
(Seriously, there is a government regulation here. All animals are not allowed to turn into monsters after 1949. It's real!) 
Yet, we still got a lot of monsters in China. Especially in the year 1995. 

What happened in 1995?
A certain character of the game changed forever that year.
A case officially reported as solved is actually unsolved.
And...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/ae5b48d410d9c9220587b0b9065950a17ef4c000.jpg[/img]
At least 4 separate paranormal incidents all happened in different places of China in that year.
From Harbin to Chengdu, from Beijing to Shanghai, they are everywhere, featuring even some monsters not native to China as a side effect of Shanghai being a big international city. 
Shanghai, the occult capital of China.
Thus, this update features 5 story documents on an investigation board you can read during the side story of "True Detective". You can also find different versions of those stories on the Internet. Some versions may be scarier than others. 
Find their connections, link them together, become an occult detective in this story.
But, not every story has a good ending, especially in this game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/2e9caf71c4c07495ec6bbae1db75dc21e9b1677d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: DD#18 the Tea at 3pm and the People Who Lay Down
notes.notes:
Welcome to another week's developer diary.

This week we got some weird content added into the game.
A guy lays down in Liu, fighting his war by just laying down. 
Another guy appears every 3 pm, asking you to drink tea.

If you are not familiar with the current Internet culture in China, you may ask what's the story behind all that?
 
The tea at 3 pm is a shootout for many people that works so hard here. As you may once hear the story of 996 in China which I will call modern-day slavery, people are tired, burned out in endless overtime. And then, one day, they see a Singapore gentleman with an Indian look while he can speak good Cantonese telling everybody "stop working, drink tea first!" It's like people's desires are called out. It becomes a meme to fight against cruel company cultures of hard working. It becomes popular very fast thanks to the Internet even under censorship. People will quietly go to drink a cup of tea at 3 pm and look at their coworkers who do the same. It's like a secret sign among secret societies who are secretly fighting against all the things like 996 in a silent style.

The man lays down is a much more extreme way to show people's disobedience against the "normal" hardworking culture. People chose not to even participate in regular company jobs. They decide to work on their own. They may get less income. But, they also spend less. What's more important is that they can have the freedom that allows them to just simply lay down without doing any additional work. It's almost a luxury to those works for big tech companies nowadays. 

As Neolithic is a game about memories, as To the End is set in a modern-day world, as we are all standing at the frontline of the past history of the future, I believe those movements shall be remembered just like those past events that have been recorded in SAPC++. This is our history and memory.

It's a world that not only provides a stage for passionate big figures like Donald Trump and Bernie Sanders who desire to change the world in the way they believe in no matter what many others like or not. It's also a world for common people. To those who struggle against life every day, to those people who want to have an easy and normal life while fate simply denies them happiness, no matter how unremarkable they are, no matter how many times their humble jobs are looked down upon, they live with their own story. Everyone is the hero of their own life. (Except me and a certain character in the game, as he said "Don't picture me as a hero. This is personal.")

Thus, go drinking a cup of tea at 3 pm, lay down and forget about works sometimes. If you find others are doing the same. Maybe, you just find a comrade of this new movement.

Even if the meme, the movement dies down one day. 
Neolithic remembers and the evolution never stops.

Do you still remember the NPC who sings the song of people's struggle in Stone Age Online, 20 years ago? Stone Age Online is no more. But, I am doing the same in Neolithic.
Because I remember.

notes.title: DD#17 the Hope and the Delusion
notes.notes:
Welcome to another week's developer diary.

Because of some real-life problems, this week's update was not so frequent as before.
However, the side story of the "Unfinished Building" is almost close to an end.

In order not to spoil any story details, I'm going to just tell some other background stories related to it.

In the 1950s, a cruel experiment was taken on rats. They were thrown into water tanks to die. They will always struggle to keep their heads above water. But, their dismay is inevitable.
The difference is, some rats faced a similar situation but were rescued. Thus, they have hope to be rescued again. Those rats who have hope can struggle for days before they die while the others gave up within 15 minutes.

It's the famous drowning rats experiment which is also called the hope experiment.

Hopes hold such great power that can make people push their limits.
However, it can also be used to exploit them in some modern-day management doctrines. They are called incentives. 

Many people do not really like their jobs. They like what they will be rewarded from the jobs. They hope for that. Yet, such hope can be just delusions. A bonus, a promotion, an early retirement, sometimes, they never come. But, they keep people working hard to dream about them.

Moreover, it's also common for people to deny such delusion after they have put great effort into it. Even when they somehow realize it, they chose not to believe what they have been fighting so hard for is a mere delusion. It's sometimes just so horrible to even think about it. 

It's just like if you were the rats that struggled for days in the water tanks, waiting for rescues. Will it be dreadful for you to even think the help may never come?  Unfortunately, in that experiment, the help did never come.

However, sometimes, hope, even a delusive one, a white lie, is all that keep people alive in depression.
Ignorance can be bliss. It may even for a greater good this time.
What will you choose to solve this case?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/76f6b23ac159f5a94fe7d0da8534aca52030b40f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: DD#16 The Art of Uniqueness
notes.notes:
Welcome to another week's developer diary.

First, let's address an issue many have about this game.
That is the mixing of 3D and 2D arts in this game. Some love it. Others do not.
So, what's the solution to find a common ground to solve this issue?
Here comes a cartoon filter.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b0b1772d0aff19b8ded989cac3e541f4b23db5a7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/b9521ecfc15a434998077122a19d9f5eae85a1a3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/fb0bc7852298c9e6c7b4a8ba2d47fd08951c209e.jpg[/img]
The goal is to fuse the 2 very different types of arts into 1 style.
With a toon shader, it may be achievable. 
However, the ancient RMXP engine does not have shader at all. And the RGD is not effective enough to handle the task in real-time. Thus, the art assets must be rendered offline.
Thus, technically, I am making a different game version.
But, thanks to Steam's "Beta Branch" feature. You can pick the art style which more suitable for your taste here:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/e42858835b4129ee96d26345ecdd6aa57f9aa9df.jpg[/img]
I'm not a believer in "class struggle". I'd prefer "live and let live". Thus, different art-style branches shall co-exist in this game, leaving the choice to you, the players.

In conclusion, we now have 1 game coming with 2 art styles. It is also moddable when we get the Steam workshop integrated into the game later.

I also watched some videos of this game that people post, literally frame to frame to study the player-behaviors of non-Chinese players. I found quite a few very useful suggestions and constructive criticisms. 
Thus, the priority shifted a bit to first address those indirect feedbacks.
Such as:
1, Quite a few English localization problems fix.
2, Added water into toilets.
3, Put a toilet in a sanitary area into a secret room with a door.
4, Fix a crash caused by the money window.
...
Things can be small or big. But, whatever can make this game better I'm always listening.
All you need to do is just to let me know. Maybe it will make the game more enjoyable to you in return.

Some may call this game wacky, some may call it a trip.
But, that's exactly my plan for this game.
It's a unique experience in a supernatural world while the "normal" is merely a facet.
After all, I don't know if any other game's demos that use Steam's beta branches to deliver different art-style versions. But, this game is unique as it is in the last 16 years, being the last RMXP game that still receives frequent updates right now. 
[b]Welcome to the cult.[/b] :)

I also would like to shout out my special thanks to a post on Keylol that brought a relatively tremendous number of wishlists from China/Russia/Argentine/Hong Kong/Taiwan and a significant number of demo download/playtime.
Although I didn't intend to do any serious marketing till the game is close to early access. (Maybe I will not even do that at all. Because it's still pre-early access), it is a great morale boost.
THANK YOU!

Without any localization problems that non-Chinese players may suffer from and less cultural difference to help understand the game better, I find people can enjoy this game much better. The current demo average playtime is 1.5 hours (even with 50% of players who only play the game for less than 10 minutes to keep dragging this number back.). And we also just had 2 players who reached 10 hours of playtime according to Steam data. 

I certainly hope non-Chinese players can also enjoy this game that much. However, it may take a lot more effort to achieve. For that, I'm sorry. But, at the very least, I will try.
 
Even it may likely be a futile effort. But, well,  it can hardly be even more unappreciated than using an ancient game engine to make a game for all the old memories. 

This is a unique game that is against the tide.

notes.title: DD#15 When the Real Estate Taking Everyone Hostage
notes.notes:
Welcome to another week's developer diary.

A new store opened somewhere in the Ancient Stone Bridge area. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/e413c9355a93178a7d99a9eb30df70469e591d5c.jpg[/img]
(That's our current most fluffy weapon vendor.)

There is also an NPC in that store that is in memory of a great actor of Hong Kong who passed in February. Not everyone can be the main character of the story. But, he was among the best supporting actors in our era.  The inventory in his store also has reference to the movies that he was involved in.

But, the most important update of this week is the story of that "Unfinished Building".
In order not to spoil the story, I'm just going to tell the behind scene story of mortgage slaves(房奴) in China. 

You may be surprised to know that the real estate price in all major cities in China has increased ridiculously high in the last 30 years. They are lots of economical reasons, such as economic development, regulation on very tight control of currency exchange, and...many are just actively holding real estate assets like stocks (instead of using them to live).

Anyway, here we are, an apartment (not even a house) in Shanghai may worth 1.5 million dollars while only about 0.05% of the population have a monthly salary of more than 3k dollars. 
That basically means even a person, who is among the top 0.05%, needs to spend more than 41 years to own an apartment (without spending any money on life.)

What makes it worse is, the price is still rising! 
So, let's think about it. If you have an asset whose value just keeps rising and is rising fast, will you even consider selling it? No. Maybe you will want to buy more for investment purposes.

On the other hand, when young people are all under such a burden of a mortgage, their overall life quality dramatically reduces. They need to work overtime, find part-time jobs, with little time to spend with family. And for the first time in history, the population of China is going to decrease. That's going to hurt the economy badly. But, nobody can do anything, everyone from common fellows to the government can hardly do anything to stop this. The real estate price has taken everyone hostage.

Let's hope I'm wrong. After all, I'm just a game developer. Not a really successful expert on the economy.

But, that is the story behind the Unfinished Building.
People are still working day and night, struggling to try to win this hopeless race against the rising real estate price. On the other hand, the rich have their own agendas.  Meanwhile, the mystery antagonist also has his own plan "for the greater good".

This story will continue next week.

notes.title: Public Beta Version 20210504
notes.notes:
English
####The Admin Privilege Problem############
The game will try to restart itself and request admin privileges if the system somehow stops the game from writing data. (It happens if the game is installed into a system folder such as "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common")
All the details will still appear in the error message. (I want you to know all the details about why the game requests admin privileges. You may also decide to not grant such privileges if you don't trust me. >.<)
The game will not automatically request admin privileges by default. As I consider that's just a terrible practice done by many others. So, everything is still up to you.
It may not be the best solution as people who are affected by this problem will still see 3 error messages pop up every time the game starts. But, it is a solution. Meanwhile, I do not want to do anything like any shady software(*cough* Tencent *cough*) to sneak in to "help you" to set up the admin privileges. That's just wrong.
I'd still recommend installing the game somewhere that is not in the system folders. (But, unfortunately, that's the default folder of steam to many people.)
########Content#######################
Added some big wood boxes on the 3rd floor of the "Unfinished Building" (Just there for collision testing.)
########System########################
Changed in-game generic popup window to be customizable in size
Modified in-game generic popup window so that it can be run even before the game is fully initialized.
Changed admin privileges error popup to use the in-game popup window instead of system popup so that the flow does not get interrupted for players who are using gamepads.
Set up some generic collison box templates.
简体中文
#######系统权限问题#########
游戏现在会在发现系统阻止其写入数据时自动尝试重启并要求管理员权限运行。（一般这种情况发生在游戏被安装到一个系统文件夹时，比如 "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common"）
所有关于这个问题的报错信息仍然会被显示。（我希望你能够直到为什么游戏在要求管理员权限，最后由你决定是否给它这个权限，并且你也可以完全不给权限，如果你不相信我的话。 >.<）
游戏不会自动在一开始就获取管理员权限。因为，我觉得这种事情只有腾讯或者360才干得出来。所以，你的系统上的所有东西仍然由你自己做主。
这可能不是最好的方案，受影响的人民群众仍然会每次遇到3个报错窗口。 但是这依然是一个解决方案。 同时，我并不打算像某些软件那样偷偷摸摸地跑去“帮助”你把程序强行设置到管理员权限上。那完全是不讲武德的做法。
我仍然会推荐不要把游戏安装到系统目录中。（但是，貌似这是Steam 安装游戏的默认路径。）

notes.title: DD#14 A Failure Called "International Workers' Day"
notes.notes:
Hello, welcome to this week's recap.
It's International Workers' Day. More than a hundred years ago, people fought for 8-hour days so that many people can have a relatively easier life today. [b]However, I'm going to tell you they failed.[/b]

Working overtime, crunching is pretty much everywhere in the world in almost all industrials.
You think working from 9 am to 9 pm 6 days a week(which is called 996 in China) is bad? 
Check out those people who work 7 days a week.
I was once among those people. I tried to build up a no overtime culture in one of my start-ups. But, I failed and the company died. Ultimately, It's the involution that forces people to compete crunching hours. It's a situation everyone loses.

Those projects may be great just like the Great Wall. But, those who work on it are mostly slaves. What was once in their body shells are long dead. Their passions burned out. They will not be able to admire that "Great Work". (That's if the project will even be finished one day.)

Thus, I make this game alone. Even if there is going to be crunching. I shall do it alone. No other souls shall suffer.

Now, let's go back to the game. 
I got the most parts of the 3rd floor of the "Unfinished Building" finished this week.
You can find those guys:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/ff2967a1e83e9f3b4df2510b538ad2333331c87b.jpg[/img]
(Do you think they really love their job?)

There are documents and emails that you can find in this building, telling the stories about what happened in this building. Some people were turned, some people died. Deep down in projects like those, things are always ugly. No matter which industry, people are working in. Such things just repeat again and again.  It becomes a system, a culture, an idea that affects everyone.

But, that's just a part of the story. The 4th floor is still in development. 
Hopefully, I can tell you more next week.
Stay safe, and try not to be turned into this guy:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/7b9179f5ee6d7ecc8d2475d8541d83a07ded91ce.png[/img]

Meanwhile in China, because of some terrible labor-day-holiday arrangements plus the 996 system, many people have been working for 14 days with no stop. This is real life. 
It is even crueler than the game. 

Here is today's changelog:

notes.title: DD #13 the Traffic, Collision System Rework and Another Story
notes.notes:
Once again, it's time for NEOLITHIC's weekly developer dairy and recap.
From this week on, I'm going to put it in a news hub update instead of just a post in the Steam forum discussion so that I can put some graphics here.

Let me try...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/2de1ea95b2d292ab4397f08d8a164edc64f6397e.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/2cde5ef0ed8d10ddf4d2af77edce53233e3ec76e.gif[/img]
It seems working. That is the Arab Male character I added this week. Another effort to allow more diversity in the game. 

Now, let's go back to the topic of this week's development.
First, we got cars running in Liu now. I will feel bad if we have a city but without cars. 
Here is a video showing how it looks like:  (Guest starring, the monks from last week.)
https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV16V411J7iT

To make the cars work correctly, the collision system from SAPC++ has been porting into this game with quite a few improvements. Such as:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/a45eb419669008e09202e9070f0345fa25865f10.jpg[/img]
Right, those cars on the street can even hit people like some environmental hazards! (Based on the number of people killed by traffic accidences every year, maybe they are environmental hazards.) 
However, after test it a bit. I found it's not fun. I don't think people will like to be hit by random cars on the street. 
As a result,  I did 2 things after the initial collision test.
First, I removed the damage from cars.
Second, I taught AI drivers to know when they shall use the brake instead of just run over people! 
Finally, we get the result like the one in the video.
(Meanwhile, I heard Tesla is having some trouble in China with their cars' braking system. Hopefully, they will be OK in the end. After all, I have a small tiny amount of their stock, I am their shareholder.)

The collision rework may potentially allow me to do something more interesting in the future.
For now, you can start to drop that big fountains on enemies to block them :P

In addition to the traffic and collision, I think it has been a while that I didn't add non-procedurally generated story content.
Thus, I am heading to that "Unfinished Building" that appeared in the tutorial. 
The 3rd floor is now accessible (after the tutorial.)
Something may happen there soon. (Hopefully, I can make all the art assets I need on time. But, I am terrible at art.)

In today's update, you may find some crazed construction workers there already.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/7b9179f5ee6d7ecc8d2475d8541d83a07ded91ce.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/8a43f8ccfaaa7c03f1906f0856ef3e5b597a350b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39774670/d6b5ff3bad7de5206a09394ae728d154b831933c.gif[/img]

Hopefully, I can tell you what happened there next week.
But, I am also working on a case right now as a person of law. That may cause some delay of the game development, I will try to make some work/work balance and hope that works out while I can still have some fun. :P

See you next week in Neolithic's Weekly Recap... or much earlier, as the update is still on an almost daily basis. :D

notes.title: The Public Beta Is Here!
notes.notes:
It's Mar.31, 2021 (Local time.)
It is the day when official supports for all the old RPG Maker engines(RMVXA RMVX RMXP RM2003 RM2000) is dropped. 
But, this is also the day [NEOLITHIC]TtE goes public beta (Demo)!
The game shall carry on the memories of those who have fallen or about to fall.

Behind us, it's a 16-year long incomplete chronicle.
Ahead of us, it's a brave new world.

As long as I stand, the world will never fall.
That's it. Feel free to enjoy the game.
I shall welcome all your feedback.

(It may take a while for the download button to show up on the store page.)

notes.title: Version 20210311 Update Delay (Major Infrastructure Incident)
notes.notes:
I announce this news under NEOLITHIC's transparency policy.

One of the VPNs I'm using for game development is currently offline due to "a major datacenter fire incident." Hopefully, they will get back soon.

Details: It seems someone or something set up a fire in Strasbourg, France ːsteamfacepalmː
http://travaux.ovh.net/?do=details&id=49471

In China, VPN is a necessity for communication across the Great Firewall.
Without a VPN, even the Steam community website can't open.
It mostly impacts game files to be uploaded to Steam.
And I may not be able to access the Steam forum in the meantime.

Thus, the regular daily update may need to pause today.
I will take the chance to have some fresh air.

But, don't worry. I always have a backup plan.

notes.title: DD#5 This is Our Final Crusade. (3rd Week Recap)
notes.notes:
This week, the Templar trailer is up.
The "House" DLC from SAPC++ is fully integrated into this game.
Thus, we can have an in-game map editor and customize a pocket dimension. Import and export are included for possible future steam workshop integration.
The town of Liu gets an expansion with 3D printing(item craft) and some monsters lurking beneath its "normal" facet. 
We even have the Holy Hand Grenade in the game, now.

However, not everything this week is good news.
I just received news that all the official support to RPG MAKER XP, RPG MAKER VXA, RPG MAKER VX, and RPG MAKER 2000 will cease to exist on Mar.31, 2021.
It appears this game is going to bear more memories than expected.

After all...why am I here to begin with?
Comparing to a commercial game, this is more like a memento to the old golden age of RPG Maker XP (when indie games are really indie; when updates are free instead of being paid DLCs; when developers update games for years, even decades instead of abandon projects as soon as it's no longer profitable; when games are made with passion instead of money-hunger; And...when RPG Maker was not used to just make those cheap adult-only games.)
This is NEOLITHIC!
There are many games out there, made with modern tools and more than 1 developer. They are supposed to be better than mine.
But, they are not. Why?

If I am to be the last developer using all those ancient RPG Maker tools, then so be it.
If their official supports are going to end, they will still live with this game.
Let this game be the final crusade of all those RPG MAKERs in addition to all the memories the game already bears.

notes.title: DD#3 First Week Recap + Closed Beta Version 20210212
notes.notes:
This is the first week that our game lands on steam.
A bit bumpy especially we got 25 anti-virus software screaming "malware" to us.
The good news is, it has been addressed. There are only 4 of them remain according to virustotal. 

Even it's just the first week, a lot of progress has been made thanks to your kind feedback.
The game updated on a daily basis.
We have improved the start part of the game, balanced the difficulty, added new solutions and outcomes of missions. New systems from the NEOLITHIC homeland also keep coming into this Steam colony.  

We already have something that no other games on Steam ever have. However, the best is yet to come.
The engine is old, the functions are restricted.
But, as long as we stand, this world will never fall.
And...Happy Chinese New Year!
The dragon is lurking behind the veil.
Unfortunately, the Chinese New Year may get me trapped in some social events which may delay me a bit which I will try to reduce its impact.

这是我们抵达STEAM首周。
开局有点颠簸，特别是我们直接收到了25个杀毒软件的报毒。
不过这个问题已经基本被解决了，目前还剩4个没有修正他们的误报。

尽管这只是第一周，但是大量的进展已经被达成。感谢大量的反馈和建议。
这个游戏在这周基本保持着每日更新的状态。
我们改善了游戏的开局部分，平衡了难度，增加了新的解决方案和任务结果。新的系统也在陆续从NEOLITHIC本土被陆续搬运到这片崭新的STEAM殖民地上。

我们已经拥有了其它STEAM上的游戏从未拥有的一些功能。然而，最好的时代还在来临。好戏还在后面。
这个引擎是古老的，功能是有限的。
但是，只要我们仍然屹立，这个世界便不会倒下。
顺便...恭贺大家中国新年快乐！
龍组正在帷幕之后潜伏。
不过，由于中国新年的原因，我可能要参加一些无聊的社交活动，这将可能会造成开发的一定延迟。不过我会降低其影响。

notes.title: DD #1 Address Feedback
notes.notes:
Other than the anti-virus software shenanigan, I received some very good feedback yesterday, thanks!
So, I think it's a good time to work on address them right now.
An update is up just a few minutes ago.

######Content#################
Add Defibrillator into the game to revive fallen teammates.
######System##################
Add total mines and unmarked mine number in mine swapping mini-game(7.ti's suggestion)
I'm now using a recursion algorithm to reveal a large safe area if click on a zero in mine swapping game(7.ti's suggestion)
Mine swapping tiles are moved 64 pixels lower to accomandate with the new UI
Add mouse support to Save/Load menu. Personally, I still prefer the keyboard. You can always turn the mouse on/off with the hotkey: M (IamI's suggestion)
Reduce the price of Plastic Explosives.
The Player character will try to turn in to the mouse's direction and interact with nearby NPC if said NPC is clicked. (Previously, Player character will only try to interactive with NPC they are directly facing.) (IamI's suggestion)
When existing equipment menu, it shall return to the exact previous menu so that massive change equipment of teammates will be easier.(天狼星1110's suggestion)
######Debug###################
Fix some issues in the church map. You are not supposed to climb on the roof. :) （天狼星1110's bug report）
Also, you are not supposed to climb on those brooms either >.< (Maybe I will enable it again later.) （天狼星1110's bug report）
简体中文
######内容#################
加入急救电击器，用于复活队友
######系统改进################
在扫雷中加入地雷总数和未标记地雷的显示（7.ti的建议）
当点击到一个周围有0个地雷的格子，现在会使用了递归算法来显示一个较大的周围区域。(7.ti's suggestion)
扫雷游戏的格子全部下移64个像素，以适应新增的UI窗口
加入鼠标对于读档存档界面的支持（熊猫的建议）
降低塑胶炸弹的价格
在鼠标点击附近的NPC时，现在玩家角色将会自动转向并与身边的NPC交互（熊猫的建议）
当从装备界面返回时，现在将会准确返回到进入前的界面，从而方便批量给角色配置装备（天狼星1110的建议）
######DEBUG#################
修正教堂可以爬上房顶的BUG （天狼星1110发现的BUG）
修正可以爬上扫帚的BUG（天狼星1110发现的BUG）
